```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEvents;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketListenerAbstract;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketListenerPriority;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketSendEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.manager.server.ServerVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.User;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.Column;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.states.WrappedBlockState;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.util.Vector3i;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerBlockAction;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerBlockBreakAnimation;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerBlockChange;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerBlockEntityData;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerChunkData;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerEffect;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerExplosion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerParticle;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSoundEffect;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnExperienceOrb;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnLivingEntity;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnPainting;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnPlayer;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerUnloadChunk;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerUpdateLight;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask.TerrainChunkPayload;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask.TerrainLightSanitizer;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask.TerrainMaskPacketGateway;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask.TerrainMaskPositionPolicy;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask.TerrainMaskService;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

/** Outgoing per-recipient terrain and positional-effect transformations for PacketEvents 2.14.0.
 *
 * <p>Wrappers built from a send event are already decoded by their constructor; calling
 * {@code read()} again would re-read the exhausted buffer and fail. Every handler below
 * therefore uses the event-constructed wrapper directly. */
public final class TerrainMaskPacketListener extends PacketListenerAbstract implements TerrainMaskPacketGateway {
    private final TerrainMaskService service;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Integer> stateIds = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<ClientVersion, Set<Integer>> airStateIds = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private volatile boolean preflightComplete;

    public TerrainMaskPacketListener(TerrainMaskService service, Logger logger) {
        super(PacketListenerPriority.HIGHEST);
        this.service = service;
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    /** Must run after PacketEvents initialized, before registering the listener. */
    public String preflight() {
        try {
            var api = PacketEvents.getAPI();
            if (api == null || !api.isInitialized()) return failPreflight("PacketEvents API is not initialized");
            if (api.getServerManager().getVersion() != ServerVersion.V_1_21_11) {
                return failPreflight("PacketEvents reports server version " + api.getServerManager().getVersion()
                        + "; expected V_1_21_11");
            }
            WrappedBlockState.ensureLoad();
            resolveState(ClientVersion.V_1_21_11, "AIR");
            for (var rule : service.config().worlds().values()) {
                if (!rule.enabled()) continue;
                if (!rule.fakeBlock().isBlock() || !rule.fakeBlock().isSolid() || rule.fakeBlock().isAir()) {
                    return failPreflight("fake-block must be a solid non-air block: " + rule.fakeBlock());
                }
                Integer fake = resolveState(ClientVersion.V_1_21_11, rule.fakeBlock().name());
                if (fake == null || fake.equals(resolveState(ClientVersion.V_1_21_11, "AIR"))) {
                    return failPreflight("PacketEvents cannot map fake-block " + rule.fakeBlock()
                            + " for client protocol 1.21.11");
                }
            }
            preflightComplete = true;
            return "PacketEvents 2.14.0 / Paper 1.21.11 chunk rewrite preflight passed; "
                    + "entity vision active";
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            return failPreflight(failure.getClass().getSimpleName() + ": " + failure.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private String failPreflight(String reason) {
        preflightComplete = false;
        return reason;
    }

    @Override
    public String detail() {
        return preflightComplete ? "READY (chunk rewrite + entity vision preflight passed)"
                : "ERROR: preflight not passed";
    }

    @Override
    public void onPacketSend(PacketSendEvent event) {
        if (event == null || event.getPacketType() == null || !service.isEnabled()) return;
        try {
            User user = event.getUser();
            UUID playerId = user == null ? null : user.getUUID();
            if (playerId == null) {
                if (event.getPacketType() == PacketType.Play.Server.CHUNK_DATA) {
                    suppressAndFail(event, "chunk packet has no authenticated recipient", null);
                }
                return;
            }
            service.packetUser(playerId, user);
            Object connection = service.connection(playerId);
            TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view = service.view(connection);
            if (view == null) {
                if (isSensitive(event.getPacketType())) {
                    suppressAndFail(event, "no cached player/world state for " + playerId, null);
                }
                return;
            }
            if (!view.configured() || view.exempt()) return;

            PacketTypeCommon type = event.getPacketType();
            if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.CHUNK_DATA) {
                handleChunk(event, user, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.UNLOAD_CHUNK) {
                WrapperPlayServerUnloadChunk packet = new WrapperPlayServerUnloadChunk(event);
                service.unloadChunk(playerId, chunkKey(packet.getChunkX(), packet.getChunkZ()));
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_CHANGE) {
                handleBlockChange(event, playerId, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.MULTI_BLOCK_CHANGE) {
                handleMultiBlockChange(event, playerId, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_ENTITY_DATA) {
                handleBlockEntity(event, playerId, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.UPDATE_LIGHT) {
                handleLight(event, playerId, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_ACTION) {
                handleBlockAction(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_BREAK_ANIMATION) {
                handleBlockBreak(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.EFFECT) {
                handleEffect(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.PARTICLE) {
                handleParticle(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SOUND_EFFECT
                    || type == PacketType.Play.Server.NAMED_SOUND_EFFECT) {
                handleSound(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_SOUND_EFFECT) {
                // The packet identifies an entity, not its position. Concealed entities stay
                // hidden through the visibility API, and suppressing this recipient's
                // potentially underground sound here errs toward confidentiality.
                if (view.masked()) event.setCancelled(true);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY
                    || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_LIVING_ENTITY
                    || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PLAYER
                    || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PAINTING
                    || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_EXPERIENCE_ORB) {
                handleEntitySpawn(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.EXPLOSION) {
                handleExplosion(event, view);
            } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SCULK_VIBRATION_SIGNAL) {
                // The packet contains a positional vibration destination and may expose an
                // underground source. Suppressing this packet is safer than guessing its codec.
                if (view.masked()) event.setCancelled(true);
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            if (isSensitive(event.getPacketType())) {
                suppressAndFail(event, "unhandled outgoing " + event.getPacketName(), failure);
            } else {
                service.noteRewriteFailure("unexpected packet callback failure " + event.getPacketName(), failure);
            }
        }
    }

    private void handleChunk(PacketSendEvent event, User user, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerChunkData packet = new WrapperPlayServerChunkData(event);
        Column source = packet.getColumn();
        if (source == null || source.getChunks() == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("decoded chunk column or sections are absent");
        }
        int expectedSections = (view.maxWorldY() - view.minWorldY()) >> 4;
        if (expectedSections <= 0 || source.getChunks().length != expectedSections) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unexpected section count=" + source.getChunks().length
                    + " expected=" + expectedSections);
        }
        var light = packet.getLightData();
        if (light == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("chunk packet omitted required light data");
        TerrainChunkPayload snapshot = new TerrainChunkPayload(source, light);
        if (!service.cacheChunkIfAvailable(view.playerId(), chunkKey(source.getX(), source.getZ()), snapshot)) {
            suppressAndFail(event, "real chunk snapshot capacity reached; refusing uncached chunk", null);
            return;
        }
        if (!view.masked()) return;

        int fakeId = requireStateId(event.getClientVersion(), view.fakeBlock());
        Set<Integer> airIds = airStateIds(event.getClientVersion());
        TerrainChunkPayload.RenderedChunk rendered = snapshot.render(view, event.getClientVersion(), fakeId, airIds);
        packet.setColumn(rendered.column());
        packet.setLightData(rendered.lightData());
        publish(event, packet);
        service.noteMaskedChunk();
    }

    private void handleBlockChange(PacketSendEvent event, UUID playerId, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerBlockChange packet = new WrapperPlayServerBlockChange(event);
        Vector3i position = packet.getBlockPosition();
        int realState = packet.getBlockState().getGlobalId();
        cacheBlock(playerId, view, position.getX(), position.getY(), position.getZ(), realState,
                event.getClientVersion());
        if (!view.masked() || position.getY() >= view.hideBelowY()) return;
        packet.setBlockState(state(event.getClientVersion(), view.fakeBlock()));
        publish(event, packet);
        service.noteBlockUpdateRewritten();
    }

    private void handleMultiBlockChange(PacketSendEvent event, UUID playerId, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange packet = new WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange(event);
        Vector3i sectionPosition = packet.getChunkPosition();
        var blocks = packet.getBlocks();
        if (blocks == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("multi-block change has no block array");
        List<WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange.EncodedBlock> changed = new ArrayList<>(blocks.length);
        boolean rewritten = false;
        int fakeId = view.masked() ? requireStateId(event.getClientVersion(), view.fakeBlock()) : 0;
        for (var block : blocks) {
            if (block == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null encoded block in multi-block update");
            int x = (sectionPosition.getX() << 4) + block.getX();
            int y = (sectionPosition.getY() << 4) + block.getY();
            int z = (sectionPosition.getZ() << 4) + block.getZ();
            int realState = block.getBlockState(event.getClientVersion()).getGlobalId();
            cacheBlock(playerId, view, x, y, z, realState, event.getClientVersion());
            if (view.masked() && y < view.hideBelowY()) {
                changed.add(new WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange.EncodedBlock(fakeId,
                        block.getX(), block.getY(), block.getZ()));
                rewritten = true;
            } else {
                changed.add(new WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange.EncodedBlock(block.getBlockId(),
                        block.getX(), block.getY(), block.getZ()));
            }
        }
        if (!rewritten) return;
        packet.setBlocks(changed.toArray(WrapperPlayServerMultiBlockChange.EncodedBlock[]::new));
        publish(event, packet);
        service.noteBlockUpdateRewritten();
    }

    private void handleBlockEntity(PacketSendEvent event, UUID playerId, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerBlockEntityData packet = new WrapperPlayServerBlockEntityData(event);
        Vector3i position = packet.getPosition();
        Object payload = service.cachedChunk(playerId, chunkKey(position.getX() >> 4, position.getZ() >> 4));
        if (payload instanceof TerrainChunkPayload chunk) {
            chunk.recordBlockEntity(new TerrainChunkPayload.BlockEntityUpdate(position.getX(), position.getY(),
                    position.getZ(), packet.getType(), packet.getNBT()));
        }
        if (view.masked() && view.hideBlockEntities() && position.getY() < view.hideBelowY()) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    private void handleLight(PacketSendEvent event, UUID playerId, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerUpdateLight packet = new WrapperPlayServerUpdateLight(event);
        var light = packet.getLightData();
        if (light == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("standalone light update has no light data");
        Object payload = service.cachedChunk(playerId, chunkKey(packet.getX(), packet.getZ()));
        if (payload instanceof TerrainChunkPayload chunk) chunk.updateLight(light);
        if (!view.masked()) return;
        packet.setLightData(TerrainLightSanitizer.sanitize(light, view.minWorldY(), view.hideBelowY()));
        publish(event, packet);
    }

    private void handleBlockAction(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerBlockAction packet = new WrapperPlayServerBlockAction(event);
        if (view.masked() && packet.getBlockPosition().getY() < view.hideBelowY()) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    private void handleBlockBreak(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerBlockBreakAnimation packet = new WrapperPlayServerBlockBreakAnimation(event);
        if (view.masked() && packet.getBlockPosition().getY() < view.hideBelowY()) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    private void handleEffect(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerEffect packet = new WrapperPlayServerEffect(event);
        if (view.masked() && packet.getPosition().getY() < view.hideBelowY()) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    private void handleParticle(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerParticle packet = new WrapperPlayServerParticle(event);
        if (!view.masked()) return;
        double lowY = packet.getPosition().getY() - Math.abs(packet.getOffset().getY());
        if (lowY < view.hideBelowY()) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    private void handleSound(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerSoundEffect packet = new WrapperPlayServerSoundEffect(event);
        if (view.masked() && packet.getPosition().getY() < view.hideBelowY()) event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    private void handleExplosion(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        WrapperPlayServerExplosion packet = new WrapperPlayServerExplosion(event);
        if (!view.masked()) return;
        if (TerrainMaskPositionPolicy.explosionMayAffectHiddenTerrain(packet.getPosition().getY(),
                packet.getStrength(), view.hideBelowY())) {
            event.setCancelled(true);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Count-only observation of underground spawns per recipient state. Suppression happens
     * server-side through the visibility API; this path never modifies or cancels entity
     * packets, so a decode problem here can neither desync nor leak. Failures are counted
     * separately and never flip the pipeline status.
     */
    private void handleEntitySpawn(PacketSendEvent event, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        if (!view.hideUndergroundEntities()) return;
        try {
            if (spawnPositionY(event) < view.hideBelowY()) {
                service.noteEntitySpawnObserved(view.masked());
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            service.noteEntityFailure("entity spawn observation failed " + event.getPacketName(), failure);
        }
    }

    private static double spawnPositionY(PacketSendEvent event) {
        PacketTypeCommon type = event.getPacketType();
        if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY) {
            return new WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity(event).getPosition().getY();
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_LIVING_ENTITY) {
            return new WrapperPlayServerSpawnLivingEntity(event).getPosition().getY();
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PLAYER) {
            return new WrapperPlayServerSpawnPlayer(event).getPosition().getY();
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_PAINTING) {
            return new WrapperPlayServerSpawnPainting(event).getPosition().getY();
        } else if (type == PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_EXPERIENCE_ORB) {
            return new WrapperPlayServerSpawnExperienceOrb(event).getY();
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported spawn packet " + event.getPacketName());
    }

    private void cacheBlock(UUID playerId, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view,
                            int x, int y, int z, int realStateId, ClientVersion clientVersion) {
        Object payload = service.cachedChunk(playerId, chunkKey(x >> 4, z >> 4));
        if (payload instanceof TerrainChunkPayload chunk) {
            chunk.updateBlock(x, y, z, realStateId, airStateIds(clientVersion), view.minWorldY());
        }
    }

    @Override
    public boolean sendCachedChunk(Object packetUser, Object cachedChunk, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        if (!(packetUser instanceof User user) || !(cachedChunk instanceof TerrainChunkPayload payload) || view == null) {
            return false;
        }
        if (!preflightComplete) return false;
        try {
            ClientVersion clientVersion = user.getClientVersion();
            int fakeId = view.masked() ? requireStateId(clientVersion, view.fakeBlock()) : 0;
            Set<Integer> airIds = airStateIds(clientVersion);
            TerrainChunkPayload.RenderedChunk rendered = payload.render(view, clientVersion, fakeId, airIds);
            if (rendered.lightData() == null) return false;
            // Silent sends avoid routing this already-rendered snapshot back through this listener,
            // which would otherwise cache the masked copy as the real source for later transitions.
            user.sendPacketSilently(new WrapperPlayServerChunkData(rendered.column(), rendered.lightData()));
            for (TerrainChunkPayload.BlockEntityUpdate update : rendered.blockEntityUpdates()) {
                user.sendPacketSilently(new WrapperPlayServerBlockEntityData(new Vector3i(update.x(), update.y(), update.z()),
                        update.type(), update.nbt()));
            }
            return true;
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            logger.warning("Terrain mask could not enqueue cached chunk for " + view.playerId() + ": "
                    + failure.getClass().getSimpleName());
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void publish(PacketSendEvent event, com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.PacketWrapper<?> packet) {
        event.setLastUsedWrapper(packet);
        event.markForReEncode(true);
    }

    private void suppressAndFail(PacketSendEvent event, String message, Throwable failure) {
        event.setCancelled(true);
        service.noteRewriteFailure(message, failure);
    }

    private static boolean isSensitive(PacketTypeCommon type) {
        return type == PacketType.Play.Server.CHUNK_DATA
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_CHANGE
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.MULTI_BLOCK_CHANGE
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_ENTITY_DATA
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.UPDATE_LIGHT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_ACTION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_BREAK_ANIMATION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.EFFECT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.PARTICLE
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SOUND_EFFECT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.NAMED_SOUND_EFFECT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.ENTITY_SOUND_EFFECT
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.EXPLOSION
                || type == PacketType.Play.Server.SCULK_VIBRATION_SIGNAL;
    }

    private WrappedBlockState state(ClientVersion version, String material) {
        return TerrainMaskStateResolver.resolve(version, material);
    }

    private int requireStateId(ClientVersion version, String material) {
        Integer value = resolveState(version, material);
        if (value == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unmapped block state " + material + " for " + version);
        return value;
    }

    private Set<Integer> airStateIds(ClientVersion version) {
        return airStateIds.computeIfAbsent(version, clientVersion -> {
            int air = requireStateId(clientVersion, "AIR");
            int caveAir = optionalAirStateId(clientVersion, "CAVE_AIR", air);
            int voidAir = optionalAirStateId(clientVersion, "VOID_AIR", air);
            return Set.copyOf(List.of(air, caveAir, voidAir));
        });
    }

    private int optionalAirStateId(ClientVersion version, String material, int fallback) {
        try {
            return requireStateId(version, material);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException unsupported) {
            // Older client protocols have one canonical air state; PacketEvents may not expose
            // the post-1.13 aliases for them.
            return fallback;
        }
    }

    private Integer resolveState(ClientVersion version, String material) {
        String normalized = material.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return stateIds.computeIfAbsent(version.name() + ':' + normalized,
                ignored -> state(version, material).getGlobalId());
    }

    private static long chunkKey(int chunkX, int chunkZ) {
        return ((long) chunkX << 32) ^ (chunkZ & 0xffffffffL);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/platform/paper/TerrainMaskStateResolver.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.states.WrappedBlockState;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.states.type.StateType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.states.type.StateTypes;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.resources.ResourceLocation;

import java.util.Locale;

/** Resolves a material to a validated default state in the recipient's protocol registry. */
final class TerrainMaskStateResolver {
    private TerrainMaskStateResolver() { }

    static WrappedBlockState resolve(ClientVersion version, String material) {
        String name = material.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        WrappedBlockState byName = WrappedBlockState.getByString(version, "minecraft:" + name);
        if (hasExpectedType(byName, name)) return byName;

        // getByString may return AIR for an unknown key; validate the registered type explicitly.
        StateType type = StateTypes.getByName(ResourceLocation.minecraft(name));
        if (type != null) {
            WrappedBlockState defaultState = WrappedBlockState.getDefaultState(version, type);
            if (hasExpectedType(defaultState, name)) return defaultState;
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported block state " + material + " for " + version);
    }

    private static boolean hasExpectedType(WrappedBlockState state, String material) {
        if (state == null || state.getType() == null) return false;
        String resolvedName = state.getType().getName();
        if (resolvedName == null) return false;
        String normalized = resolvedName.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (normalized.startsWith("minecraft:")) normalized = normalized.substring("minecraft:".length());
        return normalized.equals(material);
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper;

import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer;
import org.bukkit.command.Command;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor;
import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
import org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config.Messages;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.diagnostics.VAntiCheatDiagnostics;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDiagnostics;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDefinition;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeRegistry;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeValidityMatrix;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.lunar.LunarClientService;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted.TrustedPlayer;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted.TrustedPlayerService;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public final class VAntiCheatCommand implements CommandExecutor, TabCompleter {
    private final TrustedPlayerService trusted;
    private final BooleanSupplier reload;
    private final ClientProbeCommand probeCommand;
    private final LunarClientService lunar;
    private final Messages messages;
    private final VAntiCheatDiagnostics diagnostics;

    public VAntiCheatCommand(TrustedPlayerService trusted, BooleanSupplier reload,
                             ClientProbeCommand probeCommand, LunarClientService lunar,
                             Messages messages, VAntiCheatDiagnostics diagnostics) {
        this.trusted = trusted;
        this.reload = reload;
        this.probeCommand = probeCommand;
        this.lunar = lunar;
        this.messages = messages;
        this.diagnostics = diagnostics;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean onCommand(CommandSender sender, Command command, String label, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 0 || args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("help")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) return true;
            help(sender);
            return true;
        }
        String subcommand = args[0].toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (subcommand.equals("check")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.probe")) return true;
            if (args.length < 2 || args.length > 3 || probeCommand == null) {
                sender.sendMessage(messages.render(probeCommand == null ? "probe.disabled" : "command.usage"));
                return true;
            }
            probeCommand.check(sender, args[1], args.length == 3 ? splitProbeIds(args[2]) : null);
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("status")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.status")) return true;
            if (args.length > 2 || args.length == 2 && !args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("verbose")) {
                sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.usage"));
            } else {
                status(sender, args.length == 2);
            }
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("detections")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.status")) return true;
            detections(sender);
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("reload")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.reload")) return true;
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render(reload.getAsBoolean() ? "command.reloaded" : "command.reload-failed"));
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("probes")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) return true;
            probes(sender);
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("probe")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) return true;
            if (args.length != 2) sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.usage"));
            else probe(sender, args[1]);
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("lunar")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) return true;
            if (args.length != 2) sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.usage"));
            else lunarStatus(sender, args[1]);
            return true;
        }
        if (subcommand.equals("trust")) {
            if (!require(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) return true;
            trust(sender, args);
            return true;
        }
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.usage"));
        return true;
    }

    private boolean require(CommandSender sender, String permission) {
        boolean playerSender = sender instanceof Player;
        if (!authorized(playerSender, playerSender && sender.hasPermission(permission))) {
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render("vanticheat.probe".equals(permission)
                    ? "command.no-permission-probe" : "command.no-permission-admin"));
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static boolean authorized(boolean playerSender, boolean hasPermission) {
        return !playerSender || hasPermission;
    }

    private void help(CommandSender sender) {
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.header"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.client"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.check"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.vacprobe"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.check-probe"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.probes"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.probe"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.lunar-category"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.lunar"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.admin"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.status"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.detections"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.reload"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.trust-category"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.trust-add"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.trust-remove"));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.help.trust-list"));
    }

    private void status(CommandSender sender, boolean verbose) {
        VAntiCheatDiagnostics.Snapshot status = diagnostics.snapshot();
        VAntiCheatDiagnostics.Configuration config = status.configuration();
        sender.sendMessage("§8--- §bVAntiCheat §8---");
        sender.sendMessage("§7Status: §f" + (status.enabled() ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED")
                + " §7Version: §f" + status.version() + " §7Runtime: §f" + status.runtime());
        sender.sendMessage("§7Health: §f" + status.health() + " §8(" + status.healthReason() + ")");
        sender.sendMessage("§7Detection: §f" + status.engineState()
                + " §7Automatic: §f" + (status.automatic().enabled() ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED"));
        String autoCapacity = status.automatic().capacity() == 0 ? "N/A"
                : status.automatic().active() + "/" + status.automatic().capacity();
        sender.sendMessage("§7Active scans: §f" + status.activeScans()
                + " §7Automatic capacity: §f" + autoCapacity);
        sender.sendMessage("§7Trusted players: §f" + status.trustedPlayers());
        sender.sendMessage("§7Probes total/enabled: §f" + config.totalProbes() + "/" + config.enabledProbes()
                + " §7Manual/automatic: §f" + config.manualProbes() + "/" + config.automaticProbes());
        sender.sendMessage("§7Probes verified/unverified: §f" + config.verifiedProbes()
                + "/" + config.unverifiedProbes());
        sender.sendMessage("§7Floodgate/Geyser: §f" + status.platform().providers().floodgate()
                + "/" + status.platform().providers().geyser()
                + " §7Readiness: §f" + status.platform().providers().readiness());
        sender.sendMessage("§7Cached Java/Bedrock/Unknown/No-provider: §f"
                + status.platform().javaCached() + "/" + status.platform().bedrockCached() + "/"
                + status.platform().unknownCached() + "/" + status.platform().noProviderCached());
        sender.sendMessage("§7Lunar/Apollo: §f" + status.lunar().integration()
                + " §7Ready: §f" + (status.lunar().ready() ? "YES" : "NO")

    private void probe(CommandSender sender, String id) {

    private void lunarStatus(CommandSender sender, String name) {
        Player player = Bukkit.getPlayerExact(name);
        if (player == null) {

            return;
        }

        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("lunar.report.support", Map.of("support", support)));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("lunar.report.policy", Map.of("policy", snapshot.minimapPolicyEnabled() ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED")));
        sender.sendMessage(messages.render("lunar.report.state", Map.of("state", snapshot.state())));

    }

    private void trust(CommandSender sender, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 2 && args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("list")) {
            List<TrustedPlayer> players = trusted.list();
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.trust.header", Map.of("count", players.size())));
            players.forEach(player -> sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.trust.entry", Map.of("player", player.name()))));
            return;
        }
        if (args.length != 3 || (!args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("add") && !args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("remove"))) {
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.usage"));
            return;
        }
        ResolvedPlayer player = resolve(args[2]);
        if (player == null) {
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render("command.trust.not-found"));
            return;
        }
        if (args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("add")) {
            boolean added = trusted.add(player.id(), player.name());
            trusted.save();
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render(added ? "command.trust.added" : "command.trust.exists", Map.of("player", player.name())));
        } else {
            boolean removed = trusted.remove(player.id());
            trusted.save();
            sender.sendMessage(messages.render(removed ? "command.trust.removed" : "command.trust.not-trusted", Map.of("player", player.name())));
        }
    }

    private ResolvedPlayer resolve(String name) {
        Player online = Bukkit.getPlayerExact(name);
        if (online != null) return new ResolvedPlayer(online.getUniqueId(), online.getName());
        for (TrustedPlayer player : trusted.list()) if (player.name().equalsIgnoreCase(name)) return new ResolvedPlayer(player.id(), player.name());
        OfflinePlayer cached = Bukkit.getOfflinePlayerIfCached(name);
        return cached == null || cached.getUniqueId() == null ? null
                : new ResolvedPlayer(cached.getUniqueId(), cached.getName() == null ? name : cached.getName());
    }

    @Override
    public List<String> onTabComplete(CommandSender sender, Command command, String alias, String[] args) {
        if (args.length == 1) {
            List<String> available = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            if (can(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) available.addAll(List.of("help", "probes", "probe", "lunar", "trust"));
            if (can(sender, "vanticheat.status")) available.addAll(List.of("status", "detections"));
            if (can(sender, "vanticheat.reload")) available.add("reload");
            if (can(sender, "vanticheat.probe")) available.add("check");
            return matching(available, args[0]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("status") && can(sender, "vanticheat.status")) {
            return matching(List.of("verbose"), args[1]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("check") && can(sender, "vanticheat.probe")) {
            return matching(onlinePlayers(), args[1]);
        }
        if (args.length == 3 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("check") && can(sender, "vanticheat.probe")) {
            return matching(probeIds(), args[2]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("probe") && can(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) {
            return matching(probeIds(), args[1]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("lunar") && can(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) {
            return matching(onlinePlayers(), args[1]);
        }
        if (args.length == 2 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("trust") && can(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) {
            return matching(List.of("add", "remove", "list"), args[1]);
        }
        if (args.length == 3 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("trust") && args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("remove")
                && can(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) {
            return matching(trusted.list().stream().map(TrustedPlayer::name).toList(), args[2]);
        }
        if (args.length == 3 && args[0].equalsIgnoreCase("trust") && args[1].equalsIgnoreCase("add")
                && can(sender, "vanticheat.admin")) {
            return matching(onlinePlayers(), args[2]);
        }
        return List.of();
    }

    private boolean can(CommandSender sender, String permission) {
        boolean playerSender = sender instanceof Player;
        return authorized(playerSender, playerSender && sender.hasPermission(permission));
    }

    private List<String> onlinePlayers() { return Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().stream().map(Player::getName).toList(); }
    private List<String> probeIds() { return diagnostics.probeRegistry().all().stream().map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList(); }
    static List<String> splitProbeIds(String value) {
        return java.util.Arrays.stream(value.split(","))
                .map(String::trim).filter(id -> !id.isEmpty()).distinct().toList();
    }
    static List<String> matching(List<String> values, String prefix) {
        String lower = prefix.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return values.stream().filter(value -> value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith(lower)).distinct().sorted(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
    private record ResolvedPlayer(UUID id, String name) { }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/ChallengeRegistry.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Bounded store of outstanding interactive challenges with TTL and replay protection.
 *
 * <p>Three independent ceilings are enforced, so neither one abusive player nor a
 * synchronised group can exhaust the challenge budget:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@link SecurityLimits#maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer()} per player</li>
 *   <li>{@link SecurityLimits#maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal()} across the server</li>
 *   <li>{@link SecurityLimits#challengeTtl()} time to live, so a challenge that is never
 *       answered releases its budget automatically</li>
 * </ul>
 *
 * <p>Challenge tokens are {@link java.security.SecureRandom} 128-bit values. A token is
 * single-use: {@link #consume} succeeds exactly once, so a captured response cannot be replayed
 * to satisfy a later challenge.
 *
 * <p><b>A refused, expired, replayed, or duplicated challenge is never a detection signal.</b>
 * It releases or retains budget and increments a counter only.
 */
public final class ChallengeRegistry {
    /** Why a challenge could not be issued. Never a detection signal. */
    public enum Admit { ADMITTED, PLAYER_LIMIT, GLOBAL_LIMIT }

    /**
     * Why a response did not match. Never a detection signal.
     *
     * <p>A token that has already been consumed is reported as {@link #UNKNOWN_TOKEN} rather
     * than as a distinct outcome: it was removed on use, so telling it apart from a token that
     * never existed would leak information about outstanding challenges to an attacker who is
     * guessing tokens.
     */
    public enum Consume { MATCHED, UNKNOWN_TOKEN, WRONG_PLAYER, EXPIRED }

    public record Challenge(String token, java.util.UUID playerId, long connectionId,
                             String probeId, long issuedAtMillis, long expiresAtMillis) {
        public boolean expiredAt(long now) { return now >= expiresAtMillis; }

        public long ageMillis(long now) { return now - issuedAtMillis; }
    }

    private final SecurityLimits limits;
    private final ProtectionMetrics metrics;
    private final java.util.function.LongSupplier clock;
    private final java.security.SecureRandom random = new java.security.SecureRandom();
    private final java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<String, Challenge> outstanding =
            new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<java.util.UUID, Integer> perPlayer =
            new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final AtomicInteger globalCount = new AtomicInteger();

    public ChallengeRegistry(SecurityLimits limits, ProtectionMetrics metrics,
                             java.util.function.LongSupplier clock) {
        this.limits = limits;
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    /**
     * Issues a cryptographically random challenge, or refuses without consuming budget.
     *
     * <p>The random token is generated before any admission check so a refused caller never
     * receives a token, and therefore cannot learn anything from the attempt.
     */
    public synchronized Admit issue(java.util.UUID playerId, long connectionId, String probeId,
                                    Challenge challenge) {
        if (playerId == null || probeId == null) return Admit.GLOBAL_LIMIT;
        long now = clock.getAsLong();
        sweep(now);

        int held = perPlayer.getOrDefault(playerId, 0);
        if (held >= limits.maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer()) {
            metrics.challengeRejectedPerPlayer();
            return Admit.PLAYER_LIMIT;
        }
        if (globalCount.get() >= limits.maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal()) {
            metrics.challengeRejectedGlobal();
            return Admit.GLOBAL_LIMIT;
        }
        if (outstanding.size() >= limits.maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal()) {
            metrics.challengeRejectedGlobal();
            return Admit.GLOBAL_LIMIT;
        }

        if (challenge == null || challenge.token() == null || challenge.token().isBlank()
                || !playerId.equals(challenge.playerId()) || connectionId != challenge.connectionId()
                || !probeId.equals(challenge.probeId()) || challenge.expiredAt(now)) {
            return Admit.GLOBAL_LIMIT;
        }
        if (outstanding.putIfAbsent(challenge.token(), challenge) != null) return Admit.GLOBAL_LIMIT;
        perPlayer.merge(playerId, 1, Integer::sum);
        globalCount.incrementAndGet();
        metrics.challengeIssued();
        return Admit.ADMITTED;
    }

    /**
     * Single-use consumption. Returns {@link Consume#MATCHED} at most once per token, which is
     * what makes a captured response worthless to an attacker who replays it.
     */
    public Consume consume(String token, java.util.UUID playerId, long connectionId) {
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return Consume.UNKNOWN_TOKEN;
        long now = clock.getAsLong();
        Challenge challenge = outstanding.get(token);
        if (challenge == null) return Consume.UNKNOWN_TOKEN;
        if (challenge.expiredAt(now)) {
            if (outstanding.remove(token, challenge)) {
                release(challenge.playerId());
                metrics.challengeExpired();
            }
            return Consume.EXPIRED;
        }
        if (!challenge.playerId().equals(playerId) || challenge.connectionId() != connectionId) {
            // Not consumed: the legitimate owner may still answer within its TTL.
            metrics.challengeDuplicate();
            return Consume.WRONG_PLAYER;
        }
        if (!outstanding.remove(token, challenge)) {
            // Lost the race with a concurrent consume: someone else already used it.
            metrics.challengeDuplicate();
            return Consume.UNKNOWN_TOKEN;
        }
        release(challenge.playerId());
        metrics.challengeConsumed();
        return Consume.MATCHED;
    }

    private void release(java.util.UUID playerId) {
        globalCount.decrementAndGet();
        perPlayer.computeIfPresent(playerId, (id, held) -> held <= 1 ? null : held - 1);
    }

    /** Expiry sweep. Bounded by the global ceiling and therefore safe to call per request. */
    public int sweep(long now) {
        int released = 0;
        for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, Challenge> candidate : outstanding.entrySet()) {
            Challenge challenge = candidate.getValue();
            if (challenge.expiredAt(now) && outstanding.remove(candidate.getKey(), challenge)) {
                release(challenge.playerId());
                released++;
            }
        }
        for (int index = 0; index < released; index++) metrics.challengeExpired();
        return released;
    }

    public int sweep() { return sweep(clock.getAsLong()); }

    /** Retires every challenge belonging to one connection, e.g. on disconnect or reconnect. */
    public synchronized int retireConnection(java.util.UUID playerId, long connectionId) {
        int released = 0;
        for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, Challenge> candidate : outstanding.entrySet()) {
            Challenge challenge = candidate.getValue();
            if (challenge.playerId().equals(playerId)
                    && (connectionId <= 0L || challenge.connectionId() == connectionId)
                    && outstanding.remove(candidate.getKey(), challenge)) {
                release(challenge.playerId());
                released++;
            }
        }
        return released;
    }

    public synchronized void forget(java.util.UUID playerId) {
        retireConnection(playerId, 0L);
        perPlayer.remove(playerId);
    }

    public synchronized void reset() {
        outstanding.clear();
        perPlayer.clear();
        globalCount.set(0);
    }

    public int outstandingGlobal() { return globalCount.get(); }

    public int outstandingPlayers() { return perPlayer.size(); }

    public int outstandingFor(java.util.UUID playerId) {
        return perPlayer.getOrDefault(playerId, 0);
    }

    public Duration ttl() { return limits.challengeTtl(); }

    /** Issues and stores a challenge in one step, or returns {@code null} when refused. */
    public Challenge issueOrNull(java.util.UUID playerId, long connectionId, String probeId) {
        if (playerId == null || probeId == null) return null;
        long now = clock.getAsLong();
        Challenge challenge = new Challenge(nextToken(), playerId, connectionId, probeId, now,
                now + limits.challengeTtl().toMillis());
        return issue(playerId, connectionId, probeId, challenge) == Admit.ADMITTED ? challenge : null;
    }

    /** A fresh 128-bit token. {@link java.security.SecureRandom}, so it cannot be predicted. */
    public String nextToken() {
        byte[] token = new byte[16];
        random.nextBytes(token);
        return hex(token);
    }

    private static String hex(byte[] bytes) {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(bytes.length * 2);
        for (byte value : bytes) {
            builder.append(Character.forDigit((value >> 4) & 0xF, 16));
            builder.append(Character.forDigit(value & 0xF, 16));
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/DetectionRateLimiter.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/**
 * Fixed-window rate limiter for client-originated detection traffic.
 *
 * <p>Three independent windows are enforced, in cheapest-first order:
 * <ol>
 *   <li><b>per player</b> — bounds a single connection.</li>
 *   <li><b>per channel</b> — one attacker cannot starve another declared channel.</li>
 *   <li><b>global</b> — bounds total server cost even if many players act together.</li>
 * </ol>
 *
 * <p>A fixed window is used rather than a token bucket because it needs exactly one counter
 * per key, which keeps the structure O(1) memory per tracked key and therefore trivially
 * bounded. The trade-off is that a window boundary permits a short burst of roughly twice the
 * configured rate; that is acceptable because the goal is bounding cost, not preventing
 * evasion.
 *
 * <p><b>A rate-limited payload is discarded and counted. It is never a detection signal.</b>
 * There is deliberately no path from this class to a verdict.
 *
 * <p>No allocation occurs on the accept path after warm-up; counters are reused across
 * windows by rewriting the window epoch in place.
 */
public final class DetectionRateLimiter {
    /** Why a message was refused. Never a detection signal. */
    public enum Decision { ACCEPTED, PLAYER_LIMIT, CHANNEL_LIMIT, GLOBAL_LIMIT }

    /**
     * One counter per key, packed into a single {@code long}: the high 32 bits are the current
     * one-second window epoch and the low 32 bits are the count within it.
     *
     * <p>Packing matters for correctness, not just speed. A separate {@code volatile long epoch}
     * plus {@code AtomicInteger count} has a race where one thread publishes a new epoch and
     * then resets the count, wiping a count another thread already committed against the new
     * epoch. That lets a flood exceed its allowance under load. A single compare-and-set makes
     * "advance the window" and "count an arrival" one indivisible step.
     */
    private static final class Window {
        private final java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong state =
                new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong();
        private boolean admit(long window, int permit) {
            while (true) {
                long current = state.get();
                long currentEpoch = current >>> 32;
                int currentCount = (int) current;
                if (currentEpoch != window) {
                    // Advance the window and clear the count atomically.
                    if (state.compareAndSet(current, window << 32)) continue;
                    continue;
                }
                if (currentCount + 1 > permit) return false;
                if (state.compareAndSet(current, (current & 0xFFFFFFFF00000000L) | (currentCount + 1L))) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        private int count() {
            long current = state.get();
            return (int) current;
        }

        private void reset() {
            state.set(0L);
        }
    }

    private final SecurityLimits limits;
    private final ProtectionMetrics metrics;
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<Object, Window> perPlayer = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Window> perChannel = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Window global = new Window();

    public DetectionRateLimiter(SecurityLimits limits, ProtectionMetrics metrics, LongSupplier clock) {
        this.limits = limits;
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    /**
     * Decides whether one client-originated message may be processed.
     *
     * <p>The per-player window is consulted first so a single abusive connection is reported
     * as such rather than being misattributed to global pressure.
     */
    public Decision admit(Object playerKey, String channel) {
        long window = Math.floorDiv(clock.getAsLong(), 1000L);

        if (!windowFor(perPlayer, playerKey, window, limits.playerMessagesPerSecond())) {
            metrics.playerRateLimited();
            return Decision.PLAYER_LIMIT;
        }
        if (channel != null
                && !windowFor(perChannel, channel, window, limits.channelMessagesPerSecond())) {
            metrics.channelRateLimited();
            return Decision.CHANNEL_LIMIT;
        }
        if (!global.admit(window, limits.globalMessagesPerSecond())) {
            metrics.globalRateLimited();
            return Decision.GLOBAL_LIMIT;
        }
        return Decision.ACCEPTED;
    }

    /**
     * Obtains the counter for a key, creating it if absent.
     *
     * <p>Eviction deliberately happens here rather than inside the {@code computeIfAbsent}
     * mapping function: a mapping function that mutates the same map is a recursive update,
     * which {@link java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap} rejects. Clearing from inside would
     * therefore throw the moment the table filled, which on a packet path is exactly the wrong
     * failure mode.
     */
    private <K> boolean windowFor(ConcurrentHashMap<K, Window> registry, K key,
                                  long window, int permit) {
        if (key == null) return true;
        Window counter = registry.get(key);
        if (counter == null) {
            if (registry.size() >= limits.maxTrackedRateKeys()) {
                // Clearing is O(1) and cannot itself become a bypass: the per-player window
                // restarts at zero, while the global window still bounds total admitted work.
                registry.clear();
                metrics.rateKeyEvicted();
            }
            counter = registry.computeIfAbsent(key, ignored -> new Window());
        }
        return counter.admit(window, permit);
    }

    /** Drops the counter for one player, for example on disconnect. */
    public void forget(Object playerKey) {
        if (playerKey != null) perPlayer.remove(playerKey);
    }

    /** Drops every counter. Called on reload so the fresh limits apply immediately. */
    public void reset() {
        perPlayer.clear();
        perChannel.clear();
        global.reset();
    }

    public int trackedPlayerKeys() { return perPlayer.size(); }

    public int trackedChannelKeys() { return perChannel.size(); }

    public int currentGlobalCount() { return global.count(); }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/DetectorCircuitBreaker.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

/**
 * Per-detector circuit breaker that degrades an abused path instead of the server.
 *
 * <p>When one detection path starts failing or flooding abnormally, the breaker opens and
 * suspends that path for a cooldown. Detection then reports the path as unavailable, which the
 * caller maps to {@code CLEAN} or {@code SKIPPED}.
 *
 * <p><b>The breaker never kicks, bans, or produces a verdict.</b> A tripped breaker means
 * "this path is not being checked right now", never "this player cheated". That distinction is
 * why the class has no access to the enforcement pipeline.
 *
 * <p>After the cooldown the breaker admits a bounded number of half-open probes. Success closes
 * it; any failure reopens it. This prevents a permanently broken path from being retried in a
 * hot loop.
 *
 * <p>State is bounded by the number of registered detector ids, which is fixed by
 * configuration and therefore cannot grow at runtime.
 */
public final class DetectorCircuitBreaker {
    /** Breaker state. Only {@link #ALLOW} permits work; the rest map to CLEAN/SKIPPED. */
    public enum State { ALLOW, OPEN, HALF_OPEN }

    private static final class Breaker {
        private final AtomicInteger failures = new AtomicInteger();
        private volatile State state = State.ALLOW;
        private volatile long openUntilMillis;
        private volatile int halfOpenProbes;
        private long lastFailureMillis = Long.MIN_VALUE;
    }

    public record Status(String detectorId, State state, int failures, long retryInMillis) {
    }

    private final SecurityLimits limits;
    private final ProtectionMetrics metrics;
    private final java.util.function.LongSupplier clock;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, Breaker> breakers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public DetectorCircuitBreaker(SecurityLimits limits, ProtectionMetrics metrics,
                                  java.util.function.LongSupplier clock) {
        this.limits = limits;
        this.metrics = metrics;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    /**
     * Whether one unit of work on this path may proceed.
     *
     * <p>Half-open probes are finite: once the allowance is spent, further calls are refused
     * until either a success closes the breaker or the cooldown lapses again.
     */
    public boolean allow(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakerFor(detectorId);
        long now = clock.getAsLong();
        State state = breaker.state;
        if (state == State.ALLOW) return true;
        if (state == State.OPEN) {
            if (now < breaker.openUntilMillis) {
                metrics.circuitSuppressed();
                return false;
            }
            synchronized (breaker) {
                if (breaker.state == State.OPEN && now >= breaker.openUntilMillis) {
                    breaker.state = State.HALF_OPEN;
                    breaker.halfOpenProbes = limits.circuitHalfOpenProbes();
                }
            }
            if (!claimHalfOpen(breaker)) {
                metrics.circuitSuppressed();
                return false;
            }
            metrics.circuitHalfOpened();
            return true;
        }
        if (!claimHalfOpen(breaker)) {
            metrics.circuitSuppressed();
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private boolean claimHalfOpen(Breaker breaker) {
        synchronized (breaker) {
            if (breaker.halfOpenProbes <= 0) return false;
            breaker.halfOpenProbes--;
            return true;
        }
    }

    /** Records a successful unit of work. Only meaningful while half-open. */
    public void recordSuccess(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakerFor(detectorId);
        synchronized (breaker) {
            if (breaker.state == State.HALF_OPEN) {
                breaker.state = State.ALLOW;
                breaker.failures.set(0);
                breaker.halfOpenProbes = 0;
                metrics.circuitClosed();
            }
        }
    }

    /** Records a failure or an abnormal-traffic signal, tripping the breaker at threshold. */
    public void recordFailure(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakerFor(detectorId);
        synchronized (breaker) {
            long now = clock.getAsLong();
            if (breaker.state == State.ALLOW && breaker.lastFailureMillis != Long.MIN_VALUE
                    && now >= breaker.lastFailureMillis
                    && now - breaker.lastFailureMillis >= limits.circuitResetDelay().toMillis()) {
                // Failures are consecutive only within the configured idle window. A detector
                // that has been quiet for long enough gets a fresh failure budget.
                breaker.failures.set(0);
            }
            breaker.lastFailureMillis = now;
            int failures = breaker.failures.incrementAndGet();
            if (failures >= limits.circuitFailureThreshold()) {
                tripLocked(breaker, now);
            } else if (breaker.state == State.HALF_OPEN) {
                // A half-open probe failed, so the path is still broken: reopen immediately.
                tripLocked(breaker, now);
            }
        }
    }

    private void tripLocked(Breaker breaker, long now) {
        if (breaker.state == State.OPEN) return;
        breaker.state = State.OPEN;
        breaker.openUntilMillis = now + limits.circuitCooldown().toMillis();
        breaker.halfOpenProbes = 0;
        breaker.failures.set(0);
        breaker.lastFailureMillis = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        metrics.circuitTripped();
    }

    /** Forces a breaker closed, e.g. after an operator reload. */
    public void reset(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakers.get(detectorId);
        if (breaker == null) return;
        synchronized (breaker) {
            breaker.state = State.ALLOW;
            breaker.failures.set(0);
            breaker.openUntilMillis = 0L;
            breaker.halfOpenProbes = 0;
            breaker.lastFailureMillis = Long.MIN_VALUE;
        }
    }

    public void reset() { breakers.clear(); }

    public State stateOf(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakers.get(detectorId);
        return breaker == null ? State.ALLOW : breaker.state;
    }

    public boolean open(String detectorId) { return stateOf(detectorId) != State.ALLOW; }

    public int trackedDetectors() { return breakers.size(); }

    public Status status(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakers.get(detectorId);
        if (breaker == null) return new Status(detectorId, State.ALLOW, 0, 0L);
        long now = clock.getAsLong();
        long retry = breaker.state == State.OPEN ? Math.max(0L, breaker.openUntilMillis - now) : 0L;
        return new Status(detectorId, breaker.state, breaker.failures.get(), retry);
    }

    /** Current consecutive failure count for a path. Diagnostic only. */
    public int failuresOf(String detectorId) {
        Breaker breaker = breakers.get(detectorId);
        return breaker == null ? 0 : breaker.failures.get();
    }

    public Map<String, Status> statuses() {
        Map<String, Status> snapshot = new java.util.TreeMap<>();
        breakers.forEach((id, breaker) -> snapshot.put(id, status(id)));
        return snapshot;
    }

    private Breaker breakerFor(String detectorId) {
        String key = detectorId == null || detectorId.isBlank() ? "default" : detectorId;
        return breakers.computeIfAbsent(key, ignored -> new Breaker());
    }

    /** Human-readable one-liner for {@code /vac status}. */
    public String describe() {
        return "detectors=" + breakers.size() + " open=" + statuses().values().stream()
                .filter(status -> status.state() != State.ALLOW).count();
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/EmergencyProtection.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/**
 * The single entry point every client-originated detection input passes through.
 *
 * <p>Order of checks, cheapest first, so malformed hostile input is rejected before any work
 * proportional to its size is done:
 * <ol>
 *   <li>channel is declared by an enabled probe</li>
 *   <li>connection context exists (no connection means no safe attribution)</li>
 *   <li>payload size within cap — <b>before</b> any parse</li>
 *   <li>per-player rate window</li>
 *   <li>per-channel rate window</li>
 *   <li>global rate window</li>
 *   <li>detector circuit breaker</li>
 * </ol>
 *
 * <p>Every refusal returns a {@link ProtectionOutcome} that is explicitly not a verdict. The
 * caller must translate a refusal into {@code CLEAN} or {@code SKIPPED}; it may never
 * translate one into {@code DETECTED}.
 *
 * <p>Instances are immutable apart from internal counters, are safe to call from any thread,
 * touch no Bukkit world state, and therefore need no scheduler affinity. On Folia they run on
 * whichever region or entity thread delivered the packet, which is exactly the thread on which
 * the observation was already going to be handled.
 *
 * <p>No blocking I/O. All time comes from the injected clock so tests can drive TTL and window
 * behaviour deterministically.
 */
public final class EmergencyProtection {
    private final SecurityLimits limits;
    private final ProtectionMetrics metrics;
    private final DetectionRateLimiter rateLimiter;
    private final ChallengeRegistry challenges;
    private final DetectorCircuitBreaker breakers;
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private final java.util.Set<String> declaredChannels;

    public EmergencyProtection(SecurityLimits limits,
                               java.util.Set<String> declaredChannels,
                               LongSupplier clock) {
        this(limits, declaredChannels, clock, new ProtectionMetrics());
    }

    public EmergencyProtection(SecurityLimits limits,
                               java.util.Set<String> declaredChannels,
                               LongSupplier clock,
                               ProtectionMetrics metrics) {
        this.limits = limits == null ? SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS : limits;
        this.declaredChannels = declaredChannels == null ? java.util.Set.of()
                : java.util.Set.copyOf(declaredChannels);
        this.clock = clock == null ? System::currentTimeMillis : clock;
        this.metrics = metrics == null ? new ProtectionMetrics() : metrics;
        this.rateLimiter = new DetectionRateLimiter(this.limits, this.metrics, this.clock);
        this.challenges = new ChallengeRegistry(this.limits, this.metrics, this.clock);
        this.breakers = new DetectorCircuitBreaker(this.limits, this.metrics, this.clock);
    }

    public SecurityLimits limits() { return limits; }

    public ProtectionMetrics metrics() { return metrics; }

    public DetectionRateLimiter rateLimiter() { return rateLimiter; }

    public ChallengeRegistry challenges() { return challenges; }

    public DetectorCircuitBreaker breakers() { return breakers; }

    public java.util.Set<String> declaredChannels() { return declaredChannels; }

    /**
     * Full admission decision for one inbound plugin message.
     *
     * <p>Never throws for hostile input: every check is total over its domain, and payload
     * bytes are only measured, never parsed, before the size cap is applied.
     */
    public ProtectionOutcome admit(UUID playerId, Object connectionHandle, String channel,
                                   int payloadBytes, String detectorId) {
        if (playerId == null || connectionHandle == null) {
            metrics.inputRejected();
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.NO_CONNECTION, "no connection context");
        }
        if (channel == null || !declaredChannels.contains(channel)) {
            metrics.inputRejected();
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.UNDECLARED_CHANNEL,
                    channel == null ? "null" : channel);
        }
        // Size cap before any parsing work. A negative length is treated as oversized because
        // a real packet can never be negative.
        if (payloadBytes < 0 || payloadBytes > limits.maxPayloadBytes()) {
            metrics.oversizedPayload();
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
                    payloadBytes + ">" + limits.maxPayloadBytes());
        }
        if (payloadBytes > limits.maxChannelBytes()) {
            metrics.oversizedPayload();
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
                    payloadBytes + ">" + limits.maxChannelBytes());
        }
        DetectionRateLimiter.Decision decision = rateLimiter.admit(connectionHandle, channel);
        if (decision != DetectionRateLimiter.Decision.ACCEPTED) {
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(switch (decision) {
                case PLAYER_LIMIT -> ProtectionOutcome.Reason.RATE_LIMITED_PLAYER;
                case CHANNEL_LIMIT -> ProtectionOutcome.Reason.RATE_LIMITED_CHANNEL;
                case GLOBAL_LIMIT -> ProtectionOutcome.Reason.RATE_LIMITED_GLOBAL;
                case ACCEPTED -> ProtectionOutcome.Reason.ALLOWED;
            }, decision.name());
        }
        if (detectorId != null && !breakers.allow(detectorId)) {
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.CIRCUIT_OPEN, detectorId);
        }
        metrics.sawPayload();
        return ProtectionOutcome.allowed();
    }

    /** Size-cap check usable by parsers before they touch the byte array. */
    public ProtectionOutcome checkPayloadSize(String channel, int payloadBytes) {
        if (payloadBytes < 0 || payloadBytes > limits.maxPayloadBytes()) {
            metrics.oversizedPayload();
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
                    payloadBytes + ">" + limits.maxPayloadBytes());
        }
        if (channel != null && declaredChannels.contains(channel)
                && payloadBytes > limits.maxChannelBytes()) {
            metrics.oversizedPayload();
            return ProtectionOutcome.of(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
                    payloadBytes + ">" + limits.maxChannelBytes());
        }
        return ProtectionOutcome.allowed();
    }

    /**
     * Wraps a parser so that malformed input can never propagate out of the detection layer.
     *
     * <p>A parser that throws is a protection-layer failure, not a detection: it is recorded as
     * {@code inputFailed} and reported as {@code MALFORMED}, which callers map to
     * {@code CLEAN}. It can never become {@code DETECTED}, so it can never block a player.
     */
    public <T> ParserResult<T> guardParse(String channel, java.util.function.IntFunction<T> parser) {
        try {
            return new ParserResult<>(true, parser.apply(0), ProtectionOutcome.allowed());
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError exception) {
            metrics.malformedPayload();
            metrics.inputFailed();
            return new ParserResult<>(false, null, ProtectionOutcome.of(
                    ProtectionOutcome.Reason.MALFORMED, exception.getClass().getSimpleName()));
        }
    }

    /** Outcome of a guarded parse. */
    public record ParserResult<T>(boolean ok, T value, ProtectionOutcome outcome) { }

    /** Records that a detector path failed internally or behaved abnormally. */
    public void recordDetectorFailure(String detectorId) {
        if (detectorId != null) breakers.recordFailure(detectorId);
    }

    /** Records a successful unit of work so a half-open breaker can close. */
    public void recordDetectorSuccess(String detectorId) {
        if (detectorId != null) breakers.recordSuccess(detectorId);
    }

    /** Cleanup on disconnect. Releases every per-connection resource promptly. */
    public void forgetConnection(UUID playerId, Object connectionHandle) {
        if (playerId != null) {
            challenges.forget(playerId);
        }
        rateLimiter.forget(connectionHandle);
    }

    /** Reload: drop all runtime state so the fresh configuration governs immediately. */
    public void reset() {
        rateLimiter.reset();
        challenges.reset();
        breakers.reset();
    }

    /** Compact diagnostic line for {@code /vac status} and the console. */
    public String describe() {
        return metrics.describe() + " rateKeysPlayer=" + rateLimiter.trackedPlayerKeys()
                + " rateKeysChannel=" + rateLimiter.trackedChannelKeys()
                + " challengesOutstanding=" + challenges.outstandingGlobal()
                + " breakers=" + breakers.describe();
    }

    public Map<String, DetectorCircuitBreaker.Status> breakerStatuses() {
        return breakers.statuses();
    }
}
```
