`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/ProtectionMetrics.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.LongAdder;

/**
 * Counters for every protective decision the detection layer makes.
 *
 * <p>These exist so an operator can answer "is this path under attack, misconfigured, or just
 * quiet" without reading code. Each counter is monotonic and bounded only by {@code long}
 * overflow, so recording is allocation-free on the packet path.
 *
 * <p>Counters are diagnostics only. Nothing in this class is ever consulted when producing a
 * detection verdict.
 */
public final class ProtectionMetrics {
    private final LongAdder payloadsSeen = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder payloadsOversized = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder payloadsMalformed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder playerRateLimited = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder globalRateLimited = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder channelRateLimited = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder circuitTrips = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder circuitProbesSuppressed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder circuitHalfOpenProbes = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder circuitClosed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesIssued = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesRejectedPerPlayer = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesRejectedGlobal = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesExpired = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesReplayed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesDuplicate = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder challengesConsumed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder stagingOverflow = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder stagingExpired = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder inputRejected = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder inputFailed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder rateKeysEvicted = new LongAdder();

    public record Snapshot(long payloadsSeen, long payloadsOversized, long payloadsMalformed,
                           long playerRateLimited, long globalRateLimited, long channelRateLimited,
                           long circuitTrips, long circuitProbesSuppressed, long circuitHalfOpenProbes,
                           long circuitClosed, long challengesIssued, long challengesRejectedPerPlayer,
                           long challengesRejectedGlobal, long challengesExpired, long challengesReplayed,
                           long challengesDuplicate, long challengesConsumed, long stagingOverflow,
                           long stagingExpired, long inputRejected, long inputFailed,
                           long rateKeysEvicted) {
    }

    public void sawPayload() { payloadsSeen.increment(); }
    public void oversizedPayload() { payloadsOversized.increment(); }
    public void malformedPayload() { payloadsMalformed.increment(); }
    public void playerRateLimited() { playerRateLimited.increment(); }
    public void globalRateLimited() { globalRateLimited.increment(); }
    public void channelRateLimited() { channelRateLimited.increment(); }
    public void circuitTripped() { circuitTrips.increment(); }
    public void circuitSuppressed() { circuitProbesSuppressed.increment(); }
    public void circuitHalfOpened() { circuitHalfOpenProbes.increment(); }
    public void circuitClosed() { circuitClosed.increment(); }
    public void challengeIssued() { challengesIssued.increment(); }
    public void challengeRejectedPerPlayer() { challengesRejectedPerPlayer.increment(); }
    public void challengeRejectedGlobal() { challengesRejectedGlobal.increment(); }
    public void challengeExpired() { challengesExpired.increment(); }
    public void challengeReplayed() { challengesReplayed.increment(); }
    public void challengeDuplicate() { challengesDuplicate.increment(); }
    public void challengeConsumed() { challengesConsumed.increment(); }
    public void stagingOverflowed() { stagingOverflow.increment(); }
    public void stagingExpired() { stagingExpired.increment(); }
    public void inputRejected() { inputRejected.increment(); }
    public void inputFailed() { inputFailed.increment(); }
    public void rateKeyEvicted() { rateKeysEvicted.increment(); }

    public Snapshot snapshot() {
        return new Snapshot(payloadsSeen.sum(), payloadsOversized.sum(), payloadsMalformed.sum(),
                playerRateLimited.sum(), globalRateLimited.sum(), channelRateLimited.sum(),
                circuitTrips.sum(), circuitProbesSuppressed.sum(), circuitHalfOpenProbes.sum(),
                circuitClosed.sum(), challengesIssued.sum(), challengesRejectedPerPlayer.sum(),
                challengesRejectedGlobal.sum(), challengesExpired.sum(), challengesReplayed.sum(),
                challengesDuplicate.sum(), challengesConsumed.sum(), stagingOverflow.sum(),
                stagingExpired.sum(), inputRejected.sum(), inputFailed.sum(), rateKeysEvicted.sum());
    }

    /** Compact one-line form for the console and for {@code /vac status}. */
    public String describe() {
        Snapshot snapshot = snapshot();
        return "payloads=" + snapshot.payloadsSeen()
                + " oversized=" + snapshot.payloadsOversized()
                + " malformed=" + snapshot.payloadsMalformed()
                + " playerRateLimited=" + snapshot.playerRateLimited()
                + " globalRateLimited=" + snapshot.globalRateLimited()
                + " channelRateLimited=" + snapshot.channelRateLimited()
                + " circuitTrips=" + snapshot.circuitTrips()
                + " circuitSuppressed=" + snapshot.circuitProbesSuppressed()
                + " challengesIssued=" + snapshot.challengesIssued()
                + " challengeRejectedPlayer=" + snapshot.challengesRejectedPerPlayer()
                + " challengeRejectedGlobal=" + snapshot.challengesRejectedGlobal()
                + " challengeExpired=" + snapshot.challengesExpired()
                + " challengeReplayed=" + snapshot.challengesReplayed()
                + " challengeDuplicate=" + snapshot.challengesDuplicate()
                + " stagingOverflow=" + snapshot.stagingOverflow()
                + " stagingExpired=" + snapshot.stagingExpired()
                + " inputRejected=" + snapshot.inputRejected()
                + " inputFailed=" + snapshot.inputFailed();
    }

    public void reset() {
        payloadsSeen.reset(); payloadsOversized.reset(); payloadsMalformed.reset();
        playerRateLimited.reset(); globalRateLimited.reset(); channelRateLimited.reset();
        circuitTrips.reset(); circuitProbesSuppressed.reset();
        circuitHalfOpenProbes.reset(); circuitClosed.reset();
        challengesIssued.reset(); challengesRejectedPerPlayer.reset();
        challengesRejectedGlobal.reset(); challengesExpired.reset(); challengesReplayed.reset();
        challengesDuplicate.reset(); challengesConsumed.reset();
        stagingOverflow.reset(); stagingExpired.reset();
        inputRejected.reset(); inputFailed.reset(); rateKeysEvicted.reset();
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/ProtectionOutcome.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

/**
 * Immutable verdict produced by the protection layer for one client-originated message.
 *
 * <p>The whole point of this type is to make "the protection layer refused your input" a
 * first-class, non-cheating outcome that cannot be confused with a detection.
 *
 * <p>{@link #verdict()} deliberately has no {@code DETECTED} value available from a protection
 * failure. The only outcomes are: process the message, or report it as a resource condition
 * that the caller must map to {@code CLEAN} or {@code SKIPPED}.
 */
public record ProtectionOutcome(boolean admitted, Reason reason, String detail) {

    /** Why the protection layer made its decision. Never implies cheating. */
    public enum Reason {
        /** Within all limits; the message may be processed. */
        ALLOWED,
        /** Payload exceeded the size cap and was not parsed. */
        PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE,
        /** Payload was structurally invalid for the channel. */
        MALFORMED,
        /** The player's per-second window is exhausted. */
        RATE_LIMITED_PLAYER,
        /** The channel's per-second window is exhausted. */
        RATE_LIMITED_CHANNEL,
        /** The server-wide per-second window is exhausted. */
        RATE_LIMITED_GLOBAL,
        /** The channel is not declared by any enabled probe. */
        UNDECLARED_CHANNEL,
        /** This detector's circuit breaker is open. */
        CIRCUIT_OPEN,
        /** No live connection context, so the message cannot be attributed safely. */
        NO_CONNECTION,
        /** Input was rejected by an internal guard. */
        REJECTED
    }

    private static final ProtectionOutcome ALLOWED = new ProtectionOutcome(true, Reason.ALLOWED, "");

    public static ProtectionOutcome allowed() { return ALLOWED; }

    public static ProtectionOutcome of(Reason reason, String detail) {
        if (reason == Reason.ALLOWED) return ALLOWED;
        return new ProtectionOutcome(false, reason, detail == null ? "" : detail);
    }

    public boolean admitted() { return admitted; }

    public String detail() { return detail; }

    /** Compact one-line form for logs. */
    public String describe() {
        return admitted ? "ALLOWED" : reason + (detail.isEmpty() ? "" : "(" + detail + ")");
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/SecurityLimits.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection;

import java.time.Duration;

/**
 * Immutable server-side safety limits for every client-originated detection input.
 *
 * <p>Every limit here exists to bound memory, CPU, and state that an untrusted client can
 * influence. A limit is a resource ceiling, never a signal: exceeding one rejects input and
 * increments a diagnostic counter. No limit in this class may ever contribute to a detection
 * verdict, and no limit may produce enforcement on its own.
 *
 * <p>All values are validated on construction. A non-positive or absurd value is clamped into
 * a safe range rather than accepted, so a hand-edited configuration cannot disable the
 * protection layer by setting a limit to zero.
 */
public record SecurityLimits(int maxPayloadBytes,
                             int maxChannelBytes,
                             int playerMessagesPerSecond,
                             int globalMessagesPerSecond,
                             int channelMessagesPerSecond,
                             int maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer,
                             int maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal,
                             int maxStagedPlayers,
                             int maxStagedSignalsPerPlayer,
                             int maxTrackedRateKeys,
                             Duration challengeTtl,
                             Duration stagingTtl,
                             int circuitFailureThreshold,
                             Duration circuitCooldown,
                             int circuitHalfOpenProbes,
                             Duration circuitResetDelay) {

    /** Conservative defaults chosen so the protection layer is safe before any config load. */
    public static final SecurityLimits DEFAULTS = new SecurityLimits(
            4096, 4096, 32, 4000, 512, 2, 256, 512, 8, 4096,
            Duration.ofSeconds(15), Duration.ofMinutes(10), 64, Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1,
            Duration.ofMinutes(15));

    private static final int ABSOLUTE_PAYLOAD_CEILING = 1 << 20;
    private static final int ABSOLUTE_KEY_CEILING = 1 << 20;

    public SecurityLimits {
        maxPayloadBytes = clamp(maxPayloadBytes, 1, ABSOLUTE_PAYLOAD_CEILING, DEFAULTS_FALLBACK_PAYLOAD());
        maxChannelBytes = clamp(maxChannelBytes, 1, ABSOLUTE_PAYLOAD_CEILING, maxPayloadBytes);
        playerMessagesPerSecond = clamp(playerMessagesPerSecond, 1, 100_000, 32);
        globalMessagesPerSecond = clamp(globalMessagesPerSecond, 1, 10_000_000, 4000);
        channelMessagesPerSecond = clamp(channelMessagesPerSecond, 1, 1_000_000, 512);
        maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer = clamp(maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer, 1, 64, 2);
        maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal = clamp(maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal, 1, 100_000, 256);
        maxStagedPlayers = clamp(maxStagedPlayers, 1, 100_000, 512);
        maxStagedSignalsPerPlayer = clamp(maxStagedSignalsPerPlayer, 1, 256, 8);
        maxTrackedRateKeys = clamp(maxTrackedRateKeys, 16, ABSOLUTE_KEY_CEILING, 4096);
        challengeTtl = clampDuration(challengeTtl, Duration.ofSeconds(1), Duration.ofMinutes(10),
                Duration.ofSeconds(15));
        stagingTtl = clampDuration(stagingTtl, Duration.ofSeconds(5), Duration.ofHours(1),
                Duration.ofMinutes(10));
        circuitFailureThreshold = clamp(circuitFailureThreshold, 1, 1_000_000, 64);
        circuitCooldown = clampDuration(circuitCooldown, Duration.ofMillis(250), Duration.ofHours(1),
                Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        circuitHalfOpenProbes = clamp(circuitHalfOpenProbes, 1, 1024, 1);
        circuitResetDelay = clampDuration(circuitResetDelay, Duration.ofSeconds(1), Duration.ofHours(6),
                Duration.ofMinutes(15));
    }

    private static int DEFAULTS_FALLBACK_PAYLOAD() {
        return 4096;
    }

    private static int clamp(int value, int min, int max, int fallback) {
        if (value <= 0) return fallback;
        return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
    }

    private static Duration clampDuration(Duration value, Duration min, Duration max, Duration fallback) {
        if (value == null || value.isZero() || value.isNegative()) return fallback;
        if (value.compareTo(min) < 0) return min;
        return value.compareTo(max) > 0 ? max : value;
    }

    /** Derives limits from an operator configuration block, falling back to safe defaults. */
    public static SecurityLimits from(java.util.Map<String, Object> protection,
                                      java.util.Map<String, Object> clientDetection) {
        if (protection == null) return DEFAULTS;
        java.util.Map<String, Object> source = clientDetection == null || clientDetection.isEmpty()
                ? protection : clientDetection;
        try {
            return new SecurityLimits(
                    intOf(source, "max-payload-bytes", DEFAULTS.maxPayloadBytes()),
                    intOf(source, "max-channel-bytes", DEFAULTS.maxChannelBytes()),
                    intOf(source, "player-messages-per-second", DEFAULTS.playerMessagesPerSecond()),
                    intOf(source, "global-messages-per-second", DEFAULTS.globalMessagesPerSecond()),
                    intOf(source, "channel-messages-per-second", DEFAULTS.channelMessagesPerSecond()),
                    intOf(source, "max-concurrent-challenges-per-player",
                            DEFAULTS.maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer()),
                    intOf(source, "max-concurrent-challenges-global",
                            DEFAULTS.maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal()),
                    intOf(source, "max-staged-players", DEFAULTS.maxStagedPlayers()),
                    intOf(source, "max-staged-signals-per-player", DEFAULTS.maxStagedSignalsPerPlayer()),
                    intOf(source, "max-tracked-rate-keys", DEFAULTS.maxTrackedRateKeys()),
                    durationOf(source, "challenge-ttl", DEFAULTS.challengeTtl()),
                    durationOf(source, "staging-ttl", DEFAULTS.stagingTtl()),
                    intOf(source, "circuit-failure-threshold", DEFAULTS.circuitFailureThreshold()),
                    durationOf(source, "circuit-cooldown", DEFAULTS.circuitCooldown()),
                    intOf(source, "circuit-half-open-probes", DEFAULTS.circuitHalfOpenProbes()),
                    durationOf(source, "circuit-reset-delay", DEFAULTS.circuitResetDelay()));
        } catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
            // A malformed protection block must not prevent the plugin from starting with
            // protection enabled. Falling back to DEFAULTS is the fail-closed choice.
            return DEFAULTS;
        }
    }

    private static int intOf(java.util.Map<String, Object> source, String key, int fallback) {
        Object value = source.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number number) return number.intValue();
        if (value instanceof String text && !text.isBlank()) {
            try {
                return Integer.parseInt(text.trim());
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                return fallback;
            }
        }
        return fallback;
    }

    private static Duration durationOf(java.util.Map<String, Object> source, String key, Duration fallback) {
        Object value = source.get(key);
        if (value instanceof Number number) return Duration.ofMillis(number.longValue());
        if (value instanceof String text && !text.isBlank()) {
            String trimmed = text.trim().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
            try {
                if (trimmed.endsWith("ms")) return Duration.ofMillis(Long.parseLong(trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.length() - 2)));
                if (trimmed.endsWith("s")) return Duration.ofSeconds(Long.parseLong(trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.length() - 1)));
                if (trimmed.endsWith("m")) return Duration.ofMinutes(Long.parseLong(trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.length() - 1)));
                return Duration.ofSeconds(Long.parseLong(trimmed));
            } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                return fallback;
            }
        }
        return fallback;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainChunkPayload.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTCompound;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.Column;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.LightData;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.impl.v_1_18.Chunk_v1_18;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

/** Per-viewer unmasked chunk snapshot used to make threshold transitions reversible. */
public final class TerrainChunkPayload {
    public record BlockEntityUpdate(int x, int y, int z, int type, NBTCompound nbt) { }
    public record RenderedChunk(Column column, LightData lightData, List<BlockEntityUpdate> blockEntityUpdates) { }
    private record Position(int x, int y, int z) { }

    private final Column column;
    private volatile LightData lightData;
    private final LinkedHashMap<Position, BlockEntityUpdate> blockEntityUpdates = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public TerrainChunkPayload(Column column, LightData lightData) {
        this.column = column;
        this.lightData = lightData == null ? null : lightData.clone();
    }

    public Column column() {
        return column;
    }

    public LightData lightData() {
        LightData current = lightData;
        return current == null ? null : current.clone();
    }

    public void updateLight(LightData replacement) {
        lightData = replacement == null ? null : replacement.clone();
    }

    public synchronized void updateBlock(int x, int y, int z, int globalStateId,
                                         Set<Integer> airGlobalIds, int minWorldY) {
        int sectionIndex = Math.floorDiv(y - minWorldY, 16);
        var sections = column.getChunks();
        if (sectionIndex < 0 || sectionIndex >= sections.length) return;
        if (!(sections[sectionIndex] instanceof Chunk_v1_18 section)) return;
        int localY = Math.floorMod(y, 16);
        int localX = Math.floorMod(x, 16);
        int localZ = Math.floorMod(z, 16);
        int previous = section.getBlockId(localX, localY, localZ);
        if (previous == globalStateId) return;
        boolean previousAir = airGlobalIds.contains(previous);
        boolean replacementAir = airGlobalIds.contains(globalStateId);
        section.getChunkData().set(localX, localY, localZ, globalStateId);
        if (previousAir && !replacementAir) {
            section.setBlockCount(section.getBlockCount() + 1);
        } else if (!previousAir && replacementAir) {
            section.setBlockCount(Math.max(0, section.getBlockCount() - 1));
        }
        blockEntityUpdates.remove(new Position(x, y, z));
    }

    public synchronized void recordBlockEntity(BlockEntityUpdate update) {
        Position position = new Position(update.x(), update.y(), update.z());
        blockEntityUpdates.put(position, update);
        while (blockEntityUpdates.size() > 256) {
            blockEntityUpdates.remove(blockEntityUpdates.keySet().iterator().next());
        }
    }

    public synchronized List<BlockEntityUpdate> blockEntityUpdates() {
        return List.copyOf(new ArrayList<>(blockEntityUpdates.values()));
    }

    /** Builds the exact viewer-specific chunk payload for either initial send or transition replay. */
    public synchronized RenderedChunk render(TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view, ClientVersion clientVersion,
                                int fakeBlockGlobalId, Set<Integer> airGlobalIds) {
        if (view == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing viewer state");
        if (clientVersion == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing client version");
        if (airGlobalIds == null || airGlobalIds.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing air state ids");
        }
        Column renderedColumn = column;
        LightData renderedLight = lightData();
        List<BlockEntityUpdate> renderedBlockEntities = blockEntityUpdates();
        if (view.masked()) {
            TerrainChunkRewriter.Result rewritten = TerrainChunkRewriter.rewrite(column,
                    view.minWorldY(), view.hideBelowY(), fakeBlockGlobalId, airGlobalIds,
                    view.hideAir(), view.hideBlockEntities(), clientVersion);
            renderedColumn = rewritten.column();
            renderedLight = TerrainLightSanitizer.sanitize(renderedLight, view.minWorldY(), view.hideBelowY());
            if (view.hideBlockEntities()) {
                renderedBlockEntities = renderedBlockEntities.stream()
                        .filter(update -> update.y() >= view.hideBelowY()).toList();
            }
        }
        return new RenderedChunk(renderedColumn, renderedLight, renderedBlockEntities);
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainChunkRewriter.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.BaseChunk;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.Column;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.impl.v_1_18.Chunk_v1_18;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.DataPalette;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.PaletteType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.SingletonPalette;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTCompound;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;

/** Pure PacketEvents 1.21.11 chunk-column rewrite. It never mutates the supplied column. */
public final class TerrainChunkRewriter {
    public record Result(Column column, int rewrittenSections, long rewrittenBlocks) { }

    private TerrainChunkRewriter() { }

    public static Result rewrite(Column source, int minWorldY, int hideBelowY,
                                 int fakeBlockGlobalId, Set<Integer> airGlobalIds,
                                 boolean hideAir, boolean hideBlockEntities, ClientVersion clientVersion) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(source, "source");
        Objects.requireNonNull(airGlobalIds, "airGlobalIds");
        Objects.requireNonNull(clientVersion, "clientVersion");
        if (source.getChunks() == null || source.getChunks().length == 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("chunk has no decoded sections");
        }
        if ((minWorldY & 15) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("world minimum Y is not section-aligned");
        if (hideBelowY <= minWorldY) return new Result(source, 0, 0);
        BaseChunk[] original = source.getChunks();
        BaseChunk[] rewritten = original.clone();
        int changedSections = 0;
        long changedBlocks = 0;
        for (int sectionIndex = 0; sectionIndex < original.length; sectionIndex++) {
            BaseChunk section = original[sectionIndex];
            int sectionMinY = minWorldY + sectionIndex * 16;
            int sectionMaxY = sectionMinY + 16;
            if (sectionMinY >= hideBelowY) continue;
            if (section == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing decoded section at index " + sectionIndex);
            int replacedTopY = Math.min(sectionMaxY, hideBelowY);
            if (replacedTopY <= sectionMinY) continue;
            if (replacedTopY == sectionMaxY && hideAir) {
                rewritten[sectionIndex] = uniformSection(section, fakeBlockGlobalId, clientVersion);
                changedSections++;
                changedBlocks += 4096;
                continue;
            }

            Chunk_v1_18 copy = copySection(section, clientVersion);
            long sectionChanges = 0;
            int nonAir = copy.getBlockCount();
            boolean fakeIsAir = airGlobalIds.contains(fakeBlockGlobalId);
            for (int localY = 0; localY < 16; localY++) {
                if (sectionMinY + localY >= hideBelowY) continue;
                for (int localZ = 0; localZ < 16; localZ++) {
                    for (int localX = 0; localX < 16; localX++) {
                        int current = section.getBlockId(localX, localY, localZ);
                        boolean currentIsAir = airGlobalIds.contains(current);
                        if (!hideAir && currentIsAir) continue;
                        if (currentIsAir && !fakeIsAir) nonAir++;
                        else if (!currentIsAir && fakeIsAir) nonAir--;
                        copy.getChunkData().set(localX, localY, localZ, fakeBlockGlobalId);
                        sectionChanges++;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (sectionChanges > 0) {
                copy.setBlockCount(nonAir);
                rewritten[sectionIndex] = copy;
                changedSections++;
                changedBlocks += sectionChanges;
            }
        }
        if (changedSections == 0) return new Result(source, 0, 0);

        List<com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity> visibleBlockEntities =
                new ArrayList<>();
        for (var tileEntity : source.getTileEntities()) {
            if (tileEntity == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("null block entity in chunk payload");
            if (!hideBlockEntities || tileEntity.getY() >= hideBelowY) visibleBlockEntities.add(tileEntity);
        }
        NBTCompound sourceHeightmaps = Objects.requireNonNull(source.getHeightMaps(), "missing chunk heightmaps");
        NBTCompound heightmaps = TerrainHeightmapSanitizer.sanitize(sourceHeightmaps, minWorldY,
                original.length, hideBelowY, hideAir);
        Column rewrittenColumn = copyColumn(source, rewritten,
                visibleBlockEntities.toArray(com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[]::new),
                heightmaps);
        return new Result(rewrittenColumn, changedSections, changedBlocks);
    }

    private static Column copyColumn(Column source, BaseChunk[] sections,
                                     com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[] tileEntities,
                                     NBTCompound heightmaps) {
        if (!source.hasBiomeData()) {
            return new Column(source.getX(), source.getZ(), source.isFullChunk(), sections, tileEntities, heightmaps);
        }
        byte[] biomeBytes = source.getBiomeDataBytes();
        if (biomeBytes != null) {
            return new Column(source.getX(), source.getZ(), source.isFullChunk(), sections, tileEntities,
                    heightmaps, biomeBytes);
        }
        int[] biomeInts = source.getBiomeDataInts();
        if (biomeInts != null) {
            return new Column(source.getX(), source.getZ(), source.isFullChunk(), sections, tileEntities,
                    heightmaps, biomeInts);
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("column declared biome data without a biome payload");
    }

    private static Chunk_v1_18 uniformSection(BaseChunk source, int fakeBlockGlobalId,
                                               ClientVersion clientVersion) {
        if (!(source instanceof Chunk_v1_18 chunk)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported section implementation: " + source.getClass().getName());
        }
        DataPalette palette = new DataPalette(new SingletonPalette(fakeBlockGlobalId), null, PaletteType.CHUNK);
        return new Chunk_v1_18(clientVersion, 4096, 0, palette, chunk.getBiomeData());
    }

    private static Chunk_v1_18 copySection(BaseChunk source, ClientVersion clientVersion) {
        if (!(source instanceof Chunk_v1_18 chunk)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported section implementation: " + source.getClass().getName());
        }
        DataPalette copiedPalette = DataPalette.createForChunk();
        int fluids = chunk.getFluidCount();
        for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) {
            for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
                    int stateId = chunk.getBlockId(x, y, z);
                    copiedPalette.set(x, y, z, stateId);
                }
            }
        }
        return new Chunk_v1_18(clientVersion, chunk.getBlockCount(), fluids, copiedPalette, chunk.getBiomeData());
    }

}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainEntityVision.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import io.papermc.paper.event.entity.EntityMoveEvent;
import io.papermc.paper.event.player.PlayerTrackEntityEvent;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;
import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Entity;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityTeleportEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.vehicle.VehicleMoveEvent;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.EntityTarget;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.Scheduler;

import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

/**
 * Per-viewer underground-entity concealment built on Paper's own hide/show tracking.
 *
 * <p>Verified against the Paper 1.21.11 implementation ({@code CraftPlayer}): hiding removes
 * the viewer from the server tracker (a destroy packet is sent) and records our plugin in the
 * viewer's visibility set; the tracking tick consults that set on every attempt, so hidden
 * entities stay hidden without further packets. Showing removes our entry and re-runs the
 * tracker's own pairing step, which re-sends the complete current spawn state (identity,
 * metadata, equipment, pose) from server truth — no synthetic spawn packets are ever built,
 * so duplicates and stale state are impossible by construction. Both calls are idempotent:
 * hiding an already-hidden entity and showing a never-hidden entity touch nothing.
 *
 * <p>Three mechanisms cover every delivery path, and nothing else is needed because every
 * entity-to-client packet flows from tracker membership:
 * <ol>
 *   <li><b>Track gate.</b> {@code PlayerTrackEntityEvent} fires inside the tracker's pairing
 *   step, before any spawn bytes exist. Cancelling plus hiding here covers spawns, chunk
 *   loads, logins, and range entries uniformly.</li>
 *   <li><b>Motion evaluation.</b> Living-entity moves, vehicle moves, and teleports re-decide
 *   visibility when an entity crosses the concealment cutoff while already tracked.</li>
 *   <li><b>Transition sweeps.</b> When a viewer flips between masked and revealed (or changes
 *   world), nearby below-cutoff entities are reconciled one by one.</li>
 * </ol>
 *
 * <p>Threading: hide/show touch viewer-owned visibility state and entity-region tracker
 * state. All calls run on the subject entity's owning scheduler (entity events already run
 * there; sweep candidates hop there one-shot and revalidate everything inside the task), so
 * tracker structures are never touched cross-region. Viewer lookups are map reads only.
 * The viewer's own visibility map is a plain map inside CraftBukkit; concurrent hide/show
 * for the same viewer from different entity threads can race a single entry update, which
 * self-heals on the next entity event or viewer flip — there is no shared packet mutation
 * and nothing here can crash or corrupt client state. On Paper (single main thread) every
 * decision is exact.
 *
 * <p>State is deliberately minimal: no per-entity cache exists. Removal, disconnect, and
 * reconnect need no bookkeeping because reveal sweeps enumerate live entities and every
 * deferred task revalidates liveness, world, cutoff, mask state, and connection token
 * before acting.Viewer quit removes the service connection, which makes every pending
 * task for that connection abort.
 */
public final class TerrainEntityVision implements Listener {
    static final double SWEEP_RADIUS_XZ = 160.0;
    static final double SWEEP_RADIUS_Y = 80.0;
    static final int SWEEP_CANDIDATE_CAP = 512;

    private final Plugin plugin;
    private final Scheduler scheduler;
    private final TerrainMaskService masks;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final Function<UUID, Player> viewerLookup;
    private final Supplier<Collection<? extends Player>> onlineViewers;
    private final AtomicBoolean running = new AtomicBoolean(true);

    public TerrainEntityVision(Plugin plugin, Scheduler scheduler, TerrainMaskService masks, Logger logger) {
        this(plugin, scheduler, masks, logger, Bukkit::getPlayer, Bukkit::getOnlinePlayers);
    }

    TerrainEntityVision(Plugin plugin, Scheduler scheduler, TerrainMaskService masks, Logger logger,
                        Function<UUID, Player> viewerLookup,
                        Supplier<Collection<? extends Player>> onlineViewers) {
        this.plugin = Objects.requireNonNull(plugin, "plugin");
        this.scheduler = Objects.requireNonNull(scheduler, "scheduler");
        this.masks = Objects.requireNonNull(masks, "masks");
        this.logger = Objects.requireNonNull(logger, "logger");
        this.viewerLookup = Objects.requireNonNull(viewerLookup, "viewerLookup");
        this.onlineViewers = Objects.requireNonNull(onlineViewers, "onlineViewers");
    }

    /**
     * Reconciles nearby below-cutoff entities with the viewer's fresh mask state. Runs on the
     * viewer's owning thread (called from the mask transition path); every candidate hops to
     * its own entity scheduler and revalidates before acting.
     */
    public void onViewerTransition(Player viewer, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
        if (!running.get() || viewer == null || view == null) return;
        if (!view.configured() || !view.hideUndergroundEntities()) return;
        Collection<Entity> nearby;
        try {
            nearby = viewer.getNearbyEntities(SWEEP_RADIUS_XZ, SWEEP_RADIUS_Y, SWEEP_RADIUS_XZ);
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity sweep enumeration failed for " + view.playerId(), failure);
            return;
        }
        if (nearby == null || nearby.isEmpty()) return;
        UUID viewerId = view.playerId();
        UUID token = view.connectionToken();
        int scheduled = 0;
        for (Entity candidate : nearby) {
            if (candidate == null) continue;
            if (scheduled >= SWEEP_CANDIDATE_CAP) {
                masks.noteEntitySweepTruncated();
                break;
            }
            try {
                if (candidate.getUniqueId().equals(viewerId)) continue;
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                continue;
            }
            // Heuristic pre-filter only; the entity-thread task re-reads authoritative state.
            // Masked viewers consider everything (hide below cutoff, heal stale hides above);
            // revealed viewers only need below-cutoff restores.
            try {
                double y = candidate.getLocation().getY();
                if (!view.masked() && y >= view.hideBelowY()) continue;
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                continue;
            }
            try {
                scheduler.runAtEntity(new EntityTarget(candidate),
                        () -> actForViewer(viewerId, token, candidate));
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                masks.noteEntityFailure("entity sweep dispatch failed for " + viewerId, failure);
            }
            scheduled++;
        }
    }

    /** Entity-thread reconciliation for one sweep candidate. Revalidates everything. */
    private void actForViewer(UUID viewerId, UUID token, Entity subject) {
        if (!running.get() || subject == null) return;
        UUID subjectId;
        try {
            if (!subject.isValid() || !subject.isVisibleByDefault()) return;
            subjectId = subject.getUniqueId();
            if (subjectId.equals(viewerId)) return;
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            return;
        }
        TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view = masks.view(viewerId);
        if (view == null || !token.equals(view.connectionToken())) return;
        if (!view.configured() || !view.hideUndergroundEntities()) return;
        UUID worldUid;
        double y;
        try {
            World world = subject.getWorld();
            if (world == null || !view.worldId().equals(world.getUID())) return;
            y = subject.getLocation().getY();
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            return;
        }
        Player viewer;
        try {
            viewer = viewerLookup.apply(viewerId);
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("viewer lookup failed for " + viewerId, failure);
            return;
        }
        if (viewer == null) return;
        if (y < view.hideBelowY()) {
            if (view.masked()) conceal(viewer, subject);
            else reveal(viewer, subject);
        } else if (view.masked()) {
            // Heals entities that rose above the cutoff without observable motion
            // (non-living gradual movement); a no-op unless previously concealed.
            reveal(viewer, subject);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Track gate. Runs inside the tracker's pairing step on the subject entity's thread,
     * before any spawn bytes exist for this viewer. Covers spawns, chunk loads, logins,
     * and range entries uniformly.
     */
    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onTrackAttempt(PlayerTrackEntityEvent event) {
        if (!running.get()) return;
        Entity subject;
        Player viewer;
        try {
            subject = event.getEntity();
            viewer = event.getPlayer();
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity track evaluation failed", failure);
            return;
        }
        if (subject == null || viewer == null) return;
        UUID viewerId;
        UUID subjectId;
        double subjectY;
        UUID worldUid;
        String worldName;
        try {
            viewerId = viewer.getUniqueId();
            subjectId = subject.getUniqueId();
            if (viewerId.equals(subjectId)) return;
            if (!subject.isValid() || !subject.isVisibleByDefault()) return;
            World world = subject.getWorld();
            if (world == null) return;
            worldName = world.getName();
            worldUid = world.getUID();
            subjectY = subject.getLocation().getY();
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity track evaluation failed", failure);
            return;
        }
        TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view = masks.view(viewerId);
        if (!shouldConceal(view, worldUid, subjectY)) return;
        // Fail closed: even if hiding throws, cancel so no spawn is delivered without a
        // recorded concealment. Reveal sweeps only restore recorded entries.
        try {
            conceal(viewer, subject);
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity hide failed for viewer " + viewerId, failure);
        }
        event.setCancelled(true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onEntityMove(EntityMoveEvent event) {
        if (!running.get()) return;
        evaluateMotion(event.getEntity(), event.getFrom(), event.getTo());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onVehicleMove(VehicleMoveEvent event) {
        if (!running.get()) return;
        evaluateMotion(event.getVehicle(), event.getFrom(), event.getTo());
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onEntityTeleport(EntityTeleportEvent event) {
        if (!running.get()) return;
        evaluateMotion(event.getEntity(), event.getFrom(), event.getTo());
    }

    /**
     * Re-decides visibility when a subject moves or teleports. Runs on the subject's
     * owning thread (motion events fire there). Only Y motion relative to the concealment
     * cutoff can change the decision, so horizontal motion is a cheap no-op.
     */
    private void evaluateMotion(Entity subject, Location from, Location to) {
        if (subject == null || to == null || to.getWorld() == null) return;
        TerrainMaskConfig.WorldRule rule = masks.config().worlds().get(to.getWorld().getName());
        if (rule == null || !rule.enabled() || !rule.hideUndergroundEntities() || !masks.isEnabled()) return;
        UUID subjectId;
        try {
            if (!subject.isValid() || !subject.isVisibleByDefault()) return;
            subjectId = subject.getUniqueId();
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity motion evaluation failed", failure);
            return;
        }
        double fromY = from != null && from.getWorld() == to.getWorld() ? from.getY() : Double.NaN;
        double toY;
        UUID worldUid;
        try {
            toY = to.getY();
            worldUid = to.getWorld().getUID();
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity motion evaluation failed", failure);
            return;
        }
        for (TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view : masks.views()) {
            if (view == null || !view.configured() || !view.hideUndergroundEntities()) continue;
            if (!view.worldId().equals(worldUid)) continue;
            if (view.playerId().equals(subjectId)) continue;
            boolean wasBelow = fromY < view.hideBelowY();
            boolean nowBelow = toY < view.hideBelowY();
            if (!wasBelow && !nowBelow) continue;
            Player viewer;
            try {
                viewer = viewerLookup.apply(view.playerId());
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                masks.noteEntityFailure("viewer lookup failed for " + view.playerId(), failure);
                continue;
            }
            if (viewer == null) continue;
            try {
                if (view.masked()) {
                    if (nowBelow) conceal(viewer, subject);
                    else reveal(viewer, subject);
                } else if (wasBelow) {
                    reveal(viewer, subject);
                }
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                masks.noteEntityFailure("entity visibility update failed for viewer "
                        + view.playerId(), failure);
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean shouldConceal(TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view, UUID worldUid, double subjectY) {
        return view != null && view.configured() && view.masked() && view.hideUndergroundEntities()
                && view.worldId().equals(worldUid) && subjectY < view.hideBelowY();
    }

    /** Hides only if currently visible; the counter therefore counts actual flips. */
    private void conceal(Player viewer, Entity subject) {
        try {
            if (viewer.canSee(subject)) {
                viewer.hideEntity(plugin, subject);
                masks.noteEntitiesHidden();
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity hide failed", failure);
        }
    }

    /** Restores only if currently hidden; never force-tracks visible entities. */
    private void reveal(Player viewer, Entity subject) {
        try {
            if (!viewer.canSee(subject)) {
                viewer.showEntity(plugin, subject);
                masks.noteEntityRestored();
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            masks.noteEntityFailure("entity restore failed", failure);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Best-effort release of concealment on shutdown so a same-process re-enable starts
     * from clean visibility maps. Stale entries, if any survive, clear on viewer reconnect
     * because reconnecting creates fresh player objects.
     */
    public void shutdown() {
        if (!running.compareAndSet(true, false)) return;
        Collection<? extends Player> online;
        try {
            online = onlineViewers.get();
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            return;
        }
        if (online == null) return;
        for (Player viewer : online) {
            if (viewer == null) continue;
            TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view;
            try {
                view = masks.view(viewer.getUniqueId());
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                continue;
            }
            if (view == null || !view.configured() || !view.hideUndergroundEntities()) continue;
            Collection<Entity> nearby;
            try {
                nearby = viewer.getNearbyEntities(SWEEP_RADIUS_XZ, SWEEP_RADIUS_Y, SWEEP_RADIUS_XZ);
            } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                continue;
            }
            if (nearby == null) continue;
            int acted = 0;
            for (Entity subject : nearby) {
                if (acted++ >= SWEEP_CANDIDATE_CAP) break;
                try {
                    if (subject == null || subject.getUniqueId().equals(viewer.getUniqueId())) continue;
                    if (!subject.isValid() || !subject.isVisibleByDefault()) continue;
                    if (!view.worldId().equals(subject.getWorld().getUID())) continue;
                    if (subject.getLocation().getY() >= view.hideBelowY()) continue;
                    if (!viewer.canSee(subject)) viewer.showEntity(plugin, subject);
                } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                    // Best effort only; the server is stopping.
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainHeightmapSanitizer.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBT;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTCompound;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTLongArray;

import java.util.Objects;

/** Clamps client heightmaps to the synthetic solid surface introduced by AIR masking. */
public final class TerrainHeightmapSanitizer {
    private static final int COLUMN_COUNT = 16 * 16;

    private TerrainHeightmapSanitizer() { }

    public static NBTCompound sanitize(NBTCompound source, int minWorldY, int sectionCount,
                                       int hideBelowY, boolean hideAir) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(source, "source");
        if (sectionCount <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("chunk has no sections");
        if ((minWorldY & 15) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("minimum world Y is not section-aligned");

        NBTCompound result = source.copy();
        if (!hideAir || hideBelowY <= minWorldY) return result;
        if (result.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing chunk heightmaps for AIR masking");

        int worldHeight = Math.multiplyExact(sectionCount, 16);
        int bitsPerEntry = 32 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(worldHeight);
        int entriesPerLong = Long.SIZE / bitsPerEntry;
        int expectedLongs = (COLUMN_COUNT + entriesPerLong - 1) / entriesPerLong;
        int concealedSurface = Math.min(worldHeight, hideBelowY - minWorldY);
        long valueMask = (1L << bitsPerEntry) - 1L;

        for (String name : result.getTagNames()) {
            NBT tag = result.getTagOrNull(name);
            if (!(tag instanceof NBTLongArray array)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid chunk heightmap tag " + name);
            }
            long[] packed = array.getValue().clone();
            if (packed.length != expectedLongs) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid chunk heightmap length for " + name
                        + ": " + packed.length + " expected=" + expectedLongs);
            }
            for (int index = 0; index < COLUMN_COUNT; index++) {
                int word = index / entriesPerLong;
                int shift = index % entriesPerLong * bitsPerEntry;
                long value = packed[word] >>> shift & valueMask;
                if (value < concealedSurface) {
                    packed[word] = packed[word] & ~(valueMask << shift)
                            | (long) concealedSurface << shift;
                }
            }
            result.setTag(name, new NBTLongArray(packed));
        }
        return result;
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainLightSanitizer.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.LightData;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.BitSet;
import java.util.List;

/** Removes light below the concealment cutoff while preserving visible-section arrays. */
public final class TerrainLightSanitizer {
    private TerrainLightSanitizer() { }

    public static LightData sanitize(LightData original, int minWorldY, int hideBelowY) {
        if (original == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("missing light data");
        if ((minWorldY & 15) != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("minimum world Y is not section-aligned");
        LightData result = original.clone();
        int minSectionY = minWorldY >> 4;
        sanitizeChannel(original.getBlockLightMask(), original.getEmptyBlockLightMask(),
                original.getBlockLightArray(), result::setBlockLightMask, result::setEmptyBlockLightMask,
                result::setBlockLightArray, result::setBlockLightCount, minSectionY, hideBelowY);
        sanitizeChannel(original.getSkyLightMask(), original.getEmptySkyLightMask(),
                original.getSkyLightArray(), result::setSkyLightMask, result::setEmptySkyLightMask,
                result::setSkyLightArray, result::setSkyLightCount, minSectionY, hideBelowY);
        return result;
    }

    private static void sanitizeChannel(BitSet dataMask, BitSet emptyMask, byte[][] arrays,
                                        BitSetConsumer dataSetter, BitSetConsumer emptySetter,
                                        BytesConsumer arraysSetter, IntConsumer countSetter,
                                        int minSectionY, int hideBelowY) {
        if (dataMask == null || emptyMask == null || arrays == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("incomplete light masks or arrays");
        }
        BitSet outputDataMask = (BitSet) dataMask.clone();
        BitSet outputEmptyMask = (BitSet) emptyMask.clone();
        List<byte[]> outputArrays = new ArrayList<>(arrays.length);
        int arrayIndex = 0;
        for (int bit = dataMask.nextSetBit(0); bit >= 0; bit = dataMask.nextSetBit(bit + 1)) {
            if (arrayIndex >= arrays.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("light mask exceeds array count");
            byte[] source = arrays[arrayIndex++];
            if (source == null || source.length != 2048) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid light section array");
            }
            int sectionY = minSectionY + bit - 1;
            int sectionMinY = sectionY << 4;
            byte[] copy = source.clone();
            if (sectionMinY + 16 <= hideBelowY) {
                outputDataMask.clear(bit);
                outputEmptyMask.set(bit);
                continue;
            }
            if (sectionMinY < hideBelowY) {
                int hiddenBlocks = hideBelowY - sectionMinY;
                for (int localY = 0; localY < 16 && localY < hiddenBlocks; localY++) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                        for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) {
                            int nibble = (localY << 8) | (z << 4) | x;
                            int byteIndex = nibble >>> 1;
                            copy[byteIndex] = (byte) ((nibble & 1) == 0
                                    ? copy[byteIndex] & 0xF0 : copy[byteIndex] & 0x0F);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            outputEmptyMask.clear(bit);
            outputArrays.add(copy);
        }
        if (arrayIndex != arrays.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("unreferenced light arrays present");
        dataSetter.accept(outputDataMask);
        emptySetter.accept(outputEmptyMask);
        byte[][] packed = outputArrays.toArray(byte[][]::new);
        arraysSetter.accept(packed);
        countSetter.accept(packed.length);
    }

    @FunctionalInterface private interface BitSetConsumer { void accept(BitSet bits); }
    @FunctionalInterface private interface BytesConsumer { void accept(byte[][] bytes); }
    @FunctionalInterface private interface IntConsumer { void accept(int value); }
}

```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainMaskConfig.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import org.bukkit.Material;
import org.bukkit.configuration.ConfigurationSection;
import org.bukkit.configuration.InvalidConfigurationException;
import org.bukkit.configuration.file.YamlConfiguration;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Immutable, strictly validated terrain-mask settings. */
public record TerrainMaskConfig(boolean enabled, Map<String, WorldRule> worlds,
                                int maxChunksPerPlayerPerTick, int maxPendingChunksPerPlayer,
                                int maxCachedChunksPerPlayer,
                                boolean bedrockEnabled, String error) {
    public static final int MAX_WORLD_Y = 2048;
    public static final int MAX_CACHED_CHUNKS_PER_PLAYER = 8192;

    public record WorldRule(boolean enabled, int hideBelowY, int maskWhenPlayerAboveY,
                            Material fakeBlock, boolean hideAir, boolean hideBlockEntities,
                            boolean hideUndergroundEntities) {
        public WorldRule {
            Objects.requireNonNull(fakeBlock, "fakeBlock");
        }
    }

    public TerrainMaskConfig {
        worlds = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(worlds));
        error = error == null ? "" : error;
    }

    public static TerrainMaskConfig load(Path file) throws IOException, InvalidConfigurationException {
        YamlConfiguration yaml = new YamlConfiguration();
        yaml.load(file.toFile());
        return parse(yaml);
    }

    public static TerrainMaskConfig parse(String yamlText) throws InvalidConfigurationException {
        YamlConfiguration yaml = new YamlConfiguration();
        yaml.loadFromString(Objects.requireNonNull(yamlText, "yamlText"));
        return parse(yaml);
    }

    private static TerrainMaskConfig parse(YamlConfiguration yaml) {
        ConfigurationSection root = yaml.getConfigurationSection("terrain-mask");
        if (root == null) {
            throw reject("Missing required section terrain-mask");
        }
        requireKeys(root, "enabled", "worlds", "refresh", "bedrock");
        boolean enabled = booleanValue(root, "enabled");

        ConfigurationSection worldsSection = root.getConfigurationSection("worlds");
        if (worldsSection == null) throw reject("terrain-mask.worlds must be a mapping");
        Map<String, WorldRule> worlds = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String worldName : worldsSection.getKeys(false)) {
            if (worldName == null || worldName.isBlank()) {
                throw reject("terrain-mask.worlds contains an empty world name");
            }
            ConfigurationSection section = worldsSection.getConfigurationSection(worldName);
            if (section == null) throw reject("terrain-mask.worlds." + worldName + " must be a mapping");
            String prefix = "terrain-mask.worlds." + worldName + ".";
            requireKeys(section, "enabled", "hide-below-y", "mask-when-player-above-y",
                    "fake-block", "hide-air", "hide-block-entities", "hide-underground-entities");
            boolean ruleEnabled = booleanValue(section, "enabled");
            int hideBelowY = integerValue(section, "hide-below-y");
            int revealY = integerValue(section, "mask-when-player-above-y");
            checkY(prefix + "hide-below-y", hideBelowY);
            checkY(prefix + "mask-when-player-above-y", revealY);
            if (revealY < hideBelowY) {
                throw reject(prefix + "mask-when-player-above-y must be >= hide-below-y");
            }
            String materialName = stringValue(section, "fake-block");
            Material material = Material.matchMaterial(materialName);
            if (material == null || material.name().equals("AIR") || material.name().endsWith("_AIR")) {
                throw reject(prefix + "fake-block is not a supported non-air material: " + materialName);
            }
            worlds.put(worldName, new WorldRule(ruleEnabled, hideBelowY, revealY, material,
                    booleanValue(section, "hide-air"), booleanValue(section, "hide-block-entities"),
                    booleanValue(section, "hide-underground-entities")));
        }

        ConfigurationSection refresh = root.getConfigurationSection("refresh");
        if (refresh == null) throw reject("terrain-mask.refresh must be a mapping");
        requireKeys(refresh, "max-chunks-per-player-per-tick", "max-pending-chunks-per-player",
                "max-cached-chunks-per-player");
        int refreshLimit = integerValue(refresh, "max-chunks-per-player-per-tick");
        int pendingLimit = integerValue(refresh, "max-pending-chunks-per-player");
        int cacheLimit = integerValue(refresh, "max-cached-chunks-per-player");
        if (refreshLimit < 1 || refreshLimit > 64) {
            throw reject("terrain-mask.refresh.max-chunks-per-player-per-tick must be between 1 and 64");
        }
        if (pendingLimit < 1 || pendingLimit > MAX_CACHED_CHUNKS_PER_PLAYER) {
            throw reject("terrain-mask.refresh.max-pending-chunks-per-player must be between 1 and "
                    + MAX_CACHED_CHUNKS_PER_PLAYER);
        }
        if (cacheLimit < 1 || cacheLimit > MAX_CACHED_CHUNKS_PER_PLAYER) {
            throw reject("terrain-mask.refresh.max-cached-chunks-per-player must be between 1 and "
                    + MAX_CACHED_CHUNKS_PER_PLAYER);
        }
        if (pendingLimit < cacheLimit) {
            throw reject("terrain-mask.refresh.max-pending-chunks-per-player must be >= "
                    + "max-cached-chunks-per-player so every cached chunk can be refreshed on a transition");
        }

        ConfigurationSection bedrock = root.getConfigurationSection("bedrock");
        if (bedrock == null) throw reject("terrain-mask.bedrock must be a mapping");
        requireKeys(bedrock, "enabled");
        return new TerrainMaskConfig(enabled, worlds, refreshLimit, pendingLimit, cacheLimit,
                booleanValue(bedrock, "enabled"), "");
    }

    public static TerrainMaskConfig invalid(String message) {
        return new TerrainMaskConfig(false, Map.of(), 1, 1, 1, false,
                Objects.requireNonNullElse(message, "invalid terrain-mask configuration"));
    }

    private static void checkY(String key, int value) {
        if (value < -MAX_WORLD_Y || value > MAX_WORLD_Y) {
            throw reject(key + " must be between -" + MAX_WORLD_Y + " and " + MAX_WORLD_Y);
        }
    }

    private static boolean booleanValue(ConfigurationSection section, String key) {
        Object value = section.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof Boolean result)) {
            throw reject("terrain-mask." + section.getCurrentPath() + "." + key + " must be true or false");
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static int integerValue(ConfigurationSection section, String key) {
        Object value = section.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof Number number) || number.doubleValue() != number.intValue()) {
            throw reject(section.getCurrentPath() + "." + key + " must be an integer");
        }
        return number.intValue();
    }

    private static String stringValue(ConfigurationSection section, String key) {
        Object value = section.get(key);
        if (!(value instanceof String string) || string.isBlank()) {
            throw reject(section.getCurrentPath() + "." + key + " must be a non-empty string");
        }
        return string;
    }

    private static void requireKeys(ConfigurationSection section, String... allowed) {
        for (String key : section.getKeys(false)) {
            boolean found = false;
            for (String candidate : allowed) {
                if (candidate.equals(key)) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) throw reject("Unsupported setting " + section.getCurrentPath() + "." + key);
        }
        for (String key : allowed) {
            if (!section.contains(key)) throw reject("Missing required setting " + section.getCurrentPath() + "." + key);
        }
    }

    private static IllegalArgumentException reject(String message) {
        return new IllegalArgumentException(message);
    }
}
```
