`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainMaskPositionPolicy.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

/** Conservative tests for position-bearing effects that can expose concealed terrain. */
public final class TerrainMaskPositionPolicy {
    private TerrainMaskPositionPolicy() { }

    /**
     * PacketEvents 2.14 uses a center and strength for modern explosion packets, not the legacy
     * per-block coordinate list. Treat a blast with a radius reaching the hidden range as unsafe.
     */
    public static boolean explosionMayAffectHiddenTerrain(double centerY, float strength, int hideBelowY) {
        if (!Double.isFinite(centerY) || !Float.isFinite(strength) || strength < 0) return true;
        double conservativeLowerBound = centerY - (double) strength * 2.0;
        return conservativeLowerBound < hideBelowY;
    }
}

```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainMaskService.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import org.bukkit.Location;
import org.bukkit.World;
import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
import org.bukkit.event.EventHandler;
import org.bukkit.event.EventPriority;
import org.bukkit.event.Listener;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerChangedWorldEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerJoinEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerMoveEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerQuitEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerRespawnEvent;
import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerTeleportEvent;
import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.ClientPlatformService;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.EntityTarget;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.Scheduler;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Deque;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.LongAdder;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

/** Per-connection immutable view state plus region-owned, bounded transition refresh work. */
public final class TerrainMaskService implements Listener {
    public enum ListenerStatus { DISABLED, WARMING, READY, DEGRADED, UNAVAILABLE, ERROR }

    /** Immutable snapshot read by packet callbacks; it contains no Bukkit entity references. */
    public record PlayerView(UUID playerId, UUID connectionToken, UUID worldId, String worldName,
                             int minWorldY, int maxWorldY, double feetY, boolean configured,
                             boolean masked, int hideBelowY, int revealAboveY, String fakeBlock,
                             boolean hideAir, boolean hideBlockEntities, boolean hideUndergroundEntities,
                             boolean exempt) { }

    public record Diagnostics(boolean enabled, ListenerStatus listenerStatus, String detail,
                              List<String> protectedWorlds, List<String> worldSettings,
                              long maskedChunks, long refreshedChunks,
                              long blockUpdatesRewritten, long rewriteFailures, long refreshFailures,
                              int connectedPlayers, long pendingRefreshChunks, long cachedChunks,
                              long transitionCount, long lastCompletedTransition, int maxChunksPerPlayerPerTick,
                              int playersWithIncompleteRefresh,
                              boolean blockEntityProtection, boolean lightProtection,
                              String entityProtection, boolean bedrockEnabled,
                              long entitiesHidden, long entityRestores, long entitySweepTruncated,
                              long entitySpawnsToMasked, long entitySpawnsToRevealed,
                              long entityFailures) { }

    private static final class Connection {
        private final UUID token = UUID.randomUUID();
        private final UUID playerId;
        private final AtomicReference<PlayerView> view = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final ConcurrentHashMap<Long, Object> chunks = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        private final Deque<Long> pending = new ArrayDeque<>();
        private final HashSet<Long> queued = new HashSet<>();
        private final AtomicBoolean pumpScheduled = new AtomicBoolean();
        private volatile Object packetUser;
        private volatile boolean refreshIncomplete;
        private volatile long lastCompletedTransition;
        private long transition;

        private Connection(UUID playerId) {
            this.playerId = playerId;
        }
    }

    private final Plugin plugin;
    private final Scheduler scheduler;
    private final TerrainMaskConfig config;
    private final ClientPlatformService platforms;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final ConcurrentHashMap<UUID, Connection> connections = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final AtomicReference<TerrainMaskPacketGateway> gateway = new AtomicReference<>();
    private final AtomicReference<ListenerStatus> listenerStatus = new AtomicReference<>(ListenerStatus.WARMING);
    private final AtomicReference<String> listenerDetail = new AtomicReference<>("preflight pending");
    private final LongAdder maskedChunks = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder refreshedChunks = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder blockUpdatesRewritten = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder rewriteFailures = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder refreshFailures = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder entitiesHidden = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder entityRestores = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder entitySweepTruncated = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder entitySpawnsToMasked = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder entitySpawnsToRevealed = new LongAdder();
    private final LongAdder entityFailures = new LongAdder();
    private final AtomicLong transitionCount = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicLong lastFailureLog = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicLong lastEntityFailureLog = new AtomicLong();
    private final AtomicReference<TerrainEntityVision> entityVision = new AtomicReference<>();

    public TerrainMaskService(Plugin plugin, Scheduler scheduler, TerrainMaskConfig config,
                              ClientPlatformService platforms, Logger logger) {
        this.plugin = Objects.requireNonNull(plugin, "plugin");
        this.scheduler = Objects.requireNonNull(scheduler, "scheduler");
        this.config = Objects.requireNonNull(config, "config");
        this.platforms = platforms;
        this.logger = Objects.requireNonNull(logger, "logger");
        this.listenerStatus.set(config.enabled() && !config.worlds().isEmpty()
                ? ListenerStatus.WARMING : ListenerStatus.DISABLED);
        this.listenerDetail.set(config.error().isBlank() ? "packet preflight pending" : config.error());
    }

    public TerrainMaskConfig config() {
        return config;
    }

    public void installGateway(TerrainMaskPacketGateway replacement, boolean ready, String detail) {
        gateway.set(replacement);
        listenerStatus.set(ready ? ListenerStatus.READY
                : config.enabled() && !config.worlds().isEmpty() ? ListenerStatus.ERROR : ListenerStatus.DISABLED);
        listenerDetail.set(Objects.requireNonNullElse(detail, "no packet gateway"));
    }

    public void integrationUnavailable(String detail) {
        gateway.set(null);
        listenerStatus.set(config.enabled() && !config.worlds().isEmpty()
                ? ListenerStatus.UNAVAILABLE : ListenerStatus.DISABLED);
        listenerDetail.set(Objects.requireNonNullElse(detail, "PacketEvents unavailable"));
    }

    public void integrationFailed(String detail) {
        gateway.set(null);
        listenerStatus.set(ListenerStatus.ERROR);
        listenerDetail.set(Objects.requireNonNullElse(detail, "PacketEvents integration failed"));
    }

    public boolean isEnabled() {
        return config.enabled() && !config.worlds().isEmpty();
    }

    public PlayerView view(UUID playerId) {
        Connection connection = connections.get(playerId);
        return connection == null ? null : connection.view.get();
    }

    public Object connection(UUID playerId) {
        return connections.get(playerId);
    }

    public PlayerView view(Object handle) {
        return handle instanceof Connection connection ? connection.view.get() : null;
    }

    /** Immutable snapshots of every connected viewer; safe to read from any thread. */
    public List<PlayerView> views() {
        List<PlayerView> snapshot = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Connection connection : connections.values()) {
            PlayerView view = connection.view.get();
            if (view != null) snapshot.add(view);
        }
        return snapshot;
    }

    /** Attaches the entity-visibility component; null detaches. Called once during plugin wiring. */
    public void setEntityVision(TerrainEntityVision vision) {
        entityVision.set(vision);
    }

    public void packetUser(UUID playerId, Object user) {
        Connection connection = connections.get(playerId);
        if (connection != null && user != null) connection.packetUser = user;
    }

    public void cacheChunk(UUID playerId, long chunkKey, Object payload) {
        cacheChunkIfAvailable(playerId, chunkKey, payload);
    }

    /**
     * Stores a real per-viewer snapshot without evicting a still-loaded chunk. Returning false
     * means the caller must suppress the outgoing chunk: sending it uncached could leave real
     * terrain resident on the client when the viewer later crosses into the masked state.
     */
    public boolean cacheChunkIfAvailable(UUID playerId, long chunkKey, Object payload) {
        Connection connection = connections.get(playerId);
        if (connection == null || payload == null) return false;
        synchronized (connection.chunks) {
            if (!connection.chunks.containsKey(chunkKey)
                    && connection.chunks.size() >= config.maxCachedChunksPerPlayer()) {
                connection.refreshIncomplete = true;
                return false;
            }
            connection.chunks.put(chunkKey, payload);
            return true;
        }
    }

    public Object cachedChunk(UUID playerId, long chunkKey) {
        Connection connection = connections.get(playerId);
        return connection == null ? null : connection.chunks.get(chunkKey);
    }

    public void unloadChunk(UUID playerId, long chunkKey) {
        Connection connection = connections.get(playerId);
        if (connection == null) return;
        connection.chunks.remove(chunkKey);
        synchronized (connection.pending) {
            connection.pending.remove(chunkKey);
            connection.queued.remove(chunkKey);
        }
    }

    public void noteMaskedChunk() {
        maskedChunks.increment();
    }

    public void noteRefreshedChunk() {
        refreshedChunks.increment();
    }

    public void noteBlockUpdateRewritten() {
        blockUpdatesRewritten.increment();
    }

    public void noteEntitiesHidden() {
        entitiesHidden.increment();
    }

    public void noteEntityRestored() {
        entityRestores.increment();
    }

    public void noteEntitySweepTruncated() {
        entitySweepTruncated.increment();
    }

    public void noteEntitySpawnObserved(boolean toMaskedViewer) {
        if (toMaskedViewer) entitySpawnsToMasked.increment();
        else entitySpawnsToRevealed.increment();
    }

    public void noteEntityFailure(String message, Throwable failure) {
        entityFailures.increment();
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long before = lastEntityFailureLog.get();
        if (now - before >= 30_000 && lastEntityFailureLog.compareAndSet(before, now)) {
            logger.log(Level.WARNING, "Terrain entity visibility action failed; "
                    + "the affected entity keeps its previous visibility. " + message, failure);
        }
    }

    public void noteRewriteFailure(String message, Throwable failure) {
        rewriteFailures.increment();
        listenerStatus.set(ListenerStatus.ERROR);
        listenerDetail.set(Objects.requireNonNullElse(message, "packet rewrite failure"));
        long now = System.currentTimeMillis();
        long before = lastFailureLog.get();
        if (now - before >= 30_000 && lastFailureLog.compareAndSet(before, now)) {
            logger.log(Level.SEVERE, "Terrain mask rewrite failed; affected packet was suppressed. "
                    + "Check PacketEvents 2.14.0 and server version compatibility. " + message,
                    failure);
        }
    }

    public void noteRefreshFailure(String message, Throwable failure) {
        refreshFailures.increment();
        listenerStatus.set(ListenerStatus.ERROR);
        listenerDetail.set(Objects.requireNonNullElse(message, "chunk refresh failure"));
        logger.log(Level.WARNING, "Terrain mask transition refresh failed; some client chunks may be stale: "
                + message, failure);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onJoin(PlayerJoinEvent event) {
        Player player = event.getPlayer();
        update(player, player.getLocation(), true, false);
        Connection connection = connections.get(player.getUniqueId());
        if (connection != null) {
            // The join-event location can predate spawn positioning (a fresh spawn at y=6
            // was observed reporting y=0.0 here): re-read the settled position shortly after
            // join. Bounded to two one-shot checks; each aborts unless this same connection
            // is still live, so quit/rejoin can never apply a stale position.
            scheduleJoinResync(player, connection, 2L);
            scheduleJoinResync(player, connection, 10L);
        }
    }

    private void scheduleJoinResync(Player player, Connection connection, long delayTicks) {
        UUID playerId = player.getUniqueId();
        try {
            scheduler.runGlobalLater(() -> {
                if (connections.get(playerId) != connection) return;
                try {
                    scheduler.runAtEntity(new EntityTarget(player), () -> {
                        if (connections.get(playerId) != connection) return;
                        update(player, player.getLocation(), false, true);
                    });
                } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
                    noteRefreshFailure("join resync dispatch failed for " + playerId, failure);
                }
            }, delayTicks);
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            noteRefreshFailure("join resync scheduling failed for " + playerId, failure);
        }
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onMove(PlayerMoveEvent event) {
        Location from = event.getFrom();
        Location to = event.getTo();
        if (to == null) return;
        if (from.getWorld() == to.getWorld() && from.getY() == to.getY()) return;
        update(event.getPlayer(), to, false, true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR, ignoreCancelled = true)
    public void onTeleport(PlayerTeleportEvent event) {
        // PlayerTeleportEvent has its own handler list: PlayerMoveEvent handlers never see
        // teleports, so command/plugin teleports need this explicit funnel or the mask state
        // goes stale across them.
        Location from = event.getFrom();
        Location to = event.getTo();
        if (to == null || to.getWorld() == null) return;
        if (from != null && from.getWorld() == to.getWorld() && from.getY() == to.getY()) return;
        update(event.getPlayer(), to, false, true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onRespawn(PlayerRespawnEvent event) {
        update(event.getPlayer(), event.getRespawnLocation(), false, true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onWorldChange(PlayerChangedWorldEvent event) {
        update(event.getPlayer(), event.getPlayer().getLocation(), false, true);
    }

    @EventHandler(priority = EventPriority.MONITOR)
    public void onQuit(PlayerQuitEvent event) {
        Connection removed = connections.remove(event.getPlayer().getUniqueId());
        if (removed != null) {
            removed.chunks.clear();
            synchronized (removed.pending) {
                removed.pending.clear();
                removed.queued.clear();
            }
            removed.packetUser = null;
        }
    }

    /** May only be called from the player's owning region/event thread. */
    private void update(Player player, Location location, boolean newConnection, boolean positionTrusted) {
        if (player == null || location == null || location.getWorld() == null) return;
        UUID playerId = player.getUniqueId();
        World world = location.getWorld();
        TerrainMaskConfig.WorldRule rule = config.worlds().get(world.getName());
        ClientPlatformService.Classification platform = platforms == null ? null : platforms.get(playerId);
        boolean bedrockExempt = platform != null && !config.bedrockEnabled()
                && (platform.state() == ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK
                || platform.state() == ClientPlatformService.State.UNKNOWN);
        boolean bypass = player.hasPermission("vanticheat.terrainmask.bypass");
        boolean configured = config.enabled() && rule != null && rule.enabled();
        boolean eligible = configured && !bedrockExempt && !bypass;
        // A fresh join reports a provisional location that can predate spawn positioning
        // (y=0.0 observed for a spawn that settled at y=6). While the position is
        // unvalidated, fail closed: an eligible viewer starts masked, and the join resync
        // releases the provisional state once the settled position is known. A brief fake
        // view for an actually-underground joiner is preferable to leaking real data.
        boolean masked = eligible && (!positionTrusted || location.getY() > rule.maskWhenPlayerAboveY());

        Connection connection = connections.get(playerId);
        if (newConnection || connection == null) {
            Connection replacement = new Connection(playerId);
            Connection prior = connections.put(playerId, replacement);
            if (prior != null) clear(prior);
            connection = replacement;
        }
        PlayerView previous = connection.view.get();
        boolean worldChanged = previous == null || !Objects.equals(previous.worldId(), world.getUID());
        if (worldChanged) {
            connection.chunks.clear();
            connection.refreshIncomplete = false;
            synchronized (connection.pending) {
                connection.pending.clear();
                connection.queued.clear();
                connection.lastCompletedTransition = connection.transition;
            }
        }
        PlayerView current = new PlayerView(playerId, connection.token, world.getUID(), world.getName(),
                world.getMinHeight(), world.getMaxHeight(), location.getY(), configured, masked,
                rule == null ? 0 : rule.hideBelowY(), rule == null ? 0 : rule.maskWhenPlayerAboveY(),
                rule == null ? "DEEPSLATE" : rule.fakeBlock().name(),
                rule != null && rule.hideAir(), rule != null && rule.hideBlockEntities(),
                rule != null && rule.hideUndergroundEntities(), bedrockExempt || bypass);
        connection.view.set(current);

        boolean transition = previous != null && !worldChanged && previous.masked() != current.masked();
        if (transition) {
            synchronized (connection.pending) {
                connection.transition++;
                transitionCount.incrementAndGet();
                int limit = config.maxPendingChunksPerPlayer();
                for (long key : connection.chunks.keySet()) {
                    if (connection.queued.contains(key)) continue;
                    if (connection.pending.size() >= limit) {
                        connection.refreshIncomplete = true;
                        break;
                    }
                    connection.pending.addLast(key);
                    connection.queued.add(key);
                }
            }
            schedulePump(player, connection);
        }
        TerrainEntityVision vision = entityVision.get();
        if (vision != null && previous != null && (transition || worldChanged)
                && rule != null && rule.enabled() && rule.hideUndergroundEntities()) {
            // Fresh joins (previous == null) track nothing yet, so there is nothing to
            // conceal or restore; entity spawns after join are covered by the track gate.
            vision.onViewerTransition(player, current);
        }
    }

    private void schedulePump(Player player, Connection connection) {
        if (!connection.pumpScheduled.compareAndSet(false, true)) return;
        try {
            scheduler.runAtEntity(new EntityTarget(player), () -> pump(player, connection),
                    () -> connection.pumpScheduled.set(false));
        } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
            connection.pumpScheduled.set(false);
            noteRefreshFailure("unable to schedule player-region refresh for " + connection.playerId, failure);
        }
    }

    /** Runs on the player's entity scheduler and submits at most the configured number per tick. */
    private void pump(Player player, Connection connection) {
        try {
            if (connections.get(connection.playerId) != connection) return;
            TerrainMaskPacketGateway activeGateway = gateway.get();
            Object packetUser = connection.packetUser;
            if (activeGateway == null || packetUser == null) {
                connection.refreshIncomplete = true;
                noteRefreshFailure("PacketEvents connection is not ready for " + connection.playerId,
                        new IllegalStateException("missing packet user or gateway"));
                return;
            }
            List<Long> batch = new ArrayList<>(config.maxChunksPerPlayerPerTick());
            synchronized (connection.pending) {
                for (int index = 0; index < config.maxChunksPerPlayerPerTick(); index++) {
                    Long key = connection.pending.pollFirst();
                    if (key == null) break;
                    connection.queued.remove(key);
                    batch.add(key);
                }
            }
            PlayerView view = connection.view.get();
            if (view == null || !view.connectionToken().equals(connection.token)) return;
            for (long key : batch) {
                if (connections.get(connection.playerId) != connection) return;
                Object payload = connection.chunks.get(key);
                if (payload == null) continue;
                if (!activeGateway.sendCachedChunk(packetUser, payload, connection.view.get())) {
                    connection.refreshIncomplete = true;
                    noteRefreshFailure("could not resend cached chunk key=" + key, null);
                } else {
                    refreshedChunks.increment();
                }
            }
            synchronized (connection.pending) {
                if (connection.pending.isEmpty()) {
                    connection.lastCompletedTransition = connection.transition;
                }
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException | LinkageError failure) {
            noteRefreshFailure("region-owned chunk refresh failed for " + connection.playerId, failure);
        } finally {
            connection.pumpScheduled.set(false);
            synchronized (connection.pending) {
                if (!connection.pending.isEmpty() && connections.get(connection.playerId) == connection) {
                    schedulePump(player, connection);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void clear(Connection connection) {
        connection.chunks.clear();
        synchronized (connection.pending) {
            connection.pending.clear();
            connection.queued.clear();
        }
        connection.packetUser = null;
    }

    public Diagnostics diagnostics() {
        long pending = 0;
        long cached = 0;
        long transitionsComplete = 0;
        int incomplete = 0;
        for (Connection connection : connections.values()) {
            synchronized (connection.pending) {
                pending += connection.pending.size();
            }
            cached += connection.chunks.size();
            transitionsComplete = Math.max(transitionsComplete, connection.lastCompletedTransition);
            if (connection.refreshIncomplete) incomplete++;
        }
        return new Diagnostics(config.enabled(), listenerStatus.get(), listenerDetail.get(),
                config.worlds().entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue().enabled())
                        .map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList(),
                config.worlds().entrySet().stream().filter(entry -> entry.getValue().enabled())
                        .map(entry -> entry.getKey() + "(hideBelow=" + entry.getValue().hideBelowY()
                                + ", maskAbove=" + entry.getValue().maskWhenPlayerAboveY()
                                + ", fake=" + entry.getValue().fakeBlock().name()
                                + ", hideAir=" + entry.getValue().hideAir() + ")").toList(),
                maskedChunks.sum(), refreshedChunks.sum(),
                blockUpdatesRewritten.sum(), rewriteFailures.sum(), refreshFailures.sum(),
                connections.size(), pending, cached, transitionCount.get(), transitionsComplete,
                config.maxChunksPerPlayerPerTick(), incomplete,
                true, true, entityProtectionConfigured()
                        ? "ACTIVE: per-viewer hide/show (hidden=" + entitiesHidden.sum()
                        + ", restored=" + entityRestores.sum()
                        + ", sweepTruncated=" + entitySweepTruncated.sum()
                        + ", failures=" + entityFailures.sum() + ")"
                        : "DISABLED_BY_CONFIG",
                config.bedrockEnabled(),
                entitiesHidden.sum(), entityRestores.sum(), entitySweepTruncated.sum(),
                entitySpawnsToMasked.sum(), entitySpawnsToRevealed.sum(), entityFailures.sum());
    }

    private boolean entityProtectionConfigured() {
        return config.worlds().values().stream()
                .anyMatch(rule -> rule.enabled() && rule.hideUndergroundEntities());
    }

    public void shutdown() {
        gateway.set(null);
        for (Connection connection : connections.values()) clear(connection);
        connections.clear();
        listenerStatus.set(ListenerStatus.DISABLED);
        listenerDetail.set("shut down");
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/trusted/PersistentTrustedPlayerService.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public final class PersistentTrustedPlayerService implements TrustedPlayerService {
    private final Path file;
    private final Logger logger;
    private final Map<UUID, TrustedPlayer> players = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public PersistentTrustedPlayerService(Path file, Logger logger) {
        this.file = file;
        this.logger = logger;
    }

    @Override public boolean isTrusted(UUID id) { return id != null && players.containsKey(id); }

    @Override
    public synchronized boolean add(UUID id, String name) {
        TrustedPlayer current = players.get(id);
        if (current != null) {
            if (!current.name().equals(name)) players.put(id, new TrustedPlayer(id, name, current.addedAt()));
            return false;
        }
        players.put(id, new TrustedPlayer(id, name, Instant.now()));
        return true;
    }

    @Override public synchronized boolean remove(UUID id) { return players.remove(id) != null; }

    @Override public int size() { return players.size(); }

    @Override
    public List<TrustedPlayer> list() {
        return players.values().stream()
                .sorted(Comparator.comparing(TrustedPlayer::name, String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER)
                        .thenComparing(value -> value.id().toString()))
                .toList();
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void load() {
        players.clear();
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file)) return;
        try {
            parse(Files.readAllLines(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            logger.log(Level.WARNING, "Unable to load trusted-players.yml; starting with an empty list", exception);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized void save() {
        try {
            Path parent = file.getParent();
            if (parent != null) Files.createDirectories(parent);
            Path temporary = file.resolveSibling(file.getFileName() + ".tmp");
            Files.writeString(temporary, yaml(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            try {
                Files.move(temporary, file, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException exception) {
                Files.move(temporary, file, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            }
        } catch (IOException exception) {
            logger.log(Level.WARNING, "Unable to save trusted-players.yml", exception);
        }
    }

    private void parse(List<String> lines) {
        UUID id = null;
        String name = null;
        Instant addedAt = null;
        for (String raw : lines) {
            String line = raw.stripTrailing();
            if (line.isBlank() || line.stripLeading().startsWith("#") || line.trim().equals("trusted-players:")) continue;
            int indent = line.length() - line.stripLeading().length();
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (indent == 2 && trimmed.endsWith(":")) {
                store(id, name, addedAt);
                id = parseUuid(trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.length() - 1));
                name = null;
                addedAt = null;
            } else if (indent >= 4 && id != null) {
                String[] pair = trimmed.split(":", 2);
                if (pair.length != 2) continue;
                if (pair[0].trim().equals("name")) name = pair[1].trim();
                if (pair[0].trim().equals("added-at")) {
                    try { addedAt = Instant.parse(pair[1].trim()); }
                    catch (RuntimeException ignored) {
                        // A malformed timestamp is optional metadata; retain the valid UUID/name entry.
                        addedAt = null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        store(id, name, addedAt);
    }

    private void store(UUID id, String name, Instant addedAt) {
        if (id == null || name == null || name.isBlank()) return;
        players.put(id, new TrustedPlayer(id, name, addedAt == null ? Instant.EPOCH : addedAt));
    }

    private UUID parseUuid(String value) {
        try { return UUID.fromString(value); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException exception) {
            logger.warning("Ignoring malformed trusted player UUID: " + value);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String yaml() {
        StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder("trusted-players:\n");
        for (TrustedPlayer player : list()) {
            output.append("  ").append(player.id()).append(":\n")
                    .append("    name: ").append(player.name()).append('\n')
                    .append("    added-at: ").append(player.addedAt()).append('\n');
        }
        return output.toString();
    }
}
```

`src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/trusted/TrustedPlayer.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;

public record TrustedPlayer(UUID id, String name, Instant addedAt) {
    public TrustedPlayer {
        Objects.requireNonNull(id, "id");
        Objects.requireNonNull(name, "name");
        Objects.requireNonNull(addedAt, "addedAt");
        if (name.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("name cannot be blank");
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public interface TrustedPlayerService {
    TrustedPlayerService NONE = new TrustedPlayerService() {
        @Override public boolean isTrusted(UUID id) { return false; }
        @Override public boolean add(UUID id, String name) { return false; }
        @Override public boolean remove(UUID id) { return false; }
        @Override public List<TrustedPlayer> list() { return List.of(); }
        @Override public int size() { return 0; }
        @Override public void load() { }
        @Override public void save() { }
    };

    boolean isTrusted(UUID id);
    boolean add(UUID id, String name);
    boolean remove(UUID id);
    List<TrustedPlayer> list();
    default int size() { return list().size(); }
    void load();
    void save();
}
```

`src/main/resources/client-detection.yml`:

```yml
# ==========================================================================
# VAntiCheat - client and mod identity probes
# Paper 1.21.11 / Java 21.  Tuned for a survival multiplayer server.
# ==========================================================================
# HOW DETECTION ACTUALLY WORKS, AND WHAT IT CANNOT DO
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Almost every probe below is delivered the same way: the server writes a
# translatable component onto a temporary sign, opens that sign's editor on the
# client, and reads back the text the client submits. The client can only
# answer by opening a screen and pressing done. That is INTERACTIVE transport.
#
# What that means in practice:
#
#   * There is no non-interactive, server-observable per-mod identity signal on
#     Paper 1.21.11 for Fabric or vanilla clients. Reading one would need a
#     client-side mod or a packet library, which this plugin does not use.
#   * An interactive probe captures the player's UI and interrupts movement, so
#     auto-check.interactive is false by default and no INTERACTIVE probe runs
#     unattended. An automatic join scan opens no client UI at all.
#   * Only a translation key the target mod itself defines is authoritative. A
#     probe reports DETECTED only if it declares identity-resolution: true or an
#     exact expected-response. Without that, ambiguous localized text is
#     a verdict and is never promoted: this protocol carries plain strings and
#     cannot attribute an unknown translation to a specific mod.
#   * Client brand, Fabric brand, timing and silence are never evidence.
#
# UNVERIFIED means the exact probe has not been validated against a live
# client. It is not a claim of coverage.
#
# CURRENT HONEST STATE OF THIS FILE
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
#   total probes                42
#   VERIFIED                     0
#   LIVE_VERIFIED                3   jade-network-handshake + the two Xaero map probes
#   UNVERIFIED                  39
#   transport PASSIVE            1   jade-network-handshake
#   transport INTERACTIVE       41   /vac check only
#   automatic policy             17   enabled entries; 16 are interactive-gated
#   capable of DETECTED          3   jade-network-handshake + two exact-response map probes
#   automatic-capable            1   jade-network-handshake (the map probes are interactive)
#
# The most useful fact about this configuration: only three probes have an
# authoritative route to DETECTED, and all three identify legitimate utility or
# map mods. The other 39 are diagnostic. None is an enforcement target.
#
# All three DETECTED-capable probes are now LIVE_VERIFIED against real clients
# (sessions 2026-10-09): the passive Jade channel, and both Xaero map probes via
# an exact rendered response. The interactive transport is confirmed working:
# sign placed, editor opened, client responded in ~100ms, server classified it.
# The 39 remaining probes were not exercised end to end and stay UNVERIFIED.
# ==========================================================================
client-detection:
  enabled: true
  double-check: true

  # 40 ticks is the conservative response deadline.
  timeout-ticks: 40
  # Consecutive-silence backoff. After this many back-to-back batches each time
  # out on the full deadline, later batches use short-timeout-ticks. Every probe
  # still gets its own sign editor interaction and a shortened wait is still
  # recorded as TIMEOUT, never CLEAN, so result semantics do not change; only
  # silent-client wall time shrinks. Any response resets the streak, and
  # double-check confirmation passes always start on the full deadline, so a
  # responsive client never reaches the short one.
  # Setting short-timeout-ticks >= timeout-ticks disables the backoff.
  short-timeout-ticks: 10
  short-timeout-after-consecutive-timeouts: 2
  # A response completes the prior batch; the next may start without a tick.
  between-probe-ticks: 0

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PASSIVE OBSERVATION
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Uses only the supported Paper plugin-messaging API: Paper dispatches every
  # inbound custom payload to the Bukkit Messenger, and a listener registered
  # for a declared channel receives it. No NMS, no Netty, no dependency, and
  # nothing is ever sent to the client, so this cannot prompt the client to act.
  #
  # enforce is false and should stay false. Passive identity evidence is
  # authoritative about which mod is present, but the one channel proven so far
  # belongs to a legitimate utility mod, so kicking players for it by default
  # would be a false positive.
  passive:
    enforce: false

  # Sign line 3 carries an exploit-preventer keybind used to recognise a client
  # that neutralises the probe (reported PROTECTED). A keybind component cannot
  # be translated for a Bedrock client, so while this is true every probe sign
  # makes Geyser log "Expected tag to be a literal string ..." and the sign is
  # briefly visible to Bedrock players in view distance.
  #
  # Set false on a server with Bedrock players to remove that log flood and the
  # visibility. The trade-off is real: a neutralised channel can no longer be
  # recognised, so PROTECTED is never reported and such a response is treated as
  # an ordinary answer.
  exploit-preventer-line: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # AUTOMATIC SCANS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  auto-check:
    on-join: true
    # One second after join, so the client has finished its own login handshake
    # and the passive channel has had time to arrive.
    delay-ticks: 20
    first-join-only: false
    # Bound on simultaneous join scans. Each running scan holds a session, a
    # transport slot and a place in the challenge budget, so this is what keeps
    # a mass rejoin from saturating the server rather than any single player.
    max-concurrent: 32
    # Every probe below declares transport: INTERACTIVE except the one passive
    # probe, because the server must open a sign editor and the client must
    # submit it before any response can be observed.
    #
    # That captures the player's UI and blocks their movement, so it is NOT safe
    # unattended. With this false (the default) no INTERACTIVE probe may run
    # automatically and an automatic join scan opens no client UI at all. Run
    # them deliberately with /vac check <player>, where the operator accepts the
    # UI cost for that player.
    #
    # Set true only if you accept that every automatic check repeatedly opens a
    # sign editor on the player's screen and holds their movement while it waits.
    interactive: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PROTECTION (resource ceilings for untrusted client input)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # These are RESOURCE CEILINGS, not detection thresholds. No limit here can
  # ever produce a cheat verdict or a kick:
  #
  #   - exceeding one rejects input and increments a diagnostic counter
  #   - a rejected payload is not evidence and is not stored
  #   - a tripped circuit breaker means "this path is paused", not "cheating"
  #
  # Every value is clamped server-side into a safe range, so editing one to 0
  # cannot disable protection; it falls back to the safe default instead.
  #
  # Sized for a 100 player server. The global window is the one that protects
  # the server: individual players are already bounded by the whitelist.
  protection:
    # Maximum inbound payload bytes, checked BEFORE any parsing work.
    max-payload-bytes: 4096
    # Per-channel ceiling, so one channel can be tightened without affecting others.
    max-channel-bytes: 4096
    # Per-connection messages per second.
    player-messages-per-second: 32
    # Whole-server messages per second, across every channel and player.
    global-messages-per-second: 4000
    # Per-channel messages per second, so one channel cannot starve another.
    channel-messages-per-second: 512
    # Maximum concurrent interactive challenges.
    max-concurrent-challenges-per-player: 2
    max-concurrent-challenges-global: 256
    # Passive staging ceilings (pre-join signal staging).
    max-staged-players: 512
    max-staged-signals-per-player: 8
    # Maximum rate-limiter keys held at once, per scope.
    max-tracked-rate-keys: 4096
    # Challenge time to live, and staged-signal time to live.
    challenge-ttl: 15s
    staging-ttl: 10m
    # Circuit breaker: open after this many failures on one detector path.
    circuit-failure-threshold: 64
    # How long a tripped path stays suspended, and its half-open trial allowance.
    circuit-cooldown: 30s
    circuit-half-open-probes: 1
    # Idle reset delay for a suspended path.
    circuit-reset-delay: 15m

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PROBES
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
  #
  # FIELD REFERENCE
  #   enabled       the probe is in the catalog
  #   manual        /vac check <player> may run it
  #   automatic     eligible for an automatic scan IF the transport is permitted;
  #                 with auto-check.interactive: false an INTERACTIVE probe is
    #                 excluded even when this is true. 16 enabled probes are in
    #                 exactly that state, which is deliberate: it makes enabling
    #                 interactive scanning a one-key change. One disabled probe
    #                 retains automatic: true as catalog metadata.
  #   verification  UNVERIFIED unless a live client session backs the claim.
  #                 parse() defaults downward, so an unknown value can only
  #                 reduce confidence.
  #   source        where the identifier was read. Never a wiki page.
  #   notes         what is proven, and what is not.
  #
  # KEYBIND PROBES ARE ALL DISABLED
  #   A client renders a keybind as the player's bound key (F5), not the key
  #   string, and none of these declares an exact expected-response. They
  #   therefore have no path to DETECTED, can never reach BLOCKED,
  #   and force an untranslatable keybind component onto every sign they share a
  #   batch with. Enable one only after a real client response proves identity.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  probes:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Jade
  # P33 PASSIVE probe. Unlike every other probe in this file this one is not
  # delivered through the sign editor at all.
  #
  # Proven chain, from the real mod jar and the real Paper 1.21.11 server jar:
  #   Jade registers ClientPlayConnectionEvents.JOIN and, in that handler,
  #   unconditionally constructs ClientHandshakePacket and calls
  #   ClientPlayNetworking.send(...)                                [Jade jar]
  #     -> C2S custom payload on channel "jade:client_handshake"
  #     -> the server has no codec for that channel, so it decodes as
  #        DiscardedPayload, preserving the channel id and the raw bytes
  #     -> ServerCommonPacketListenerImpl.handleCustomPayload calls
  #        CraftServer.getMessenger().dispatchIncomingMessage(
  #            conn, "jade:client_handshake", data)
  #     -> StandardMessenger dispatches to listeners on that exact channel
  #     -> this probe
  #
  # Consequences: the client sends it on join with no user interaction, so
  # observing it opens no UI, captures no input, and cannot interrupt movement.
  # Absence of the channel proves nothing and stays CLEAN, so this probe can
  # never produce a false positive.
  #
  # This is the only PASSIVE probe capable of DETECTED. The two Xaero map probes
  # have separate exact-response routes, but they require interactive UI. Those
  # two remain UNVERIFIED: no client session exercised them.
  #
  # ENFORCEMENT: a confirmed passive detection does NOT reach enforcement unless
  # passive.enforce is true. Jade is a legitimate utility mod, so kicking players
  # for it by default would be a false positive. Confirmed live on 2026-10-09:
  # the plugin logged action=NONE "result is not confirmed" for a real player
  # who had Jade installed.

      source: "Jade 21.1.6 Fabric jar (ClientProxy.onInitializeClient -> ClientPlayConnectionEvents.JOIN -> ClientPlayNetworking.send) + Paper 1.21.11 ServerCommonPacketListenerImpl.handleCustomPayload -> Messenger.dispatchIncomingMessage"
```

`src/main/resources/config.yml`:

```yml
# ==========================================================================
# VAntiCheat - main configuration  (Paper 1.21.11, Java 21)
# ==========================================================================
# Client/mod identity probing lives in its own file, client-detection.yml,
# because it is large and is validated against the coverage matrix on every
# build. Server tuning for a survival server lives in server-configs/.
#
# Every value below is a setting the plugin actually reads. There are no
# decorative keys: ShippedConfigurationTest fails the build if a key appears
# here that no code path consumes. A key that silently does nothing is worse
# than a missing one, because an operator reads it as working.
#
# The trusted player list is data/trusted-players.yml, not this file.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

vanticheat:
  enabled: true
  # debug logs every probe batch, every evaluation and the passive signal
  # timeline. Leave it off in production: it is verbose and it is written to
  # the console on the tick thread.
  debug: false

detection:
  # Master switch for the detection layer. With this off the plugin runs with
  # no detection, which is an operator decision rather than a fallback.
  enabled: true

enforcement:
  enabled: true
  confirmed-detection:
    # Deliberately does not name the anti-cheat. A message that reveals which
    # subsystem acted tells someone tuning a client exactly what to avoid.
    message: "You were removed from the server."

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TERRAIN MASK (per-viewer underground terrain confidentiality)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Replace the illustrative `world` key with the exact names of your worlds.
# The mask never edits server blocks: it rewrites only this viewer's outgoing
# packets. Java clients are protected by default; Bedrock/Geyser remains opt-in
# until it has been validated against the server's actual Geyser/Floodgate stack.
terrain-mask:
  enabled: true
  worlds:
    world:
      enabled: true
      hide-below-y: 0
      mask-when-player-above-y: 5
      fake-block: DEEPSLATE
      hide-air: true
      hide-block-entities: true
      hide-underground-entities: true
  refresh:
    max-chunks-per-player-per-tick: 4
    max-pending-chunks-per-player: 512
    max-cached-chunks-per-player: 512
  bedrock:
    enabled: false

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# LUNAR CLIENT
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lunar Client is allowed. When the official Apollo plugin is installed,
# lunar.minimap.enabled=true disables the Lunar Minimap via an Apollo override.
# Players are never kicked or classified as cheats by this policy.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
lunar:
  enabled: true
  minimap:
    enabled: true
    action: DISABLE

```

`src/main/resources/modlist-denylist.yml`:

```yml
# ==========================================================================
# VAntiCheat - Forge mod-list denylist
# ==========================================================================
# Denies a connection when a Forge client declares an exact canonical mod
# id from the list below.
#
# WHAT THIS IS EVIDENCE OF
#   A Forge client sends its installed mod list to the server during the
#   FML handshake. The ids in that list are a declaration by the client
#   about its own installation. That is a far stronger signal than any
#   heuristic, and matching is EXACT.
#
# WHAT IT IS NOT EVIDENCE OF
#   This detects a mod that is PRESENT. It does not detect a cheat that is
#   ACTIVE, and it says nothing about what a player did.
#
# IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
#   - Forge clients only. Fabric Loader transmits no mod list to a game
#     server, so Fabric clients cannot be blocked this way at all.
#   - Bedrock clients are excluded and are never probed.
#   - Requires the PacketEvents plugin to be installed separately.
#   - Exact canonical ids only. No substring, prefix, or display-name
#     matching, ever.
#
# The list ships EMPTY. Add ids deliberately, one per line, after verifying
# each against a real client. An empty list denies nobody.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Master switch. When false, no connection is ever denied by this feature.
enabled: false

# KICK  - deny the connection on an exact match.
# AUDIT - record the match in /vac status and allow the connection.
action: KICK

# Player-facing denial message. Deliberately names neither a mod nor this
# plugin: a message that reveals what triggered it tells someone how to
# evade it.
message: "You were removed from the server."

# Canonical mod ids, written exactly as the client declares them.
# These are placeholders showing the FORMAT. They are inert until an
# operator replaces them with ids verified against a real client.
#   denied-mod-ids:
#     - your_mod_id_here
denied-mod-ids: []

# Equivalent form, when a reason should be recorded with each id.
# denied-mods:
#   some_mod_id: "reason recorded for administrators"
denied-mods: {}

```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/config/ClientDetectionConfigTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDefinition;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeMode;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeVerificationStatus;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class ClientDetectionConfigTest {
    private String bundledText() throws Exception {
        try (InputStream stream = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/client-detection.yml")) {
            return new String(stream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void bundledDefinitionsParseWithVerificationMetadata() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());
        assertTrue(config.enabled());
        assertEquals(40, config.timeoutTicks());
        assertEquals(0, config.betweenProbeTicks());
        assertEquals(42, config.probes().size());
        assertTrue(config.autoCheckOnJoin());
        assertEquals(20, config.autoCheckDelayTicks());
        assertEquals(32, config.maxConcurrentAutoChecks());
        assertEquals(17, config.automaticProbes().size());
        assertEquals(config.probes().stream().filter(probe -> probe.enabled() && probe.automatic())
                        .map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList(),
                config.automaticProbes().stream().map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList());
        // xaeros-minimap is enabled again: a live join scan proved the sign round-trip
        // resolves its key, which is the premise the P34 disable rested on.
        assertTrue(config.probes().stream()
                .filter(probe -> probe.id().equals("xaeros-minimap"))
                .allMatch(ProbeDefinition::enabled));
            assertTrue(config.probes().stream()
                    .filter(probe -> probe.id().equals("xaeros-worldmap"))
                    .anyMatch(probe -> probe.enabled()));
        assertTrue(config.probes().stream()
                .filter(probe -> probe.id().equals("litematica"))
                .anyMatch(probe -> probe.enabled()));
        assertEquals(ProbeMode.METEOR, config.probes().get(0).mode());
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, config.probes().get(0).verificationStatus(),
                "P34: the first probe must no longer claim VERIFIED without an observed response");
    }

    @Test
    void freshAndExistingFilesLoadWithoutOverwritingUserConfig() throws Exception {
        Path directory = Files.createTempDirectory("vanticheat-p12-6-");
        Path file = directory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
        assertTrue(Files.notExists(file));
        Files.writeString(file, bundledText());
        String before = Files.readString(file);

        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.loadStrict(directory);

        assertEquals(42, config.probes().size());
        assertEquals(before, Files.readString(file));
    }

    @Test
    void invalidBooleanReportsFilePathExpectedTypeAndActualType() {
        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n  auto-check:\n    on-join: \"true\"\n"));

        assertEquals("file=client-detection.yml\n"
                + "path=client-detection.auto-check.on-join\n"
                + "expected=boolean\nactual=String", exception.getMessage());
    }

    @Test
    void numericAndQuotedBooleanValuesAreNotSilentlyAccepted() {
        IllegalArgumentException quoted = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n  enabled: \"false\"\n"));
        IllegalArgumentException numeric = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n  enabled: 0\n"));

        assertTrue(quoted.getMessage().contains("actual=String"));
        assertTrue(numeric.getMessage().contains("actual=Number"));
    }

    @Test
    void quotedProbeBooleanIsRejected() {
        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n"
                        + "  probes:\n"
                        + "    test:\n"
                        + "      display-name: Test\n"
                        + "      key: test.key\n"
                        + "      mode: KEYBIND\n"
                        + "      enabled: \"true\"\n"));

        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("path=client-detection.probes.test.enabled"));
        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("actual=String"));
    }

    @Test
    void inlineCommentsDoNotChangeUnquotedBooleanType() {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(
                "client-detection:\n  enabled: true # valid YAML comment\n");

        assertTrue(config.enabled());
    }

    @Test
    void explicitManualAndAutomaticPoliciesAreIndependent() {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + "    experimental-mod:\n"
                + "      display-name: Experimental Mod\n"
                + "      key: example.mod.key\n"
                + "      mode: TRANSLATE\n"
                + "      enabled: true\n"
                + "      manual: true\n"
                + "      automatic: false\n"
                + "      verification: UNVERIFIED\n");

        assertEquals(1, config.manualProbes().size());
        assertTrue(config.automaticProbes().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test
    void invalidProbeMetadataHasPathSpecificErrors() {
        IllegalArgumentException exception = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n"
                        + "  probes:\n"
                        + "    invalid id:\n"
                        + "      display-name: Invalid\n"
                        + "      key: invalid.key\n"
                        + "      mode: TRANSLATE\n"));

        assertTrue(exception.getMessage().contains("path=client-detection.probes.invalid id"));
    }

    @Test
    void unknownModeAndMissingKeyAreRejected() {
        IllegalArgumentException unknownMode = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n"
                        + "  probes:\n"
                        + "    test:\n"
                        + "      display-name: Test\n"
                        + "      key: test.key\n"
                        + "      mode: UNKNOWN\n"));
        assertTrue(unknownMode.getMessage().contains("path=client-detection.probes.test.mode"));

        IllegalArgumentException missingKey = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n"
                        + "  probes:\n"
                        + "    test:\n"
                        + "      display-name: Test\n"
                        + "      mode: TRANSLATE\n"));
        assertTrue(missingKey.getMessage().contains("path=client-detection.probes.test.key"));
    }

    @Test
    void legacyAutomaticProbeListMigratesIntoDefinitionPolicy() {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  auto-check:\n"
                + "    probes:\n"
                + "      - first\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + "    first:\n"
                + "      display-name: First\n"
                + "      key: first.key\n"
                + "      mode: TRANSLATE\n"
                + "    second:\n"
                + "      display-name: Second\n"
                + "      key: second.key\n"
                + "      mode: TRANSLATE\n");

        assertEquals(List.of("first"), config.autoProbeIds());
        assertEquals(List.of("first"), config.automaticProbes().stream().map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList());
    }

    @Test
    void catalogMetadataLoadsAndNewUnverifiedProbesAreManualOnly() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());
        ProbeDefinition appleSkin = config.probeRegistry().require("apple-skin");
        ProbeDefinition ipn = config.probeRegistry().get("inventory-profiles-next");

        assertEquals("utility", appleSkin.category());
        assertEquals("text.autoconfig.appleskin.title", appleSkin.key());
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, appleSkin.verificationStatus(),
                "no client response was ever observed, so this cannot be VERIFIED");
        assertTrue(appleSkin.enabled());
        assertTrue(appleSkin.manual());
        assertTrue(!appleSkin.automatic());
        assertTrue(appleSkin.source().contains("AppleSkin"));
        assertTrue(appleSkin.notes().contains("UNVERIFIED"));
        assertFalse(appleSkin.canResolveIdentity(),
                "an unproven round-trip must not claim identity resolution");
        assertTrue(appleSkin.expectedResponse().isBlank(),
                "P34: an unproven target must keep no expected response to match against");

        assertTrue(ipn != null);
        assertTrue(config.manualProbes().contains(ipn));
        assertTrue(!config.automaticProbes().contains(ipn));
        assertTrue(!config.probeRegistry().contains("unknown-mod"));
        assertTrue(config.probeRegistry().contains("emi-recipe-viewer"));
        assertTrue(config.probeRegistry().contains("jade-config"));
    }

    @Test
    void bundledDefaultsEnableConsecutiveSilenceBackoff() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());

        assertEquals(10, config.shortTimeoutTicks());
        assertEquals(2, config.shortTimeoutAfterConsecutiveTimeouts());
        assertEquals(40, config.batchTimeoutTicks(0));
        assertEquals(40, config.batchTimeoutTicks(1));
        assertEquals(10, config.batchTimeoutTicks(2));
        assertEquals(10, config.batchTimeoutTicks(9));
    }

    @Test
    void shortTimeoutDefaultsToFullTimeoutWhenAbsent() {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(
                "client-detection:\n  enabled: true\n  timeout-ticks: 40\n");

        assertEquals(40, config.shortTimeoutTicks());
        assertEquals(2, config.shortTimeoutAfterConsecutiveTimeouts());
        assertEquals(40, config.batchTimeoutTicks(0));
        assertEquals(40, config.batchTimeoutTicks(100));
    }

    @Test
    void shortTimeoutAtOrAboveFullTimeoutDisablesAdaptation() {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(
                "client-detection:\n  enabled: true\n  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                        + "  short-timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                        + "  short-timeout-after-consecutive-timeouts: 1\n");

        assertEquals(40, config.batchTimeoutTicks(0));
        assertEquals(40, config.batchTimeoutTicks(10));
    }

    @Test
    void invalidShortTimeoutValuesAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> ClientDetectionConfig.parse(
                "client-detection:\n  enabled: true\n  short-timeout-ticks: 0\n"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> ClientDetectionConfig.parse(
                "client-detection:\n  enabled: true\n"
                        + "  short-timeout-after-consecutive-timeouts: 0\n"));
    }

    @Test
    void catalogMetadataIsConsistentAcrossAllProbes() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());

        for (ProbeDefinition probe : config.probes()) {
            assertTrue(!probe.category().isBlank(), "category missing: " + probe.id());
            if (probe.key().startsWith("key.") && probe.mode() != ProbeMode.METEOR) {
                assertEquals(ProbeMode.KEYBIND, probe.mode(), "key.* namespace requires KEYBIND: " + probe.id());
            }
        }
        assertEquals(ProbeMode.KEYBIND, config.probeRegistry().require("world-downloader").mode());
        assertEquals(ProbeMode.KEYBIND, config.probeRegistry().require("antiafk").mode());
        assertEquals(ProbeMode.KEYBIND, config.probeRegistry().require("ui-utils").mode());
        assertEquals("utility", config.probeRegistry().require("autoswitch").category());
        assertEquals("Wurst Client", config.probeRegistry().require("wurst").displayName());

        // xaeros-minimap was disabled in P34 on the assumption that the sign round-trip
        // could not resolve translation keys. A live join scan disproved that assumption, so
        // it is enabled again and promoted by an exact expected-response.
        ProbeDefinition minimap = config.probeRegistry().require("xaeros-minimap");
        assertTrue(minimap.enabled());
        assertTrue(minimap.automatic());
        assertEquals("Minimap", minimap.expectedResponse(),
                "xaeros-minimap promotes by exact match on the string from its own lang file");
    }

    @Test
    void verifiedWithoutEvidenceMetadataIsRejected() {
        String base = "client-detection:\n  probes:\n    test:\n"
                + "      display-name: Test\n      key: test.key\n      mode: TRANSLATE\n"
                + "      verification: VERIFIED\n";
        IllegalArgumentException missing = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse(base));
        assertTrue(missing.getMessage().contains("client-detection.probes.test.verification"));

        IllegalArgumentException notesOnly = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () ->
                ClientDetectionConfig.parse(base + "      notes: \"some notes\"\n"));
        assertTrue(notesOnly.getMessage().contains("missing evidence metadata"));

        ClientDetectionConfig accepted = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(base
                + "      notes: \"some notes\"\n      source: \"some source\"\n");
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.VERIFIED,
                accepted.probeRegistry().require("test").verificationStatus());
    }

    @Test
    void bundledVerifiedProbesCarryEvidenceMetadata() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());

        // P34: no probe is VERIFIED, because no real client response was ever recorded.
        assertTrue(config.probeRegistry().verified().isEmpty(),
                "a probe may only be VERIFIED once a real client response proves its identity");
        // A probe that can reach DETECTED, or that claims to be verified, must justify
        // itself. A never-verified probe need not carry a source.
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : config.probeRegistry().all()) {
            if (probe.detectedCapable()
                    || probe.verificationStatus() == ProbeVerificationStatus.VERIFIED) {
                assertTrue(!probe.source().isBlank(), "source missing for a claiming probe: " + probe.id());
                assertTrue(!probe.notes().isBlank(), "notes missing for a claiming probe: " + probe.id());
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void disabledItemscrollerRemainsVisibleButExcludedFromSelection() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());
        ProbeDefinition itemscroller = config.probeRegistry().require("itemscroller");

        assertTrue(!itemscroller.enabled());
        assertTrue(config.probeRegistry().contains("itemscroller"));
        assertTrue(config.automaticProbes().stream().noneMatch(probe -> probe.id().equals("itemscroller")));
        assertTrue(config.manualProbes().stream().noneMatch(probe -> probe.id().equals("itemscroller")));
    }

    @Test
    void enabledProbesAvoidKnownFabricatedIdentifierTemplate() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());

        // "<mod>.hotkey.name.<action>" was disproved live in P28 for a real masa-family mod
        // (its real keys use "<mod>.config.hotkeys.name.<action>"). No enabled definition may
        // reintroduce the unprovable template without an in-hand artifact to back it.
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : config.probeRegistry().enabled()) {
            assertTrue(!probe.key().matches("^[a-z0-9_.-]+\\.hotkey\\.name\\..+$"),
                    "fabricated hotkey.name template in enabled probe: " + probe.id());
        }
        assertEquals(42, config.probeRegistry().size());
        assertEquals(config.probeRegistry().size(), config.probeRegistry().liveVerifiedCount()
                + config.probeRegistry().verifiedCount() + config.probeRegistry().unverifiedCount());
        assertEquals(config.probeRegistry().size() - config.probeRegistry().enabledCount(),
                config.probeRegistry().all().stream()
                        .filter(probe -> !probe.enabled()).count(),
                "every disabled definition is counted as disabled, not merely unverified");
    }

    @Test
    void expandedCatalogRegistryFiltersByEnabledManualAutomaticAndVerification() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(bundledText());

        assertEquals(42, config.probeRegistry().size());
        assertEquals(24, config.probeRegistry().enabledCount());
        assertEquals(24, config.probeRegistry().manualCount());
        assertEquals(17, config.probeRegistry().automaticCount());
        assertEquals(0, config.probeRegistry().verified().size());
        // Three probes (jade-network-handshake and the two Xaero map probes) left UNVERIFIED
        // on recorded 2026-10-09 live sessions. The remaining 39 were never driven end to
        // end, so they stay UNVERIFIED.
        assertEquals(39, config.probeRegistry().unverified().size());
        assertEquals(0, config.probeRegistry().verifiedCount());
        assertEquals(3, config.probeRegistry().liveVerifiedCount());
        assertTrue(config.probeRegistry().get("apple-skin").manual());
        assertTrue(!config.probeRegistry().get("apple-skin").automatic());
        assertTrue(config.probeRegistry().automatic().stream()
                .noneMatch(probe -> probe.id().startsWith("inventory-profiles-next")));
    }
}
```
