`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/config/ConfigurationContractTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.lunar.LunarPolicyConfig;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.SecurityLimits;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Exhaustive contract tests for every {@code config.yml} key and for the hand-rolled parsers that
 * read it.
 *
 * <p>The three parsers ({@link ConfigurationLoader}, {@link EnforcementConfig},
 * {@link LunarPolicyConfig}) do not use a YAML library: they walk lines by indentation. That makes
 * their failure modes specific and worth pinning, particularly the requirement that one bad line
 * cannot silently disable unrelated protection.
 */
class ConfigurationContractTest {
    private static final Logger LOG = Logger.getLogger(ConfigurationContractTest.class.getName());

    private static final String MINIMAL = """
            vanticheat:
              enabled: true
              debug: false
            detection:
              enabled: true
            enforcement:
              enabled: true
              confirmed-detection:
                message: "You were removed from the server."
            lunar:
              enabled: true
              minimap:
                enabled: true
                action: DISABLE
            """;

    private static Path write(String content) throws Exception {
        Path dir = Files.createTempDirectory("vac-config");
        Files.writeString(dir.resolve("config.yml"), content);
        return dir;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- config.yml keys

    @Test
    @DisplayName("every shipped config.yml key is consumed by a parser")
    void everyShippedKeyIsParsed() throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL);
        FoundationConfig foundation = ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG);
        assertTrue(foundation.enabled());
        assertFalse(foundation.debug());
        assertTrue(foundation.detectionEnabled());

        EnforcementConfig enforcement = ConfigurationLoader.loadEnforcement(dir, LOG);
        assertTrue(enforcement.enabled());
        assertEquals("You were removed from the server.", enforcement.confirmedDetectionMessage());

        LunarPolicyConfig lunar = LunarPolicyConfig.load(dir, LOG);
        assertTrue(lunar.enabled());
        assertTrue(lunar.minimapEnabled());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a missing config.yml falls back to documented defaults")
    void missingFileYieldsDefaults() throws Exception {
        Path empty = Files.createTempDirectory("vac-config-missing");
        assertTrue(ConfigurationLoader.load(empty, LOG).enabled());
        assertTrue(ConfigurationLoader.loadEnforcement(empty, LOG).enabled());
        // LunarPolicyConfig treats an absent data directory as explicitly disabled, so a server
        // without a config cannot accidentally start pushing Apollo minimap policy.
        assertFalse(LunarPolicyConfig.load(null, LOG).enabled());
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "vanticheat.enabled={0} is adopted")
    @ValueSource(strings = {"true", "false"})
    @DisplayName("vanticheat.enabled is honoured in both states")
    void foundationEnabledIsAdopted(String value) throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("vanticheat:\n  enabled: true", "vanticheat:\n  enabled: " + value));
        assertEquals(Boolean.parseBoolean(value), ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG).enabled());
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "vanticheat.debug={0} is adopted")
    @ValueSource(strings = {"true", "false"})
    @DisplayName("vanticheat.debug is honoured in both states")
    void foundationDebugIsAdopted(String value) throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("  debug: false", "  debug: " + value));
        assertEquals(Boolean.parseBoolean(value), ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG).debug());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("detection.enabled=false is adopted and does not disturb other sections")
    void detectionEnabledIsAdoptedIndependently() throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("detection:\n  enabled: true", "detection:\n  enabled: false"));
        FoundationConfig foundation = ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG);
        assertFalse(foundation.detectionEnabled());
        // Unrelated sections must survive: one key cannot corrupt the rest of the file.
        assertTrue(foundation.enabled(), "vanticheat.enabled must be unaffected");
        assertTrue(ConfigurationLoader.loadEnforcement(dir, LOG).enabled());
        assertTrue(LunarPolicyConfig.load(dir, LOG).enabled());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("enforcement.enabled=false is adopted and disables action")
    void enforcementEnabledIsAdopted() throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("enforcement:\n  enabled: true", "enforcement:\n  enabled: false"));
        EnforcementConfig enforcement = ConfigurationLoader.loadEnforcement(dir, LOG);
        assertFalse(enforcement.enabled());
        // The message must survive so the operator still sees their configured text.
        assertEquals("You were removed from the server.", enforcement.confirmedDetectionMessage());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a blank enforcement message is rejected and enforcement falls back to disabled")
    void blankEnforcementMessageIsRejected() throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("message: \"You were removed from the server.\"",
                "message: \"   \""));
        EnforcementConfig enforcement = ConfigurationLoader.loadEnforcement(dir, LOG);
        assertFalse(enforcement.enabled(), "an unusable message must not leave enforcement live");
        assertNotNull(enforcement.confirmedDetectionMessage());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a blank enforcement message is rejected by the constructor itself")
    void blankMessageCannotConstruct() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new EnforcementConfig(true, ""));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new EnforcementConfig(true, null));
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "lunar.enabled={0} is adopted")
    @ValueSource(strings = {"true", "false"})
    @DisplayName("lunar.enabled and lunar.minimap.enabled are adopted independently")
    void lunarFlagsAreAdopted(String value) throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("lunar:\n  enabled: true", "lunar:\n  enabled: " + value));
        assertEquals(Boolean.parseBoolean(value), LunarPolicyConfig.load(dir, LOG).enabled());

        Path minimap = write(MINIMAL.replace("  minimap:\n    enabled: true",
                "  minimap:\n    enabled: " + value));
        assertEquals(Boolean.parseBoolean(value), LunarPolicyConfig.load(minimap, LOG).minimapEnabled());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("lunar.minimap.action only accepts the single supported value")
    void lunarActionIsValidated() throws Exception {
        assertTrue(LunarPolicyConfig.load(write(MINIMAL), LOG).minimapEnabled());
        // Anything other than DISABLE is a hard error, so lunar integration is switched off
        // rather than silently doing nothing the operator asked for.
        Path bad = write(MINIMAL.replace("action: DISABLE", "action: BAN"));
        assertFalse(LunarPolicyConfig.load(bad, LOG).enabled(),
                "an unsupported action must not leave lunar policy enabled");
        assertFalse(LunarPolicyConfig.load(bad, LOG).minimapEnabled());
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "malformed value {0} is rejected")
    @ValueSource(strings = {"yes", "1", "TRUEISH", "on", "''"})
    @DisplayName("a non-boolean value is rejected rather than coerced")
    void nonBooleanValuesAreRejected(String value) throws Exception {
        Path dir = write(MINIMAL.replace("vanticheat:\n  enabled: true", "vanticheat:\n  enabled: " + value));
        // Falls back to defaults rather than throwing out of the loader.
        assertTrue(ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG).enabled());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an unknown key under detection: does not abort the whole file")
    void unknownKeyUnderDetectionDoesNotAbortTheFile() throws Exception {
        // The foundation parser splits every line under detection: and parses the value as a
        // boolean before checking the key name. A future non-boolean key added under that
        // section would therefore throw, discarding vanticheat.enabled and debug too.
        String withExtra = MINIMAL.replace("detection:\n  enabled: true",
                "detection:\n  enabled: true\n  timeout-seconds: 30");
        Path dir = write(withExtra);
        FoundationConfig foundation = ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG);
        assertTrue(foundation.enabled(),
                "an unrecognised detection key must not discard unrelated settings");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("comments and blank lines are ignored")
    void commentsAndBlankLinesAreIgnored() throws Exception {
        Path dir = write("# leading\n\n" + MINIMAL.replace("vanticheat:", "# note\nvanticheat:")
                + "\n\n# trailing\n");
        FoundationConfig foundation = ConfigurationLoader.load(dir, LOG);
        assertTrue(foundation.enabled());
        assertTrue(foundation.detectionEnabled());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------- protection block clamping contract

    @Test
    @DisplayName("every protection limit is clamped and none can be disabled by an invalid value")
    void protectionLimitsClampIntoASafeRange() {
        Map<String, Object> hostile = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String key : new String[]{"max-payload-bytes", "max-channel-bytes",
                "player-messages-per-second", "global-messages-per-second",
                "channel-messages-per-second", "max-concurrent-challenges-per-player",
                "max-concurrent-challenges-global", "max-staged-players",
                "max-staged-signals-per-player", "circuit-failure-threshold",
                "circuit-half-open-probes"}) {
            hostile.put(key, 0); // A hand-edited 0 must never disable protection.
        }
        hostile.put("max-tracked-rate-keys", 0);
        hostile.put("challenge-ttl", "0s");
        hostile.put("staging-ttl", "0s");
        hostile.put("circuit-cooldown", "0s");
        hostile.put("circuit-reset-delay", "0s");

        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(hostile, null);
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS, limits,
                "every hostile value must clamp back to the documented default");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a negative protection value cannot disable protection either")
    void negativeProtectionValuesClamp() {
        Map<String, Object> negative = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        negative.put("max-payload-bytes", -1);
        negative.put("max-concurrent-challenges-per-player", -99);
        negative.put("challenge-ttl", "-5s");
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(negative, null);
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.maxPayloadBytes(), limits.maxPayloadBytes());
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer(),
                limits.maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer());
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.challengeTtl(), limits.challengeTtl());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an absurd protection value is capped at the absolute ceiling")
    void oversizedProtectionValuesAreCapped() {
        Map<String, Object> huge = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        huge.put("max-payload-bytes", Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(huge, null);
        assertTrue(limits.maxPayloadBytes() <= (1 << 20),
                "payload ceiling must stay bounded: " + limits.maxPayloadBytes());
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "malformed value {0} falls back")
    @ValueSource(strings = {"0s", "-1s", "not-a-duration", "5 seconds", "''"})
    @DisplayName("a malformed or out-of-range duration never leaves protection without a bound")
    void malformedDurationsFallBack(String ttl) {
        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        map.put("challenge-ttl", ttl);
        map.put("staging-ttl", ttl);
        map.put("circuit-cooldown", ttl);
        map.put("circuit-reset-delay", ttl);
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(map, null);
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.challengeTtl(), limits.challengeTtl());
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.stagingTtl(), limits.stagingTtl());
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.circuitCooldown(), limits.circuitCooldown());
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.circuitResetDelay(), limits.circuitResetDelay());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a valid duration is adopted rather than always clamped to the default")
    void validDurationsAreAdopted() {
        Map<String, Object> map = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        map.put("challenge-ttl", "45s");
        map.put("staging-ttl", "2m");
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(map, null);
        assertEquals(Duration.ofSeconds(45), limits.challengeTtl());
        assertEquals(Duration.ofMinutes(2), limits.stagingTtl());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("all sixteen shipped protection keys are present in the shipped file")
    void shippedProtectionBlockIsComplete() throws Exception {
        String text = Files.readString(Path.of("src/main/resources/client-detection.yml"));
        List<String> required = List.of("max-payload-bytes", "max-channel-bytes",
                "player-messages-per-second", "global-messages-per-second",
                "channel-messages-per-second", "max-concurrent-challenges-per-player",
                "max-concurrent-challenges-global", "max-staged-players",
                "max-staged-signals-per-player", "max-tracked-rate-keys", "challenge-ttl",
                "staging-ttl", "circuit-failure-threshold", "circuit-cooldown",
                "circuit-half-open-probes", "circuit-reset-delay");
        for (String key : required) {
            assertTrue(text.contains("    " + key + ":"), "protection key missing: " + key);
        }
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "auto-check.{0} is set to {1}")
    @CsvSource({"delay-ticks,0", "delay-ticks,1", "delay-ticks,20", "delay-ticks,100000",
            "max-concurrent,1", "max-concurrent,32", "max-concurrent,-1"})
    @DisplayName("auto-check numeric options accept extremes without throwing")
    void autoCheckNumbersAreRobust(String key, String value) throws Exception {
        String yaml = """
                client-detection:
                  enabled: true
                  probes:
                    p:
                      display-name: "P"
                      key: a.b
                      mode: TRANSLATE
                      enabled: true
                      manual: true
                      automatic: false
                      verification: UNVERIFIED
                      category: client
                      transport: INTERACTIVE
                      source: test
                      notes: test
                  auto-check:
                    on-join: true
                    first-join-only: false
                    interactive: false
                    """ + "                    " + key + ": " + value + "\n";
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.parse(yaml);
        assertNotNull(config.probeRegistry());
        assertEquals(1, config.probeRegistry().size());
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/config/MessagePlaceholderTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * A literal {@code %token%} must never reach a player.
 *
 * <p>This has now happened three times in this project: an unknown message key printed its own
 * name, a deployed jar and shipped template disagreed on the verdict placeholder, and a caller
 * failed to supply a token. Each time the defect was invisible in the source and visible only in
 * a screenshot. These tests make the class of defect fail the build instead.
 */
class MessagePlaceholderTest {
    private static final Pattern TOKEN = Pattern.compile("%[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*%");

    private static Messages messages() {
        return Messages.load(Path.of("src/main/resources/messages.yml"),
                java.util.logging.Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }

    @Test
    void everyShippedTemplateTokenHasACallerThatSuppliesIt() throws Exception {
        // Extracts the tokens from every shipped template, then confirms each one appears as a
        // map key somewhere in the command or transport call sites.
        String templates = Files.readString(Path.of("src/main/resources/messages.yml"));
        String sources = allSources();

        for (String line : templates.split("\n")) {
            String trimmed = line.trim();
            if (trimmed.startsWith("#") || !trimmed.contains("%")) continue;
            String key = trimmed.substring(0, trimmed.indexOf(':'));
            Matcher matcher = TOKEN.matcher(trimmed.substring(trimmed.indexOf(':') + 1));
            while (matcher.find()) {
                String token = matcher.group();
                String name = token.substring(1, token.length() - 1);
                if (name.equals("prefix")) continue;
                assertTrue(sources.contains("\"" + name + "\""),
                        "messages.yml key '" + key + "' uses " + token
                                + " but no call site ever supplies \"" + name + "\"");
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void anUnresolvedTokenIsStrippedRatherThanSentToChat() {
        Messages messages = messages();
        messages.clearMissingKeys();
        // A template demanding a token the caller does not provide must not print the token.
        String rendered = messages.render("command.trust.header", Map.of());
        assertFalse(rendered.contains("%"),
                "no raw placeholder may reach a player: " + rendered);
    }

    @Test
    void anUnknownMessageKeyProducesNoTextAtAll() {
        Messages messages = messages();
        messages.clearMissingKeys();
        assertEquals("", messages.render("definitely.not.a.real.key"),
                "an unknown key must fail silently, not print its own name");
        assertTrue(messages.missingKeys().stream()
                        .anyMatch(key -> key.contains("definitely.not.a.real.key")),
                "the missing key must still be recorded for the console");
    }

    @Test
    void suppliedTokensAreStillReplaced() {
        Messages messages = messages();
        String rendered = messages.render("command.trust.header", Map.of("count", 7));
        assertTrue(rendered.contains("7"), "a supplied token must render: " + rendered);
        assertFalse(rendered.contains("%count%"));
    }

    @Test
    void ampersandColourCodesStillRender() {
        Messages messages = messages();
        String rendered = messages.render("command.trust.header", Map.of("count", 1));
        assertTrue(rendered.indexOf('\u00a7') >= 0,
                "colour codes must still translate: " + rendered);
    }

    private static String allSources() throws Exception {
        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
        try (var stream = Files.walk(Path.of("src/main/java"))) {
            for (Path path : stream.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                builder.append(Files.readString(path)).append('\n');
            }
        }
        return builder.toString();
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/config/MessagesTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

class MessagesTest {
    @Test
    void bundledMessagesRenderColorsAndPlaceholders() {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(null, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());

        assertEquals("§8[§bVAntiCheat§8] §rClient probe Alex: CLEAN (evidence=3, mods=none, action=NONE)",
                messages.render("probe.result", Map.of("player", "Alex", "status", "CLEAN", "evidence", 3,
                        "mods", "none", "action", "NONE")));
    }

    @Test
    void kickMessageRendersMultilinePlaceholders() {
        Messages messages = Messages.load(null, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());

        assertEquals("\u00a7c\u00a7lConnection Lost\n\n\u00a7fCheating detected.\n"
                        + "\u00a77Detected: \u00a7fXaero's Minimap\n\u00a77Reason: \u00a7fdouble-check complete",
                messages.render("kick.confirmed", Map.of("mods", "Xaero's Minimap",
                        "reason", "double-check complete")));
    }

    @Test
    void customMessagesOverrideDefaults() throws Exception {
        Path directory = Files.createTempDirectory("vanticheat-messages");
        Files.writeString(directory.resolve("messages.yml"),
                "prefix: '&a[VAC] '\nprobe.offline: '%prefix%offline: %player%'\n");

        Messages messages = Messages.load(directory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());

        assertEquals("\u00a7a[VAC] offline: Alex",
                messages.render("probe.offline", Map.of("player", "Alex")));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/config/ProbeTransportConfigTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDefinition;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeMode;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeTransportMode;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeVerificationStatus;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/** Phase 2: transport and evidence declarations are validated configuration metadata. */
class ProbeTransportConfigTest {
    @TempDir
    private Path temporaryDirectory;

    private ClientDetectionConfig parse(String yaml) throws Exception {
        Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
        Files.writeString(file, yaml);
        return ClientDetectionConfig.load(temporaryDirectory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }

    /** Rejection tests must see the real error, not the fail-closed disabled config. */
    private void parseStrict(String yaml) throws Exception {
        Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
        Files.writeString(file, yaml);
        ClientDetectionConfig.loadStrict(temporaryDirectory);
    }

    private ClientDetectionConfig bundled() throws Exception {
        Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
        try (InputStream stream = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/client-detection.yml")) {
            Files.write(file, stream.readAllBytes());
        }
        return ClientDetectionConfig.load(temporaryDirectory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }

    private static String probe(String id, String extra) {
        return probe(id, true, extra);
    }

    private static String probe(String id, boolean automatic, String extra) {
        return "    " + id + ":\n"
                + "      display-name: \"" + id + "\"\n"
                + "      key: \"mod." + id + ".title\"\n"
                + "      mode: TRANSLATE\n"
                + "      enabled: true\n"
                + "      manual: true\n"
                + (automatic ? "      automatic: true\n" : "")
                + "      verification: UNVERIFIED\n"
                + "      category: test\n"
                + extra;
    }

    @Test
    void everyBundledProbeDeclaresItsTransport() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        assertEquals(42, config.probes().size());
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : config.probes()) {
            if (probe.passiveChannelProbe()) {
                assertEquals(ProbeTransportMode.PASSIVE, probe.transport(), probe.id());
                assertFalse(probe.passiveChannel().isBlank(), probe.id() + " must declare its channel");
            } else {
                assertEquals(ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE, probe.transport(),
                        probe.id() + " must declare the interactive sign transport explicitly");
            }
        }
        assertEquals(1, config.probeRegistry().passiveCount());
        assertEquals(41, config.probeRegistry().interactiveCount());
    }

    @Test
    void identityResolutionRequiresRecordedLiveEvidenceOfKeyResolution() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : config.probes()) {
            boolean claims = probe.canResolveIdentity()
                    || (probe.expectedResponse() != null && !probe.expectedResponse().isBlank());
            if (!claims) continue;
            // The P34 blanket ban rested on a false premise: the sign round-trip DOES resolve
            // translation keys, which a live join scan proved. The rule is now narrower and
            // stronger: a probe may promote on an exact match only when it records why that
            // match is trustworthy, which means citing an observed live session.
            String cited = ((probe.source() == null ? "" : probe.source())
                    + (probe.notes() == null ? "" : probe.notes()))
                    .toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
            assertTrue(cited.contains("live") || cited.contains("observed"),
                    probe.id() + " promotes on an exact match but records no live evidence");
        }
        // The passive channel probe must remain the only PASSIVE detected-capable probe.
        List<String> passiveCapable = config.probes().stream()
                .filter(probe -> probe.detectedCapable()
                        && probe.transport() == ProbeTransportMode.PASSIVE)
                .map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList();
        assertEquals(List.of("jade-network-handshake"), passiveCapable);
    }

    /**
     * P33: the three operator-requested clients are recorded but never enabled, because no
     * artifact was available to confirm a real identifier. Enabling a placeholder key would
     * silently report CLEAN forever and give false assurance.
     */
    @Test
    void requestedClientsWithoutArtifactsStayDisabledAndUnverified() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        for (String id : List.of("cezar-client", "nova-client", "forwarded")) {
            ProbeDefinition probe = config.probeRegistry().require(id);
            assertFalse(probe.enabled(), id + " must ship disabled");
            assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, probe.verificationStatus(), id);
            assertTrue(probe.manual(), id + " should be manual-only once its key is confirmed");
            assertFalse(probe.automatic(), id + " must not be automatic");
            assertTrue(probe.key().contains("unconfirmed-identifier"),
                    id + " must be visibly a placeholder, not a claimed key");
            assertFalse(probe.detectedCapable(), id + " cannot detect without a real identifier");
        }
    }

    /** P33: the passive channel map is explicit and is the only thing observed. */
    @Test
    void passiveChannelsAreDeclaredExplicitlyAndNotInferred() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        assertEquals(java.util.Map.of("jade:client_handshake", "jade-network-handshake"),
                config.passiveChannels());
        assertEquals(1, config.passiveProbeCount());
        assertFalse(config.passiveEnforce(),
                "passive evidence must not reach enforcement by default");
    }

    /**
     * Sign line 3 is an unconditional keybind, which Bedrock clients cannot translate.
     * The operator must be able to turn it off, and the default must preserve the
     * PROTECTED conclusion.
     */
    @Test
    void exploitPreventerLineDefaultsOnAndCanBeDisabled() throws Exception {
        assertTrue(bundled().exploitPreventerLine(),
                "the PROTECTED conclusion depends on this line, so it defaults on");

        ClientDetectionConfig off = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  exploit-preventer-line: false\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("one", ""));
        assertFalse(off.exploitPreventerLine());
    }

    @Test
    void passiveEnforceIsParsedWhenExplicitlyEnabled() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("chan", "      transport: PASSIVE\n      passive-channel: \"mod:chan\"\n")
                + "  passive:\n"
                + "    enforce: true\n");
        assertTrue(config.passiveEnforce());
        assertEquals(java.util.Map.of("mod:chan", "chan"), config.passiveChannels());
    }

    @Test
    void absentTransportFailsClosedToInteractive() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("undeclared", ""));

        assertEquals(ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE,
                config.probes().get(0).transport(),
                "an undeclared transport must never silently become automatic-safe");
        assertEquals(0, config.automaticEligibleProbes().size());
    }

    @Test
    void passiveProbeWithoutAChannelIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new ProbeDefinition("p", "P", "k",
                ProbeMode.TRANSLATE, "", true, true, true, ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED,
                "test", "", "", "", ProbeTransportMode.PASSIVE, false, ""));
    }

    @Test
    void interactiveProbeWithAChannelIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new ProbeDefinition("i", "I", "k",
                ProbeMode.TRANSLATE, "", true, true, true, ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED,
                "test", "", "", "", ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE, false, "mod:chan"));
    }

    @Test
    void passiveTransportIsParsedAndBecomesAutomaticEligible() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("brand", "      transport: PASSIVE\n      passive-channel: \"test:brand\"\n"));

        assertEquals(ProbeTransportMode.PASSIVE, config.probes().get(0).transport());
        assertEquals(1, config.automaticEligibleProbes().size(),
                "a passive probe is safe for automatic use without any opt-in");
    }

    @Test
    void identityResolutionRequiresAnInteractiveTransport() {
        IllegalArgumentException error = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parseStrict("""
                client-detection:
                  enabled: true
                  timeout-ticks: 40
                  between-probe-ticks: 0
                  probes:
                    brand:
                      display-name: "Brand"
                      key: "mod.brand.title"
                      mode: TRANSLATE
                      enabled: true
                      manual: true
                      automatic: true
                      verification: UNVERIFIED
                      category: test
                      transport: PASSIVE
                      identity-resolution: true
                """));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("identity-resolution"),
                "the rejection must name the offending path");
    }

    @Test
    void invalidTransportValueIsRejectedWithTheFileScopedPath() {
        IllegalArgumentException error = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parseStrict("""
                client-detection:
                  enabled: true
                  timeout-ticks: 40
                  between-probe-ticks: 0
                  probes:
                    thing:
                      display-name: "Thing"
                      key: "mod.thing.title"
                      mode: TRANSLATE
                      enabled: true
                      manual: true
                      automatic: true
                      verification: UNVERIFIED
                      category: test
                      transport: TELEPATHIC
                """));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("client-detection.probes.thing.transport"));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("TELEPATHIC"));
    }

    @Test
    void interactiveAutomaticOptInIsParsedAndDefaultsToFalse() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig off = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("interactive-one", "")
                + "  auto-check:\n"
                + "    on-join: true\n");
        assertFalse(off.interactiveAutomatic());
        assertEquals(0, off.automaticEligibleProbes().size());
        assertFalse(off.warnings().isEmpty(), "reduced automatic coverage must be reported");

        ClientDetectionConfig on = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("interactive-one", "")
                + "  auto-check:\n"
                + "    on-join: true\n"
                + "    interactive: true\n");
        assertTrue(on.interactiveAutomatic());
        assertEquals(1, on.automaticEligibleProbes().size());
    }

    @Test
    void legacyAutoProbeListSyntaxIsStillMigrated() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = parse("client-detection:\n"
                + "  enabled: true\n"
                + "  timeout-ticks: 40\n"
                + "  between-probe-ticks: 0\n"
                + "  probes:\n"
                + probe("listed", false, "")
                + probe("unlisted", false, "")
                + "  auto-check:\n"
                + "    on-join: true\n"
                + "    probes:\n"
                + "      - listed\n");

        assertEquals(List.of("listed"), config.autoProbeIds());
        assertEquals(0, config.automaticEligibleProbes().size(),
                "the legacy list still cannot bypass the transport gate");
    }

    @Test
    void verifiedGuardrailStillRequiresEvidenceMetadata() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parseStrict("""
                client-detection:
                  enabled: true
                  timeout-ticks: 40
                  between-probe-ticks: 0
                  probes:
                    claim:
                      display-name: "Claim"
                      key: "mod.claim.title"
                      mode: TRANSLATE
                      enabled: true
                      manual: true
                      automatic: true
                      verification: VERIFIED
                      category: test
                """));
    }

    @Test
    void detectedCapabilityIsDerivedNotConfigured() {
        ProbeDefinition noEvidence = new ProbeDefinition("a", "A", "mod.a.title", ProbeMode.TRANSLATE,
                "", true, true, true, ProbeVerificationStatus.VERIFIED, "test", "src", "notes", "");
        assertFalse(noEvidence.detectedCapable(),
                "a plausible identifier alone must never imply DETECTED capability");

        ProbeDefinition withIdentity = new ProbeDefinition("b", "B", "mod.b.title", ProbeMode.TRANSLATE,
                "", true, true, true, ProbeVerificationStatus.VERIFIED, "test", "src", "notes", "",
                ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE, true);
        assertTrue(withIdentity.detectedCapable());
        assertTrue(withIdentity.canResolveIdentity());
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/config/ShippedConfigurationTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDefinition;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeRegistry;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeTransportMode;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeVerificationStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.SecurityLimits;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * The shipped configuration set must load, be internally consistent, and not contain keys
 * that do nothing.
 *
 * <p>A config key that silently does nothing is worse than a missing one, because an operator
 * reads it as working. This test is what stops that class of mistake.
 */
class ShippedConfigurationTest {
    @Test
    void shippedClientDetectionConfigLoads() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        assertTrue(config.enabled());
        ProbeRegistry registry = config.probeRegistry();
        assertTrue(registry.all().size() >= 40,
                "catalog looks truncated: " + registry.all().size());
    }

    @Test
    void everyProbeIdIsUniqueAndKeysAreWellFormed() throws Exception {
        ProbeRegistry registry = bundled().probeRegistry();
        Map<String, Integer> seen = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : registry.all()) {
            seen.merge(probe.id(), 1, Integer::sum);
            assertFalse(probe.displayName().isBlank(), probe.id() + " needs a display name");
            assertNotNull(probe.mode(), probe.id() + " needs a mode");
            assertNotNull(probe.transport(), probe.id() + " needs a transport");
            assertNotNull(probe.verificationStatus(), probe.id() + " needs a verification");
        }
        seen.forEach((id, count) -> assertEquals(1, count, "duplicate probe id: " + id));
    }

    /**
     * The single most important invariant for an operator-facing file: a probe declared
     * {@code automatic: true} but blocked by {@code auto-check.interactive: false} must not
     * pretend to be automatic.
     */
    @Test
    void automaticProbesThatCannotRunAutomaticallyAreCountedNotHidden() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        assertFalse(config.interactiveAutomatic(),
                "automatic interactive scanning must stay off by default");
        List<String> blocked = config.automaticProbes().stream()
                .filter(probe -> !config.automaticEligibleProbes().contains(probe))
                .map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList();
        // The catalogue deliberately marks probes automatic so that enabling interactive
        // scanning is a one-key change. The count is asserted so a rebalance is deliberate.
        assertTrue(blocked.size() > 0,
                "expected some probes to be automatic-but-gated by the interactive switch");
        for (String id : blocked) {
            assertEquals(ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE, config.probeRegistry().require(id).transport(),
                    id + " is gated, so it must be an interactive probe");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void theHonestyInvariantsSurviveInTheShippedFile() throws Exception {
        ProbeRegistry registry = bundled().probeRegistry();
        // One live client session was performed on 2026-10-09 against a real Fabric 1.21.11
        // client and a real Paper 1.21.11 server. It exercised the passive Jade channel only,
        // so exactly one probe may claim LIVE_VERIFIED and nothing else may leave UNVERIFIED.
        List<String> liveVerified = registry.all().stream()
                .filter(probe -> probe.verificationStatus().liveVerified())
                .map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList();
        assertEquals(List.of("xaeros-minimap", "xaeros-worldmap", "jade-network-handshake"), liveVerified,
                "only the probes backed by the recorded live sessions may be LIVE_VERIFIED");
        assertEquals(0, registry.verifiedCount(),
                "the honesty correction left zero VERIFIED probes");
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : registry.all()) {
            boolean claims = probe.identityResolution()
                    || (probe.expectedResponse() != null && !probe.expectedResponse().isBlank());
            if (!claims || probe.verificationStatus().liveVerified()) continue;
            // Promotion by exact match is still permitted, but only when the probe documents
            // the observed evidence that justified it. That is why the Xaero pair may declare an
            // expected response while their verification status stays UNVERIFIED: no session
            // drove an interactive sign round trip for them.
            String cited = ((probe.source() == null ? "" : probe.source())
                    + (probe.notes() == null ? "" : probe.notes()))
                    .toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
            assertTrue(cited.contains("live") || cited.contains("observed"),
                    probe.id() + " declares an expected response with no cited live evidence");
            assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, probe.verificationStatus(),
                    probe.id() + " must stay UNVERIFIED: no session recorded an exact response");
        }
        List<String> passiveCapable = registry.all().stream()
                .filter(probe -> probe.detectedCapable()
                        && probe.transport() == ProbeTransportMode.PASSIVE)
                .map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList();
        assertEquals(List.of("jade-network-handshake"), passiveCapable);
    }

    /**
     * A probe whose key is an explicit placeholder must be disabled. A placeholder resolves to
     * nothing on a real client, so an enabled placeholder probe reports CLEAN forever and gives
     * false assurance.
     */
    @Test
    void placeholderKeysAreNeverEnabled() throws Exception {
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : bundled().probeRegistry().all()) {
            boolean placeholder = probe.key().contains("unconfirmed-identifier");
            if (!placeholder) continue;
            assertFalse(probe.enabled(),
                    probe.id() + " has a placeholder key and must ship disabled");
            assertFalse(probe.automatic(),
                    probe.id() + " has a placeholder key and can never run automatically");
        }
    }

    /**
     * A KEYBIND probe renders as the player's bound key, not the key string, so it has no path
     * to an authoritative identity match. Every one must therefore ship disabled.
     */
    @Test
    void everyKeybindProbeIsDisabled() throws Exception {
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : bundled().probeRegistry().all()) {
            if (probe.mode() != site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeMode.KEYBIND) continue;
            assertFalse(probe.enabled(),
                    probe.id() + " is a KEYBIND probe and has no path to DETECTED");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void theShippedProtectionBlockParsesIntoClampedLimits() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        SecurityLimits limits = config.securityLimits();
        assertTrue(limits.maxPayloadBytes() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.playerMessagesPerSecond() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.globalMessagesPerSecond() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxStagedPlayers() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxStagedSignalsPerPlayer() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.circuitFailureThreshold() > 0);
        assertFalse(limits.challengeTtl().isZero());
        assertFalse(limits.stagingTtl().isZero());
        // The shipped values must be the configured ones, not the defaults, or the operator
        // would be editing a file that has no effect.
        assertEquals(16, config.securitySection().size(),
                "the shipped protection block should declare all sixteen limits, found: "
                        + config.securitySection().keySet());
    }

    @Test
    void aConfigWithoutTheProtectionBlockStillLoadsSafely() throws Exception {
        // An operator running an older deployed file must not get a null protection layer.
        Path directory = Files.createTempDirectory("no-protection");
        String original = read("/client-detection.yml");
        String stripped = original.replaceAll("(?m)^  protection:\\s*$\\n((^[ ]+.*\\n)+)", "");
        assertFalse(stripped.contains("max-payload-bytes"), "strip should have removed the block");
        Files.write(directory.resolve("client-detection.yml"),
                stripped.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        ClientDetectionConfig config = ClientDetectionConfig.load(directory,
                Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
        assertNotNull(config.securityLimits());
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.maxPayloadBytes(),
                config.securityLimits().maxPayloadBytes(),
                "a missing block must fall back to safe defaults, never to no protection");
        assertTrue(config.securityLimits().playerMessagesPerSecond() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void passiveEnforcementDefaultsOff() throws Exception {
        assertFalse(bundled().passiveEnforce(),
                "the only detected-capable probe belongs to a legitimate mod, so enforcing it "
                        + "by default would be a false positive");
    }

    @Test
    void exploitPreventerLineIsDocumentedForGeyserOperators() throws Exception {
        // The value may be either, but the key must exist so the trade-off is discoverable.
        assertNotNull(bundled().securitySection());
        assertTrue(read("/client-detection.yml").contains("exploit-preventer-line"));
    }

    @Test
    void shippedMainConfigHasNoDecorativeKeys() throws Exception {
        String config = read("/config.yml");
        // Keys the loader actually reads.
        for (String real : new String[]{"enabled:", "debug:", "detection:", "enforcement:"}) {
            assertTrue(config.contains(real), "expected a real key: " + real);
        }
        // Keys that must NOT be present, because nothing reads them. Leaving them in
        // would tell an operator they are doing something.
        for (String decorative : new String[]{"log-interval-seconds", "still-detect",
                "bypass-enforcement", "skip-java-detectors", "fail-closed-on-unknown",
                "players-file"}) {
            boolean present = config.contains(decorative + ":");
            assertFalse(present,
                    "'" + decorative + "' is not read by any code path; a decorative key is "
                            + "worse than a missing one");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void everyVerificationStatusInTheFileIsParseable() throws Exception {
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : bundled().probeRegistry().all()) {
            assertNotNull(ProbeVerificationStatus.parse(probe.verificationStatus().name()));
        }
    }

    @Test
    void theCoverageMatrixAndTheCatalogStillAgree() throws Exception {
        String matrix = read("/client-coverage-matrix.yml");
        for (ProbeDefinition probe : bundled().probeRegistry().all()) {
            // Every passive probe must appear in the matrix, because a passive signal is the
            // strongest claim the project makes and must be documented.
            if (probe.transport() != ProbeTransportMode.PASSIVE) continue;
            assertTrue(matrix.contains(probe.id()),
                    probe.id() + " is passive and must be documented in the coverage matrix");
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

    private static String read(String resource) throws Exception {
        try (InputStream stream = ShippedConfigurationTest.class.getResourceAsStream(resource)) {
            assertNotNull(stream, resource + " must ship with the plugin");
            return new String(stream.readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        }
    }

    private static ClientDetectionConfig bundled() throws Exception {
        Path directory = Files.createTempDirectory("shipped-config");
        Files.write(directory.resolve("client-detection.yml"),
                read("/client-detection.yml").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        return ClientDetectionConfig.load(directory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.core;

        assertEquals(LifecycleState.RUNNING, core.state());

            @Override public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) { return handle(); }
            @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) { return handle(); }
            @Override public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) { return handle(); }
            @Override public void shutdown() { }
            private TaskHandle handle() { return new TaskHandle() {
                @Override public void cancel() { }
                @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
            }; }
        });
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/detection/BinaryVerdictContractTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.CheckHacksResponseEvaluator;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeCorroboration;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDefinition;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeEvidenceStrength;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeEvaluation;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeMode;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeResultAggregator;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeTransportMode;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeVerificationStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeValidityMatrix;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.ConfirmedDetection;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.DefaultEnforcementPolicy;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementAction;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementDecision;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementPolicy;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.EnumSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Locks in the binary verdict contract.
 *
 * <p>Two properties are under test and both are non-negotiable:
 *
 * <ol>
 *   <li>There are exactly two public outcomes, CLEAN and BLOCKED. No third verdict exists,
 *       and no internal state, diagnostic label or transport outcome can become one.</li>
 *   <li>Weak evidence never blocks. A signal that is unattributable, unexpected, unknown,
 *       timed out, failed or missing resolves to CLEAN. Binary output must not have lowered
 *       the evidence bar.</li>
 * </ol>
 */
class BinaryVerdictContractTest {

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the type is binary

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the verdict enum has exactly two outcomes")
    void verdictHasExactlyTwoValues() {
        assertEquals(2, Verdict.values().length, "a third verdict must not exist");
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.valueOf("CLEAN"));
        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, Verdict.valueOf("BLOCKED"));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("no forbidden third-verdict name exists in any public enum")
    void noThirdVerdictNameExists() {
        Set<String> forbidden = Set.of("UNCERTAIN", "INCONCLUSIVE", "SUSPICIOUS",
                "WEAK_EVIDENCE", "UNKNOWN", "AMBIGUOUS", "MAYBE");
        for (Class<?> type : List.of(Verdict.class, DetectionStatus.class,
                site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementAction.class)) {
            for (Object constant : type.getEnumConstants()) {
                assertFalse(forbidden.contains(((Enum<?>) constant).name()),
                        type.getSimpleName() + " must not expose " + constant);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("only DETECTED maps to BLOCKED; every other state is CLEAN")
    void onlyDetectedBlocks() {
        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, Verdict.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED));
        for (DetectionStatus status : DetectionStatus.values()) {
            if (status == DetectionStatus.DETECTED) continue;
            assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(status), status + " must not block");
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a timeout, failure, skip or missing response is CLEAN")
    void transportOutcomesNeverBlock() {
        for (DetectionStatus status : List.of(DetectionStatus.TIMEOUT, DetectionStatus.ERROR,
                DetectionStatus.SKIPPED, DetectionStatus.UNSUPPORTED, DetectionStatus.PROTECTED,
                DetectionStatus.NOT_CHECKED, DetectionStatus.RUNNING, DetectionStatus.CLEAN)) {
            DetectionResult result = DetectionResult.of(status, "diagnostic only");
            assertFalse(result.blocked(), status + " must not produce a block");
            assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, result.verdict());
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- weak evidence can never escalate

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an unattributable localized response is CLEAN with WEAK evidence")
    void weakLocalizedResponseIsCleanNotAVerdict() {
        ProbeDefinition probe = probe("weak", "target.key", false);
        // A client that renders translated text but never exposes its key cannot be attributed.
        ProbeEvaluation evaluation = CheckHacksResponseEvaluator.evaluateDetailed(
                probe, "Some Localized Label", null, false);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, evaluation.status(),
                "unattributable text must never carry a non-clean status");
        assertEquals(ProbeEvidenceStrength.WEAK, evaluation.evidenceStrength(),
                "the ambiguity must stay on record as a diagnostic");
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(evaluation.status()));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("corroboration reports ambiguity as a diagnostic over a CLEAN status")
    void ambiguityIsDiagnosticOverClean() {
        ProbeCorroboration.Observation weak = new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("weak",
                DetectionStatus.CLEAN, ProbeEvidenceStrength.WEAK,
                ProbeCorroboration.Basis.WEAK_LOCALIZED, true);
        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(weak));

        assertEquals(ProbeCorroboration.Conclusion.AMBIGUOUS, decision.conclusion(),
                "the diagnostic conclusion should still be visible");
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, decision.status(),
                "but the status behind it must be CLEAN");
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(decision.status()));
        assertFalse(decision.confirmed(), "an unattributable response must not confirm");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("aggregation of only-weak results resolves to CLEAN")
    void aggregationOfWeakResultsIsClean() {
        DetectionStatus aggregated = ProbeResultAggregator.aggregate(List.of(
                DetectionStatus.CLEAN, DetectionStatus.CLEAN, DetectionStatus.TIMEOUT));
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(aggregated));
        assertFalse(ProbeResultAggregator.needsConfirmation(aggregated));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a probe that cannot carry identity tops out at CLEAN, never a half-state")
    void nonDetectedCapableProbeTopsOutClean() {
        DetectionStatus worst = ProbeValidityMatrix.worstCaseFor(false);
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, worst);
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(worst));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- enforcement follows the verdict

    @Test
    @DisplayName("policy kicks on a verified identity and never on CLEAN")
    void policyFollowsBinaryVerdict() {
        EnforcementPolicy policy = new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true);

        DetectionResult blocked = verifiedIdentity();
        DetectionResult clean = DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, "no verified identity");

        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, blocked.verdict());
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, clean.verdict());

        EnforcementDecision blockedDecision = policy.decide(blocked);
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, blockedDecision.action(),
                "a verified identity must be enforced");
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, policy.decide(clean).action(),
                "CLEAN must never be enforced");
    }

    /**
     * A verified identity needs the confirmation record, not just the status. A bare DETECTED
     * with no independently recorded confirmation is deliberately not enforced.
     */
    @Test
    @DisplayName("DETECTED without a confirmation record is BLOCKED but not enforced")
    void detectedWithoutConfirmationRecordIsNotEnforced() {
        DetectionResult bare = DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "status only");

        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, bare.verdict(),
                "the verdict still follows the status");
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(bare),
                "but enforcement requires an independently verified confirmation record");
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE,
                new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true).decide(bare).action());
    }

    /** A fully verified blocked-client identity: DETECTED plus a CONFIRMATION record. */
    private static DetectionResult verifiedIdentity() {
        return DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "verified blocked-client identity")
                .withEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "confirmation",
                        java.time.Instant.EPOCH,
                        java.util.Map.of("pass", "CONFIRMATION", "classification", "DETECTED",
                                "category", "client", "transport", "INTERACTIVE",
                                "probe", "blocked-client")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("no confirmation record means no enforcement, whatever the status")
    void unconfirmedResultsAreNeverEnforced() {
        DetectionResult result = DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "no confirmation pass");
        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, result.verdict(), "the verdict follows the status");
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result),
                "but enforcement requires an independently verified confirmation record");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("every non-detected status produces a non-confirmed, non-kicking result")
    void noNonDetectedStatusEverKicks() {
        for (DetectionStatus status : EnumSet.complementOf(EnumSet.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED))) {
            DetectionResult result = DetectionResult.of(status, "diagnostic");
            assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result),
                    status + " must not be confirmable");
            assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, result.verdict(), status + " must be CLEAN");
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an authoritative strong match is the only path to BLOCKED")
    void onlyAuthoritativeStrongMatchBlocks() {
        ProbeDefinition probe = probe("strong", "target.key", false);

        ProbeEvaluation detected = CheckHacksResponseEvaluator.evaluateDetailed(
                probe, "exact configured text", null, false);
        assertEquals(ProbeEvidenceStrength.STRONG, detected.evidenceStrength());
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, detected.status());

        ProbeCorroboration.Observation observation = new ProbeCorroboration.Observation(
                probe.id(), detected.status(), detected.evidenceStrength(),
                ProbeCorroboration.Basis.EXACT_CONFIGURED_RESPONSE, true);
        assertTrue(observation.authoritative(), "an exact response match is authoritative");

        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(observation));
        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, Verdict.of(decision.status()));
        assertTrue(decision.confirmed());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the verdict is derived, so a stored result cannot disagree with it")
    void verdictIsDerivedNotStored() {
        // The same status always yields the same verdict; there is no field to desynchronize.
        for (DetectionStatus status : DetectionStatus.values()) {
            DetectionResult first = DetectionResult.of(status, "reason");
            DetectionResult second = first.withEvidence(
                    new Evidence(EvidenceType.SYSTEM, "note", java.time.Instant.now(),
                            java.util.Map.of("k", "v")));
            assertEquals(first.verdict(), second.verdict(),
                    "adding evidence must not change the verdict");
            assertEquals(first.verdict(), Verdict.of(first));
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("inverse is a total pairing over exactly two values")
    void inversePairsTheTwoVerdicts() {
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.BLOCKED.inverse());
        assertEquals(Verdict.BLOCKED, Verdict.CLEAN.inverse());
        for (Verdict verdict : Verdict.values()) {
            assertNotEquals(verdict, verdict.inverse());
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers

    private static ProbeDefinition probe(String id, String key, boolean identityResolution) {
        return new ProbeDefinition(id, id, key, ProbeMode.TRANSLATE, "fallback",
                true, true, false, ProbeVerificationStatus.LIVE_VERIFIED,
                "client", "test fixture", "", "exact configured text",
                ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE, identityResolution, "");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("weak signal count is retained as diagnostics without becoming an outcome")
    void weakSignalCountSurvivesAsDiagnostic() {
        List<ProbeCorroboration.Observation> observations = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("a", DetectionStatus.CLEAN,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.WEAK, ProbeCorroboration.Basis.WEAK_LOCALIZED, true),
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("b", DetectionStatus.CLEAN,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.WEAK, ProbeCorroboration.Basis.WEAK_LOCALIZED, true)));
        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(observations);

        assertEquals(2, decision.weakSignals(), "the diagnostic count is preserved");
        assertTrue(decision.promotedProbes().isEmpty(), "nothing was promoted");
        assertFalse(decision.reason().isBlank(), "the reason explains why nothing was promoted");
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(decision.status()));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/detection/DetectionRegistryTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config.FoundationConfig;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.Platform;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.PlatformContext;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.Scheduler;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.TaskHandle;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class DetectionRegistryTest {
    @Test
    void registersLooksUpUnregistersAndRejectsDuplicates() {
        DetectionRegistry registry = new DetectionRegistry();
        TestModule module = new TestModule("sample");
        registry.register(module);

        assertEquals(module, registry.lookup("sample"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> registry.register(new TestModule("sample")));
        assertEquals(module, registry.unregister("sample"));
        assertEquals(List.of(), registry.activeModules());
    }

    @Test
    void disabledModulesAreNotRegistered() {
        DetectionRegistry registry = new DetectionRegistry();
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> registry.register(new TestModule("disabled", false)));
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentRegistrationKeepsAllUniqueModules() throws Exception {
        DetectionRegistry registry = new DetectionRegistry();
        var executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        CountDownLatch ready = new CountDownLatch(8);
        List<Runnable> work = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            int id = i;
            work.add(() -> {
                ready.countDown();
                try { ready.await(); } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw new AssertionError(exception);
                }
                registry.register(new TestModule("sample-" + id));
            });
        }
        var futures = work.stream().map(executor::submit).toList();
        for (var future : futures) future.get();
        executor.shutdownNow();
        assertEquals(8, registry.activeModules().size());
    }

    @Test
    void emptyRegistryInitializesAndStops() {
        DetectionRegistry registry = new DetectionRegistry();
        registry.initializeAll(context());
        registry.startAll();
        registry.stopAll();
        registry.stopAll();
        assertEquals(List.of(), registry.activeModules());
    }

    @Test
    void moduleLifecycleRunsInOrder() {
        DetectionRegistry registry = new DetectionRegistry();
        TestModule module = new TestModule("sample");
        registry.register(module);
        registry.initializeAll(context());
        registry.startAll();
        registry.stopAll();

        assertEquals(List.of("initialize", "start", "stop"), module.calls);
    }

    private static DetectionModuleContext context() {
        return new DetectionModuleContext(new PlatformContext(Platform.PAPER, new NoopScheduler()),
                FoundationConfig.defaults(), Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }

    private static DetectionDefinition definition(String id, boolean enabled) {
        return new DetectionDefinition(id, "Sample", "Generic test definition",
                DetectionCategory.CLIENT, DetectionSeverity.INFO, enabled);
    }

    private static final class TestModule implements DetectionModule {
        private final DetectionDefinition definition;
        private final List<String> calls = new ArrayList<>();

        private TestModule(String id) { this(id, true); }
        private TestModule(String id, boolean enabled) { this.definition = DetectionRegistryTest.definition(id, enabled); }
        @Override public DetectionDefinition definition() { return definition; }
        @Override public String version() { return "test"; }
        @Override public void initialize(DetectionModuleContext context) { calls.add("initialize"); }
        @Override public void start() { calls.add("start"); }
        @Override public void stop() { calls.add("stop"); }
    }

    private static final class NoopScheduler implements Scheduler {
        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.EntityTarget target, Runnable task) { return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAtLocation(site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.RegionTarget target, Runnable task) { return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) { return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) { return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) { return handle(); }
        @Override public void shutdown() { }
        private TaskHandle handle() { return new TaskHandle() {
            @Override public void cancel() { }
            @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
        }; }
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/detection/DetectionSessionTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class DetectionSessionTest {
    @Test
    void completesWithImmutableEvidence() {
        DetectionSession session = session();
        Evidence evidence = new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.now(), Map.of("key", "value"));

        session.start();
        session.addEvidence(evidence);
        session.beginCompletion();
        session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, "no finding"));

        assertEquals(DetectionSessionState.COMPLETED, session.state());
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, session.result().status());
        assertEquals(List.of(evidence), session.evidence());
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> session.start());
    }

    @Test
    void cancellationTimeoutAndFailureAreNotClean() {
        DetectionSession cancelled = session();
        cancelled.start();
        cancelled.cancel("cancelled by owner");
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.SKIPPED, cancelled.result().status());

        DetectionSession timedOut = session();
        timedOut.start();
        timedOut.timeout("deadline exceeded");
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.TIMEOUT, timedOut.result().status());

        DetectionSession failed = session();
        failed.start();
        failed.fail("execution failed");
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.ERROR, failed.result().status());
    }

    @Test
    void invalidTransitionsAreRejected() {
        DetectionSession session = session();
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> session.beginCompletion());
        session.start();
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, "no finding")));
        session.cancel("done");
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> session.addEvidence(
                new Evidence(EvidenceType.SYSTEM, "test", Instant.now(), Map.of())));
    }

    @Test
    void cancellationCannotInterruptCompletionInProgress() {
        DetectionSession session = session();
        session.start();
        session.beginCompletion();

        session.cancel("player disconnected");
        session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, "response received"));

        assertEquals(DetectionSessionState.COMPLETED, session.state());
    }

    private static DetectionSession session() {
        return new DetectionSession(UUID.randomUUID(), UUID.randomUUID(), "sample", Instant.now());
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/detection/probe/CheckHacksClientDetectionModuleTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe;

    @Test
    void timeoutIsProtectedAndProducesEvidenceForEveryProbe() {
        List<ProbeDefinition> probes = probes(4);
        FakeTransport transport = new FakeTransport(ProbeResponse.Outcome.TIMEOUT);
        CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module = module(probes, transport, false);
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        module.check(target(), result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.TIMEOUT, result.get().status());
        assertEquals(4, result.get().evidence().size());
        assertTrue(result.get().evidence().get(0).metadata().containsKey("session"));
        assertEquals("TIMEOUT", result.get().evidence().get(0).metadata().get("classification"));
    }

    }

    @Test

        List<ProbeDefinition> probes = probes(1);

        DetectionTarget target = target();

        module.check(target, manual::set);
        assertTrue(module.isActive(target.id()));
        assertNull(module.checkIfIdle(target, probes, "JOIN", ignored -> { }));

        transport.respond();

    }

    @Test

        BlockingTransport transport = new BlockingTransport();
        CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module = module(probes(1), transport, false);
        AtomicInteger callbacks = new AtomicInteger();
        DetectionSession session = module.check(target(), ignored -> callbacks.incrementAndGet());

        module.stop();
        module.stop();

        assertTrue(session.state().terminal());

    }

    @Test
    void nextBatchSchedulerFailureCompletesAsErrorWithoutLeakingSession() {
        ClientProbeTransport transport = new FakeTransport(ProbeResponse.Outcome.RESPONSE);
        Scheduler scheduler = new ImmediateScheduler() {
            @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("scheduler unavailable");
            }
        };
        ClientDetectionConfig config = new ClientDetectionConfig(true, false, 20, 1, probes(4));
        CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module = new CheckHacksClientDetectionModule(config, transport);
        module.initialize(new DetectionModuleContext(new PlatformContext(Platform.PAPER, scheduler),
                FoundationConfig.defaults(), Logger.getLogger("test")));
        module.start();
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        AtomicInteger callbacks = new AtomicInteger();

        DetectionSession session = module.check(target(), value -> {
            callbacks.incrementAndGet();
            result.set(value);
        });

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.ERROR, result.get().status());
        assertEquals(1, callbacks.get());
        assertTrue(session.state().terminal());
        assertEquals(0, module.activeSessionCount());
    }

    @Test
    void confirmationNextBatchSchedulingFailureCompletesOnceAsError() {
        java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger delayedSchedules = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger();
        Scheduler scheduler = new ImmediateScheduler() {
            @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) {
                if (delayedSchedules.incrementAndGet() == 1) {
                    task.run(); // finish the initial pass's second batch
                    return new TaskHandle() {
                        @Override public void cancel() { }
                        @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
                    };
                }
                throw new IllegalStateException("confirmation batch scheduler unavailable");
            }
        };
        ClientProbeTransport transport = new ClientProbeTransport() {
            @Override public ProbeHandle send(ProbeRequest request,
                    java.util.function.Consumer<ProbeResponse> response) {
                List<String> lines = new ArrayList<>(request.probes().stream()
                        .map(ProbeDefinition::key).toList());
                while (lines.size() < 3) lines.add("");
                lines.add("not-a-keybind");
                response.accept(new ProbeResponse(request.sessionId(), request.target().id(), lines,
                        ProbeResponse.Outcome.RESPONSE));
                return new DelayedHandle();
            }
            @Override public void stop() { }
        };
        ClientDetectionConfig config = new ClientDetectionConfig(true, true, 20, 1, probes(4));
        CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module = new CheckHacksClientDetectionModule(config, transport);
        module.initialize(new DetectionModuleContext(new PlatformContext(Platform.PAPER, scheduler),
                FoundationConfig.defaults(), Logger.getLogger("test-confirm-scheduler")));
        module.start();
        AtomicInteger callbacks = new AtomicInteger();
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        DetectionSession session = module.check(target(), value -> {
            callbacks.incrementAndGet();
            result.set(value);
        });

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.ERROR, result.get().status());
        assertEquals(1, callbacks.get());
        assertTrue(session.state().terminal());
        assertEquals(0, module.activeSessionCount());
        assertEquals(1, module.diagnostics().errors());
    }
```
