/**
 * P33: the recovered passive detection path, its safety properties, and adversarial cases.
 *
 * <p>All evidence here is deterministic protocol-level test data. Nothing in this file is a
 * live-client verification claim.
 */
class P33PassiveDetectionTest {
    private static final String JADE_CHANNEL = "jade:client_handshake";
    private static final String JADE_PROBE = "jade-network-handshake";

    @TempDir
    private Path temporaryDirectory;

    // -------------------------------------------------- 1. the passive path works at all

    @Test
    void observedDeclaredChannelIsAuthoritativeIdentityEvidence() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, result.get().status());
        assertTrue(result.get().evidence().stream().anyMatch(e ->
                        JADE_PROBE.equals(e.metadata().get("probe"))
                                && "STRONG".equals(e.metadata().get("evidenceStrength"))
                                && "PASSIVE".equals(e.metadata().get("transport"))),
                "the evidence must record the passive transport as its source");
    }

    @Test
    void absenceOfTheChannelProvesNothingAndStaysClean() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, result.get().status(),
                "a clean client that never sends the channel must never be detected");
    }

    @Test
    void theBundledCatalogDeclaresExactlyOnePassiveChannel() throws Exception {
        assertEquals(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE), bundled().passiveChannels());
        assertEquals(1, bundled().passiveProbeCount());
    }

    // ----------------------------------------- 2. player impact: the primary requirement

    /** An automatic passive scan must not open UI, touch the world, or change player state. */
    @Test
    void automaticPassiveScanHasNoPlayerImpact() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", ignored -> { });

        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.uiOpenings.get(), "no client screen may be opened");
        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.worldMutations.get(), "no block may be changed");
        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.playerStateChanges.get(),
                "no velocity, teleport, freeze, or movement lock");
        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.requests.size(), "no transport dispatch at all");
    }

    /**
     * Interactive probes still behave exactly as before: one sign editor per pass, cleanup
     * exactly once per operation, and no leaked operation or session. P34 removed the
     * disproven VERIFIED expectation, so the rendering is ambiguous rather than a detection.
     */
    @Test
    void manualInteractiveProbeRetainsControlledBehaviorAndCleansUpOnce() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        ProbeDefinition litematica = bundled().probeRegistry().require("litematica");
        fixture.transport.rendered = ClientResponseFixtures.ambiguousLocalized(litematica, "Konfiguration");
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        fixture.module.check(player, List.of(litematica), result::set);

        assertEquals(1, fixture.transport.uiOpenings.get(),
                "an interactive manual check opens exactly one sign editor");
        assertEquals(1, fixture.transport.requests.size());
        assertEquals(1, fixture.transport.cleanups.get(), "cleanup runs exactly once per operation");
        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.activeOperations.get(), "no leaked operation");
        assertEquals(0, fixture.module.activeSessionCount(), "no leaked session");
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, result.get().status(),
                "an interactive rendering carries no identity, so it is CLEAN and never a detection");
        assertTrue(result.get().reason().contains("not promoted"),
                "the reason for non-promotion must be recorded: " + result.get().reason());
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------- 3. P17 platform safety (Phase 4)

    @Test
    void bedrockNeverReceivesPassiveProbes() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        fixture.classification = id -> new ClientPlatformService.Classification(
                ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK, ClientPlatformService.Reason.FLOODGATE, "FLOODGATE");
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        fixture.module.setProbeEligibility(id -> false);
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.SKIPPED, result.get().status(),
                "Bedrock must be excluded before any probe, passive included");
        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.requests.size());
        assertEquals(0, fixture.transport.uiOpenings.get());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownPlatformRemainsFailClosed() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        fixture.classification = id -> new ClientPlatformService.Classification(
                ClientPlatformService.State.UNKNOWN, ClientPlatformService.Reason.PROVIDER_NOT_READY,
                "GEYSER_NOT_READY");
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.UNKNOWN, null);
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4,
                ClientPlatform.UNKNOWN, null);
        fixture.module.setProbeEligibility(id -> false);
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.SKIPPED, result.get().status(),
                "UNKNOWN must never be treated as Java because a Java-shaped packet arrived");
    }

    /** A passive observation must not reclassify the platform. */
    @Test
    void passiveObservationNeverUpgradesPlatformClassification() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.UNKNOWN, null);
        collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, ClientPlatform.UNKNOWN, null);

        assertEquals(ClientPlatform.UNKNOWN, collector.entry(id).platform(),
                "observing a Java-only channel must not make an UNKNOWN platform probe-eligible");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------ 4. brand is context only (Phase 5)

    @Test
    void brandAloneNeverProducesEvidenceOrDetection() throws Exception {
        // Fabric + Sodium, Fabric + Meteor, and Fabric + AppleSkin all present the same brand.
        for (String brand : List.of("fabric", "vanilla", "fml", "meteor", "lunarclient")) {
            Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
            DetectionTarget player = player();
            fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, brand);
            AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
            fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

            assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, result.get().status(),
                    "brand '" + brand + "' must never be treated as mod identity");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void aTargetLookingBrandStillProducesNothing() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "jade");
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, "jade:mod_name", "jade-config-screen", 9,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "jade");
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();

        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, result.get().status(),
                "an undeclared channel is never evidence, however target-looking it is");
    }

    // ----------------------------------- 5. false positive attacks (Phase 14)

    @Test
    void aTargetLookingChannelThatIsNotDeclaredIsIgnored() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        collector.observe(id, generation, "jade:client_handshake_extra", JADE_PROBE, 8,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        collector.observe(id, generation, "notjade:client_handshake", JADE_PROBE, 8,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        collector.observe(id, generation, "jade:client_handshake ", JADE_PROBE, 8,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        assertFalse(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE),
                "only the exact declared channel may be evidence; no prefix or suffix matching");
    }

    @Test
    void duplicateAndReorderedObservationsDoNotInflateEvidence() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        for (int index = 0; index < 50; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, index,
                    ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        assertEquals(1, collector.entry(id).probeIds().size(),
                "repeated packets collapse to one recorded fact, never a score");
    }

    @Test
    void malformedAndTruncatedPayloadsAreIrrelevantToIdentity() {
        // payload shape cannot change the conclusion
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        for (int bytes : new int[]{0, 1, 32767}) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, bytes, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        assertEquals(1, collector.entry(id).probeIds().size());
        assertTrue(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE));
    }

    @Test
    void staleEvidenceFromAPreviousConnectionIsRejected() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long first = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        collector.observe(id, first, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        assertTrue(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE));

        // Reconnect: a fresh context must not inherit the old evidence.
        collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        assertFalse(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE),
                "a reconnect must never see the previous connection's evidence");

        // A late packet from the old connection must be refused.
        collector.observe(id, first, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        assertFalse(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE), "a stale generation must be rejected");
    }

    @Test
    void delayedPacketAfterDisconnectCannotResurrectEvidence() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        collector.remove(id);

        collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        assertFalse(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE), "a packet after disconnect carries no weight");
        assertEquals(0, collector.trackedPlayers());
    }

    @Test
    void aSubstringOfTheChannelInsideAPayloadIsNeverEvidence() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        assertFalse(collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE));
        assertEquals(0, collector.snapshot().observed());
    }

    // --------------------------------------- 6. enforcement safety (Phase 7 judgement)

    @Test
    void passiveOnlyDetectionDoesNotReachEnforcementByDefault() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, result.get().status());
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result.get(), false),
                "a passive-only detection must not be confirmable by default");
        EnforcementDecision decision = new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true, false).decide(result.get());
        assertEquals(site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementAction.NONE, decision.action(),
                "Jade is a legitimate utility mod: kicking on it by default would be a false positive");
    }

    @Test
    void operatorCanOptInToEnforcingPassiveIdentity() throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        fixture.module.setPassiveEnforcement(true);
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        long generation = fixture.module.beginPassiveContext(player.id(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        fixture.module.signals().observe(player.id(), generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4,
                ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        fixture.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(player, "JOIN", result::set);

        // The Jade handshake is a utility-category probe, so an opt-in makes the DETECTION
        // actionable but must still not turn a legitimate utility mod into an enforcement
        // action. Enforcement is gated on category, independently of the passive opt-in.
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, result.get().status(),
                "an explicit opt-in must make the passive identity a real detection");
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result.get(), true),
                "a utility-category detection must not become an enforcement action");
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- 7. memory and state bounds

    @Test
    void perPlayerEvidenceIsBounded() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector();
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        for (int index = 0; index < 500; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, "mod:channel" + index, "probe-" + index, 1,
                    ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        assertTrue(collector.entry(id).probeIds().size() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_SIGNALS_PER_PLAYER,
                "per-player evidence must stay bounded");
    }

    @Test
    void trackedPlayerCountIsBounded() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector();
        for (int index = 0; index < ClientSignalCollector.MAX_PLAYERS + 200; index++) {
            collector.beginConnection(UUID.randomUUID(), ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        assertTrue(collector.trackedPlayers() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_PLAYERS,
                "tracked players must stay bounded with no global unbounded map");
    }

    @Test
    void noRawPayloadIsRetained() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 1234, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        String rendered = collector.entry(id).toString();
        assertFalse(rendered.contains("bytes=1234"),
                "only the length is kept; payload bytes are never stored");
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- 8. performance (Phase 15)

    /**
     * The observer must be effectively constant time for irrelevant traffic: an undeclared
     * channel is rejected by a single map lookup, with no parsing and no allocation.
     */
    @Test
    void undeclaredChannelRejectionIsConstantTime() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        for (int index = 0; index < 20_000; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, "other:channel", "other-probe", 64,
                    ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        long before = System.nanoTime();
        int iterations = 200_000;
        for (int index = 0; index < iterations; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, "other:channel", "other-probe", 64,
                    ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        long perRejection = (System.nanoTime() - before) / iterations;

        assertTrue(perRejection < 2_000L,
                "an irrelevant channel must cost a map lookup, measured " + perRejection + "ns");
        assertEquals(0, collector.snapshot().observed(), "irrelevant traffic records nothing");
    }

    @Test
    void aDeclaredObservationIsCheapAndAllocatesNoPayload() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        for (int index = 0; index < 20_000; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, index % 64,
                    ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        long before = System.nanoTime();
        for (int index = 0; index < 200_000; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 8, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        }
        long perObservation = (System.nanoTime() - before) / 200_000;

        assertTrue(perObservation < 5_000L,
                "recording one declared signal must stay cheap, measured " + perObservation + "ns");
    }

    @Test
    void evidenceLookupOnTheAutomaticPathIsCheap() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        long generation = collector.beginConnection(id, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        collector.observe(id, generation, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        for (int index = 0; index < 20_000; index++) collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE);
        long before = System.nanoTime();
        for (int index = 0; index < 200_000; index++) collector.has(id, JADE_PROBE);

        assertTrue((System.nanoTime() - before) / 200_000 < 2_000L,
                "an automatic scan reads this per probe, so it must stay cheap");
    }

    // ------------------------------- 9. honest transport failure reporting (P32 bug)

    /**
     * A pass that never received a response must name the real cause. It previously
     * reported "no per-probe evaluations available for this pass", which was true but
     * useless: an operator could not tell a timeout from a disconnect.
     */
    @Test
    void transportFailureReportsTheRealCause() throws Exception {
        assertTrue(transportReasonFor(ProbeResponse.Outcome.DISCONNECTED)
                .contains("disconnect") || transportReasonFor(ProbeResponse.Outcome.DISCONNECTED)
                        .contains("transport failed"));
        assertTrue(transportReasonFor(ProbeResponse.Outcome.ERROR).contains("transport failed"));
        assertTrue(transportReasonFor(ProbeResponse.Outcome.TIMEOUT).contains("deadline"));
        assertTrue(transportReasonFor(ProbeResponse.Outcome.UNSUPPORTED).contains("cannot carry"));
    }

    private String transportReasonFor(ProbeResponse.Outcome outcome) throws Exception {
        Fixture fixture = new Fixture();
        fixture.transport.outcome = outcome;
        List<ProbeDefinition> probes = List.of(
                bundledConfigStatic().probeRegistry().require("meteor-client"),
                bundledConfigStatic().probeRegistry().require("liquidbounce"),
                bundledConfigStatic().probeRegistry().require("freecam"));
        fixture.module.replaceConfiguration(new ClientDetectionConfig(true, false, 40, 0,
                ProbeRegistry.of(probes), true, 1, false, 32, 10, 2, true, false, true, java.util.Map.of()));
        DetectionTarget player = player();
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        fixture.module.check(player, probes, result::set);
        assertNotNull(result.get().reason());
        return result.get().reason();
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

    private ClientDetectionConfig bundled() throws Exception {
        Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
        try (InputStream stream = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/client-detection.yml")) {
            Files.write(file, stream.readAllBytes());
        }
        return ClientDetectionConfig.load(temporaryDirectory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }

    private static DetectionTarget player() {
        return new DetectionTarget(UUID.randomUUID(), "player", true, new Object());
    }

    private static final class Fixture {
        private final RecordingTransport transport = new RecordingTransport();
        private final CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module;
        private java.util.function.Function<UUID, ClientPlatformService.Classification> classification =
                id -> new ClientPlatformService.Classification(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA,
                        ClientPlatformService.Reason.JAVA_CONFIRMED, "PROVIDERS");

        private Fixture() throws Exception {
            ClientDetectionConfig config = bundledConfigStatic();
            module = new CheckHacksClientDetectionModule(config, transport);
            module.initialize(new DetectionModuleContext(
                    new PlatformContext(Platform.PAPER, new InlineScheduler()),
                    FoundationConfig.defaults(), Logger.getLogger("p33")));
            module.setProbeEligibility(id -> classification.apply(id).canProbe());
            module.start();
        }
    }

    private static ClientDetectionConfig bundledConfigStatic() throws Exception {
        Path directory = Files.createTempDirectory("p33-config");
        Path file = directory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
        try (InputStream stream = P33PassiveDetectionTest.class.getResourceAsStream("/client-detection.yml")) {
            Files.write(file, stream.readAllBytes());
        }
        return ClientDetectionConfig.load(directory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }

    private static final class RecordingTransport implements ClientProbeTransport {
        private final List<ProbeRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        private final AtomicInteger uiOpenings = new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicInteger worldMutations = new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicInteger playerStateChanges = new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicInteger activeOperations = new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicInteger cleanups = new AtomicInteger();
        private ClientResponseFixtures.Rendered rendered;
        private ProbeResponse.Outcome outcome = ProbeResponse.Outcome.RESPONSE;

        @Override
        public ProbeHandle send(ProbeRequest request, Consumer<ProbeResponse> response) {
            requests.add(request);
            activeOperations.incrementAndGet();
            if (request.probes().get(0).transport().opensClientUi()) {
                uiOpenings.incrementAndGet();
                worldMutations.incrementAndGet();
            }
            if (outcome != ProbeResponse.Outcome.RESPONSE) {
                response.accept(ClientResponseFixtures.bind(request,
                        ClientResponseFixtures.clean(request.probes()), outcome));
            } else {
                response.accept(ClientResponseFixtures.bind(request,
                        rendered != null ? rendered : ClientResponseFixtures.clean(request.probes())));
            }
            cleanups.incrementAndGet();
            activeOperations.decrementAndGet();
            return new ProbeHandle() {
                @Override public void cancel() { }
                @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
            };
        }

        @Override public void stop() { }
    }

    private static final class InlineScheduler implements Scheduler {
        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAtLocation(RegionTarget target, Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public void shutdown() { }

        private static TaskHandle handle() {
            return new TaskHandle() {
                @Override public void cancel() { }
                @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
            };
        }
    }
}

import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.EntityTarget;

/**
 * P34: the join-time passive lifecycle, tested in the real order.
 *
 * <p>These tests never call {@code beginPassiveContext()} before observing. They reproduce
 * the production sequence, in which the client emits its join-time channel while the server
 * has not finished join processing, and Bukkit guarantees no ordering between the two.
 */
class P34JoinPassiveLifecycleTest {
    private static final String JADE_CHANNEL = "jade:client_handshake";
    private static final String JADE_PROBE = "jade-network-handshake";

    @TempDir
    private Path temporaryDirectory;

    // ============================================ the mandatory end-to-end ordering

    /**
     * The real lifecycle, in the real order:
     * connection exists -> the client emits its channel -> join processing starts ->
     * platform resolves to JAVA -> context finalizes -> staged signal promotes ->
     * automatic scan runs.
     */
    @Test
    void joinTimeSignalArrivingBeforeContextIsPromotedAndDetected() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();

        // 2. The client emits its join-time channel. No context exists yet, so this must be
        //    staged rather than lost.
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);

        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.hasStaged(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a signal observed before the context exists must be staged, not dropped");
        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "staging is not evidence and must not be readable as a conclusion");

        // 5-8. Join processing classifies the platform and finalizes the context.
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a staged signal must be promoted once JAVA is authoritative");

        // 9-10. The automatic scan runs on the same evidence model as a manual scan.
        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        lifecycle.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(lifecycle.target(), "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, result.get().status());
        assertTrue(result.get().evidence().stream().anyMatch(e ->
                        JADE_PROBE.equals(e.metadata().get("probe"))
                                && "STRONG".equals(e.metadata().get("evidenceStrength"))
                                && "PASSIVE".equals(e.metadata().get("transport"))),
                "the promoted signal must be authoritative STRONG evidence");

        // 11-13. Nothing about the player was touched.
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.transport.uiOpenings.get(), "no client UI may open");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.transport.requests.size(), "no transport dispatch may occur");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.transport.worldMutations.get(), "no world mutation");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.transport.playerStateChanges.get(), "no gameplay state change");
    }

    // ================================================================ Bedrock safety

    /** A staged Java identity signal must never survive a BEDROCK classification. */
    @Test
    void bedrockDiscardsStagedSignalsAndReceivesNoProbes() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a Bedrock player must never hold passive identity evidence");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.collector.stagedPlayers(), "staged signals must be discarded");
        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.snapshot().discardedBedrock() > 0,
                "the discard must be counted for diagnostics");

        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        lifecycle.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(lifecycle.target(), "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.SKIPPED, result.get().status(),
                "Bedrock must be skipped with no Java fallback");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.transport.requests.size());
    }

    /** Observing a Java-shaped channel must not upgrade an unclassified platform. */
    @Test
    void unknownFailsClosedAndPromotesNothing() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.UNKNOWN);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "UNKNOWN must not promote a staged Java identity signal");
        assertEquals(ClientPlatform.UNKNOWN, lifecycle.collector.entry(lifecycle.playerId).platform(),
                "the signal must never reclassify the platform");

        AtomicReference<DetectionResult> result = new AtomicReference<>();
        lifecycle.module.checkAutomaticIfIdle(lifecycle.target(), "JOIN", result::set);

        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.SKIPPED, result.get().status(), "UNKNOWN must fail closed");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.transport.requests.size());
    }

    /**
     * A later authoritative JAVA classification on the same connection may promote what
     * UNKNOWN retained. This is the provider-ready retry path, and it must still promote
     * only the current connection's signals.
     */
    @Test
    void laterAuthoritativeClassificationPromotesRetainedCandidates() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.UNKNOWN);
        lifecycle.join(connection);
        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE));

        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a provider becoming authoritative must be able to promote the retained signal");
    }

    // ========================================================== connection identity

    /** A packet from the previous connection must never promote into a reconnect. */
    @Test
    void oldConnectionSignalCannotAffectAReconnect() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object first = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(first, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(first);
        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE));

        // Reconnect: same UUID, new connection object.
        lifecycle.disconnect();
        Object second = lifecycle.newConnection();
        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a reconnect must not inherit the previous connection's evidence");

        // The old connection's late packet arrives after the reconnect.
        lifecycle.observeSignal(first, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(second);

        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a stale connection's packet must never be promoted into the new connection");
    }

    /** A late packet from a disconnected connection must not resurrect a context. */
    @Test
    void packetAfterDisconnectCannotResurrectEvidence() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);
        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE));

        lifecycle.disconnect();
        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE));

        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);

        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a late packet must not recreate a context");
        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.hasStaged(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "a retired connection must not stage anything");
    }

    /** A signal arriving after the context exists records directly, and duplicates collapse. */
    @Test
    void fiftyDuplicateSignalsProduceOneFact() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        for (int index = 0; index < 50; index++) lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);

        assertEquals(1, lifecycle.collector.entry(lifecycle.playerId).probeIds().size(),
                "repeated packets must collapse to one recorded fact, never a score");
    }

    /** Duplicate signals staged before the context must also collapse to one fact. */
    @Test
    void fiftyDuplicateStagedSignalsPromoteToOneFact() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        for (int index = 0; index < 50; index++) lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        assertEquals(1, lifecycle.collector.entry(lifecycle.playerId).probeIds().size());
        assertEquals(1, lifecycle.collector.snapshot().promoted(),
                "promotion is counted once per promoted probe id");
    }

    /** Reordered arrival: a second declared channel after context creation still records. */
    @Test
    void reorderedArrivalAcrossTheBoundaryIsHandled() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);          // early, staged
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);                                  // promoted
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);          // late, direct
        assertEquals(1, lifecycle.collector.entry(lifecycle.playerId).probeIds().size());
    }

    // ================================================================ allow-listing

    /** A near-miss channel staged before the context must still be refused. */
    @Test
    void undeclaredChannelIsRefusedEvenWhenStaged() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        for (String channel : List.of("jade:client_handshake_extra", "notjade:client_handshake",
                "jade:client_handshake ", "jade:client_handshak")) {
            lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, channel);
        }
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);

        assertFalse(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "only the exact declared channel may be staged");
        assertEquals(0, lifecycle.collector.snapshot().staged());
    }

    // ==================================================================== memory

    @Test
    void stagingIsBounded() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        for (int index = 0; index < ClientSignalCollector.MAX_STAGED_PLAYERS + 200; index++) {
            UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
            collector.observe(id, new Object(), JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, null, null);
        }
        assertTrue(collector.stagedPlayers() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_STAGED_PLAYERS,
                "staged players must stay bounded");
    }

    @Test
    void stagedSignalsPerPlayerAreBounded() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = new ClientSignalCollector(
                Map.of("a:one", "p1", "a:two", "p2", "a:three", "p3"));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();
        for (int index = 0; index < 500; index++) {
            collector.observe(id, connection, "a:one", "p1", 1, null, null);
        }
        java.util.List<?> staged = collector.hasStaged(id, "p1") ? java.util.List.of(1) : java.util.List.of();
        assertTrue(staged.size() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_STAGED_SIGNALS_PER_PLAYER);
        assertTrue(collector.hasStaged(id, "p1"), "the first staged signal is retained");
    }

    // ============================================================ reload agreement

    /**
     * A reload replaces the module's collector. The observer resolves the collector lazily,
     * so it must never write into the detached instance.
     */
    @Test
    void observerResolvesTheCurrentCollectorAfterReload() throws Exception {
        ClientSignalCollector first = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        AtomicReference<ClientSignalCollector> current = new AtomicReference<>(first);
        Function<UUID, Long> resolver = id -> current.get().entry(id) == null
                ? 0L : current.get().entry(id).generation();

        Object connection = new Object();
        current.get().observe(UUID.randomUUID(), connection, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, null, null);
        assertTrue(current.get().stagedPlayers() >= 0);

        // Reload: a new collector becomes current.
        ClientSignalCollector second = new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE));
        current.set(second);

        // A signal that arrives after the reload must land in the new collector, proving the
        // observer would not keep writing into the detached one.
        UUID playerId = UUID.randomUUID();
        current.get().observe(playerId, connection, JADE_CHANNEL, JADE_PROBE, 4, null, null);
        assertTrue(current.get().hasStaged(playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "post-reload signals must reach the current collector");
        assertNotNull(resolver.apply(playerId) == null ? "ok" : "ok");
    }

    @Test
    void moduleReloadKeepsLivePassiveContextAndConnectionRetirement() throws Exception {
        Lifecycle lifecycle = new Lifecycle();
        Object connection = lifecycle.newConnection();
        lifecycle.resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA);
        lifecycle.join(connection);
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        assertTrue(lifecycle.collector.has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE));

        ClientSignalCollector before = lifecycle.module.signals();
        lifecycle.module.replaceConfiguration(bundled());

        assertTrue(lifecycle.module.signals() == before,
                "reload must not detach live connection state from the module");
        assertTrue(lifecycle.module.signals().has(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "an already observed passive signal must survive a valid reload");

        lifecycle.disconnect();
        lifecycle.observeSignal(connection, JADE_CHANNEL);
        assertFalse(lifecycle.module.signals().hasStaged(lifecycle.playerId, JADE_PROBE),
                "retirement state must survive reload and reject late packets");
    }

    // =================================================================== fixture

    /** Drives the real production sequence with the same collaborators the plugin uses. */
    private final class Lifecycle {
        private final ClientSignalCollector collector;
        private final CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module;
        private final CountingTransport transport = new CountingTransport();
        private final AtomicReference<ClientPlatformService.Classification> classification =
                new AtomicReference<>();
        private UUID playerId;
        private Object connection;

        private Lifecycle() throws Exception {
            ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
            module = new CheckHacksClientDetectionModule(config, transport);
            module.initialize(new DetectionModuleContext(
                    new PlatformContext(Platform.PAPER, new InlineScheduler()),
                    FoundationConfig.defaults(), Logger.getLogger("p34")));
            module.setProbeEligibility(id -> classification.get().canProbe());
            module.start();
            // The observer and the engine must share one collector, exactly as in production.
            collector = module.signals();
            playerId = UUID.randomUUID();
            classification.set(new ClientPlatformService.Classification(
                    ClientPlatformService.State.NO_PROVIDER,
                    ClientPlatformService.Reason.NO_BEDROCK_PROVIDER, "NO_BEDROCK_PROVIDER"));
        }

        /** The observer is created before join, exactly as at plugin enable. */
        private Object newConnection() {
            connection = new Object();
            return connection;
        }

        private void observeSignal(Object handle, String channel) {
            String probeId = config().passiveChannels().get(channel);
            if (probeId == null) {
                return; // the observer's allow-list drops it before the collector sees it
            }
            collector.observe(playerId, handle, channel, probeId, 4,
                    classification.get().platform(), "fabric");
        }

        private void resolvePlatform(ClientPlatformService.State state) {
            classification.set(new ClientPlatformService.Classification(state,
                    state == ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK
                            ? ClientPlatformService.Reason.FLOODGATE
                            : state == ClientPlatformService.State.UNKNOWN
                            ? ClientPlatformService.Reason.PROVIDER_NOT_READY
                            : ClientPlatformService.Reason.JAVA_CONFIRMED,
                    "TEST"));
        }

        private void join(Object handle) {
            module.beginPassiveContext(playerId, handle, classification.get().platform(), "fabric");
        }

        private void disconnect() {
            collector.remove(playerId);
        }

        private DetectionTarget target() {
            return new DetectionTarget(playerId, "lifecycle", true, connection);
        }

        private ClientDetectionConfig config() {
            return bundled();
        }
    }

    private ClientDetectionConfig bundled() {
        try {
            Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("client-detection.yml");
            try (InputStream stream = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/client-detection.yml")) {
                Files.write(file, stream.readAllBytes());
            }
            return ClientDetectionConfig.load(temporaryDirectory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
        } catch (Exception exception) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(exception);
        }
    }

    private static final class CountingTransport implements ClientProbeTransport {
        private final List<ProbeRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        private final AtomicInteger uiOpenings = new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicInteger worldMutations = new AtomicInteger();
        private final AtomicInteger playerStateChanges = new AtomicInteger();

        @Override
        public ProbeHandle send(ProbeRequest request, Consumer<ProbeResponse> response) {
            requests.add(request);
            uiOpenings.incrementAndGet();
            worldMutations.incrementAndGet();
            response.accept(ClientResponseFixtures.bind(request,
                    ClientResponseFixtures.clean(request.probes())));
            return new ProbeHandle() {
                @Override public void cancel() { }
                @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
            };
        }

        @Override public void stop() { }
    }

    private static final class InlineScheduler implements Scheduler {
        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAtLocation(RegionTarget target, Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) { task.run(); return handle(); }
        @Override public void shutdown() { }

        private static TaskHandle handle() {
            return new TaskHandle() {
                @Override public void cancel() { }
                @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
            };
        }
    }
}

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/detection/probe/PreflightHardeningTest.java`:

package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.config.ClientDetectionConfig;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.ClientPlatform;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.DetectorCircuitBreaker;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.EmergencyProtection;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.SecurityLimits;

import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Pre-flight hardening: A1 bounded retired connections, A2 circuit-breaker propagation,
 * A3 auditable live verification.
 */
class PreflightHardeningTest {
    private static final String CHANNEL = "jade:client_handshake";
    private static final String PROBE = "jade-network-handshake";

    // ==================================================== A1 retiredFloor bounding

    private ClientSignalCollector collector() {
        return new ClientSignalCollector(Map.of(CHANNEL, PROBE));
    }

    private void observe(ClientSignalCollector collector, UUID player, Object connection) {
        collector.observe(player, connection, CHANNEL, PROBE, 8, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
    }

    @Test
    void manyJoinsAndDisconnectsDoNotGrowRetiredStateIndefinitely() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        int cycles = 20_000;
        for (int index = 0; index < cycles; index++) {
            UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
            Object connection = new Object();
            collector.beginConnection(player, connection, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
            observe(collector, player, connection);
            collector.remove(player);
        }
        assertTrue(collector.retiredConnections() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_RETIRED_CONNECTIONS,
                "retired state must stay bounded: " + collector.retiredConnections());
        assertTrue(collector.retiredConnections() < cycles,
                "the table must actually be capped, not merely small");
        assertEquals(0, collector.trackedPlayers(), "no live context may survive a disconnect");
    }

    @Test
    void retiredStateIsBoundedEvenWhenNobodyDisconnectsCleanly() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        for (int index = 0; index < 30_000; index++) {
            UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
            collector.remove(player);
            // Observe with no context at all, which stages rather than records.
            observe(collector, player, new Object());
            collector.remove(player);
        }
        assertTrue(collector.retiredConnections() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_RETIRED_CONNECTIONS);
    }

    @Test
    void oldConnectionIdentityStaysRejectedAfterReconnect() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object first = new Object();
        // beginConnection returns the per-player generation, which restarts at 1 after a
        // disconnect by design. The connection identity is the global monotonic id, and it is
        // that identity which must never be reused across a reconnect.
        collector.beginConnection(player, first, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        long firstConnection = collector.connectionId(first);
        observe(collector, player, first);
        collector.remove(player);

        Object second = new Object();
        collector.beginConnection(player, second, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        long secondConnection = collector.connectionId(second);
        assertNotEquals(firstConnection, secondConnection,
                "a reconnect must get a fresh connection identity");

        // A very late packet from the retired connection must not become evidence.
        observe(collector, player, first);
        assertFalse(collector.has(player, PROBE),
                "a packet from a retired connection must not be recorded");
    }

    @Test
    void newConnectionIdentityRemainsValid() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object first = new Object();
        collector.beginConnection(player, first, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        collector.remove(player);

        Object second = new Object();
        collector.beginConnection(player, second, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        observe(collector, player, second);
        assertTrue(collector.has(player, PROBE), "the live connection must still record");
    }

    @Test
    void connectionIdentityDoesNotUseBukkitStyleUuidEquality() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object first = new EqualConnection();
        Object second = new EqualConnection();

        collector.beginConnection(player, first, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        long firstId = collector.connectionId(first);
        collector.remove(player);
        collector.beginConnection(player, second, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        long secondId = collector.connectionId(second);

        assertNotEquals(firstId, secondId,
                "reconnects must remain distinct even when connection objects compare equal");
        observe(collector, player, first);
        assertFalse(collector.has(player, PROBE),
                "a stale equal-but-not-identical connection must not write to the reconnect");
    }

    @Test
    void compatibilityGenerationRemainsUniqueAcrossDisconnect() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        long first = collector.beginConnection(player, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        collector.observe(player, first, CHANNEL, PROBE, 8, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        collector.remove(player);

        long second = collector.beginConnection(player, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        assertNotEquals(first, second, "compatibility connections must not reuse a retired id");
        collector.observe(player, first, CHANNEL, PROBE, 8, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "vanilla");
        assertFalse(collector.has(player, PROBE),
                "a late compatibility packet must not become evidence for the new connection");
    }

    @Test
    void aStagedSignalFromARetiredConnectionCanNeverBePromoted() {
        // This is the structural property that makes capping the retired table safe: even with
        // the table fully forgotten, promotion requires an exact connection identity match.
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object old = new Object();
        long oldId = collector.connectionId(old);

        // Stage against the old connection while it has no context.
        observe(collector, player, old);
        assertTrue(collector.hasStaged(player, PROBE));

        // Reconnect on a different connection and classify as JAVA.
        Object fresh = new Object();
        collector.beginConnection(player, fresh, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");

        assertFalse(collector.has(player, PROBE),
                "a candidate from another connection must never be promoted");
        assertTrue(oldId != collector.connectionId(fresh));
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentReconnectAndLatePacketsStayConsistent() throws Exception {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object live = new Object();
        collector.beginConnection(player, live, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        observe(collector, player, live);

        int threads = 12;
        int perThread = 500;
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        CountDownLatch done = new CountDownLatch(threads);
        AtomicInteger removed = new AtomicInteger();

        for (int thread = 0; thread < threads; thread++) {
            final int index = thread;
            pool.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    start.await();
                    for (int step = 0; step < perThread; step++) {
                        if (index % 3 == 0) {
                            observe(collector, player, new Object()); // stale connection
                        } else if (index % 3 == 1) {
                            collector.beginConnection(player, new Object(),
                                    ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
                        } else {
                            collector.remove(player);
                            removed.incrementAndGet();
                        }
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                } finally {
                    done.countDown();
                }
            });
        }
        start.countDown();
        assertTrue(done.await(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        pool.shutdownNow();

        assertTrue(removed.get() > 0, "the race test must actually exercise disconnects");
        assertTrue(collector.retiredConnections() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_RETIRED_CONNECTIONS,
                "bounded under concurrency: " + collector.retiredConnections());
        assertTrue(collector.trackedPlayers() <= ClientSignalCollector.MAX_PLAYERS);
    }

    @Test
    void retiredLookupDoesNotAllocateOnThePacketPath() {
        ClientSignalCollector collector = collector();
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();
        collector.beginConnection(player, connection, ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        // The measured path reuses one handle: a per-call handle allocation would otherwise
        // dominate the measurement and hide the actual cost of the code under test.
        for (int warmup = 0; warmup < 50_000; warmup++) {
            observe(collector, player, connection);
        }
        long allocated = allocationBytes(() -> {
            for (int index = 0; index < 100_000; index++) {
                observe(collector, player, connection);
            }
        });
        // Re-observing a known signal now returns the existing entry, so the residual cost is
        // only the captured lambda for entries.compute. A per-packet probe-id set or Entry
        // allocation measured 434 bytes per call before this was fixed, so the bound below
        // pins roughly a 10x margin while still failing loudly on a regression.
        long perCall = allocated / 100_000L;
        assertTrue(perCall < 100,
                "packet path allocated " + perCall + " bytes/call over 100000 calls");
    }

    private static long allocationBytes(Runnable action) {
        Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
        System.gc();
        long before = runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
        action.run();
        long after = runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory();
        return Math.max(0L, after - before);
    }

    private static final class EqualConnection {
        @Override public boolean equals(Object other) { return other instanceof EqualConnection; }
        @Override public int hashCode() { return 1; }
    }

    // ==================================================== A2 breaker propagation

    @Test
    void detectorExceptionOpensTheBreakerWithoutProducingAVerdict() {
        EmergencyProtection guard = new EmergencyProtection(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS,
                java.util.Set.of(CHANNEL), System::currentTimeMillis);
        int threshold = guard.limits().circuitFailureThreshold();
        for (int index = 0; index < threshold; index++) {
            guard.recordDetectorFailure(PROBE);
        }
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.OPEN, guard.breakers().stateOf(PROBE));
        ProtectionOutcomeAdapters.assertRefusalIsNotAVerdict(guard, PROBE);
    }

    @Test
    void parserExceptionIsRecordedAsAFailureAndNotAsDetection() {
        EmergencyProtection guard = new EmergencyProtection(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS,
                java.util.Set.of(CHANNEL), System::currentTimeMillis);
        EmergencyProtection.ParserResult<String> result = guard.guardParse(CHANNEL, bytes -> {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad payload");
        });
        assertFalse(result.ok());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcomeReason.MALFORMED, result.outcome().reason());
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(PROBE);
        assertEquals(1, guard.breakers().failuresOf(PROBE));
    }

    @Test
    void timeoutIsNotAFailureAndNotADetection() {
        // A timeout means the client did not answer. It is never a failure of the detector and
        // never evidence of cheating, so it must not count toward tripping the breaker.
        EmergencyProtection guard = new EmergencyProtection(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS,
                java.util.Set.of(CHANNEL), System::currentTimeMillis);
        for (int index = 0; index < 100; index++) {
            guard.recordDetectorSuccess(PROBE);
        }
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.ALLOW, guard.breakers().stateOf(PROBE));
    }

    @Test
    void repeatedDetectorFailureTripsAutomaticallyAndRecoversThroughHalfOpen() throws Exception {
        EmergencyProtection guard = new EmergencyProtection(
                new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, 100, 1000, 100, 2, 64, 512, 8, 4096,
                        java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10), 3,
                        java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(1), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15)),
                java.util.Set.of(CHANNEL), System::currentTimeMillis);
        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) guard.recordDetectorFailure(PROBE);
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.OPEN, guard.breakers().stateOf(PROBE));
        assertFalse(guard.breakers().allow(PROBE));

        Thread.sleep(1200);
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow(PROBE), "one bounded trial after the cooldown");
        assertFalse(guard.breakers().allow(PROBE), "the allowance is finite");
        guard.recordDetectorSuccess(PROBE);
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.ALLOW, guard.breakers().stateOf(PROBE));
    }

    @Test
    void breakerIsolatesTheFailingDetectorFromHealthyOnes() {
        EmergencyProtection guard = new EmergencyProtection(
                new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, 100, 1000, 100, 2, 64, 512, 8, 4096,
                        java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10), 2,
                        java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15)),
                java.util.Set.of(CHANNEL), System::currentTimeMillis);
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(PROBE);
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(PROBE);
        assertFalse(guard.breakers().allow(PROBE));
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow("healthy-probe"));
    }

    @Test
    void breakerHasNoPathToEnforcement() {
        // Structural: the breaker and its outcome type expose nothing that could act on a
        // player, so a tripped breaker cannot kick.
        for (java.lang.reflect.Method method
                : DetectorCircuitBreaker.class.getDeclaredMethods()) {
            assertFalse(method.getReturnType().getName().contains("Kick"),
                    "the breaker must not return an enforcement action");
            assertFalse(method.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).contains("kick"));
            assertFalse(method.getName().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).contains("ban"));
        }
        for (site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.ProtectionOutcome.Reason reason
                : site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.ProtectionOutcome.Reason.values()) {
            assertFalse(reason.name().contains("DETECTED"));
            assertFalse(reason.name().contains("KICK"));
        }
    }

    @Test
    void catastrophicErrorsAreNotSwallowedByTheBreaker() {
        // The module must not catch Throwable. Catching an OutOfMemoryError into a circuit
        // breaker would hide a JVM-level failure from whoever is operating the server.
        String source = readSource("CheckHacksClientDetectionModule.java");
        assertFalse(source.contains("catch (Throwable"),
                "the module must not catch Throwable");
        assertFalse(source.contains("catch (Error"),
                "the module must not catch Error");
    }

    // ==================================================== A3 auditable live verification

    private static LiveValidationRecord goodRecord(String target, String detector, String version) {
        return new LiveValidationRecord(target, version, "JAVA", "session-0001",
                List.of(detector), Instant.parse("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
                "observed the client emit the channel during a real session",
                LiveValidationRecord.Result.CONFIRMED_DETECTED, "operator-a");
    }

    @Test
    void aCompleteRecordJustifiesLiveVerification() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        ProbeDefinition probe = config.probeRegistry().require(PROBE);
        LiveValidationLedger ledger = new LiveValidationLedger(
                List.of(goodRecord(PROBE, PROBE, "1.21.11")));

        // PROBE is jade-network-handshake, the one probe the 2026-10-09 session actually
        // justified, so a complete record is now ACCEPTED for it. The safeguard under test is
        // that acceptance requires the record; liveVerifiedWithoutARecordIsRejected covers the
        // case where it does not.
        assertEquals(LiveValidationLedger.Decision.ACCEPTED,
                ledger.justificationFor(PROBE, probe));
    }

    @Test
    void liveVerifiedWithoutARecordIsRejected() {
        ProbeDefinition claimed = probeWithStatus(PROBE, ProbeVerificationStatus.LIVE_VERIFIED);
        LiveValidationLedger ledger = new LiveValidationLedger();
        assertEquals(LiveValidationLedger.Decision.REJECTED_NO_RECORD,
                ledger.justificationFor(PROBE, claimed));

        LiveValidationLedger.AuditResult audit = ledger.audit(List.of(claimed));
        assertFalse(audit.clean());
        assertEquals(List.of(PROBE), audit.rejectedProbeIds(),
                "an unjustified live verification must be reported, not trusted");
    }

    @Test
    void aRecordForADifferentDetectorDoesNotTransfer() {
        ProbeDefinition claimed = probeWithStatus(PROBE, ProbeVerificationStatus.LIVE_VERIFIED);
        LiveValidationLedger ledger = new LiveValidationLedger(
                List.of(goodRecord("meteor-client", "meteor-client", "1.21.11-86")));
        assertEquals(LiveValidationLedger.Decision.REJECTED_NO_RECORD,
                ledger.justificationFor(PROBE, claimed),
                "proving one detector says nothing about another");
    }

    @Test
    void incompleteRecordsAreRejected() {
        assertEquals(LiveValidationRecord.Defect.MISSING_VERSION,
                new LiveValidationRecord(PROBE, "", "JAVA", "s1", List.of(PROBE), Instant.now(),
                        "e", LiveValidationRecord.Result.CONFIRMED_DETECTED, "op").validate());
        assertEquals(LiveValidationRecord.Defect.MISSING_DETECTOR,
                new LiveValidationRecord(PROBE, "1.21.11", "JAVA", "s1", List.of(), Instant.now(),
                        "e", LiveValidationRecord.Result.CONFIRMED_DETECTED, "op").validate());
        assertEquals(LiveValidationRecord.Defect.MISSING_TIMESTAMP,
                new LiveValidationRecord(PROBE, "1.21.11", "JAVA", "s1", List.of(PROBE), null,
                        "e", LiveValidationRecord.Result.CONFIRMED_DETECTED, "op").validate());
        assertEquals(LiveValidationRecord.Defect.MISSING_EVIDENCE,
                new LiveValidationRecord(PROBE, "1.21.11", "JAVA", "s1", List.of(PROBE),
                        Instant.now(), "  ", LiveValidationRecord.Result.CONFIRMED_DETECTED,
                        "op").validate());
        assertEquals(LiveValidationRecord.Defect.MISSING_OPERATOR,
                new LiveValidationRecord(PROBE, "1.21.11", "JAVA", "s1", List.of(PROBE),
                        Instant.now(), "e", LiveValidationRecord.Result.CONFIRMED_DETECTED,
                        "").validate());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownOrMalformedVerificationDataCannotIncreaseConfidence() {
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, ProbeVerificationStatus.parse("SUPER_VERIFIED"),
                "an unknown status must default downward");
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, ProbeVerificationStatus.parse(""));
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, ProbeVerificationStatus.parse(null));
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.UNVERIFIED, ProbeVerificationStatus.parse("verified!!"));
        assertEquals(ProbeVerificationStatus.LIVE_VERIFIED,
                ProbeVerificationStatus.parse("live-verified"),
                "the real status must still parse, including in kebab case");
    }

    @Test
    void inconclusiveOrErrorSessionsCanNeverRaiseConfidence() {
        for (LiveValidationRecord.Result result : new LiveValidationRecord.Result[]{
                LiveValidationRecord.Result.PROVED_NOTHING, LiveValidationRecord.Result.ERROR}) {
            LiveValidationRecord record = new LiveValidationRecord(PROBE, "1.21.11", "JAVA",
                    "s1", List.of(PROBE), Instant.now(), "session proved nothing",
                    result, "operator-a");
            assertFalse(record.valid(), result + " must not be a valid justification");
            assertFalse(new LiveValidationLedger().add(record),
                    "an invalid record must not be accepted into the ledger");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void theShippedCatalogHasExactlyOneLiveVerificationAndNoRuntimeRecords() throws Exception {
        ClientDetectionConfig config = bundled();
        assertEquals(3, config.probeRegistry().liveVerifiedCount(),
                "only the three probes exercised on 2026-10-09 are live-verified");
        assertEquals(List.of("xaeros-minimap", "xaeros-worldmap", "jade-network-handshake"),
                config.probeRegistry().liveVerified().stream().map(ProbeDefinition::id).toList());

        // The runtime ledger stays empty by design: it is a release-time audit tool and nothing
        // in the detection or protection path may write to it. Its consequence is that the
        // ledger deliberately refuses to confirm the shipped claim, because it holds no record.
        // The claim itself is backed by the release validation log, not by this ledger.
        LiveValidationLedger runtime = new LiveValidationLedger();
        assertEquals(0, runtime.size(),
                "the runtime ledger must stay empty; it is never populated from probe execution");
        assertFalse(runtime.audit(config.probes()).clean(),
                "an empty ledger must not vouch for a live-verified claim; that is its purpose");
        assertEquals(List.of("xaeros-minimap", "xaeros-worldmap", "jade-network-handshake"),
                runtime.audit(config.probes()).rejectedProbeIds(),
                "and it must reject exactly the probes that claim live evidence");

        // With the release records supplied, the same claims are accepted, which is what makes
        // the rejection above a real check rather than a permanent refusal. One record per probe
        // is required: a session for one probe never justifies another.
        LiveValidationLedger withRecord = new LiveValidationLedger(List.of(
                goodRecord("jade-network-handshake", "jade-network-handshake", "21.1.6"),
                goodRecord("xaeros-minimap", "xaeros-minimap", "26.5.0"),
                goodRecord("xaeros-worldmap", "xaeros-worldmap", "1.46.0")));
        assertTrue(withRecord.audit(config.probes()).clean(),
                "the recorded sessions are what justify the shipped claims");

        // A single record must not vouch for the other two.
        LiveValidationLedger partial = new LiveValidationLedger(
                List.of(goodRecord("jade-network-handshake", "jade-network-handshake", "21.1.6")));
        assertFalse(partial.audit(config.probes()).clean(),
                "a session for one probe must never justify another probe's claim");
        assertEquals(List.of("xaeros-minimap", "xaeros-worldmap"),
                partial.audit(config.probes()).rejectedProbeIds());
    }

    @Test
    void theLedgerIsNotReachableFromProbeExecution() {
        // Nothing in the detection or protection path may construct a record.
        for (String source : List.of(readSource("CheckHacksClientDetectionModule.java"),
                readSource("CheckHacksResponseEvaluator.java"))) {
            assertFalse(source.contains("LiveValidationLedger"),
                    "the detection path must not reach the live verification ledger");
            assertFalse(source.contains("LIVE_VERIFIED"),
                    "the detection path must not reference LIVE_VERIFIED");
        }
    }

    /** Alias so the intent at each assertion site is obvious. */
    private static final class ProtectionOutcomeReason {
        static final site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.ProtectionOutcome.Reason MALFORMED =
                site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.ProtectionOutcome.Reason.MALFORMED;
    }

    private static final class ProtectionOutcomeAdapters {
        static void assertRefusalIsNotAVerdict(EmergencyProtection guard, String detectorId) {
            var outcome = guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 8, detectorId);
            assertFalse(outcome.admitted());
            assertEquals(site.vackstudio.vanticheat.protection.ProtectionOutcome.Reason.CIRCUIT_OPEN,
                    outcome.reason());
        }
    }

    private static ProbeDefinition probeWithStatus(String id, ProbeVerificationStatus status) {
        return new ProbeDefinition(id, "test", "key.test", ProbeMode.TRANSLATE, "", true, true,
                true, status, "client", "source", "notes", null,
                ProbeTransportMode.INTERACTIVE, false, null);
    }

    private static String readSource(String fileName) {
        try {
            return new String(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(
                    java.nio.file.Path.of("src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/detection/probe/"
                            + fileName)), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        } catch (java.io.IOException failure) {
            throw new AssertionError("cannot read " + fileName, failure);
        }
    }

    @TempDir
    private Path temporaryDirectory;

    private ClientDetectionConfig bundled() throws Exception {
        try (InputStream stream = getClass().getResourceAsStream("/client-detection.yml")) {
            Files.write(temporaryDirectory.resolve("client-detection.yml"), stream.readAllBytes());
        }
        return ClientDetectionConfig.load(temporaryDirectory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }
