`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/enforcement/EnforcementPipelineSafetyTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.DisplayName;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.EnumSource;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionResult;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.Evidence;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.EvidenceType;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.Verdict;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeCorroboration;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeEvidenceStrength;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Full-pipeline enforcement safety, from a classified observation to an action on a disposable
 * target.
 *
 * <p>Every assertion here is about what must NOT happen. A system that blocks every modified
 * client is unacceptable if it also blocks legitimate players, so the emphasis is on refusals.
 */
class EnforcementPipelineSafetyTest {

    private static final UUID TARGET = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-0000-0000-0000000000a1");

    /** Builds evidence with the metadata the real pipeline writes. */
    private static Evidence evidence(DetectionStatus classification, String pass, String category,
                                     String transport, String probeId) {
        Map<String, String> metadata = new HashMap<>();
        metadata.put("pass", pass);
        metadata.put("classification", classification.name());
        metadata.put("category", category);
        metadata.put("transport", transport);
        metadata.put("probe", probeId);
        return new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, classification.name() + " via " + probeId,
                Instant.now(), metadata);
    }

    private static DetectionResult result(DetectionStatus status, Evidence... items) {
        DetectionResult base = DetectionResult.of(status, "test");
        for (Evidence item : items) base = base.withEvidence(item);
        return base;
    }

    private static EnforcementTarget target() {
        return new EnforcementTarget(TARGET, "TestPlayer", true, null);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- never reaches enforcement

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "{0} never punishes")
    @EnumSource(value = DetectionStatus.class, names = {"CLEAN", "TIMEOUT", "UNSUPPORTED",
            "PROTECTED", "ERROR", "SKIPPED"})
    @DisplayName("a non-detected status can never be confirmed, whatever the evidence says")
    void nonDetectedStatusNeverEnforces(DetectionStatus status) {
        DetectionResult result = result(status,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result),
                status + " must not be confirmable even with a confirmation record");
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(result));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("an INITIAL pass alone never confirms; a CONFIRMATION pass is required")
    void initialPassAloneNeverConfirms() {
        DetectionResult initial = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "INITIAL", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(initial),
                "a diagnostic-only finding must not bypass the confirmation pass");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a legitimate utility category never confirms, so no legitimate mod is punished")
    void legitimateCategoriesNeverConfirm() {
        for (String category : List.of("utility", "map", "platform", "unknown")) {
            DetectionResult result = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                    evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", category, "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
            assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result, false, Set.of("client")),
                    category + " must never become an enforcement action");
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the category gate holds even when the operator opts in to passive enforcement")
    void categoryGateHoldsWithPassiveOptIn() {
        // The passive opt-in short-circuits before the passive-support check, so it is the one
        // way the category gate could be bypassed. Testing only with passiveAllowed=false would
        // pass even with the gate removed, because the passive branch would refuse afterwards.
        for (String category : List.of("utility", "map", "platform", "unknown")) {
            DetectionResult result = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                    evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", category, "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
            assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result, true, Set.of("client")),
                    category + " must not confirm even when passive enforcement is enabled");
        }
        // And the eligible category still works through the same path, so this is a real gate and
        // not a blanket refusal.
        DetectionResult cheat = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        assertTrue(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(cheat, true, Set.of("client")));
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("the only eligible category is client")
    void onlyClientCategoryIsEligible() {
        DetectionResult cheat = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        assertTrue(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(cheat, false, Set.of("client")));

        for (String category : List.of("utility", "map")) {
            DetectionResult other = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                    evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", category, "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
            assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(other, false, Set.of("client")));
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a confirmed interactive cheat detection does reach enforcement")
    void confirmedCheatDetectionEnforces() {
        DetectionResult result = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "INITIAL", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"),
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        assertTrue(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result));
        EnforcementDecision decision = new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true).decide(result);
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, decision.action());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("passive identity alone never enforces, even when the operator opts in to passive")
    void passiveOnlyIdentityNeverEnforces() {
        DetectionResult result = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "INITIAL", "client", "PASSIVE", "jade-network-handshake"));
        // passiveAllowed=true would confirm the record, but jade-network-handshake is a utility
        // probe, so the category gate still refuses. Both gates must hold independently.
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(result, true, Set.of("client")),
                "a passive-only record must not confirm on its own");
    }

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "enforcement.enabled={0}")
    @org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ValueSource(booleans = {true, false})
    @DisplayName("the enforcement.enabled switch is honoured in both states")
    void enforcementEnabledSwitchIsHonoured(boolean enabled) {
        DetectionResult result = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "INITIAL", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"),
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        EnforcementDecision decision = new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(enabled).decide(result);
        assertEquals(enabled ? EnforcementAction.KICK : EnforcementAction.NONE, decision.action());
        if (!enabled) assertEquals("enforcement disabled", decision.reason());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("every declared enforcement action is exercised end to end")
    void everyEnforcementActionIsExercised() {
        // The only supported actions are NONE and KICK. There is no ban: an operator reading the
        // docs must not be able to expect a ban that the code cannot perform.
        assertEquals(2, EnforcementAction.values().length);
        assertNotNull(EnforcementAction.valueOf("NONE"));
        assertNotNull(EnforcementAction.valueOf("KICK"));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- corroboration refusals

    @Test
    @DisplayName("unclassified strong evidence never confirms")
    void unclassifiedEvidenceNeverConfirms() {
        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.STRONG, ProbeCorroboration.Basis.UNCLASSIFIED, true)));
        assertFalse(decision.confirmed());
        assertNotEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, decision.status());
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("conflicting authoritative and non-authoritative evidence cancels promotion")
    void conflictingEvidenceCancelsPromotion() {
        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.STRONG,
                        ProbeCorroboration.Basis.EXACT_CONFIGURED_RESPONSE, true),
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.WEAK, ProbeCorroboration.Basis.WEAK_LOCALIZED, true)));
        assertFalse(decision.confirmed(),
                "a detected-but-weak record for the same probe must revoke the promotion");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("ambiguous localized evidence stays CLEAN and is never promoted")
    void ambiguousEvidenceStaysClean() {
        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.CLEAN,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.WEAK, ProbeCorroboration.Basis.WEAK_LOCALIZED, true)));
        assertFalse(decision.confirmed());
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, decision.status());
        assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(decision.status()));
        assertTrue(decision.weakSignals() > 0, "the ambiguity must stay on record");
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a timeout or unsupported result never confirms")
    void timeoutAndUnsupportedNeverConfirm() {
        for (DetectionStatus status : List.of(DetectionStatus.TIMEOUT, DetectionStatus.UNSUPPORTED)) {
            ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(
                    new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", status, ProbeEvidenceStrength.NONE,
                            ProbeCorroboration.Basis.NO_EVIDENCE, true)));
            assertFalse(decision.confirmed(), status + " must not confirm");
            assertEquals(Verdict.CLEAN, Verdict.of(decision.status()));
        }
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("duplicate findings for one probe produce one promotion, not two")
    void duplicateFindingsProduceOnePromotion() {
        ProbeCorroboration.Decision decision = ProbeCorroboration.decide(List.of(
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.STRONG,
                        ProbeCorroboration.Basis.EXACT_CONFIGURED_RESPONSE, true),
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.STRONG,
                        ProbeCorroboration.Basis.EXACT_CONFIGURED_RESPONSE, true),
                new ProbeCorroboration.Observation("p", DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                        ProbeEvidenceStrength.STRONG,
                        ProbeCorroboration.Basis.EXACT_CONFIGURED_RESPONSE, true)));
        assertEquals(1, decision.promotedProbes().size(),
                "a repeated signal is one fact, never a second score");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ trusted player bypass

    @Test
    @DisplayName("a trusted player is never punished even with a confirmed detection")
    void trustedPlayerIsNeverPunished() {
        // EnforcementService is exercised with an isolated fake trusted set. The policy decision
        // itself must still be KICK, proving the bypass comes from trust and not from a weakened
        // confirmation rule.
        DetectionResult result = result(DetectionStatus.DETECTED,
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "INITIAL", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"),
                evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "CONFIRMATION", "client", "INTERACTIVE", "p"));
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true).decide(result).action());
        // The service-level bypass is covered by TrustedEnforcementTest and
        // LegitimateModEnforcementTest with disposable targets.
    }

    @Test
    @DisplayName("one malformed result cannot affect a neighbouring session's verdict")
    void malformedResultDoesNotLeakAcrossSessions() {
        List<DetectionResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) {
            DetectionStatus status = index == 1 ? DetectionStatus.ERROR : DetectionStatus.CLEAN;
            results.add(result(status,
                    evidence(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "INITIAL", "client", "INTERACTIVE",
                            "probe-" + index)));
        }
        for (DetectionResult candidate : results) {
            assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(candidate),
                    "each result must be evaluated on its own evidence only");
        }
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/enforcement/EnforcementServiceTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionResult;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.Evidence;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.EvidenceType;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted.TrustedPlayerService;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class EnforcementServiceTest {
    private static final UUID ID = UUID.randomUUID();
    private final AtomicInteger kicks = new AtomicInteger();
    private final AtomicReference<String> kickMessage = new AtomicReference<>();
    private final EnforcementExecutor executor = (target, message) -> {
        kicks.incrementAndGet();
        kickMessage.set(message);
        return true;
    };
    private final EnforcementTarget target = new EnforcementTarget(ID, "tester", true, new Object());

    @Test
    void confirmedDetectionKicksOnceAndRecordsAction() {
        EnforcementService service = service(true);

        EnforcementOutcome first = service.enforce(target, confirmed(DetectionStatus.DETECTED));
        EnforcementOutcome duplicate = service.enforce(target, confirmed(DetectionStatus.DETECTED));

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, first.decision().action());
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, duplicate.decision().action());
        assertEquals(1, kicks.get());
        assertEquals("KICK", first.result().evidence().getLast().metadata().get("action"));
    }

    @Test
    void nonDetectedStatusesDoNotKick() {
        EnforcementService service = service(true);
        for (DetectionStatus status : new DetectionStatus[]{DetectionStatus.CLEAN, DetectionStatus.ERROR,
                DetectionStatus.PROTECTED, DetectionStatus.TIMEOUT,
                DetectionStatus.UNSUPPORTED, DetectionStatus.SKIPPED}) {
            assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, service.enforce(target, confirmed(status)).decision().action());
        }
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void initialDetectionWithoutConfirmationDoesNotKick() {
        EnforcementService service = service(true);
        DetectionResult initial = DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "initial")
                .withEvidence(evidence("INITIAL", "DETECTED"));

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, service.enforce(target, initial).decision().action());
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void disabledEnforcementDoesNotKickConfirmedDetection() {
        EnforcementService service = service(false);

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE,
                service.enforce(target, confirmed(DetectionStatus.DETECTED)).decision().action());
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void offlineTargetRetainsConfirmedResultWithoutKicking() {
        EnforcementService service = service(true);
        EnforcementTarget offline = new EnforcementTarget(ID, "tester", false, new Object());

        EnforcementOutcome outcome = service.enforce(offline, confirmed(DetectionStatus.DETECTED));

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, outcome.decision().action());
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, outcome.result().status());
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void aReconnectWithANewSessionCanBeEnforcedAgain() {
        EnforcementService service = service(true);

        service.enforce(target, confirmedSession("first"));
        EnforcementOutcome reconnect = service.enforce(target, confirmedSession("second"));

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, reconnect.decision().action());
        assertEquals(2, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void recentlyHandledKeysExpireWithoutAffectingConcurrentDuplicateProtection() {
        AtomicLong clock = new AtomicLong(10L);
        EnforcementService service = new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true), executor,
                "Cheating detected.", Logger.getLogger("test-enforcement"), TrustedPlayerService.NONE,
                clock::get);
        DetectionResult result = confirmedSession("expiring-session");

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, service.enforce(target, result).decision().action());
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, service.enforce(target, result).decision().action());
        assertEquals(1, service.retainedEnforcementKeyCount());

        clock.addAndGet(EnforcementService.ENFORCEMENT_KEY_TTL_NANOS + 1);
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, service.enforce(target, result).decision().action());
        assertEquals(2, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void enforcementDeduplicationIsBoundedAndFailsClosedAtCapacity() {
        Logger quiet = Logger.getLogger("test-enforcement-bounded");
        quiet.setLevel(java.util.logging.Level.OFF);
        EnforcementService service = new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true), executor,
                "Cheating detected.", quiet);
        for (int index = 0; index < EnforcementService.MAX_RETAINED_ENFORCEMENT_KEYS + 10; index++) {
            EnforcementOutcome outcome = service.enforce(target,
                    confirmedSession("bounded-session-" + index));
            if (index < EnforcementService.MAX_RETAINED_ENFORCEMENT_KEYS) {
                assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, outcome.decision().action());
            } else {
                assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, outcome.decision().action());
                assertEquals("enforcement deduplication capacity reached", outcome.decision().reason());
            }
        }
        assertEquals(EnforcementService.MAX_RETAINED_ENFORCEMENT_KEYS,
                service.retainedEnforcementKeyCount());
        assertEquals(0, service.inFlightEnforcementCount());
        assertEquals(EnforcementService.MAX_RETAINED_ENFORCEMENT_KEYS, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentDuplicateEnforcementClaimsOnlyOnce() throws Exception {
        AtomicInteger concurrentKicks = new AtomicInteger();
        java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch enteredExecutor = new java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1);
        java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch releaseExecutor = new java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1);
        EnforcementService service = new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true),
                (candidate, message) -> {
                    concurrentKicks.incrementAndGet();
                    enteredExecutor.countDown();
                    try {
                        releaseExecutor.await();
                    } catch (InterruptedException exception) {
                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                        throw new IllegalStateException(exception);
                    }
                    return true;
                }, "kick", Logger.getLogger("test-enforcement"));
        DetectionResult result = confirmedSession("concurrent-session");
        var executor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try {
            var first = executor.submit(() -> service.enforce(target, result));
            org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue(enteredExecutor.await(5,
                    java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS));
            var second = executor.submit(() -> service.enforce(target, result));
            assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, second.get().decision().action());
            releaseExecutor.countDown();
            assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, first.get().decision().action());
            assertEquals(1, concurrentKicks.get());
            assertEquals(0, service.inFlightEnforcementCount());
        } finally {
            releaseExecutor.countDown();
            executor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    @Test
    void throwingEnforcementActionReleasesInFlightReservationAndStaysDeduplicated() {
        EnforcementService service = new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true),
                (candidate, message) -> { throw new IllegalStateException("kick failed"); },
                "kick", Logger.getLogger("test-enforcement"));
        DetectionResult result = confirmedSession("throwing-kick");

        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class,
                () -> service.enforce(target, result));
        assertEquals(0, service.inFlightEnforcementCount());
        assertEquals(1, service.retainedEnforcementKeyCount());
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, service.enforce(target, result).decision().action());
    }

    @Test
    void confirmedXaeroJoinResultIsIdentifiedButNeverKicked() {
        // Xaero's Minimap is a legitimate map mod. A confirmed two-pass exact match is a real
        // detection, and it must still not become a kick. This test previously asserted a KICK,
        // which encoded the missing category gate.
        EnforcementService service = service(true);

        EnforcementOutcome outcome = service.enforce(target,
                confirmedProbe("xaeros-minimap", "join-session", "map"));

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, outcome.decision().action(),
                "a confirmed detection of a legitimate mod must not kick");
        assertEquals("xaeros-minimap", outcome.result().evidence().getLast().metadata().get("probe"),
                "the detection is still recorded for an operator to read");
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void confirmedXaeroJoinResultStillHonorsTrustedPlayerBypass() {
        TrustedPlayerService trusted = new TrustedPlayerService() {
            @Override public boolean isTrusted(UUID id) { return ID.equals(id); }
            @Override public boolean add(UUID id, String name) { return false; }
            @Override public boolean remove(UUID id) { return false; }
            @Override public java.util.List<site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted.TrustedPlayer> list() {
                return java.util.List.of();
            }
            @Override public void load() { }
            @Override public void save() { }
        };
        EnforcementService service = new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true), executor,
                "Cheating detected.", Logger.getLogger("test-enforcement"), trusted);

        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE,
                service.enforce(target, confirmedProbe("xaeros-minimap", "trusted-session"))
                        .decision().action());
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());
    }

    private EnforcementService service(boolean enabled) {
        return new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(enabled), executor,
                "Cheating detected.", Logger.getLogger("test-enforcement"));
    }

    private static DetectionResult confirmed(DetectionStatus status) {
        return DetectionResult.of(status, "result")
                .withEvidence(evidence("CONFIRMATION", status.name()));
    }

    /**
     * Enforcement fixtures represent cheat clients, so they carry {@code category=client}.
     * A fixture with no category is treated as ineligible and can never be enforced.
     */
    private static Evidence evidence(String pass, String classification) {
        return new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.EPOCH,
                Map.of("pass", pass, "classification", classification,
                        "category", "client", "transport", "INTERACTIVE"));
    }

    private static DetectionResult confirmedSession(String session) {
        return DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "result")
                .withEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.EPOCH,
                        Map.of("pass", "CONFIRMATION", "classification", "DETECTED",
                "category", "client", "transport", "INTERACTIVE", "session", session,
                                "probe", "test-probe")));
    }

    private static DetectionResult confirmedProbe(String probe, String session) {
        return confirmedProbe(probe, session, "client");
    }

    /**
     * @param category the probe category. Enforcement is gated on it, so a fixture must state
     *                 which category it represents rather than relying on a default.
     */
    private static DetectionResult confirmedProbe(String probe, String session, String category) {
        return DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "double-check complete")
                .withEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.EPOCH,
                        Map.of("pass", "CONFIRMATION", "classification", "DETECTED",
                                "session", session, "probe", probe, "trigger", "JOIN",
                                "category", category, "transport", "INTERACTIVE")));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/enforcement/LegitimateModEnforcementTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionResult;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionSession;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.Evidence;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.EvidenceType;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * A legitimate mod is not a cheat.
 *
 * <p>This suite exists because enabling exact-match promotion on the Xaero probes would
 * otherwise have made the plugin kick players for having a map mod installed. The probes were
 * correct; the enforcement gate was missing.
 */
class LegitimateModEnforcementTest {
    private static DetectionResult result(String probeId, String category, String pass,
                                         String classification, String transport) {
        DetectionSession session = new DetectionSession(UUID.randomUUID(), UUID.randomUUID(),
                "test", Instant.now());
        session.start();
        session.beginCompletion();
        session.addEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.now(),
                Map.of("probe", probeId, "category", category, "pass", pass,
                        "classification", classification, "transport", transport)));
        session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "test"));
        return session.result();
    }

    private static DetectionResult confirmed(String probeId, String category, String transport) {
        DetectionSession session = new DetectionSession(UUID.randomUUID(), UUID.randomUUID(),
                "test", Instant.now());
        session.start();
        session.beginCompletion();
        // Both passes detected, which is what "confirmed" means.
        for (String pass : List.of("INITIAL", "CONFIRMATION")) {
            session.addEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.now(),
                    Map.of("probe", probeId, "category", category, "pass", pass,
                            "classification", "DETECTED", "transport", transport)));
        }
        session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "test"));
        return session.result();
    }

    @Test
    void xaeroOnBothPassesIsDetectedButNeverConfirmedForEnforcement() {
        DetectionResult minimap = confirmed("xaeros-minimap", "map", "INTERACTIVE");
        // Two passes detected and an exact string match: this is a real, correct DETECTION.
        assertTrue(minimap.status() == DetectionStatus.DETECTED);
        assertEquals(2, minimap.evidence().size());

        // What it must never be is an enforcement action, because the category is not a cheat.
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(minimap, true, Set.of("client")),
                "a map-mod detection must not confirm for enforcement");
    }

    @Test
    void theDefaultEnforcementGateExcludesEveryNonCheatCategory() {
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(
                        confirmed("jade-config-screen", "utility", "INTERACTIVE"), true, Set.of()),
                "with no configured category the default gate is client-only, so utility is out");
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(
                        confirmed("xaeros-worldmap", "map", "INTERACTIVE"), true, Set.of()));
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(
                        confirmed("litematica", "utility", "INTERACTIVE"), true, Set.of()));
    }

    @Test
    void aCheatClientOnBothPassesStillConfirms() {
        assertTrue(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(
                        confirmed("meteor-client", "client", "INTERACTIVE"), true, Set.of("client")),
                "a confirmed cheat-client detection must remain enforceable");
    }

    @Test
    void ineligibleInteractiveEvidenceCannotAuthorizePassiveClientEvidence() {
        DetectionResult mixed = DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "mixed evidence")
                .withEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.EPOCH,
                        Map.of("probe", "jade-network-handshake", "category", "client",
                                "pass", "CONFIRMATION", "classification", "DETECTED",
                                "transport", "PASSIVE")))
                .withEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.EPOCH,
                        Map.of("probe", "jade-config-screen", "category", "utility",
                                "pass", "INITIAL", "classification", "DETECTED",
                                "transport", "INTERACTIVE")));

        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(mixed, false, Set.of("client")),
                "only eligible-category interactive evidence may bypass the passive gate");
    }

    @Test
    void aSinglePassIsNeverEnough() {
        DetectionResult single = result("meteor-client", "client", "INITIAL", "DETECTED", "INTERACTIVE");
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(single, true, Set.of("client")),
                "double-check requires a CONFIRMATION pass");
    }

    @Test
    void aCleanResultIsNeverConfirmed() {
        DetectionSession session = new DetectionSession(UUID.randomUUID(), UUID.randomUUID(),
                "test", Instant.now());
        session.start();
        session.beginCompletion();
        session.addEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.now(),
                Map.of("probe", "meteor-client", "category", "client", "pass", "CONFIRMATION",
                        "classification", "CLEAN", "transport", "INTERACTIVE")));
        session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.CLEAN, "test"));
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(session.result(), true, Set.of("client")));
    }

    @Test
    void evidenceWithoutARecordedCategoryIsIneligible() {
        // Pre-category evidence must fail closed rather than be treated as a cheat client.
        DetectionSession session = new DetectionSession(UUID.randomUUID(), UUID.randomUUID(),
                "test", Instant.now());
        session.start();
        session.beginCompletion();
        for (String pass : List.of("INITIAL", "CONFIRMATION")) {
            session.addEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.now(),
                    Map.of("probe", "unknown-probe", "pass", pass,
                            "classification", "DETECTED", "transport", "INTERACTIVE")));
        }
        session.complete(DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "test"));
        assertFalse(ConfirmedDetection.isConfirmed(session.result(), true, Set.of("client")),
                "evidence with no category must never confirm");
    }

    @Test
    void thePolicyRefusesToKickOnALegitimateMod() {
        DefaultEnforcementPolicy policy = new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true, true);
        var decision = policy.decide(confirmed("xaeros-minimap", "map", "INTERACTIVE"));
        assertTrue(decision.action() == site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementAction.NONE,
                "the policy must not kick a player for a map mod");
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/enforcement/TrustedEnforcementTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionResult;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.DetectionStatus;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.Evidence;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.EvidenceType;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted.PersistentTrustedPlayerService;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class TrustedEnforcementTest {
    @TempDir Path temporaryDirectory;

    @Test
    void trustedDetectionStaysDetectedButCannotKickUntilTrustIsRemoved() {
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        PersistentTrustedPlayerService trusted = new PersistentTrustedPlayerService(
                temporaryDirectory.resolve("trusted.yml"), Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
        trusted.add(player, "trusted");
        AtomicInteger kicks = new AtomicInteger();
        EnforcementService enforcement = new EnforcementService(new DefaultEnforcementPolicy(true),
                (target, message) -> { kicks.incrementAndGet(); return true; }, "kick", Logger.getAnonymousLogger(), trusted);
        EnforcementTarget target = new EnforcementTarget(player, "trusted", true, new Object());

        EnforcementOutcome bypassed = enforcement.enforce(target, confirmed("first"));
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.NONE, bypassed.decision().action());
        assertEquals(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, bypassed.result().status());
        assertEquals(0, kicks.get());

        trusted.remove(player);
        EnforcementOutcome enforced = enforcement.enforce(target, confirmed("second"));
        assertEquals(EnforcementAction.KICK, enforced.decision().action());
        assertEquals(1, kicks.get());
        assertTrue(enforced.result().evidence().stream().anyMatch(value ->
                "KICK".equals(value.metadata().get("action"))));
    }

    private static DetectionResult confirmed(String session) {
        return DetectionResult.of(DetectionStatus.DETECTED, "confirmed")
                .withEvidence(new Evidence(EvidenceType.OBSERVATION, "test", Instant.EPOCH,
                        Map.of("pass", "CONFIRMATION", "classification", "DETECTED", "session", session,
                                "category", "client", "transport", "INTERACTIVE")));
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.lunar;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.EntityTarget;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.RegionTarget;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.Scheduler;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.TaskHandle;

import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/** Lunar is an optional Apollo side effect and never a client-detection verdict. */
class LunarClientServiceTest {
    private final UUID playerId = UUID.randomUUID();

    @Test
    void absentApolloLeavesServiceAndDetectionIndependent() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), null);

        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.NOT_PRESENT, service.integrationStatus());
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.RegistrationOutcome.IGNORED_UNAVAILABLE,
                service.handleRegistration(registration(new Object())));
        assertEquals(0, scheduler.entityTasks.size());
        assertEquals(0, service.trackedPlayers());
    }

    @Test
    void readyApolloActionRunsOnPlayerEntityContext() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = player;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);

        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.AVAILABLE, service.integrationStatus());
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.RegistrationOutcome.SCHEDULED,
                service.handleRegistration(registration(player)));
        assertEquals(0, integration.settingWrites);
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();

        assertEquals(1, integration.settingWrites);
        assertTrue(service.isLunar(playerId));
        assertEquals(LunarPlayerState.MINIMAP_DISABLED, service.snapshot(playerId).state());
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.ActionState.APPLIED, service.lastAction());
    }

    @Test
    void presentButUnreadyIsReportedWithoutRepeatingSchedulerWork() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        integration.readiness = LunarClientIntegration.Availability.NOT_READY;
        integration.currentPlayer = new Object();
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);

        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.NOT_READY, service.integrationStatus());
        service.handleRegistration(registration(integration.currentPlayer));
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();

        assertEquals(1, scheduler.entitySchedules);
        assertEquals(0, integration.supportCalls);
        assertEquals(0, integration.settingWrites);
        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.NOT_READY, service.integrationStatus());
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.ActionState.NOT_RUN, service.lastAction());
    }

    @Test
    void repeatedRegistrationsKeepTheOverrideIdempotent() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = player;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            service.handleRegistration(registration(player));
            scheduler.runEntityTasks();
        }

        assertEquals(1, integration.settingWrites);
        assertEquals(2, integration.alreadyAppliedCount);
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.ActionState.ALREADY_APPLIED, service.lastAction());
        assertEquals(LunarPlayerState.MINIMAP_DISABLED, service.snapshot(playerId).state());
    }

    @Test
    void apiFailureIsRecordedSeparatelyWithoutErasingLunarSupport() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = player;
        integration.throwOnMutation = true;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);

        service.handleRegistration(registration(player));
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();

        assertTrue(service.isLunar(playerId));
        assertEquals(LunarPlayerState.FAILED, service.snapshot(playerId).state());
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.ActionState.FAILED, service.lastAction());
        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.FAILED, service.integrationStatus());
    }

    @Test
    void quitAndReconnectUseOnlyTheCurrentPlayerIdentity() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object playerA = new Object();
        Object playerB = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = playerA;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);

        LunarClientIntegration.Registration old = registration(playerA);
        service.handleRegistration(old);
        service.handleQuit(playerId, playerA);
        assertTrue(scheduler.entityTasks.peek().handle.cancelled());

        integration.currentPlayer = playerB;
        service.handleRegistration(registration(playerB));
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();
        service.handleUnregister(old); // delayed unregister from the old connection

        assertEquals(1, integration.settingWrites);
        assertTrue(service.isLunar(playerId));
        assertEquals(LunarPlayerState.MINIMAP_DISABLED, service.snapshot(playerId).state());
    }

    @Test
    void quitReenteredDuringApolloLookupPreventsStalePlayerMutation() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object playerA = new Object();
        Object playerB = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = playerA;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);
        integration.afterSupportLookup = () -> {
            service.handleQuit(playerId, playerA);
            integration.currentPlayer = playerB;
            service.handleRegistration(registration(playerB));
        };

        service.handleRegistration(registration(playerA));
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();

        assertEquals(1, integration.settingWrites, "only the replacement connection receives the action");
        assertTrue(service.isLunar(playerId));
        assertEquals(LunarPlayerState.MINIMAP_DISABLED, service.snapshot(playerId).state());
    }

    @Test
    void shutdownCancelsPendingWorkAndRejectsLaterRegistrations() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = player;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);
        service.handleRegistration(registration(player));

        service.stop();
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();

        assertEquals(0, integration.settingWrites);
        assertTrue(integration.stopped);
        assertEquals(LunarClientService.RegistrationOutcome.IGNORED_DISABLED,
                service.handleRegistration(registration(player)));

    }

    @Test
    void ApolloDisableCancelsPendingWorkAndReenableReusesTheBridge() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();
        integration.currentPlayer = player;
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);
        service.handleRegistration(registration(player));

        service.apolloDisabled();
        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.NOT_READY, service.integrationStatus());
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();
        assertEquals(0, integration.settingWrites);
        assertTrue(integration.stopped);

        service.apolloEnabled();
        service.handleRegistration(registration(player));
        scheduler.runEntityTasks();
        assertEquals(2, integration.startCalls);
        assertEquals(1, integration.settingWrites);
        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.AVAILABLE, service.integrationStatus());
    }

    @Test
    void settingWorkCannotRunOutsideEntityScheduler() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);

        integration.currentPlayer = player;

        assertThrows(AssertionError.class, () -> integration.hasSupport(playerId));

        assertEquals(1, integration.settingWrites);
        assertEquals(1, scheduler.entitySchedules);
    }

    @Test
    void ApolloEntitySchedulingFailureIsIsolatedAndRecorded() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        scheduler.failEntityScheduling = true;
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();

                service.handleRegistration(registration(player)));
        assertEquals(LunarPlayerState.FAILED, service.snapshot(playerId).state());
        assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.AVAILABLE, service.integrationStatus());
        assertEquals(0, integration.settingWrites);
        assertEquals(0, scheduler.entityTasks.size());
    }

    @Test
    void ApolloEntityRetirementDoesNotRunApiMutationOffContext() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        scheduler.retireEntityScheduling = true;
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        Object player = new Object();

    @Test
    void disabledPolicyDoesNotLoadOrStartApollo() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.disabled(), integration);

        assertEquals(LunarClientService.RegistrationOutcome.IGNORED_DISABLED,

    @Test
    void statusReadsUseCachedApolloAvailability() {
        TestScheduler scheduler = new TestScheduler();
        FakeIntegration integration = new FakeIntegration(scheduler, playerId);
        LunarClientService service = service(scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(), integration);

        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            assertEquals(LunarClientIntegration.Availability.AVAILABLE, service.integrationStatus());
            service.snapshot(playerId);
        }
        assertEquals(checksAfterStart, integration.availabilityCalls);
    }

    private LunarClientIntegration.Registration registration(Object player) {
        return new LunarClientIntegration.Registration(playerId, "lunar", player);
    }

    private static LunarClientService service(TestScheduler scheduler, LunarPolicyConfig config,
                                               LunarClientIntegration integration) {
        LunarClientService service = new LunarClientService(Logger.getAnonymousLogger(), scheduler);
        service.start(config, integration);
        return service;
    }

    private static final class FakeIntegration implements LunarClientIntegration {
        private final TestScheduler scheduler;
        private final Set<UUID> lunar = new HashSet<>();
        private Object currentPlayer;
        private Availability readiness = Availability.AVAILABLE;
        private boolean overrideSet;
        private boolean throwOnMutation;
        private boolean stopped;
        private int startCalls;
        private int availabilityCalls;
        private int supportCalls;
        private int settingWrites;
        private int alreadyAppliedCount;
        private Runnable afterSupportLookup;

        private FakeIntegration(TestScheduler scheduler, UUID playerId) {
            this.scheduler = scheduler;
            lunar.add(playerId);
        }

        @Override public Availability availability() { availabilityCalls++; return readiness; }

        @Override public boolean hasSupport(UUID id) {
            assertTrue(scheduler.inEntityContext);
            supportCalls++;
            Runnable hook = afterSupportLookup;
            afterSupportLookup = null;
            if (hook != null) hook.run();
            return lunar.contains(id);
        }

        @Override public MinimapAction disableMinimap(UUID id, Object playerHandle) {
            assertTrue(scheduler.inEntityContext);
            assertTrue(lunar.contains(id) && currentPlayer == playerHandle);
            if (throwOnMutation) {
                readiness = Availability.FAILED;
                throw new IllegalStateException("stub API failure");
            }
            if (overrideSet) {
                alreadyAppliedCount++;
                return MinimapAction.ALREADY_APPLIED;
            }
            overrideSet = true;
            settingWrites++;
            return MinimapAction.APPLIED;
        }

        @Override public Optional<Boolean> minimapStatus(UUID id) {
            return lunar.contains(id) ? Optional.of(!overrideSet) : Optional.empty();
        }

        @Override public void start() { startCalls++; stopped = false; }
        @Override public void stop() { stopped = true; }
    }

    private static final class TestScheduler implements Scheduler {
        private final Queue<EntityTask> entityTasks = new ArrayDeque<>();
        private int entitySchedules;
        private boolean inEntityContext;
        private boolean failEntityScheduling;
        private boolean retireEntityScheduling;

        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task) {
            entitySchedules++;
            if (failEntityScheduling) throw new IllegalStateException("entity scheduling unavailable");
            TestTaskHandle handle = new TestTaskHandle();
            entityTasks.add(new EntityTask(target.nativeEntity(), task, handle));
            return handle;
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task, Runnable retired) {
            if (retireEntityScheduling) {
                retired.run();
                return new TestTaskHandle();
            }
            return runAtEntity(target, task);
        }

        private void runEntityTasks() {
            while (!entityTasks.isEmpty()) {
                EntityTask scheduled = entityTasks.remove();
                if (scheduled.handle.cancelled()) continue;
                inEntityContext = true;
                try { scheduled.task.run(); }
                finally { inEntityContext = false; }
            }
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runAtLocation(RegionTarget target, Runnable task) {
            throw new AssertionError("Lunar setting work must use the entity scheduler");
        }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) {
            throw new AssertionError("Unexpected global scheduler usage");
        }
        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) {
            throw new AssertionError("Unexpected delayed scheduler usage");
        }
        @Override public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) {
            throw new AssertionError("Apollo mutation must not run asynchronously");
        }
        @Override public void shutdown() { }
    }

    private record EntityTask(Object target, Runnable task, TestTaskHandle handle) { }

    private static final class TestTaskHandle implements TaskHandle {
        private boolean cancelled;
        @Override public void cancel() { cancelled = true; }
        @Override public boolean cancelled() { return cancelled; }
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/lunar/LunarPolicyConfigTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.lunar;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class LunarPolicyConfigTest {
    @TempDir Path temporaryDirectory;

    @Test
    void missingSectionFallsBackToSecureDefaults() {
        LunarPolicyConfig config = LunarPolicyConfig.parse("vanticheat:\n  enabled: true\n");

        assertTrue(config.enabled());
        assertTrue(config.minimapEnabled());
    }

    @Test
    void fullSectionParses() {
        LunarPolicyConfig config = LunarPolicyConfig.parse(
                "lunar:\n  enabled: true\n  minimap:\n    enabled: true\n    action: DISABLE\n");

        assertTrue(config.enabled());
        assertTrue(config.minimapEnabled());
    }

    @Test
    void disabledIntegrationAndPolicyAreRespected() {
        LunarPolicyConfig config = LunarPolicyConfig.parse(
                "lunar:\n  enabled: false\n  minimap:\n    enabled: false\n    action: DISABLE\n");

        assertFalse(config.enabled());
        assertFalse(config.minimapEnabled());
    }

    @Test
    void unknownActionIsRejectedWithPath() {
        IllegalArgumentException failure = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> LunarPolicyConfig.parse(
                        "lunar:\n  enabled: true\n  minimap:\n    enabled: true\n    action: KICK\n"));

        assertTrue(failure.getMessage().contains("lunar.minimap.action"));
    }

    @Test
    void invalidBooleanIsRejectedWithPath() {
        IllegalArgumentException failure = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> LunarPolicyConfig.parse("lunar:\n  enabled: yes\n"));

        assertTrue(failure.getMessage().contains("lunar.enabled"));
    }

    @Test
    void missingFileUsesDefaultsAndMalformedFileDisables() throws Exception {
        assertEquals(LunarPolicyConfig.defaults(),
                LunarPolicyConfig.load(temporaryDirectory.resolve("missing"), Logger.getAnonymousLogger()));

        Path directory = Files.createDirectory(temporaryDirectory.resolve("server"));
        Files.writeString(directory.resolve("config.yml"), "lunar:\n  enabled: yes\n");

        assertEquals(LunarPolicyConfig.disabled(),
                LunarPolicyConfig.load(directory, Logger.getAnonymousLogger()));
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/modlist/ForgeModListAdmissionListenerTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.modlist;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper.ForgeModListAdmissionListener;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Lifecycle and platform-isolation tests for the admission layer.
 *
 * <p>These use deterministic adapters: no server, no packets, no players. They cover the properties
 * the spec requires that cannot be observed from the parser alone - reuse across reloads, cleanup,
 * and the guarantee that a platform is never promoted by packet observation.
 */
class ForgeModListAdmissionListenerTest {

    private static final String TEST_ID = "p36_test_blocked_mod";

    private static Logger quietLogger() {
        Logger logger = Logger.getLogger("AdmissionTest");
        logger.setLevel(Level.OFF);
        return logger;
    }

    private record Harness(ModListConnectionRegistry registry, ModListEnforcement enforcement,
                           ForgeModListAdmissionListener listener, AtomicInteger disconnects) { }

    private static Harness harness(boolean enabled, String... ids) {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = new ModListEnforcement(
                new ModListEnforcement.Policy(enabled, ModListEnforcement.Mode.ENFORCE,
                        "removed", List.of(ids), Map.of()));
        AtomicInteger disconnects = new AtomicInteger();
        ForgeModListAdmissionListener listener = new ForgeModListAdmissionListener(
                registry, enforcement, id -> disconnects.incrementAndGet(), quietLogger());
        return new Harness(registry, enforcement, listener, disconnects);
    }

    private static ModListEnforcement.Observation complete(String... ids) {
        Map<String, String> mods = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String id : ids) {
            mods.put(id, "");
        }
        return ModListEnforcement.Observation.complete(mods, ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.MODERN);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- platform isolation

    @Test
    void bedrockProducesNoObservationAndIsNeverDenied() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        UUID bedrock = UUID.randomUUID();
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = harness.registry().begin(bedrock);

        // A Bedrock connection produces no Forge handshake at all. Recording that is correct;
        // turning it into a denial is not.
        harness.registry().observe(bedrock, entry.token(),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.unsupported("bedrock"));

        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = harness.enforcement()
                .evaluate(harness.registry().current(bedrock).observation());
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW, decision.outcome(),
                "a Bedrock player must never be denied by Forge enforcement");
    }

    @Test
    void fabricProducesNoModListAndIsNeverDenied() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        UUID fabric = UUID.randomUUID();
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = harness.registry().begin(fabric);

        // Fabric Loader transmits no mod list, so this is UNSUPPORTED, not MALFORMED. Conflating the
        // two would let a missing signal look like evasion.
        harness.registry().observe(fabric, entry.token(),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.unsupported("no forge handshake"));

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                harness.enforcement().evaluate(harness.registry().current(fabric).observation())
                        .outcome());
    }

    @Test
    void observingAPacketNeverChangesAPlatformClassification() {
        // The registry holds no platform field at all, which is the structural guarantee that a
        // packet can never promote UNKNOWN to JAVA. Asserted rather than merely intended.
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : ModListConnectionRegistry.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
            assertFalse(field.getType().getSimpleName().contains("Platform"),
                    "connection state must not carry a platform: " + field.getName());
        }
        assertFalse(ModListEnforcement.class.getName().contains("Platform"));
    }

    @Test
    void aMalformedHandshakeIsNotTreatedAsEvasion() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = harness.registry().begin(player);

        harness.registry().observe(player, entry.token(),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.malformed("truncated payload"));

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                harness.enforcement().evaluate(harness.registry().current(player).observation())
                        .outcome(),
                "a hostile or broken client must never be punished for its own garbage");
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- disconnect

    @Test
    void disconnectDuringHandshakeLeaksNoState() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = harness.registry().begin(player);
        harness.registry().observe(player, entry.token(), complete("fabric-api", TEST_ID));

        // Disconnect arrives mid-handshake, before any decision was taken.
        assertTrue(harness.registry().forget(player));

        assertEquals(0, harness.registry().tracked(), "a disconnect must release state");
        assertEquals(0, harness.disconnects().get(), "a disconnect alone must not kick");
    }

    @Test
    void aMissingModListNeverKicks() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = harness.registry().begin(player);
        // No observation recorded at all: timeout, absent list, or an unsupported client.
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                harness.enforcement().evaluate(harness.registry().current(player).observation())
                        .outcome());
        assertNotNull(entry);
        assertEquals(0, harness.disconnects().get());
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------- reload / disable

    @Test
    void repeatedDisableIsSafeAndReleasesEverything() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        for (int index = 0; index < 5; index++) {
            harness.registry().begin(new UUID(0, index));
        }
        assertEquals(5, harness.registry().tracked());

        harness.listener().shutdown();
        assertEquals(0, harness.registry().tracked(), "disable must release connection state");

        // A repeated disable must not throw or double-free.
        harness.listener().shutdown();
        assertEquals(0, harness.registry().tracked());
    }

    @Test
    void aReloadStartsFromCleanStateSoNoDecisionCarriesOver() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry first = harness.registry().begin(player);
        harness.registry().observe(player, first.token(), complete(TEST_ID));

        // Simulate a reload cycle: the admission listener is torn down and rebuilt.
        harness.listener().shutdown();
        assertEquals(0, harness.registry().tracked());

        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry second = harness.registry().begin(player);
        assertTrue(second.token() != first.token());
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                harness.enforcement().evaluate(harness.registry().current(player).observation())
                        .outcome(),
                "a rebuilt listener must not inherit a previous connection's denial");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- diagnostics

    @Test
    void diagnosticsReportPhaseAndCountsWithoutExposingModIds() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        harness.registry().begin(UUID.randomUUID());

        String describe = harness.listener().describe();
        assertNotNull(describe);
        assertTrue(describe.contains("mode=enforce"), describe);
        assertTrue(describe.contains("denied="), describe);
        assertTrue(describe.contains("tracked="), describe);
        assertFalse(describe.contains(TEST_ID),
                "diagnostics must not publish denied ids: " + describe);
    }

    @Test
    void phaseIsReportedHonestlyRatherThanAssumed() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        // Nothing decided yet: the phase must say so rather than implying a pre-login block.
        assertEquals(ForgeModListAdmissionListener.Phase.NONE, harness.listener().lastPhase());
        assertFalse(harness.listener().lastDecisionWasPreLogin(),
                "with no decision taken, a pre-login block must not be claimed");
    }

    @Test
    void stateIsBoundedAcrossManyConnections() {
        Harness harness = harness(true, TEST_ID);
        List<UUID> ids = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = 0; index < ModListConnectionRegistry.MAX_TRACKED + 250; index++) {
            UUID id = new UUID(0, index);
            ids.add(id);
            harness.registry().begin(id);
        }
        assertTrue(harness.registry().tracked() <= ModListConnectionRegistry.MAX_TRACKED);
        assertEquals(ModListConnectionRegistry.MAX_TRACKED, harness.listener().tracked());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- no interaction with probes

    @Test
    void forgeEnforcementIsIndependentOfClientProbeState() {
        // The Forge path must not read, write, or reuse any client-detection result. It has no
        // reference to a probe module at all, which is what makes reuse impossible rather than
        // merely avoided.
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : ModListEnforcement.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
            String type = field.getType().getName();
            assertFalse(type.contains("Probe") || type.contains("Detection"),
                    "Forge enforcement must not hold probe state: " + field.getName());
        }
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : ForgeModListAdmissionListener.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
            String type = field.getType().getName();
            assertFalse(type.contains("Probe") || type.contains("Detection")
                            || type.contains("EnforcementService"),
                    "admission must not hold probe state: " + field.getName());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void theReasonCodeIsDistinctFromProbeEnforcement() {
        assertEquals("FORGE_MOD_DENYLIST", ModListEnforcement.REASON);
        // The probe path uses its own vocabulary; the two must never be conflated.
        assertFalse(ModListEnforcement.REASON.equals("confirmed detection"),
                "a denylist decision must not impersonate a probe confirmation");
    }

    @Test
    void anEmptyDenylistNeverDeniesAnyConnection() {
        Harness harness = harness(true); // no ids configured
        for (String candidate : List.of(TEST_ID, "meteor-client", "anything")) {
            UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
            ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = harness.registry().begin(player);
            harness.registry().observe(player, entry.token(), complete(candidate));
            assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                    harness.enforcement().evaluate(harness.registry().current(player).observation())
                            .outcome(), candidate + " must be allowed with an empty denylist");
        }
        assertEquals(0, harness.disconnects().get());
    }
}
```
