`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/modlist/ForgeModListParserTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.modlist;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertInstanceOf;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * The parser's job is to survive an unauthenticated client while never turning hostile bytes into
 * a punishment.
 *
 * <p><b>All fixtures here are synthetic.</b> Every payload is hand-built from the documented wire
 * format to exercise the parser. None of it is captured client traffic, and no test here should be
 * cited as evidence of live interoperability.
 */
class ForgeModListParserTest {

    private static byte[] legacy(Object... mods) {
        java.util.List<String[]> pairs = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = 0; index + 1 < mods.length; index += 2) {
            pairs.add(new String[] {String.valueOf(mods[index]), String.valueOf(mods[index + 1])});
        }
        return ForgeModListParser.encodeLegacyForTest(pairs);
    }

    private static byte[] modern(String... ids) {
        return ForgeModListParser.encodeModernForTest(List.of(ids));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- legacy format

    @Test
    void parsesALegacyModListWithVersions() {
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL,
                        legacy("meteor-client", "1.21.11-86", "fabric-api", "0.141.6")));

        assertEquals(ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.LEGACY, parsed.format());
        assertEquals("1.21.11-86", parsed.mods().get("meteor-client"));
        assertEquals("0.141.6", parsed.mods().get("fabric-api"));
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- modern format

    @Test
    void parsesAModernModListWithNoVersions() {
        // This is the format a real 1.21.11 Forge client sends, so it is the path that matters.
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL,
                        modern("meteor-client", "fabric-api", "sodium")));

        assertEquals(ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.MODERN, parsed.format());
        assertEquals(List.of("meteor-client", "fabric-api", "sodium"),
                ForgeModListParser.idsOf(parsed));
        for (String version : parsed.mods().values()) {
            assertEquals("", version,
                    "the modern wire format carries no version; none may be fabricated");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void aLegacyPayloadIsNotSilentlyReadWithTheModernLayout() {
        // The regression this whole split exists for. Parsing a legacy id/version list with the
        // modern layout pairs each id with the NEXT id and treats it as a version, then walks into
        // the channel section. That produces plausible garbage instead of an error.
        byte[] legacyPayload = legacy("meteor-client", "1.0", "fabric-api", "0.2");

        ForgeModListParser.Result parsed =
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, legacyPayload);

        // It must NOT come back as a clean mod list, and must not invent the ids.
        assertFalse(parsed instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed
                        && List.copyOf(((ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed) parsed).mods().keySet())
                                .equals(List.of("meteor-client", "fabric-api")),
                "a legacy payload must not be reinterpreted as the modern format");
    }

    @Test
    void aModernPayloadIsNotReadWithTheLegacyLayout() {
        // The mirror image: the legacy layout would read "fabric-api" as the version of the
        // preceding id and then run out of bytes, or worse, succeed with shifted pairs.
        ForgeModListParser.Result parsed =
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL,
                        modern("meteor-client", "fabric-api", "sodium"));

        assertFalse(parsed instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed,
                "a modern payload must not be reinterpreted as the legacy format, got: " + parsed);
    }

    @Test
    void modernMessageIndexIsAVarintNotAByte() {
        // SimpleChannel prefixes with a varint index. Reading a byte would misinterpret the
        // continuation bit of a multi-byte varint as part of the value.
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeVarInt(buffer, ForgeModListParser.MODERN_MOD_LIST_INDEX);
        writeVarInt(buffer, 1);
        writeString(buffer, "some-mod");
        writeVarInt(buffer, 0); // channel count
        writeVarInt(buffer, 0); // registry count

        assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, buffer.toByteArray()),
                "the modern index must be read as a varint");
    }

    @Test
    void modernChannelAndRegistrySectionsAreConsumedNotMistakenForMods() {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeVarInt(buffer, ForgeModListParser.MODERN_MOD_LIST_INDEX);
        writeVarInt(buffer, 1);
        writeString(buffer, "real-mod");
        writeVarInt(buffer, 2);                                  // two channels
        writeString(buffer, "some:channel");
        writeString(buffer, "v1");
        writeString(buffer, "other:channel");
        writeString(buffer, "v2");
        writeVarInt(buffer, 1);                                  // one registry
        writeString(buffer, "minecraft:some_registry");

        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, buffer.toByteArray()));

        assertEquals(List.of("real-mod"), ForgeModListParser.idsOf(parsed),
                "channels and registries are not mod ids and must never appear as such");
    }

    @Test
    void aHugeModernChannelCountIsRefusedRatherThanSkipped() {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        writeVarInt(buffer, ForgeModListParser.MODERN_MOD_LIST_INDEX);
        writeVarInt(buffer, 0);                                   // zero mods
        writeVarInt(buffer, Integer.MAX_VALUE);                   // then a hostile channel count

        assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, buffer.toByteArray()),
                "an unchecked skip loop could spin on a client-chosen count");
    }

    @Test
    void nonModListModernIndicesAreNotModLists() {
        for (int index : new int[] {0, 1, 3, 5, 6}) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            writeVarInt(buffer, index);
            writeVarInt(buffer, 0);
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.NotAModList.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL,
                            buffer.toByteArray()),
                    "index " + index + " is a different handshake message");
        }
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------- channel discrimination

    @Test
    void formatIsSelectedByChannelAndNeverGuessed() {
        assertEquals(ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.LEGACY,
                ForgeModListParser.formatFor(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL));
        assertEquals(ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.MODERN,
                ForgeModListParser.formatFor(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL));
        assertNull(ForgeModListParser.formatFor("minecraft:brand"));
        assertNull(ForgeModListParser.formatFor(null));
    }

    @Test
    void unrelatedChannelsAreRefusedWithoutParsing() {
        assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse("minecraft:brand", modern("meteor-client")));
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- empty list

    @Test
    void anEmptyModListIsValidInBothFormats() {
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed legacyParsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL, legacy()));
        assertTrue(legacyParsed.mods().isEmpty());

        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed modernParsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, modern()));
        assertTrue(modernParsed.mods().isEmpty(),
                "zero declared mods is legal, not malformed, and denies nobody");
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------- hostile input

    @Test
    void aHugeDeclaredCountIsRefusedBeforeAllocating() {
        for (String channel : List.of(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL,
                ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL)) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            if (ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL.equals(channel)) {
                buffer.write(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_MOD_LIST_DISCRIMINATOR);
            } else {
                writeVarInt(buffer, ForgeModListParser.MODERN_MOD_LIST_INDEX);
            }
            writeVarInt(buffer, Integer.MAX_VALUE); // the client chose this. It must not be obeyed.

            ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused refused = assertInstanceOf(
                    ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(channel, buffer.toByteArray()));
            assertTrue(refused.reason().contains("exceeds"),
                    channel + " must refuse on the count, got: " + refused.reason());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void aHugeDeclaredStringLengthIsRefused() {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        buffer.write(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_MOD_LIST_DISCRIMINATOR);
        writeVarInt(buffer, 1);
        writeVarInt(buffer, 1_000_000_000); // a 1 GB mod id
        assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL, buffer.toByteArray()),
                "a 1 GB declared string must be refused, not allocated");
    }

    @Test
    void anOversizedPayloadIsRefused() {
        byte[] data = new byte[ForgeModListParser.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES + 1];
        for (String channel : ForgeModListParser.handshakeChannels()) {
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(channel, data));
        }
    }

    @Test
    void truncatedAndEmptyPayloadsAreRefusedWithoutThrowing() {
        for (String channel : ForgeModListParser.handshakeChannels()) {
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(channel, null), channel + " null");
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(channel, new byte[0]), channel + " empty");
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(channel, new byte[] {2}), channel + " truncated");
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(channel,
                            new byte[] {2, (byte) 0x80, (byte) 0x80, (byte) 0x80, (byte) 0x80}),
                    channel + " varint overflow");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void otherLegacyHandshakePacketsAreNotAModList() {
        for (int discriminator : new int[] {0, 1, 3, 7, 255}) {
            byte[] data = new byte[] {(byte) discriminator, 0};
            assertInstanceOf(ForgeModListParser.Result.NotAModList.class,
                    ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL, data),
                    "discriminator " + discriminator + " is a normal handshake packet");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void arbitraryBytesNeverThrowAndYieldOnlyDeclaredOutcomes() {
        for (String channel : ForgeModListParser.handshakeChannels()) {
            for (int first = 0; first < 256; first++) {
                for (byte[] tail : new byte[][] {{1, 2, 3}, {1}, {}, {2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8}}) {
                    byte[] data = new byte[tail.length + 1];
                    data[0] = (byte) first;
                    System.arraycopy(tail, 0, data, 1, tail.length);
                    ForgeModListParser.Result result = ForgeModListParser.parse(channel, data);
                    assertTrue(result instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed
                                    || result instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.NotAModList
                                    || result instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused,
                            "outcome must be a declared state for first byte " + first);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void aFullSizedModernListIsAccepted() {
        java.util.List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (int index = 0; index < ForgeModListParser.MAX_MOD_COUNT; index++) {
            ids.add("mod" + index);
        }
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL,
                        ForgeModListParser.encodeModernForTest(ids)));
        assertEquals(ForgeModListParser.MAX_MOD_COUNT, parsed.mods().size());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ exact matching

    @Test
    void denylistMatchesOnlyExactModIds() {
        ModListDenylist denylist = ModListDenylist.ofIds(List.of("meteor-client"));

        assertTrue(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("meteor-client", "")));
        assertTrue(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("fabric-api", "", "meteor-client", "")));

        // The whole point of exact matching. Each of these is a different mod.
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("notmeteor-client", "")));
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("meteor", "")));
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("meteor-clientx", "")));
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("x", "meteor-client")), "version is never the id");
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("METEOR-CLIENT-FREE", "")));
    }

    @Test
    void denylistMatchingIsCaseInsensitiveBecauseForgeIdsAre() {
        ModListDenylist denylist = ModListDenylist.ofIds(List.of("meteor-client"));
        assertTrue(denylist.isBlocked("Meteor-Client"));
        assertTrue(denylist.isBlocked("  METEOR-CLIENT  "));
    }

    @Test
    void globLikeEntriesAreRejectedRatherThanStored() {
        ModListDenylist denylist = ModListDenylist.ofIds(
                List.of("meteor*", "meteor-client", "", "   ", "has space", "a/b", "Eternal Shadow"));
        assertEquals(1, denylist.size(),
                "only the one real id may be stored; display names and globs are refused");
        assertTrue(denylist.isBlocked("meteor-client"));
    }

    @Test
    void anEmptyDenylistBlocksNothing() {
        ModListDenylist denylist = ModListDenylist.empty();
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.of("meteor-client", "")));
        assertTrue(denylist.findMatches(Map.of("meteor-client", "")).isEmpty());
        assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(null));
    }

    @Test
    void matchesCarryTheConfiguredReasonAndNeverRawClientBytes() {
        ModListDenylist denylist =
                ModListDenylist.of(Map.of("meteor-client", "known cheat client"));
        List<ModListDenylist.Match> matches =
                denylist.findMatches(Map.of("fabric-api", "", "meteor-client", "1.0"));

        assertEquals(1, matches.size());
        ModListDenylist.Match match = matches.get(0);
        assertEquals("meteor-client", match.modId());
        assertEquals("known cheat client", match.reason());
        assertEquals("meteor-client (known cheat client)", match.toString());
    }

    @Test
    void parsingThenDenylistingComposesIntoOneVerdict() {
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL,
                        modern("fabric-api", "meteor-client")));

        assertEquals(1, ModListDenylist.ofIds(List.of("meteor-client"))
                .findMatches(parsed.mods()).size());
    }

    @Test
    void aRefusedParseYieldsNoModsAndSoNoMatch() {
        ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        buffer.write(ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_MOD_LIST_DISCRIMINATOR);
        writeVarInt(buffer, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        ForgeModListParser.Result result = ForgeModListParser.parse(
                ForgeModListParser.LEGACY_CHANNEL, buffer.toByteArray());

        assertTrue(ForgeModListParser.idsOf(result).isEmpty(),
                "a refused parse must contribute no mods to any decision");
        assertFalse(ModListDenylist.ofIds(List.of("meteor-client")).blocksAny(Map.of()));
    }

    @Test
    void aMalformedListDeniesNobody() {
        // Every non-Parsed outcome must be inert. This is the property the whole enforcement path
        // rests on: garbage never becomes a denial.
        ModListDenylist denylist = ModListDenylist.ofIds(List.of("meteor-client"));
        ForgeModListParser.Result[] nonModListResults = {
                new ForgeModListParser.Result.NotAModList(1),
                new ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused("boom"),
                new ForgeModListParser.Result.NotAModList(255),
        };
        for (ForgeModListParser.Result result : nonModListResults) {
            assertFalse(denylist.blocksAny(Map.copyOf(
                            ForgeModListParser.idsOf(result).stream()
                                    .collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toMap(
                                            id -> id, id -> "")))),
                    "a non-parsed result must never produce a match: " + result);
        }
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------- immutability / order

    @Test
    void declaredOrderIsPreserved() {
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL,
                        modern("zeta", "alpha", "meteor-client", "beta")));

        assertEquals(List.of("zeta", "alpha", "meteor-client", "beta"),
                ForgeModListParser.idsOf(parsed),
                "mod lists are rendered in declaration order so output is reproducible");
    }

    @Test
    void parsedResultsAreImmutable() {
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed parsed = assertInstanceOf(
                ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed.class,
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, modern("meteor-client")));
        try {
            parsed.mods().put("injected", "");
            // UnmodifiableMap throws rather than silently accepting, which is what we want.
            assertTrue(parsed.mods().containsKey("injected"),
                    "if this ever mutates, callers could forge a decision after the fact");
        } catch (UnsupportedOperationException immutable) {
            assertFalse(parsed.mods().containsKey("injected"));
        }
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------------- fixtures

    private static void writeVarInt(ByteArrayOutputStream out, int value) {
        while (true) {
            if ((value & ~0x7F) == 0) {
                out.write(value);
                return;
            }
            out.write((value & 0x7F) | 0x80);
            value >>>= 7;
        }
    }

    private static void writeString(ByteArrayOutputStream out, String text) {
        byte[] bytes = text.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        writeVarInt(out, bytes.length);
        out.writeBytes(bytes);
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/modlist/ModListEnforcementTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.modlist;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * End-to-end tests for the decision path and the connection lifecycle.
 *
 * <p>These exercise parse -&gt; observe -&gt; decide with deterministic adapters. They do not open a
 * socket, do not run PacketEvents, and do not represent live interoperability.
 */
class ModListEnforcementTest {

    private static final UUID PLAYER = UUID.fromString("00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa");

    /** The harmless id the spec requires for automated denial tests. */
    private static final String TEST_ID = "p36_test_blocked_mod";

    private static ModListEnforcement enforcing(String... ids) {
        return new ModListEnforcement(new ModListEnforcement.Policy(true,
                ModListEnforcement.Mode.ENFORCE, "removed", List.of(ids),
                Map.of(TEST_ID, "test id")));
    }

    private static ModListEnforcement.Observation complete(String... ids) {
        java.util.Map<String, String> mods = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String id : ids) {
            mods.put(id, "");
        }
        return ModListEnforcement.Observation.complete(mods, ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.MODERN);
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------- decision path

    @Test
    void validListWithNoDeniedIdIsAllowed() {
        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = enforcing(TEST_ID)
                .evaluate(complete("fabric-api", "sodium", "lithium"));

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW, decision.outcome());
        assertNull(decision.matched());
        assertEquals(3, decision.modCount());
    }

    @Test
    void validListWithAnExactDeniedIdIsDenied() {
        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision =
                enforcing(TEST_ID).evaluate(complete("fabric-api", TEST_ID));

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.DENY, decision.outcome());
        assertEquals(TEST_ID, decision.matched());
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.REASON, decision.reason());
    }

    @Test
    void similarButNonEqualIdsAreAllowed() {
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);
        for (String lookalike : new String[] {
                TEST_ID + "x", "x" + TEST_ID, TEST_ID.replace("_", ""), "p36testblockedmod",
                TEST_ID.toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).substring(0, 3) + "_other"}) {
            assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                    enforcement.evaluate(complete(lookalike)).outcome(),
                    lookalike + " is a different mod and must be allowed");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void multipleIdsWithOneExactDeniedIdIsDenied() {
        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = enforcing(TEST_ID)
                .evaluate(complete("fabric-api", "sodium", TEST_ID, "lithium"));

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.DENY, decision.outcome());
        assertEquals(TEST_ID, decision.matched());
        assertEquals(4, decision.modCount());
    }

    @Test
    void malformedObservationNeverDenies() {
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);
        List<ModListEnforcement.Observation> nonDenying = List.of(
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.malformed("truncated"),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.notAModList("index 1"),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.unsupported("no forge handshake"),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.complete(Map.of(), ForgeModListParser.WireFormat.MODERN));

        for (ModListEnforcement.Observation observation : nonDenying) {
            assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW, enforcement.evaluate(observation).outcome(),
                    observation + " must never deny");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void aRefusedParseProducesAnObservationThatCannotDeny() {
        byte[] hostile = new byte[ForgeModListParser.MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES + 1];
        ForgeModListParser.Result result =
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, hostile);
        assertInstanceOfRefused(result);

        ModListEnforcement.Observation observation =
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.malformed("refused");
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                enforcing(TEST_ID).evaluate(observation).outcome());
    }

    private static void assertInstanceOfRefused(ForgeModListParser.Result result) {
        assertTrue(result instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.Refused,
                "expected a refusal, got " + result);
    }

    @Test
    void aHugeDeclaredCountIsRefusedAndDeniesNobody() {
        java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream buffer = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        buffer.write(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_MOD_LIST_INDEX);
        writeVarInt(buffer, Integer.MAX_VALUE);

        ForgeModListParser.Result result = ForgeModListParser.parse(
                ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, buffer.toByteArray());
        assertInstanceOfRefused(result);
        assertTrue(ForgeModListParser.idsOf(result).isEmpty(),
                "a refused parse contributes no ids, so nothing can match");
    }

    @Test
    void auditModeRecordsButAllows() {
        ModListEnforcement audit = new ModListEnforcement(new ModListEnforcement.Policy(true,
                ModListEnforcement.Mode.AUDIT, "removed", List.of(TEST_ID), Map.of(TEST_ID, "")));

        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = audit.evaluate(complete(TEST_ID));
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.AUDIT, decision.outcome());
        assertEquals(TEST_ID, decision.matched());
        assertFalse(decision.denied(), "audit must never deny");
    }

    @Test
    void disabledPolicyNeverDenies() {
        ModListEnforcement disabled = new ModListEnforcement(new ModListEnforcement.Policy(false,
                ModListEnforcement.Mode.ENFORCE, "removed", List.of(TEST_ID), Map.of()));

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                disabled.evaluate(complete(TEST_ID)).outcome());
    }

    @Test
    void anEmptyDenylistDeniesNobody() {
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                enforcing().evaluate(complete(TEST_ID, "meteor-client")).outcome(),
                "the shipped configuration must deny nobody");
    }

    @Test
    void theTestIdIsNotPresentInTheShippedResource() {
        // The spec requires the harmless test id to be absent from any production denylist.
        String resource = ModListDenylistConfig.defaultResource();
        assertFalse(resource.contains(TEST_ID),
                "the test id must never appear in the shipped configuration");
        assertTrue(resource.contains("denied-mod-ids: []"),
                "the shipped denylist must be empty");
        assertTrue(resource.contains("enabled: false"),
                "the shipped policy must be disabled by default");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------- connection lifecycle rules

    @Test
    void duplicateHandshakeMessagesCannotProduceADuplicateDenial() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = registry.begin(PLAYER);
        assertNotNull(entry);

        assertTrue(registry.observe(PLAYER, entry.token(), complete("fabric-api", TEST_ID)));
        // A duplicate or replayed message must not overwrite or re-trigger anything.
        assertFalse(registry.observe(PLAYER, entry.token(), complete("fabric-api", TEST_ID)));

        ModListEnforcement.Decision first = enforcement.evaluate(registry.current(PLAYER).observation());
        assertTrue(registry.decide(PLAYER, entry.token(), first));
        assertFalse(registry.decide(PLAYER, entry.token(), first),
                "a second decision for one connection would be a duplicate denial path");
    }

    @Test
    void reconnectWithTheSameUuidCannotInheritAPreviousDecision() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);

        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry first = registry.begin(PLAYER);
        registry.observe(PLAYER, first.token(), complete(TEST_ID));
        registry.decide(PLAYER, first.token(), enforcement.evaluate(registry.current(PLAYER).observation()));
        registry.forget(PLAYER);

        // Same UUID, brand new connection, clean client.
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry second = registry.begin(PLAYER);
        assertTrue(second.token() != first.token(), "a new connection must get a new token");

        assertNull(registry.current(PLAYER, first.token()),
                "a stale token must resolve to nothing, never to the new connection's state");
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                enforcement.evaluate(registry.current(PLAYER, second.token()).observation()).outcome(),
                "the second connection must not inherit the first connection's denial");
    }

    @Test
    void disconnectReleasesStateExactlyOnce() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        registry.begin(PLAYER);
        registry.observe(PLAYER, registry.current(PLAYER).token(), complete("fabric-api"));

        assertTrue(registry.forget(PLAYER));
        assertFalse(registry.forget(PLAYER), "a repeated cleanup must be a no-op");
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked());
        assertNull(registry.current(PLAYER));
    }

    @Test
    void shutdownReleasesEverything() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        registry.begin(PLAYER);
        registry.begin(UUID.randomUUID());
        registry.begin(UUID.randomUUID());

        assertEquals(3, registry.clear());
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked());
        assertEquals(0, registry.clear(), "clearing twice releases nothing the second time");
    }

    @Test
    void anObservationForAnUntrackedConnectionIsDroppedRatherThanCreatingState() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        assertFalse(registry.observe(PLAYER, 12345L, complete(TEST_ID)),
                "a packet for an unannounced connection must not allocate state");
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked(), "and must not leak an entry");
    }

    @Test
    void trackedStateIsBounded() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        for (int index = 0; index < ModListConnectionRegistry.MAX_TRACKED + 500; index++) {
            registry.begin(new UUID(0, index));
        }
        assertTrue(registry.tracked() <= ModListConnectionRegistry.MAX_TRACKED,
                "connection state must stay bounded; was " + registry.tracked());
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentObservationAndCleanupDoNotCorruptState() {
        // Exercises the lock: a Netty thread observing while a Bukkit thread releases.
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);
        List<Throwable> failures = java.util.Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
        List<Thread> threads = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int index = 0; index < 8; index++) {
            UUID id = new UUID(0, index);
            threads.add(Thread.ofVirtual().start(() -> {
                try {
                    for (int iteration = 0; iteration < 400; iteration++) {
                        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = registry.begin(id);
                        if (entry != null) {
                            registry.observe(id, entry.token(), complete("fabric-api", TEST_ID));
                            enforcement.evaluate(registry.current(id, entry.token()) == null
                                    ? null : registry.current(id).observation());
                        }
                    }
                } catch (Throwable failure) {
                    failures.add(failure);
                }
            }));
        }
        for (Thread thread : threads) {
            try {
                thread.join(30_000);
            } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                throw new AssertionError(interrupted);
            }
        }
        assertTrue(failures.isEmpty(), "concurrent access must not throw: " + failures);
        assertTrue(registry.tracked() <= ModListConnectionRegistry.MAX_TRACKED);
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------- bedrock / unknown safety

    @Test
    void bedrockAndUnsupportedClientsAreNeverDenied() {
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);
        // A Bedrock or vanilla connection produces no Forge handshake at all.
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                enforcement.evaluate(ModListEnforcement.Observation.unsupported("no handshake")).outcome());
        // A Fabric client sends no mod list, which is also UNSUPPORTED, not a malformed list.
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                enforcement.evaluate(ModListEnforcement.Observation.unsupported("fabric")).outcome());
    }

    @Test
    void anEmptyValidForgeListDeniesNobody() {
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW,
                enforcing(TEST_ID).evaluate(complete()).outcome(),
                "a Forge client with no mods is a legitimate client");
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- full path tests

    @Test
    void fullPathFromPayloadToDenial() {
        byte[] payload = ForgeModListParser.encodeModernForTest(List.of("fabric-api", TEST_ID));
        ForgeModListParser.Result parsed =
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, payload);

        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = enforcing(TEST_ID);
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = registry.begin(PLAYER);

        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed ok = assertParsed(parsed);
        registry.observe(PLAYER, entry.token(),
                ModListEnforcement.Observation.complete(ok.mods(), ok.format()));

        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = enforcement.evaluate(registry.current(PLAYER).observation());
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.DENY, decision.outcome());
        assertEquals(TEST_ID, decision.matched());
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.REASON, decision.reason());

        registry.decide(PLAYER, entry.token(), decision);
        registry.forget(PLAYER);
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked(), "denial must release state exactly once");
    }

    @Test
    void fullPathForACleanClientAllows() {
        byte[] payload = ForgeModListParser.encodeModernForTest(List.of("fabric-api", "sodium"));
        ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed ok = assertParsed(
                ForgeModListParser.parse(ForgeModListParser.MODERN_CHANNEL, payload));

        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = enforcing(TEST_ID)
                .evaluate(ModListEnforcement.Observation.complete(ok.mods(), ok.format()));
        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW, decision.outcome());
    }

    private static ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed assertParsed(ForgeModListParser.Result result) {
        assertTrue(result instanceof ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed,
                "expected a parsed list, got " + result);
        return (ForgeModListParser.Result.Parsed) result;
    }

    private static void writeVarInt(java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream out, int value) {
        while (true) {
            if ((value & ~0x7F) == 0) {
                out.write(value);
                return;
            }
            out.write((value & 0x7F) | 0x80);
            value >>>= 7;
        }
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/modlist/PacketEventsBridgeTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.modlist;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Failure-path tests for the optional PacketEvents integration.
 *
 * <p><b>PacketEvents is not installed in this test environment</b>, so these tests exercise exactly
 * the path that matters most in practice: the feature must be inert, must say why, and must never
 * fall back to a less careful interception route.
 *
 * <p>They do not prove interception works. That requires the real plugin and a real client.
 */
class PacketEventsBridgeTest {

    private static Logger quietLogger() {
        Logger logger = Logger.getLogger("PacketEventsBridgeTest");
        logger.setLevel(Level.OFF);
        return logger;
    }

    private static ModListEnforcement.Policy policy(boolean enabled, String... ids) {
        return new ModListEnforcement.Policy(enabled, ModListEnforcement.Mode.ENFORCE,
                "removed", java.util.List.of(ids), java.util.Map.of());
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------ disabled path

    @Test
    void aDisabledFeatureNeverInitialisesAndStaysInert() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());

        // Deliberately configured with a denied id, so only `enabled` prevents activation.
        bridge.initialise(false, id -> { });

        assertEquals(PacketEventsBridge.Status.UNAVAILABLE, bridge.status());
        assertFalse(bridge.active());
        assertEquals("disabled by configuration", bridge.detail());
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked(), "an inert feature tracks nothing");
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------- PacketEvents not installed

    @Test
    void missingPacketEventsYieldsAnExplicitDiagnosticAndNoFallback() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());

        PacketEventsBridge.Status status = bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });

        // Either PacketEvents is absent (UNAVAILABLE) or present but unusable (FAILED). Both are
        // inert. What must never happen is ACTIVE, or a silent exception.
        assertTrue(status == PacketEventsBridge.Status.UNAVAILABLE
                        || status == PacketEventsBridge.Status.FAILED,
                "an unusable integration must report UNAVAILABLE or FAILED, got " + status);
        assertFalse(bridge.active());
        assertNotNull(bridge.detail());
        assertFalse(bridge.detail().isBlank(), "the reason must be recorded, not left blank");
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked(), "a failed integration must not create state");
    }

    @Test
    void theDenierIsNeverInvokedWhenTheIntegrationIsInert() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        AtomicInteger invocations = new AtomicInteger();

        bridge.initialise(true, id -> invocations.incrementAndGet());

        assertEquals(0, invocations.get(),
                "an unusable integration must never disconnect anybody");
    }

    @Test
    void initializationNeverThrowsForAnyEnvironment() {
        // Runs in an environment with and without PacketEvents; neither may break startup.
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });
        assertNotNull(bridge.status());
        assertNotNull(bridge.describe());
    }

    // --------------------------------------------------------------- idempotency

    @Test
    void repeatedInitialisationDoesNotDoubleRegister() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());

        PacketEventsBridge.Status first = bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });
        PacketEventsBridge.Status second = bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });
        PacketEventsBridge.Status third = bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });

        // The contract is that the status is stable and registration happens at most once.
        assertEquals(first, second, "repeated initialisation must not change status");
        assertEquals(second, third);
    }

    @Test
    void anInactiveBridgeCanBeReInitialised() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());

        bridge.initialise(false, id -> { });          // disabled -> UNAVAILABLE
        assertEquals(PacketEventsBridge.Status.UNAVAILABLE, bridge.status());

        bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });           // operator enables
        assertTrue(bridge.status() == PacketEventsBridge.Status.UNAVAILABLE
                        || bridge.status() == PacketEventsBridge.Status.FAILED,
                "re-initialisation after enabling must remain inert here, not fabricate success");
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------ shutdown / cleanup

    @Test
    void shutdownIsSafeWhenNeverInitialised() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        bridge.shutdown(); // must not throw
        bridge.shutdown(); // and must remain safe
        assertEquals(PacketEventsBridge.Status.UNAVAILABLE, bridge.status());
    }

    @Test
    void shutdownAfterInitialisationLeavesNothingActive() {
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });
        bridge.shutdown();
        assertFalse(bridge.active());
        assertEquals(PacketEventsBridge.Status.UNAVAILABLE, bridge.status());
    }

    @Test
    void shutdownReleasesTrackedConnectionState() {
        // Disabling the plugin must release per-connection state, not leave it behind.
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        for (int index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
            registry.begin(new UUID(0, index));
        }
        assertEquals(10, registry.tracked());

        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        bridge.shutdown();
        assertEquals(0, registry.tracked(), "plugin disable must release connection state");
    }

    @Test
    void diagnosticsNeverExposeModIdsOrPayloads() {
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = new ModListEnforcement(
                policy(true, "p36_test_blocked_mod"));
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        bridge.initialise(false, id -> { });

        String describe = bridge.describe() + " " + enforcement.describe();

        assertFalse(describe.contains("p36_test_blocked_mod"),
                "the status line must not publish the blocklist: " + describe);
        assertTrue(describe.contains("trackedConnections="));
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------- inert feature denies nobody

    @Test
    void anInertIntegrationLeavesEveryConnectionAllowed() {
        ModListEnforcement enforcement = new ModListEnforcement(
                policy(true, "p36_test_blocked_mod"));
        ModListConnectionRegistry registry = new ModListConnectionRegistry();
        PacketEventsBridge bridge = new PacketEventsBridge(registry, quietLogger());
        bridge.initialise(true, id -> { });

        // Even though the policy is enabled and would deny, no observation can exist, so every
        // connection is allowed. An unreachable denylist must not become an accidental one.
        ModListConnectionRegistry.Entry entry = registry.begin(UUID.randomUUID());
        ModListEnforcement.Decision decision = enforcement.evaluate(registry.current(
                entry.playerId(), entry.token()).observation());

        assertEquals(ModListEnforcement.Outcome.ALLOW, decision.outcome(),
                "with no observation, nothing can be denied");
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/physics/AllocationMeter.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.physics;

import java.lang.management.ManagementFactory;
import java.lang.management.ThreadMXBean;

/**
 * Precise allocation measurement for the hot-path tests.
 *
 * <p>The obvious approach, {@code totalMemory() - freeMemory()}, is not an allocation counter.
 * It measures heap occupancy, so it drifts with GC timing and produces different answers on
 * identical runs. A guard written that way is flaky by construction and will eventually fail a
 * build for no reason.
 *
 * <p>{@code getThreadAllocatedBytes} counts bytes actually allocated by the calling thread, so
 * it is deterministic and needs no warm-up or GC dance.
 *
 * <p>Falls back to the heap-delta method on a JVM without the extension, and reports which
 * method was used so a fallback run is never mistaken for a precise one.
 */
public final class AllocationMeter {
    private static final ThreadMXBean THREADS = ManagementFactory.getThreadMXBean();
    private static final java.lang.reflect.Method ALLOCATED_BYTES = findAllocatedBytes();

    private AllocationMeter() {
    }

    private static java.lang.reflect.Method findAllocatedBytes() {
        try {
            java.lang.reflect.Method method = THREADS.getClass()
                    .getMethod("getThreadAllocatedBytes", long.class);
            method.setAccessible(true);
            return method;
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException unavailable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** True when the precise per-thread counter is available on this JVM. */
    public static boolean precise() {
        return ALLOCATED_BYTES != null;
    }

    /** Bytes allocated by the current thread so far. */
    public static long allocated() {
        if (ALLOCATED_BYTES == null) return -1L;
        try {
            return (long) ALLOCATED_BYTES.invoke(THREADS, Thread.currentThread().getId());
        } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException failure) {
            return -1L;
        }
    }

    /** Bytes allocated by {@code action} on the current thread, or -1 if unavailable. */
    public static long measure(Runnable action) {
        if (ALLOCATED_BYTES == null) {
            action.run();
            return -1L;
        }
        long before = allocated();
        action.run();
        long after = allocated();
        return after - before;
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Queue;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class AutomaticCheckCoordinatorTest {
    private final FakeScheduler scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
    private final UUID playerId = UUID.randomUUID();

    @Test
    void delayAndDuplicateAdmissionArePerPlayer() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(2);
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Target target = target(playerId, true, true);

        assertTrue(coordinator.schedule(target, checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target, checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.activeCount());
        assertEquals(0, checks.get());

        scheduler.runDelayed();
        assertEquals(1, checks.get());
        coordinator.complete(playerId);
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void diagnosticsCountersTrackAdmissionStartCompletionAndSkip() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(1);
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Target target = target(playerId, true, true);
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Ticket ticket = coordinator.scheduleTicket(target, ignored -> { });
        assertNotNull(ticket);
        assertNull(coordinator.scheduleTicket(target, ignored -> { }));

        var admitted = coordinator.metrics();
        assertEquals(1, admitted.active());
        assertEquals(1, admitted.capacity());
        assertEquals(1, admitted.admitted());
        assertEquals(1, admitted.skippedAdmissions());
        assertEquals(0, admitted.started());

        scheduler.runDelayed();
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.metrics().started());
        assertTrue(coordinator.complete(ticket));
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.metrics().released());
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.metrics().active());
    }

    @Test
    void capacityIsAtomicAndReleasedOnCompletionOrDisconnect() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(1);
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();
        UUID secondId = UUID.randomUUID();

        assertTrue(coordinator.schedule(target(playerId, true, true), checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target(secondId, true, true), checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.activeCount());
        coordinator.disconnect(playerId);
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
        assertTrue(coordinator.schedule(target(secondId, true, true), checks::incrementAndGet));
        scheduler.runDelayed();
        assertEquals(1, checks.get());
        coordinator.complete(secondId);
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void firstJoinOnlyIsAppliedAtAdmission() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = new AutomaticCheckCoordinator(
                scheduler, 1, true, 2, Logger.getLogger("test-first-join"));
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();

        assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target(playerId, true, false), checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertTrue(coordinator.schedule(target(playerId, true, true), checks::incrementAndGet));
        scheduler.runDelayed();
        assertEquals(1, checks.get());
    }

    @Test
    void staleTicketCannotCompleteReconnectOperation() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(2);
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Ticket oldTicket = coordinator.scheduleTicket(
                target(playerId, true, true), ignored -> checks.incrementAndGet());
        assertNotNull(oldTicket);
        coordinator.disconnect(playerId);
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Ticket reconnectTicket = coordinator.scheduleTicket(
                target(playerId, true, true), ignored -> checks.incrementAndGet());
        assertNotNull(reconnectTicket);

        assertFalse(coordinator.complete(oldTicket));
        assertTrue(coordinator.isCurrent(reconnectTicket));
        scheduler.runDelayed(); // includes the cancelled late task for the old ticket
        assertEquals(1, checks.get());
        assertTrue(coordinator.isCurrent(reconnectTicket));
        assertTrue(coordinator.complete(reconnectTicket));
        assertFalse(coordinator.complete(reconnectTicket));
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void resultClaimIsExactlyOnceAndHoldsCapacityUntilFinalCleanup() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(1);
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Ticket ticket = coordinator.scheduleTicket(
                target(playerId, true, true), ignored -> { });
        scheduler.runDelayed();

        assertNotNull(ticket);
        assertTrue(coordinator.claimCompletion(ticket));
        assertFalse(coordinator.claimCompletion(ticket));
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.activeCount(), "capacity remains held during result/enforcement handling");
        assertTrue(coordinator.complete(ticket));
        assertFalse(coordinator.complete(ticket));
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void duplicateScheduledCallbacksStartOnlyOneCheck() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(2);
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();
        coordinator.schedule(target(playerId, true, true), checks::incrementAndGet);

        scheduler.runFirstDelayedTwice();

        assertEquals(1, checks.get());
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.activeCount());
        coordinator.complete(playerId);
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void dynamicOfflineStatePreventsEntityStartAndReleasesCapacity() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(1);
        AtomicBoolean online = new AtomicBoolean(true);
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Target target = new AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Target(
                playerId, "player", online::get, true, new Object());

        assertNotNull(coordinator.scheduleTicket(target, ignored -> checks.incrementAndGet()));
        online.set(false);
        scheduler.runDelayed();

        assertEquals(0, checks.get());
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void rejectedFirstJoinAndConcurrencyDoNotLeakState() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = new AutomaticCheckCoordinator(
                scheduler, 1, true, 1, Logger.getLogger("test-join"));
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();

        assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target(UUID.randomUUID(), true, false), checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertTrue(coordinator.schedule(target(playerId, true, true), checks::incrementAndGet));
        assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target(UUID.randomUUID(), true, true), checks::incrementAndGet));
        coordinator.disconnect(playerId);
        scheduler.runDelayed();
        assertEquals(0, checks.get());
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void stopReleasesPendingAndRejectsNewAdmission() {
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(2);
        coordinator.schedule(target(playerId, true, true), () -> { });

        coordinator.stop();

        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
        assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target(UUID.randomUUID(), true, true), () -> { }));
        scheduler.runDelayed();
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    @Test
    void entitySchedulingFailureReleasesTicketAndReportsFailureOnce() {
        scheduler.failEntityScheduling = true;
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(1);
        AtomicInteger failures = new AtomicInteger();

        AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Ticket ticket = coordinator.scheduleTicket(
                target(playerId, true, true), ignored -> { }, ignored -> { }, ignored -> failures.incrementAndGet());
        assertNotNull(ticket);
        scheduler.runDelayed();

        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
        assertEquals(1, failures.get());
        assertFalse(coordinator.complete(ticket));
    }

    @Test
    void retiredEntityContextReleasesTicketAndDoesNotRunPlayerWork() {
        scheduler.retireEntityScheduling = true;
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(1);
        AtomicInteger checks = new AtomicInteger();
        AtomicInteger failures = new AtomicInteger();
        var ticket = coordinator.scheduleTicket(target(playerId, true, true), ignored -> { },
                ignored -> checks.incrementAndGet(), ignored -> failures.incrementAndGet());

        scheduler.runDelayed();

        assertEquals(0, checks.get());
        assertEquals(1, failures.get());
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
        assertEquals(1, coordinator.metrics().released());
        assertFalse(coordinator.complete(ticket));
    }

    @Test
    void accountingIsBoundedAcrossConfiguredPlayerCounts() {
        for (int capacity : List.of(1, 4, 8, 16, 32, 40)) {
            AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(capacity);
            for (int i = 0; i < capacity; i++) {
                assertTrue(coordinator.schedule(target(UUID.randomUUID(), true, true), () -> { }));
            }
            assertEquals(capacity, coordinator.activeCount());
            assertFalse(coordinator.schedule(target(UUID.randomUUID(), true, true), () -> { }));
            coordinator.stop();
            assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
        }
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentAdmissionsNeverExceedConfiguredCapacity() throws Exception {
        int capacity = 16;
        AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator = coordinator(capacity);
        AtomicInteger admitted = new AtomicInteger();
        try (var executor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newFixedThreadPool(12)) {
            List<java.util.concurrent.Future<?>> submissions = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
                UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
                submissions.add(executor.submit(() -> {
                    if (coordinator.schedule(target(id, true, true), () -> { })) admitted.incrementAndGet();
                }));
            }
            for (var submission : submissions) submission.get();
        }
        assertEquals(capacity, admitted.get());
        assertEquals(capacity, coordinator.activeCount());
        coordinator.stop();
        assertEquals(0, coordinator.activeCount());
    }

    private AutomaticCheckCoordinator coordinator(int maxConcurrent) {
        return new AutomaticCheckCoordinator(scheduler, 1, false, maxConcurrent,
                Logger.getLogger("test-join"));
    }

    private static AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Target target(UUID id, boolean online, boolean firstJoin) {
        return new AutomaticCheckCoordinator.Target(id, "player", online, firstJoin, new Object());
    }

    private static final class FakeScheduler implements Scheduler {
        private final Queue<Delayed> delayed = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue<>();
        private volatile boolean failEntityScheduling;
        private volatile boolean retireEntityScheduling;

        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task) {
            if (failEntityScheduling) throw new IllegalStateException("entity scheduler unavailable");
            task.run();
            return handle();
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task, Runnable retired) {
            if (retireEntityScheduling) {
                retired.run();
                return handle();
            }
            return runAtEntity(target, task);
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runAtLocation(RegionTarget target, Runnable task) {
            task.run();
            return handle();
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) {
            task.run();
            return handle();
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) {
            FakeHandle handle = new FakeHandle();
            delayed.add(new Delayed(task, handle));
            return handle;
        }

        @Override public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) {
            task.run();
            return handle();
        }

        void runDelayed() {
            Delayed entry;
            while ((entry = delayed.poll()) != null) entry.task().run();
        }

        void runFirstDelayedTwice() {
            Delayed entry = delayed.poll();
            entry.task().run();
            entry.task().run();
        }

        @Override public void shutdown() { }

        private static FakeHandle handle() { return new FakeHandle(); }

        private record Delayed(Runnable task, FakeHandle handle) { }
    }

    private static final class FakeHandle implements TaskHandle {
        private volatile boolean cancelled;
        @Override public void cancel() { cancelled = true; }
        @Override public boolean cancelled() { return cancelled; }
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/platform/ClientBrandCacheTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper.PaperPassiveChannelObserver;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * The brand must be captured once, on the owning thread, and read without touching the player.
 *
 * <p>The cross-region read this replaces was wrapped in a try/catch, which is exactly the kind
 * of quiet mitigation that hides a Folia violation instead of removing it. These tests pin the
 * structural property instead.
 */
class ClientBrandCacheTest {
    private static final AtomicLong CLOCK = new AtomicLong(1_000_000L);

    private static ClientBrandCache cache(int max, Duration ttl) {
        return new ClientBrandCache(max, ttl, CLOCK::get);
    }

    @Test
    void brandIsCapturedOnceAndReadWithoutBukkit() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(16, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        assertNull(cache.brand(player), "nothing captured yet");

        cache.record(player, "fabric");
        assertTrue(cache.known(player));
        assertEquals("fabric", cache.brand(player));
        assertEquals(1, cache.stats().captures());
    }

    @Test
    void aNullBrandIsStillARecordedCapture() {
        // A server that does not expose a brand must be distinguishable from "never captured",
        // otherwise a miss looks like a bug and a real capture looks like a failure.
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(16, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        cache.record(player, null);
        assertTrue(cache.known(player), "captured with no brand is still a capture");
        assertNull(cache.brand(player));
        assertEquals(1, cache.stats().captures());
    }

    @Test
    void forgetOnDisconnectPreventsAReconnectInheritingTheOldValue() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(16, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        cache.record(player, "fabric");

        cache.forget(player);
        assertFalse(cache.known(player));
        assertNull(cache.brand(player),
                "a late packet from a retired connection must not read the old brand");
    }

    @Test
    void reconnectReplacesTheBrand() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(16, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        cache.record(player, "fabric");
        cache.forget(player);
        cache.record(player, "vanilla");
        assertEquals("vanilla", cache.brand(player));
    }

    @Test
    void entriesAreBounded() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(64, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        for (int index = 0; index < 5000; index++) {
            cache.record(UUID.randomUUID(), "fabric-" + index);
        }
        assertTrue(cache.size() <= 64, "the cache must stay bounded: " + cache.size());
        assertTrue(cache.stats().evictions() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void entriesExpireOnSweep() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(64, Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        UUID fresh = UUID.randomUUID();
        UUID stale = UUID.randomUUID();
        cache.record(stale, "fabric");
        CLOCK.addAndGet(11_000L);
        cache.record(fresh, "fabric");

        assertEquals(1, cache.sweep());
        assertFalse(cache.known(stale));
        assertTrue(cache.known(fresh));
    }

    @Test
    void aNullPlayerIsHandledRatherThanStored() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(16, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        cache.record(null, "fabric");
        assertNull(cache.brand(null));
        assertFalse(cache.known(null));
        cache.forget(null);
        assertEquals(0, cache.size());
    }

    @Test
    void theReadPathHoldsNoBukkitState() {
        // Structural guarantee: the cache exists so the hot path cannot reach a Player. If a
        // field or parameter ever became a Bukkit type, the reason for this class disappears.
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : ClientBrandCache.class.getDeclaredFields()) {
            assertFalse(field.getType().getName().startsWith("org.bukkit"),
                    "the brand cache must not hold Bukkit state: " + field.getName());
        }
        for (java.lang.reflect.Method method : ClientBrandCache.class.getDeclaredMethods()) {
            for (Class<?> parameter : method.getParameterTypes()) {
                assertFalse(parameter.getName().startsWith("org.bukkit"),
                        "the brand cache must not accept Bukkit state");
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * The passive callback path must not read the brand from the player. This is the actual
     * cross-region access that the cache removes.
     */
    @Test
    void thePassiveObserverDeliversWithoutReadingThePlayer() throws Exception {
        String source = Files.readString(Path.of(
                "src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/platform/paper/PaperPassiveChannelObserver.java"));
        assertFalse(source.contains("getClientBrandName"),
                "the passive observer runs on the messaging thread and must not read player state");
        assertTrue(source.contains("deliver"), "sanity: the delivery path still exists");
    }

    @Test
    void theBrandIsReadExactlyOnceInProductionCode() throws Exception {
        // One capture point, on the join thread. A second direct read anywhere would reintroduce
        // the cross-region access this class was written to remove.
        List<String> offenders = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try (var stream = Files.walk(Path.of("src/main/java"))) {
            for (Path path : stream.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                String text = Files.readString(path);
                if (text.contains("getClientBrandName")
                        && !path.toString().endsWith("ClientBrandCache.java")
                        && !text.contains("readBrand(event.getPlayer())")) {
                    offenders.add(path.toString());
                }
            }
        }
        assertEquals(List.of(), offenders,
                "getClientBrandName must only be called from the single join-thread capture point");
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentRecordAndReadStaysConsistent() throws Exception {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(4096, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        cache.record(player, "fabric");

        int threads = 12;
        int perThread = 20_000;
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        CountDownLatch done = new CountDownLatch(threads);
        AtomicReference<Throwable> failure = new AtomicReference<>();

        for (int thread = 0; thread < threads; thread++) {
            final int index = thread;
            pool.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    start.await();
                    for (int step = 0; step < perThread; step++) {
                        if (index == 0) cache.record(player, "fabric");
                        else if (cache.brand(player) == null) failure.set(new AssertionError("lost brand"));
                    }
                } catch (Throwable problem) {
                    failure.compareAndSet(null, problem);
                } finally {
                    done.countDown();
                }
            });
        }
        start.countDown();
        assertTrue(done.await(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        pool.shutdownNow();
        assertNull(failure.get());
        assertEquals("fabric", cache.brand(player));
    }

    @Test
    void readDoesNotAllocate() {
        ClientBrandCache cache = cache(4096, Duration.ofMinutes(30));
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        cache.record(player, "fabric");
        for (int warmup = 0; warmup < 200_000; warmup++) cache.brand(player);

        int probe = 1_000_000;
        long allocated = site.vackstudio.vanticheat.physics.AllocationMeter.measure(() -> {
            for (int index = 0; index < probe; index++) cache.brand(player);
        });
        System.out.printf("[PERF] ClientBrandCache.brand: %d bytes over %d calls (precise=%s)%n",
                allocated, probe, site.vackstudio.vanticheat.physics.AllocationMeter.precise());
        if (allocated < 0) return; // no per-thread counter on this JVM
        assertEquals(0L, allocated,
                "the hot brand read must not allocate at all");
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.UUID;

class ClientPlatformServiceTest {
    @Test
    void floodgateBedrockIsAuthoritative() {

        var classification = service.classify(UUID.randomUUID());
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK, classification.state());
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.Reason.FLOODGATE, classification.reason());
    }

    @Test
    void geyserBedrockAndBothProviderAgreementAreReported() {

                service(false, false, true, true).classify(UUID.randomUUID()).state());

    }

    @Test

        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.NO_PROVIDER, noProvider.state());
        assertTrue(noProvider.canProbe());

        var pending = service(true, null, false, false).classify(UUID.randomUUID());
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.UNKNOWN, pending.state());
        assertFalse(pending.canProbe());

                service(true, null, false, false).readiness());
    }

    @Test

                new FakeProvider("GEYSER", false, false));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();

        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA, service.classify(id).state());
        floodgate.answer = true;
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA, service.classify(id).state(), "classification is cached");
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK, service.refresh(id).state());
        assertEquals(1, service.size());
        service.invalidate(id);
        assertEquals(0, service.size());
        service.classify(id);
        service.remove(id);
        assertEquals(0, service.size());
        service.classify(id);
        service.clear();
        assertEquals(0, service.size());
        assertEquals(0, service.count(ClientPlatformService.State.BEDROCK));
    }

    @Test

        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();

        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA, service.inspect(id).state());

        assertEquals(0, service.size());
        assertEquals(0, service.count(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA));
    }

    @Test
    void cachedProviderAndPlatformDiagnosticsDoNotRequeryProviders() {
        AtomicInteger calls = new AtomicInteger();
        FakeProvider floodgate = new FakeProvider("FLOODGATE", true, false) {
            @Override public boolean installed() { calls.incrementAndGet(); return super.installed(); }
            @Override public boolean ready() { calls.incrementAndGet(); return super.ready(); }
        };
        ClientPlatformService service = new ClientPlatformService(floodgate,
                new FakeProvider("GEYSER", false, false));
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();

        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA, service.refresh(id).state());
        assertEquals(1, service.count(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA));
        int providerCallsAfterClassification = calls.get();
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.ProviderState.READY,
                    service.providerSnapshot().floodgate());
            assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.Readiness.READY, service.readiness());
            assertEquals("FLOODGATE", service.providers());
            assertEquals(1, service.count(ClientPlatformService.State.JAVA));
        }
        assertEquals(providerCallsAfterClassification, calls.get());
    }

    @Test
    void providerDiagnosticsDistinguishNotReadyFromFailure() {
        ClientPlatformService notReady = new ClientPlatformService(
                new FakeProvider("FLOODGATE", true, null), new FakeProvider("GEYSER", false, null));
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.ProviderState.NOT_READY,
                notReady.providerSnapshot().floodgate());
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.ProviderState.NOT_PRESENT,
                notReady.providerSnapshot().geyser());

        ClientPlatformService failed = new ClientPlatformService(new FakeProvider("FLOODGATE", true, null) {
            @Override public ClientPlatformService.ProviderState status() {
                return ClientPlatformService.ProviderState.FAILED;
            }
        }, new FakeProvider("GEYSER", false, null));
        assertEquals(ClientPlatformService.ProviderState.FAILED,
                failed.providerSnapshot().floodgate());
```
