`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/platform/paper/ReliabilityInvariants.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper;

import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.CheckHacksClientDetectionModule;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ProbeDiagnostics;
import site.vackstudio.vanticheat.enforcement.EnforcementService;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/** Test-only global invariant checker. No production use. */
final class ReliabilityInvariants {
    private ReliabilityInvariants() { }

    static void assertTerminalState(String context,
                                    CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module,
                                    PaperSignProbeTransport transport,
                                    int coordinatorActive,
                                    int apolloTracked,
                                    int enforcementInFlight) {
        assertTerminalState(context, module, transport.activeOperations(),
                coordinatorActive, apolloTracked, enforcementInFlight);
    }

    static void assertTerminalState(String context,
                                    CheckHacksClientDetectionModule module,
                                    int transportActiveOps,
                                    int coordinatorActive,
                                    int apolloTracked,
                                    int enforcementInFlight) {
        ProbeDiagnostics.Snapshot snapshot = module.diagnostics();
        assertEquals(0, module.activeSessionCount(), context + ": no active session without an operation");
        assertEquals(0, transportActiveOps, context + ": no active transport operation");
        assertEquals(0, coordinatorActive, context + ": no automatic operation without coordinator ownership");
        assertEquals(0, snapshot.activeScans().size(), context + ": no failed operation remains active");
        assertEquals(0, apolloTracked, context + ": no pending Apollo action after shutdown");
        assertEquals(0, enforcementInFlight, context + ": no released operation with future enforcement");
        assertTrue(snapshot.recentScans().size() <= ProbeDiagnostics.RECENT_SCAN_LIMIT,
                context + ": history remains bounded");
    }

    static void assertEnforcementBounded(EnforcementService service) {
        assertTrue(service.retainedEnforcementKeyCount() <= EnforcementService.MAX_RETAINED_ENFORCEMENT_KEYS,
                "enforcement dedupe remains bounded");
        assertEquals(0, service.inFlightEnforcementCount(), "no enforcement reservation leaks");
    }

    /**
     * Cleanup outcome of one temporary sign operation. Restoration that the platform
     * actually performed, restoration that was attempted but refused, and cleanup that
     * could not be scheduled are distinct states and are asserted separately.
     */
    record CleanupOutcome(int restoreAttempts, int restores, int barrierRestores, int cleanupSchedules,
                          int callbackCount) {
        boolean restored() { return restores == 1 && barrierRestores == 1; }
        boolean attemptedButFailed() { return restoreAttempts == 1 && restores == 0; }
        boolean couldNotBeScheduled() { return cleanupSchedules == 0; }
    }

    /** After a terminal sign operation nothing may remain active or half-owned. */
    static void assertCleanupTerminal(String context, PaperSignProbeTransport transport, CleanupOutcome outcome) {
        assertEquals(0, transport.activeOperations(), context + ": terminal operation released");
        assertTrue(outcome.callbackCount() <= 1, context + ": response callback reported at most once");
        assertEquals(1, outcome.cleanupSchedules(), context + ": cleanup scheduled exactly once");
    }

    /** Successful cleanup must leave the world free of temporary state. */
    static void assertCleanupCompleted(String context, CleanupOutcome outcome) {
        assertCleanupTerminal(context, null, outcome);
        assertTrue(outcome.restored(), context + ": temporary sign and barrier restored exactly once");
    }

    /** An externally refused cleanup stays explicit and never reports success. */
    static void assertCleanupFailed(String context, CleanupOutcome outcome) {
        assertTrue(outcome.attemptedButFailed(),
                context + ": refused restoration is recorded as attempted but not completed");
        assertTrue(!outcome.restored(), context + ": a failed cleanup must never report success");
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/platform/paper/TerrainMaskEventRoundTripTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEvents;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEventsAPI;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.event.PacketSendEvent;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.injector.ChannelInjector;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.manager.player.PlayerManager;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.manager.protocol.ProtocolManager;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.manager.server.ServerManager;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.manager.server.ServerVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.netty.NettyManager;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.netty.buffer.ByteBufAllocationOperator;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.netty.buffer.ByteBufOperator;
import io.netty.buffer.ByteBuf;
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.ConnectionState;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTLongArray;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketType;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.packettype.PacketTypeCommon;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.User;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.UserProfile;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.BaseChunk;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.Column;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.LightData;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.impl.v_1_18.Chunk_v1_18;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.DataPalette;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.states.WrappedBlockState;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.settings.PacketEventsSettings;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.util.Vector3i;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerBlockChange;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerChunkData;
import io.netty.buffer.Unpooled;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.lang.reflect.Constructor;
import java.util.BitSet;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Reproduces the exact listener decode path: bytes on the wire become a send event, and the
 * event-constructed wrapper must already be decoded. An extra {@code read()} over-reads the
 * exhausted buffer and fails every chunk on a real server.
 */
class TerrainMaskEventRoundTripTest {
    private static final ClientVersion VERSION = ClientVersion.V_1_21_11;
    private static final ServerVersion SERVER = ServerVersion.V_1_21_11;

    @BeforeAll
    static void installMappingResourceProvider() {
        TerrainMaskTestBuffers.installApi();
    }

    @Test
    void chunkEventConstructionDecodesWithoutAnExtraRead() throws Exception {
        Column column = column();
        LightData light = light();
        Object bytes = encodeChunk(column, light);

        WrapperPlayServerChunkData decoded = new WrapperPlayServerChunkData(sendEvent(
                PacketType.Play.Server.CHUNK_DATA, bytes));

        assertEquals(0, decoded.getColumn().getX());
        assertEquals(2, decoded.getColumn().getChunks().length);
        assertEquals(7, block(decoded.getColumn(), -9));
        assertEquals(9, block(decoded.getColumn(), 3));
        assertNotNull(decoded.getLightData());
        assertEquals(1, decoded.getLightData().getBlockLightCount());
        assertTrue(decoded.getColumn().getHeightMaps().getTagNames().contains("WORLD_SURFACE"));
        assertThrows(IndexOutOfBoundsException.class, decoded::read,
                "the event constructor already consumed the buffer; a second read must fail, "
                        + "so handlers must never call read() after event construction");
    }

    @Test
    void blockChangeEventConstructionDecodesWithoutAnExtraRead() throws Exception {        WrappedBlockState.ensureLoad();
        int stone = TerrainMaskStateResolver.resolve(VERSION, "STONE").getGlobalId();
        WrapperPlayServerBlockChange writer =
                new WrapperPlayServerBlockChange(new Vector3i(9, -9, 9), stone);
        writer.setClientVersion(VERSION);
        writer.setServerVersion(SERVER);
        Object bytes = Unpooled.buffer();
        writer.setBuffer(bytes);
        writer.write();

        WrapperPlayServerBlockChange decoded = new WrapperPlayServerBlockChange(sendEvent(
                PacketType.Play.Server.BLOCK_CHANGE, bytes));

        assertEquals(new Vector3i(9, -9, 9), decoded.getBlockPosition());
        assertEquals(stone, decoded.getBlockState().getGlobalId());
    }

    @Test
    void spawnEventConstructionDecodesPositionWithoutAnExtraRead() throws Exception {
        com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity writer =
                new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity(
                        7, java.util.Optional.of(UUID.randomUUID()),
                        com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.entity.type.EntityTypes.ARMOR_STAND,
                        new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.util.Vector3d(9.5, -8.0, 9.5),
                        0f, 0f, 0f, 0, java.util.Optional.empty());
        writer.setClientVersion(VERSION);
        writer.setServerVersion(SERVER);
        Object bytes = Unpooled.buffer();
        writer.setBuffer(bytes);
        writer.write();

        com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity decoded =
                new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerSpawnEntity(
                        sendEvent(PacketType.Play.Server.SPAWN_ENTITY, bytes));

        assertEquals(9.5, decoded.getPosition().getX());
        assertEquals(-8.0, decoded.getPosition().getY());
        assertEquals(9.5, decoded.getPosition().getZ());
        assertThrows(IndexOutOfBoundsException.class, decoded::read,
                "the event constructor already consumed the buffer; a second read must fail, "
                        + "so handlers must never call read() after event construction");
    }

    private static Object encodeChunk(Column column, LightData light) {
        WrapperPlayServerChunkData writer = new WrapperPlayServerChunkData(column, light);
        writer.setClientVersion(VERSION);
        writer.setServerVersion(SERVER);
        Object bytes = Unpooled.buffer();
        writer.setBuffer(bytes);
        writer.write();
        return bytes;
    }

    private static PacketSendEvent sendEvent(PacketTypeCommon type, Object bytes) throws Exception {
        Constructor<PacketSendEvent> constructor = PacketSendEvent.class.getDeclaredConstructor(
                int.class, PacketTypeCommon.class, ServerVersion.class,
                Object.class, User.class, Object.class, Object.class);
        constructor.setAccessible(true);
        User user = new User(null, ConnectionState.PLAY, VERSION,
                new UserProfile(UUID.randomUUID(), "P37"));
        // The 1.17+ section count comes from the dimension height supplied by the login flow.
        user.setDimensionType(dimension(32));
        return constructor.newInstance(type.getId(VERSION), type, SERVER, null, user, null, bytes);
    }

    private static com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.dimension.DimensionType dimension(int height) {
        return (com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.dimension.DimensionType)
                java.lang.reflect.Proxy.newProxyInstance(
                        TerrainMaskEventRoundTripTest.class.getClassLoader(),
                        new Class<?>[]{
                                com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.dimension.DimensionType.class},
                        (proxy, method, args) -> {
                            if (method.getName().equals("getHeight")) return height;
                            if (method.getName().equals("hasSkyLight")) return true;
                            if (method.getName().equals("toString")) return "TestDimension";
                            if (method.getName().equals("hashCode")) return 1;
                            if (method.getName().equals("equals")) return proxy == args[0];
                            Class<?> type = method.getReturnType();
                            if (type == boolean.class) return false;
                            if (type == int.class) return 0;
                            if (type == long.class) return 0L;
                            if (type == double.class) return 0.0;
                            if (type == float.class) return 0.0f;
                            if (type == void.class) return null;
                            return null;
                        });
    }

    private static Column column() {
        BaseChunk[] sections = new BaseChunk[2];
        for (int index = 0; index < sections.length; index++) {
            Chunk_v1_18 section = new Chunk_v1_18(VERSION, 0, DataPalette.createForChunk(),
                    DataPalette.createForBiome());
            for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) {
                for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) section.getChunkData().set(x, y, z, 0);
                }
            }
            section.setBlockCount(0);
            sections[index] = section;
        }
        Column column = new Column(0, 0, true, sections,
                new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[0],
                heightmaps());
        set(column, -9, 7);
        set(column, 3, 9);
        return column;
    }

    private static java.util.Map<com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.HeightmapType, long[]>
    heightmaps() {
        int bits = 32 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(32);
        int perLong = Long.SIZE / bits;
        java.util.Map<com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.HeightmapType, long[]> map =
                new java.util.HashMap<>();
        map.put(com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.HeightmapType.WORLD_SURFACE,
                new long[(256 + perLong - 1) / perLong]);
        return map;
    }

    private static void set(Column column, int worldY, int stateId) {
        int sectionIndex = (worldY + 16) >> 4;
        Chunk_v1_18 section = (Chunk_v1_18) column.getChunks()[sectionIndex];
        section.getChunkData().set(0, worldY & 15, 0, stateId);
        section.setBlockCount(section.getBlockCount() + 1);
    }

    private static int block(Column column, int worldY) {
        int sectionIndex = (worldY + 16) >> 4;
        return column.getChunks()[sectionIndex].getBlockId(0, worldY & 15, 0);
    }

    private static LightData light() {
        byte[] section = new byte[2048];
        java.util.Arrays.fill(section, (byte) 0xFF);
        BitSet mask = new BitSet();
        mask.set(1);
        return new LightData(true, mask, new BitSet(), new BitSet(), new BitSet(),
                0, 1, new byte[0][], new byte[][]{section});
    }
}
```

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.paper;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.List;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class VAntiCheatCommandTest {
    @Test
    void parsesCommaSeparatedProbeIds() {
        assertEquals(List.of("meteor-client", "freecam", "xaeros-minimap"),
                VAntiCheatCommand.splitProbeIds("meteor-client, freecam,xaeros-minimap,meteor-client"));
    }

    @Test
    void ignoresEmptyProbeIds() {
        assertEquals(List.of("freecam"), VAntiCheatCommand.splitProbeIds(", freecam, "));
    }

    @Test
    void tabCompletionMatchesCaseInsensitively() {
        assertEquals(List.of("meteor-client"), VAntiCheatCommand.matching(
                List.of("freecam", "meteor-client"), "MET"));
    }

    @Test
    void permissionGateAllowsConsoleAndRejectsUnauthorizedPlayers() {
        assertTrue(VAntiCheatCommand.authorized(false, false), "console is not permission-gated");
        assertTrue(VAntiCheatCommand.authorized(true, true));
        assertFalse(VAntiCheatCommand.authorized(true, false));
    }
```

```java
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

/**
 * Slice 1 / spec section 21 regression suite.
 *
 * <p>The invariant under test throughout is that the protection layer bounds cost while
 * producing no detection. Every refusal must be countable, bounded, and incapable of turning
 * into a verdict.
 */
class EmergencyProtectionRegressionTest {
    private static final String CHANNEL = "jade:client_handshake";
    private static final String DETECTOR = "jade-network-handshake";

    /** Deterministic clock so windows and TTLs are testable without sleeping. */
    private static final class Clock {
        private final AtomicLong now = new AtomicLong(1_000_000L);
        long get() { return now.get(); }
        void advanceMillis(long millis) { now.addAndGet(millis); }
    }

    private static SecurityLimits limits(int playerRate, int globalRate, int channelRate,
                                         int perPlayer, int globalChallenges) {
        return new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, playerRate, globalRate, channelRate,
                perPlayer, globalChallenges, 512, 8, 4096,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10), 3,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15));
    }

    private static SecurityLimits limitsWithStaging(int stagedPlayers, int stagedSignals) {
        return new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, 1000, 100_000, 1000, 2, 256,
                stagedPlayers, stagedSignals, 4096,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10), 3,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15));
    }

    private EmergencyProtection guard(SecurityLimits limits, Clock clock) {
        return new EmergencyProtection(limits, Set.of(CHANNEL), clock::get);
    }

    // ===================================================== flood

    @Test
    void floodFromOnePlayerIsRateLimitedAfterTheWindowAllowance() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(5, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();

        int admitted = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < 200; index++) {
            if (guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted()) admitted++;
        }
        assertEquals(5, admitted, "exactly the window allowance may pass");
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().playerRateLimited() >= 195,
                "the rest must be counted as rate limited");
    }

    @Test
    void rateLimitNeverLeaksBetweenPlayers() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(2, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        UUID loud = UUID.randomUUID();
        UUID quiet = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object loudConnection = new Object();
        Object quietConnection = new Object();

        assertTrue(guard.admit(loud, loudConnection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        assertTrue(guard.admit(loud, loudConnection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        assertFalse(guard.admit(loud, loudConnection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());

        // One abusive player must not throttle an unrelated one.
        assertTrue(guard.admit(quiet, quietConnection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        assertTrue(guard.admit(quiet, quietConnection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
    }

    @Test
    void globalWindowStopsCoordinatedFloodAcrossManyPlayers() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(100, 10, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        int admitted = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < 500; index++) {
            if (guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted()) {
                admitted++;
            }
        }
        assertEquals(10, admitted, "the global window bounds total admitted work");
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().globalRateLimited() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void perChannelWindowThrottlesOneChannelWithoutStarvingAnother() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        String other = "other:channel";
        EmergencyProtection guard = new EmergencyProtection(limits(1000, 10_000, 3, 2, 64),
                Set.of(CHANNEL, other), clock::get);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();

        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) {
            assertTrue(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        }
        ProtectionOutcome refused = guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(refused.admitted());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.RATE_LIMITED_CHANNEL, refused.reason());
        assertTrue(guard.admit(player, connection, other, 8, DETECTOR).admitted(),
                "a different declared channel must remain available");
    }

    @Test
    void windowReopensAfterOneSecond() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1, 100, 100, 2, 64), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();
        assertTrue(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        assertFalse(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        clock.advanceMillis(1001);
        assertTrue(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted(),
                "the window must reopen so throttling is not a permanent lockout");
    }

    // ===================================================== oversized payloads

    @Test
    void oversizedPayloadIsRefusedBeforeAnyParse() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        ProtectionOutcome outcome = guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL,
                1 << 20, DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(outcome.admitted());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, outcome.reason());
        assertEquals(1, guard.metrics().snapshot().payloadsOversized());
    }

    @Test
    void negativePayloadLengthIsTreatedAsOversized() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        ProtectionOutcome outcome = guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, -1, DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(outcome.admitted());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, outcome.reason());
    }

    @Test
    void payloadExactlyAtTheCapIsAccepted() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64);
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        assertTrue(guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL,
                limits.maxPayloadBytes(), DETECTOR).admitted());
    }

    @Test
    void channelCapCanBeStricterThanTheGlobalPayloadCap() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = new SecurityLimits(4096, 16, 1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64, 512, 8,
                4096, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10), 3,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15));
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        assertTrue(guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 16, DETECTOR).admitted());
        assertFalse(guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 17, DETECTOR).admitted());
    }

    // ===================================================== malformed input

    @Test
    void throwingParserIsReportedMalformedAndNeverEscapes() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        EmergencyProtection.ParserResult<String> result = guard.guardParse(CHANNEL, bytes -> {
            throw new IllegalStateException("malformed payload");
        });
        assertFalse(result.ok());
        assertNull(result.value());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.MALFORMED, result.outcome().reason());
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().inputFailed() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void undeclaredChannelIsRefusedAndCounted() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        ProtectionOutcome outcome = guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), "not:declared", 1,
                DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(outcome.admitted());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.UNDECLARED_CHANNEL, outcome.reason());
    }

    @Test
    void missingConnectionContextIsRefused() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.NO_CONNECTION,
                guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), null, CHANNEL, 1, DETECTOR).reason());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.NO_CONNECTION,
                guard.admit(null, new Object(), CHANNEL, 1, DETECTOR).reason());
    }

    @Test
    void nullChannelNeverThrows() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        ProtectionOutcome outcome = guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), null, 1, DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(outcome.admitted());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.UNDECLARED_CHANNEL, outcome.reason());
    }

    // ===================================================== challenge limits

    @Test
    void perPlayerChallengeCeilingIsEnforced() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 256), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        assertNotNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR));
        assertNotNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR));
        assertNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR),
                "the third challenge must be refused");
        assertEquals(1, guard.metrics().snapshot().challengesRejectedPerPlayer());
        assertEquals(2, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal(),
                "exactly the two admitted challenges hold budget");
    }

    @Test
    void globalChallengeCeilingIsEnforcedAcrossPlayers() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 8, 4), clock);
        int issued = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < 50; index++) {
            if (guard.challenges().issueOrNull(UUID.randomUUID(), 1L, DETECTOR) != null) issued++;
        }
        assertEquals(4, issued, "the global ceiling bounds the whole server");
        assertEquals(4, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal());
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().challengesRejectedGlobal() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void challengeTokenIsRandomAndSingleUse() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 8, 256), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();

        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge first = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 7L, DETECTOR);
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge second = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 7L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(first);
        assertNotNull(second);
        assertFalse(first.token().equals(second.token()), "tokens must not repeat");
        assertEquals(32, first.token().length());

        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.MATCHED,
                guard.challenges().consume(first.token(), player, 7L));
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.UNKNOWN_TOKEN,
                guard.challenges().consume(first.token(), player, 7L),
                "a consumed token must never match twice, and must not reveal that it existed");
    }

    @Test
    void replayedResponseAgainstAFreshChallengeIsRejected() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 8, 256), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge first = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(first);
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.MATCHED,
                guard.challenges().consume(first.token(), player, 1L));

        // The attacker replays the same answer against a new challenge.
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge second = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(second);
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.UNKNOWN_TOKEN,
                guard.challenges().consume(first.token(), player, 1L),
                "a captured answer cannot satisfy a different challenge");
    }

    @Test
    void unknownAndForeignTokensAreRejectedWithoutConsumingTheRealOne() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 8, 256), clock);
        UUID owner = UUID.randomUUID();
        UUID attacker = UUID.randomUUID();
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge challenge = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(owner, 3L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(challenge);

        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.UNKNOWN_TOKEN,
                guard.challenges().consume("deadbeef", owner, 3L));
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.WRONG_PLAYER,
                guard.challenges().consume(challenge.token(), attacker, 3L));
        // The genuine owner must still be able to answer.
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.MATCHED,
                guard.challenges().consume(challenge.token(), owner, 3L));
    }

    @Test
    void responseFromAnotherConnectionIsRejected() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 8, 256), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge challenge = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 11L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(challenge);
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.WRONG_PLAYER,
                guard.challenges().consume(challenge.token(), player, 12L),
                "a reconnect must not be able to answer the previous connection's challenge");
    }

    // ===================================================== TTL cleanup

    @Test
    void expiredChallengeReleasesItsBudgetAndNeverMatches() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 1, 64);
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge challenge = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(challenge);
        assertEquals(1, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal());

        clock.advanceMillis(limits.challengeTtl().toMillis() + 1);
        assertEquals(ChallengeRegistry.Consume.EXPIRED,
                guard.challenges().consume(challenge.token(), player, 1L),
                "a timeout must never be treated as a match");
        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal());
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().challengesExpired() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void sweepExpiresAbandonedChallengesAndFreesGlobalBudget() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 1, 2);
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 2; index++) {
            assertNotNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(UUID.randomUUID(), 1L, DETECTOR));
        }
        assertNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(UUID.randomUUID(), 1L, DETECTOR));
        clock.advanceMillis(limits.challengeTtl().toMillis() + 1);
        assertEquals(2, guard.challenges().sweep());
        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal());
        assertNotNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(UUID.randomUUID(), 1L, DETECTOR),
                "an expired challenge must return its budget");
    }

    // ===================================================== reconnect

    @Test
    void reconnectRetiresTheOldConnectionChallenges() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 4, 256), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        assertNotNull(guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR));
        assertEquals(1, guard.challenges().outstandingFor(player));

        guard.forgetConnection(player, new Object());
        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingFor(player),
                "disconnect must release every per-player challenge");
        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal());
    }

    @Test
    void disconnectClearsTheRateWindowSoARejoinIsNotPunished() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1, 100, 100, 2, 64), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();
        assertTrue(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());
        assertFalse(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted());

        guard.forgetConnection(player, connection);
        Object reconnected = new Object();
        assertTrue(guard.admit(player, reconnected, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted(),
                "a reconnecting legitimate player must not inherit a throttle");
    }

    // ===================================================== circuit breaker

    @Test
    void circuitOpensAfterTheFailureThresholdAndSuspendsThePath() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();

        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR));
        for (int index = 0; index < 2; index++) guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR), "below the threshold nothing is suspended");

        guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR));
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.OPEN, guard.breakers().stateOf(DETECTOR));
        assertEquals(1, guard.metrics().snapshot().circuitTrips());
    }

    @Test
    void openCircuitRefusesThePayloadWithoutAnyVerdict() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        ProtectionOutcome outcome = guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(outcome.admitted());
        assertEquals(ProtectionOutcome.Reason.CIRCUIT_OPEN, outcome.reason());
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().circuitProbesSuppressed() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void circuitAllowsOneHalfOpenProbeThenClosesOnSuccess() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);

        clock.advanceMillis(31_000);
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR), "after the cooldown one trial is allowed");
        assertFalse(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR), "the half-open allowance is finite");

        guard.recordDetectorSuccess(DETECTOR);
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.ALLOW, guard.breakers().stateOf(DETECTOR));
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR));
    }

    @Test
    void failedHalfOpenProbeReopensImmediately() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        clock.advanceMillis(31_000);
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR));
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.OPEN, guard.breakers().stateOf(DETECTOR));
    }

    @Test
    void circuitFailureBudgetResetsAfterConfiguredIdleDelay() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, 1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64,
                512, 8, 4096, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10),
                3, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);

        guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        assertEquals(2, guard.breakers().failuresOf(DETECTOR));
        clock.advanceMillis(10_001);
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);

        assertEquals(1, guard.breakers().failuresOf(DETECTOR),
                "a quiet detector path must receive a fresh failure budget");
        assertEquals(DetectorCircuitBreaker.State.ALLOW, guard.breakers().stateOf(DETECTOR));
    }

    @Test
    void breakersAreIsolatedPerDetector() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 3; index++) guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);
        assertFalse(guard.breakers().allow(DETECTOR));
        assertTrue(guard.breakers().allow("other-probe"),
                "one broken path must not disable an unrelated one");
    }

    // ===================================================== reload

    @Test
    void reloadResetsEveryRuntimeTable() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 4, 64), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        Object connection = new Object();
        for (int index = 0; index < 10; index++) {
            guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR);
        }
        guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR);
        guard.recordDetectorFailure(DETECTOR);

        guard.reset();

        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal());
        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingPlayers());
        assertEquals(0, guard.rateLimiter().trackedPlayerKeys());
        assertEquals(0, guard.breakers().trackedDetectors());
        assertTrue(guard.admit(player, connection, CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted(),
                "after a reload the fresh limits govern immediately");
    }

    @Test
    void resetKeepsTheConfiguredLimits() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = limits(1, 100, 100, 1, 8);
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        guard.reset();
        assertEquals(1, guard.limits().playerMessagesPerSecond());
        assertEquals(1, guard.limits().maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer());
    }

    // ===================================================== concurrency

    @Test
    void manySimultaneousPlayersNeverExceedTheGlobalWindow() throws Exception {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        int threads = 16;
        int perThread = 500;
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(10_000, 1000, 10_000, 8, 100_000), clock);
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        CountDownLatch done = new CountDownLatch(threads);
        AtomicInteger admitted = new AtomicInteger();

        for (int thread = 0; thread < threads; thread++) {
            pool.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    start.await();
                    for (int index = 0; index < perThread; index++) {
                        if (guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR).admitted()) {
                            admitted.incrementAndGet();
                        }
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                } finally {
                    done.countDown();
                }
            });
        }
        start.countDown();
        assertTrue(done.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        pool.shutdownNow();

        assertEquals(1000, admitted.get(),
                "the global ceiling must hold exactly under concurrency");
    }

    @Test
    void concurrentConsumeAdmitsExactlyOneWinner() throws Exception {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(10_000, 100_000, 10_000, 8, 1000), clock);
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        ChallengeRegistry.Challenge challenge = guard.challenges().issueOrNull(player, 1L, DETECTOR);
        assertNotNull(challenge);

        int threads = 24;
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        CountDownLatch done = new CountDownLatch(threads);
        AtomicInteger matched = new AtomicInteger();
        for (int thread = 0; thread < threads; thread++) {
            pool.execute(() -> {
                try {
                    start.await();
                    if (guard.challenges().consume(challenge.token(), player, 1L)
                            == ChallengeRegistry.Consume.MATCHED) {
                        matched.incrementAndGet();
                    }
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                } finally {
                    done.countDown();
                }
            });
        }
        start.countDown();
        assertTrue(done.await(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        pool.shutdownNow();

        assertEquals(1, matched.get(), "a single-use token must have exactly one winner");
        assertEquals(0, guard.challenges().outstandingGlobal(), "budget is released exactly once");
    }

    @Test
    void stagingOverflowIsBoundedAndCounted() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limitsWithStaging(16, 2), clock);
        site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ClientSignalCollector collector =
                new site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ClientSignalCollector(
                        java.util.Map.of(CHANNEL, DETECTOR), clock::get);
        collector.setProtection(guard);

        // No connection context yet, so every observation is staged and must hit a ceiling.
        int players = 200;
        for (int index = 0; index < players; index++) {
            UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
            for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt++) {
                collector.observe(player, new Object(), CHANNEL, DETECTOR, 8,
                        site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
            }
        }
        assertTrue(collector.stagedPlayers() <= 16,
                "staged players must stay within the configured ceiling: "
                        + collector.stagedPlayers());
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().stagingOverflow() > 0,
                "staging overflow must be visible to an operator");
    }

    @Test
    void staleStagedSignalsExpireAndFreeTheirState() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, 1000, 100_000, 1000, 2, 64,
                512, 8, 4096, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(1), 3,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15));
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ClientSignalCollector collector =
                new site.vackstudio.vanticheat.detection.probe.ClientSignalCollector(
                        java.util.Map.of(CHANNEL, DETECTOR), clock::get);
        collector.setProtection(guard);

        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        collector.observe(player, new Object(), CHANNEL, DETECTOR, 8,
                site.vackstudio.vanticheat.platform.ClientPlatform.JAVA, "fabric");
        assertTrue(collector.hasStaged(player, DETECTOR));

        clock.advanceMillis(limits.stagingTtl().toMillis() + 1);
        int swept = collector.sweepStaged();
        assertEquals(1, swept);
        assertEquals(0, collector.stagedPlayers());
        assertFalse(collector.hasStaged(player, DETECTOR));
    }

    // ===================================================== Folia boundary

    @Test
    void protectionLayerHoldsNoBukkitOrWorldState() {
        // Folia boundary: the protection layer must not capture a World, Player, Region, or
        // Scheduler, because it runs on whichever region or entity thread delivered the packet.
        assertNoBukkitState(EmergencyProtection.class);
        assertNoBukkitState(DetectionRateLimiter.class);
        assertNoBukkitState(ChallengeRegistry.class);
        assertNoBukkitState(DetectorCircuitBreaker.class);
        assertNoBukkitState(ProtectionMetrics.class);
    }

    private static void assertNoBukkitState(Class<?> type) {
        for (java.lang.reflect.Field field : type.getDeclaredFields()) {
            assertFalse(field.getType().getName().startsWith("org.bukkit"),
                    type.getSimpleName() + " must not hold Bukkit state: " + field.getName());
        }
        for (java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> constructor : type.getDeclaredConstructors()) {
            for (Class<?> parameter : constructor.getParameterTypes()) {
                assertFalse(parameter.getName().startsWith("org.bukkit"),
                        type.getSimpleName() + " must not accept Bukkit state");
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    void protectionLayerPerformsNoBlockingIo() throws java.io.IOException {
        // A blocking call here would run on a region thread and stall a Folia region.
        String source = java.nio.file.Files.readString(java.nio.file.Path.of(
                "src/main/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/protection/EmergencyProtection.java"));
        for (String forbidden : new String[]{"Files.", "new File", "FileInputStream",
                "readAllBytes", "Thread.sleep", ".join()", "getLogger()"}) {
            assertFalse(source.contains(forbidden),
                    "protection layer must not block: found " + forbidden);
        }
    }

    // ===================================================== limit hardening

    @Test
    void anAbsurdlyShortChallengeTtlIsClampedRatherThanTrusted() {
        // 250ms would let a legitimate client on a 200ms RTT time out constantly, so the
        // clamp keeps the challenge window usable instead of trusting a hand-edited value.
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(java.util.Map.of(),
                java.util.Map.of("challenge-ttl", "250ms"));
        assertEquals(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(1), limits.challengeTtl());
    }

    @Test
    void zeroOrNegativeLimitsCannotDisableProtection() {
        SecurityLimits limits = new SecurityLimits(0, -5, 0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0,
                java.time.Duration.ZERO, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(-9),
                0, java.time.Duration.ZERO, 0, java.time.Duration.ZERO);
        assertTrue(limits.maxPayloadBytes() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.playerMessagesPerSecond() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.globalMessagesPerSecond() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxConcurrentChallengesPerPlayer() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxConcurrentChallengesGlobal() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxStagedPlayers() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.maxStagedSignalsPerPlayer() > 0);
        assertFalse(limits.challengeTtl().isZero() || limits.challengeTtl().isNegative());
        assertFalse(limits.stagingTtl().isZero() || limits.stagingTtl().isNegative());
        assertTrue(limits.circuitFailureThreshold() > 0);
        assertTrue(limits.circuitHalfOpenProbes() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void malformedProtectionBlockFallsBackToSafeDefaults() {
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(java.util.Map.of(),
                java.util.Map.of("max-payload-bytes", "abc", "challenge-ttl", "?"));
        assertEquals(SecurityLimits.DEFAULTS.maxPayloadBytes(), limits.maxPayloadBytes());
        assertTrue(limits.playerMessagesPerSecond() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void durationStringsAreParsed() {
        SecurityLimits limits = SecurityLimits.from(java.util.Map.of(), java.util.Map.of(
                "challenge-ttl", "3s", "staging-ttl", "3m", "circuit-cooldown", "45s"));
        assertEquals(3000, limits.challengeTtl().toMillis());
        assertEquals(java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(3), limits.stagingTtl());
        assertEquals(java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(45), limits.circuitCooldown());
    }

    @Test
    void rateKeyTableIsBounded() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        SecurityLimits limits = new SecurityLimits(4096, 4096, 1000, 100_000, 1000, 2, 64, 512, 8,
                64, java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(15), java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(10), 3,
                java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(30), 1, java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(15));
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits, clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 5000; index++) {
            guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 8, DETECTOR);
        }
        assertTrue(guard.rateLimiter().trackedPlayerKeys() <= 64,
                "the rate key table must stay bounded: " + guard.rateLimiter().trackedPlayerKeys());
        assertTrue(guard.metrics().snapshot().rateKeysEvicted() > 0);
    }

    @Test
    void metricsDescribeCoversEveryDiagnosticTheSpecRequires() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1, 1, 1, 1, 1), clock);
        guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 1, DETECTOR);
        guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 1, DETECTOR);
        guard.admit(UUID.randomUUID(), new Object(), CHANNEL, 1 << 20, DETECTOR);
        guard.challenges().issueOrNull(UUID.randomUUID(), 1L, DETECTOR);
        String described = guard.describe();
        for (String required : new String[]{"oversized", "playerRateLimited", "channelRateLimited",
                "globalRateLimited", "circuitTrips", "challengeRejectedPlayer",
                "challengeRejectedGlobal", "challengeExpired", "challengeReplayed",
                "challengeDuplicate", "stagingOverflow", "stagingExpired", "inputRejected"}) {
            assertTrue(described.contains(required), "diagnostics must expose " + required);
        }
    }

    @Test
    void noProtectionOutcomeCanEverExpressDetection() {
        // Structural guarantee: the type has no verdict-shaped member at all.
        for (ProtectionOutcome.Reason reason : ProtectionOutcome.Reason.values()) {
            assertFalse(reason.name().contains("DETECTED"), "reason " + reason + " implies detection");
            assertFalse(reason.name().contains("CHEAT"), "reason " + reason + " implies cheating");
            assertFalse(reason.name().contains("VIOLATION"), "reason " + reason + " implies a verdict");
            assertFalse(reason.name().contains("KICK"), "reason " + reason + " implies enforcement");
        }
    }

    @Test
    void detectorContractSurfaceStaysSmallAndBounded() {
        Clock clock = new Clock();
        EmergencyProtection guard = guard(limits(1000, 10_000, 1000, 2, 64), clock);
        for (int index = 0; index < 1000; index++) {
            guard.recordDetectorFailure("probe-" + index);
        }
        assertEquals(1000, guard.breakers().trackedDetectors(),
                "breaker state is bounded by the configured detector count");
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainChunkPayloadTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.BaseChunk;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.Column;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.LightData;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.impl.v_1_18.Chunk_v1_18;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.DataPalette;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTLongArray;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.BitSet;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.UUID;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotSame;

class TerrainChunkPayloadTest {
    private static final ClientVersion VERSION = ClientVersion.V_1_21_11;
    private static final int AIR = 0;
    private static final int CAVE_AIR = 3;
    private static final int VOID_AIR = 4;
    private static final int STONE = 1;
    private static final int DEEPSLATE = 2;
    private static final Set<Integer> AIR_STATES = Set.of(AIR, CAVE_AIR, VOID_AIR);

    @Test
    void renderMasksCachedTerrainAndLightButKeepsTheRealSnapshotForReveal() {
        Column real = column();
        set(real, -9, STONE);
        LightData originalLight = light();
        TerrainChunkPayload payload = new TerrainChunkPayload(real, originalLight);

        TerrainChunkPayload.RenderedChunk hidden = payload.render(view(true), VERSION, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);
        TerrainChunkPayload.RenderedChunk revealed = payload.render(view(false), VERSION, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(hidden.column(), -9));
        assertEquals(0, nibble(hidden.lightData().getBlockLightArray()[0], 0));
        assertEquals(15, nibble(hidden.lightData().getBlockLightArray()[0], 8 << 8));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(revealed.column(), -9));
        assertEquals(15, nibble(revealed.lightData().getBlockLightArray()[0], 0));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(real, -9), "rendering must not mutate cached real terrain");
        assertNotSame(real.getChunks()[0], hidden.column().getChunks()[0]);
    }

    @Test
    void renderSanitizesLightEvenWhenAirIsIntentionallyNotReplaced() {
        Column real = column();
        TerrainChunkPayload payload = new TerrainChunkPayload(real, light());

        TerrainChunkPayload.RenderedChunk hidden = payload.render(view(true, false, true), VERSION,
                DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);

        assertEquals(AIR, block(hidden.column(), -9));
        assertEquals(0, nibble(hidden.lightData().getBlockLightArray()[0], 0));
        assertEquals(15, nibble(hidden.lightData().getBlockLightArray()[0], 8 << 8));
    }

    @Test
    void hiddenBlockEntityUpdatesAreNotIncludedInMaskedReplay() {
        TerrainChunkPayload payload = new TerrainChunkPayload(column(), light());
        payload.recordBlockEntity(new TerrainChunkPayload.BlockEntityUpdate(0, -9, 0, 1, null));
        payload.recordBlockEntity(new TerrainChunkPayload.BlockEntityUpdate(0, -8, 0, 1, null));

        var hidden = payload.render(view(true), VERSION, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);
        var revealed = payload.render(view(false), VERSION, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);

        assertEquals(1, hidden.blockEntityUpdates().size());
        assertEquals(-8, hidden.blockEntityUpdates().getFirst().y());
        assertEquals(2, revealed.blockEntityUpdates().size());
    }

    @Test
    void cachedBlockUpdatesKeepSectionNonAirCountCorrectForAllAirVariants() {
        Column real = column();
        TerrainChunkPayload payload = new TerrainChunkPayload(real, light());
        Chunk_v1_18 section = (Chunk_v1_18) real.getChunks()[0];

        payload.updateBlock(0, -1, 0, CAVE_AIR, AIR_STATES, -16);
        assertEquals(0, section.getBlockCount());
        payload.updateBlock(0, -1, 0, STONE, AIR_STATES, -16);
        assertEquals(1, section.getBlockCount());
        payload.updateBlock(0, -1, 0, CAVE_AIR, AIR_STATES, -16);
        assertEquals(0, section.getBlockCount());
    }

    @Test
    void laterRealBlockUpdatesRemainMaskedForAAndAreRestoredForB() {
        Column real = column();
        TerrainChunkPayload payload = new TerrainChunkPayload(real, light());
        payload.updateBlock(0, -9, 0, STONE, AIR_STATES, -16);

        var masked = payload.render(view(true), VERSION, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);
        var revealed = payload.render(view(false), VERSION, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES);

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(masked.column(), -9));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(revealed.column(), -9));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(real, -9), "the real cached snapshot receives the server update");
    }

    private static TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view(boolean masked) {
        return view(masked, true, true);
    }

    private static TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view(boolean masked, boolean hideAir, boolean hideBlockEntities) {
        UUID player = UUID.randomUUID();
        return new TerrainMaskService.PlayerView(player, UUID.randomUUID(), UUID.randomUUID(), "world",
                -16, 16, masked ? 6 : 5, true, masked, -8, 5, "DEEPSLATE", hideAir,
                hideBlockEntities, true, false);
    }

    private static Column column() {
        Chunk_v1_18 section = new Chunk_v1_18(VERSION, 0, DataPalette.createForChunk(),
                DataPalette.createForBiome());
        for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) {
            for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) section.getChunkData().set(x, y, z, AIR);
            }
        }
        section.setBlockCount(0);
        Column column = new Column(0, 0, true, new BaseChunk[]{section},
                new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[0], java.util.Map.of());
        int bits = 32 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(16);
        int perLong = Long.SIZE / bits;
        int length = (256 + perLong - 1) / perLong;
        column.getHeightMaps().setTag("WORLD_SURFACE", new NBTLongArray(new long[length]));
        return column;
    }

    private static void set(Column column, int worldY, int stateId) {
        Chunk_v1_18 section = (Chunk_v1_18) column.getChunks()[0];
        int localY = Math.floorMod(worldY, 16);
        section.getChunkData().set(0, localY, 0, stateId);
        section.setBlockCount(1);
    }

    private static int block(Column column, int worldY) {
        return column.getChunks()[0].getBlockId(0, Math.floorMod(worldY, 16), 0);
    }

    private static LightData light() {
        byte[] section = new byte[2048];
        java.util.Arrays.fill(section, (byte) 0xFF);
        BitSet mask = new BitSet();
        mask.set(1);
        return new LightData(true, mask, new BitSet(), new BitSet(), new BitSet(),
                0, 1, new byte[0][], new byte[][]{section});
    }

    private static int nibble(byte[] array, int index) {
        int value = array[index >>> 1] & 0xFF;
        return (index & 1) == 0 ? value & 0xF : value >>> 4 & 0xF;
    }

}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainChunkRewriterTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.player.ClientVersion;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.BaseChunk;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.Column;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.impl.v_1_18.Chunk_v1_18;
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.nbt.NBTLongArray;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.Set;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotSame;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;

class TerrainChunkRewriterTest {
    private static final ClientVersion VERSION = ClientVersion.V_1_21_11;
    private static final int AIR = 0;
    private static final int CAVE_AIR = 3;
    private static final int VOID_AIR = 4;
    private static final int STONE = 1;
    private static final int DEEPSLATE = 2;
    private static final Set<Integer> AIR_STATES = Set.of(AIR, CAVE_AIR, VOID_AIR);

    @Test
    void solidBlocksBelowZeroBecomeFakeAndVisibleBlocksStayReal() {
        Column source = column(-16, 2);
        set(source, -1, STONE);
        set(source, 0, STONE);

        Column masked = rewrite(source, 0, true).column();

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(masked, -1));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(masked, 0));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(source, -1), "source packet model must remain unchanged");
    }

    @Test
    void airBelowZeroBecomesFakeWhenHideAirIsEnabled() {
        Column source = column(-16, 2);

        Column masked = rewrite(source, 0, true).column();

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(masked, -1));
        assertEquals(AIR, block(masked, 0));
    }

    @Test
    void blocksAtOrAboveCutoffRemainUnchanged() {
        Column source = column(-16, 2);
        set(source, 0, STONE);
        set(source, 1, AIR);

        Column masked = rewrite(source, 0, true).column();

        assertEquals(STONE, block(masked, 0));
        assertEquals(AIR, block(masked, 1));
    }

    @Test
    void fullHiddenSectionUsesAUniformFakePalette() {
        Column source = column(-16, 1);
        set(source, -3, STONE);

        var result = rewrite(source, 0, true);
        Chunk_v1_18 section = (Chunk_v1_18) result.column().getChunks()[0];

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, section.getBlockId(0, 0, 0));
        assertEquals(4096, section.getBlockCount());
        assertEquals(4096, result.rewrittenBlocks());
        assertNotSame(source.getChunks()[0], section);
    }

    @Test
    void crossingSectionRewritesOnlyTheConcealedHalf() {
        Column source = column(-16, 1);
        set(source, -9, STONE);
        set(source, -8, STONE);
        assertEquals(STONE, block(source, -9));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(source, -8));
        assertEquals(AIR, block(source, -10));

        Column masked = rewrite(source, -8, true).column();

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(masked, -9));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(masked, -8));
        assertEquals(2049, ((Chunk_v1_18) masked.getChunks()[0]).getBlockCount());
    }

    @Test
    void caveAirIsCountedAsAirWhenASectionIsPartiallyRewritten() {
        Column source = column(-16, 1);
        set(source, -9, CAVE_AIR);
        assertEquals(0, ((Chunk_v1_18) source.getChunks()[0]).getBlockCount());

        Column masked = rewrite(source, -8, true).column();

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(masked, -9));
        assertEquals(2048, ((Chunk_v1_18) masked.getChunks()[0]).getBlockCount());
    }

    @Test
    void hideAirFalsePreservesAirAndDoesNotMutateOtherViewersColumn() {
        Column sharedInput = column(-16, 1);
        set(sharedInput, -1, STONE);
        set(sharedInput, -2, AIR);

        Column viewerA = rewrite(sharedInput, 0, false).column();
        Column viewerB = rewrite(sharedInput, -16, true).column();

        assertEquals(DEEPSLATE, block(viewerA, -1));
        assertEquals(AIR, block(viewerA, -2));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(viewerB, -1));
        assertEquals(STONE, block(sharedInput, -1));
        assertNotSame(viewerA.getChunks()[0], sharedInput.getChunks()[0]);
    }

    @Test
    void malformedChunkIsRejectedRatherThanReturnedAsOriginal() {
        Column malformed = new Column(0, 0, true, new BaseChunk[0], new
                com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[0]);
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> rewrite(malformed, 0, true));
    }

    @Test
    void airMaskClampsHeightmapsToTheSyntheticSurfaceWithoutMutatingTheSource() {
        Column source = column(-16, 2);
        long[] heightmap = packedHeightmap(6, 2, 20);
        source.getHeightMaps().setTag("WORLD_SURFACE", new NBTLongArray(heightmap));

        Column masked = rewrite(source, 0, true).column();
        long[] maskedHeightmap = masked.getHeightMaps()
                .getTagOfTypeOrThrow("WORLD_SURFACE", NBTLongArray.class).getValue();

        assertEquals(16, heightValue(maskedHeightmap, 0, 6));
        assertEquals(20, heightValue(maskedHeightmap, 1, 6), "visible heights above the cutoff stay intact");
        assertEquals(2, heightValue(source.getHeightMaps()
                        .getTagOfTypeOrThrow("WORLD_SURFACE", NBTLongArray.class).getValue(), 0, 6),
                "the real input heightmap must remain unchanged");
    }

    @Test
    void airMaskRejectsMissingHeightmapsInsteadOfPublishingAnIncompleteChunk() {
        Column source = new Column(0, 0, true, column(-16, 2).getChunks(),
                new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[0]);

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> rewrite(source, 0, true));
    }

    private static long[] packedHeightmap(int bits, int first, int second) {
        int perLong = Long.SIZE / bits;
        long[] packed = new long[(256 + perLong - 1) / perLong];
        putHeight(packed, 0, bits, first);
        putHeight(packed, 1, bits, second);
        return packed;
    }

    private static void putHeight(long[] packed, int index, int bits, int value) {
        int perLong = Long.SIZE / bits;
        int shift = index % perLong * bits;
        packed[index / perLong] |= (long) value << shift;
    }

    private static int heightValue(long[] packed, int index, int bits) {
        int perLong = Long.SIZE / bits;
        int shift = index % perLong * bits;
        long mask = (1L << bits) - 1;
        return (int) (packed[index / perLong] >>> shift & mask);
    }

    private static TerrainChunkRewriter.Result rewrite(Column source, int cutoff, boolean hideAir) {
        return TerrainChunkRewriter.rewrite(source, -16, cutoff, DEEPSLATE, AIR_STATES,
                hideAir, true, VERSION);
    }

    private static Column column(int minY, int sectionCount) {
        BaseChunk[] sections = new BaseChunk[sectionCount];
        for (int index = 0; index < sectionCount; index++) {
            Chunk_v1_18 section = new Chunk_v1_18(VERSION, 0,
                    com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.DataPalette.createForChunk(),
                    com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.palette.DataPalette.createForBiome());
            for (int y = 0; y < 16; y++) {
                for (int z = 0; z < 16; z++) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < 16; x++) section.getChunkData().set(x, y, z, AIR);
                }
            }
            section.setBlockCount(0);
            sections[index] = section;
        }
        Column column = new Column(0, 0, true, sections,
                new com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.TileEntity[0], java.util.Map.of());
        addHeightmap(column, sectionCount);
        return column;
    }

    private static void addHeightmap(Column column, int sectionCount) {
        int worldHeight = sectionCount * 16;
        int bits = 32 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(worldHeight);
        int perLong = Long.SIZE / bits;
        int length = (256 + perLong - 1) / perLong;
        column.getHeightMaps().setTag("WORLD_SURFACE", new NBTLongArray(new long[length]));
    }

    private static void set(Column column, int worldY, int stateId) {
        int sectionIndex = (worldY + 16) >> 4;
        int localY = worldY & 15;
        Chunk_v1_18 section = (Chunk_v1_18) column.getChunks()[sectionIndex];
        int old = section.getBlockId(0, localY, 0);
        section.getChunkData().set(0, localY, 0, stateId);
        boolean oldAir = AIR_STATES.contains(old);
        boolean newAir = AIR_STATES.contains(stateId);
        if (oldAir && !newAir) section.setBlockCount(section.getBlockCount() + 1);
        if (!oldAir && newAir) section.setBlockCount(section.getBlockCount() - 1);
    }

    private static int block(Column column, int worldY) {
        int sectionIndex = (worldY + 16) >> 4;
        int localY = worldY & 15;
        return column.getChunks()[sectionIndex].getBlockId(0, localY, 0);
    }

}
```

```java
class TerrainEntityVisionTest {
    @Test
    void trackAttemptHidesFromMaskedViewerButLeavesRevealedViewerAlone() throws Exception {
        Fixture fix = new Fixture();
        FakeEntity stand = fix.entity("world", -8, true);
        PlayerTrackEntityEvent attempt =
                new PlayerTrackEntityEvent(fix.viewerA.player, stand.entity);

        fix.vision.onTrackAttempt(attempt);

        assertTrue(attempt.isCancelled(), "the spawn must never reach a masked viewer");
        assertTrue(fix.callsTo("hide", fix.viewerA.id, stand.id) == 1);
        assertTrue(fix.noCallsFor(fix.viewerB.id), "revealed viewer tracking stays natural");
        assertEquals(1, fix.service.diagnostics().entitiesHidden());
    }

    @Test
```
