```java
    private static final class Fixture {
        final FakeScheduler scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
        final TerrainMaskService service;
        final TerrainEntityVision vision;
        final Map<UUID, FakeViewer> viewers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        final Map<UUID, FakeEntity> entities = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        final Map<UUID, Player> online = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        final Map<String, UUID> worldIds = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        FakeViewer viewerA;
        FakeViewer viewerB;

        Fixture() throws Exception {
            String yaml = """
                    terrain-mask:
                      enabled: true
                      worlds:
                        world:
                          enabled: true
                          hide-below-y: 0
                          mask-when-player-above-y: 5
                          fake-block: DEEPSLATE
                          hide-air: true
                          hide-block-entities: true
                          hide-underground-entities: true
                        far:
                          enabled: true
                          hide-below-y: 0
                          mask-when-player-above-y: 5
                          fake-block: DEEPSLATE
                          hide-air: true
                          hide-block-entities: true
                          hide-underground-entities: true
                      refresh:
                        max-chunks-per-player-per-tick: 4
                        max-pending-chunks-per-player: 8
                        max-cached-chunks-per-player: 8
                      bedrock:
                        enabled: false
                    """;
            Plugin plugin = proxy(Plugin.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "isEnabled" -> true;
                case "getName" -> "VAntiCheat";
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
            service = new TerrainMaskService(plugin, scheduler, TerrainMaskConfig.parse(yaml), null,
                    Logger.getLogger("TerrainEntityVisionTest"));
            vision = new TerrainEntityVision(plugin, scheduler, service,
                    Logger.getLogger("TerrainEntityVisionTest"),
                    id -> viewers.containsKey(id) ? viewers.get(id).player : null,
                    () -> List.copyOf(online.values()));
            service.setEntityVision(vision);
            service.installGateway(new FakeMaskGateway(), true, "test gateway");
            viewerA = joinViewer("world", 6);
            viewerB = joinViewer("world", -8);
        }

        FakeViewer joinViewer(String worldName, double y) {
            FakeViewer viewer = new FakeViewer(worldName, y, uidFor(worldName));
            viewers.put(viewer.id, viewer);
            online.put(viewer.id, viewer.player);
            service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(viewer.player, Component.empty()));
            service.packetUser(viewer.id, "user");
            validate();
            return viewer;
        }

        void validate() {
            scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
            scheduler.runNextEntity();
            scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
            scheduler.runNextEntity();
            drainEntities();
        }

        void quit(FakeViewer viewer) {
            service.onQuit(new PlayerQuitEvent(viewer.player, Component.empty(),
                    PlayerQuitEvent.QuitReason.DISCONNECTED));
            viewers.remove(viewer.id);
            online.remove(viewer.id);
        }

        void rejoin(FakeViewer viewer, double y) {
            viewer.settleAt(y);
            viewers.put(viewer.id, viewer);
            online.put(viewer.id, viewer.player);
            service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(viewer.player, Component.empty()));
        }

        void moveViewer(FakeViewer viewer, double y) {
            Location from = viewer.at(viewer.lastY);
            viewer.settleAt(y);
            service.onMove(new org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerMoveEvent(
                    viewer.player, from, viewer.at(y)));
            viewer.lastY = y;
        }

        void moveViewerTo(FakeViewer viewer, String worldName, double y) {
            World target = worldProxy(worldName);
            viewer.settleAt(new Location(target, 0, y, 0));
            service.onWorldChange(new PlayerChangedWorldEvent(viewer.player, viewer.world));
            viewer.lastY = y;
        }

        void placeNearby(FakeEntity entity, double x, double y) {
            entity.placeAt(x, y, 0);
            for (FakeViewer viewer : viewers.values()) viewer.nearby.add(entity.entity);
        }

        void sweep(FakeViewer viewer) {
            vision.onViewerTransition(viewer.player, service.view(viewer.id));
        }

        void drainEntities() {
            for (int i = 0; i < 10000 && !scheduler.entityTasks.isEmpty(); i++) {
                scheduler.runNextEntity();
            }
        }

        int scheduledEntityTasks() {
            return scheduler.entityTasks.size();
        }

        int callsTo(String method, UUID viewerId, UUID subjectId) {
            FakeViewer viewer = viewers.get(viewerId);
            if (viewer == null) return 0;
            int count = 0;
            for (String call : viewer.calls) {
                if (call.equals(method + ":" + viewerId + ":" + subjectId)) count++;
            }
            return count;
        }

        boolean noCallsFor(UUID viewerId) {
            FakeViewer viewer = viewers.get(viewerId);
            return viewer == null || viewer.calls.isEmpty();
        }

        FakeEntity entity(String worldName, double y, boolean visibleByDefault) {
            FakeEntity entity = new FakeEntity(worldName, uidFor(worldName), y, visibleByDefault, false);
            entities.put(entity.id, entity);
            return entity;
        }

        FakeEntity vehicle(String worldName, double y, boolean visibleByDefault) {
            FakeEntity entity = new FakeEntity(worldName, uidFor(worldName), y, visibleByDefault, true);
            entities.put(entity.id, entity);
            return entity;
        }

        UUID uidFor(String worldName) {
            return worldIds.computeIfAbsent(worldName, ignored -> UUID.randomUUID());
        }

        World worldProxy(String worldName) {
            UUID worldId = uidFor(worldName);
            return proxy(World.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "getUID" -> worldId;
                case "getName" -> worldName;
                case "getMinHeight" -> -64;
                case "getMaxHeight" -> 320;
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
        }
    }

    private static final class FakeMaskGateway implements TerrainMaskPacketGateway {
        @Override
        public boolean sendCachedChunk(Object packetUser, Object cachedChunk,
                                       TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
            return true;
        }
    }

    private static final class FakeScheduler implements Scheduler {
        final Queue<Runnable> entityTasks = new ArrayDeque<>();
        final Queue<Runnable> delayedGlobalTasks = new ArrayDeque<>();
        final List<EntityTarget> entityTargets = new ArrayList<>();

        @Override
        public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task) {
            entityTargets.add(target);
            entityTasks.add(task);
            return new NoopTaskHandle();
        }

        @Override
        public TaskHandle runAtLocation(RegionTarget target, Runnable task) { return new NoopTaskHandle(); }
        @Override
        public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) { return new NoopTaskHandle(); }
        @Override
        public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) {
            delayedGlobalTasks.add(task);
            return new NoopTaskHandle();
        }
        @Override
        public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) { return new NoopTaskHandle(); }
        @Override
        public void shutdown() { entityTasks.clear(); }

        void runNextDelayedGlobal() {
            Runnable task = delayedGlobalTasks.poll();
            if (task == null) throw new AssertionError("expected scheduled delayed task");
            task.run();
        }

        void runNextEntity() {
            Runnable task = entityTasks.poll();
            if (task == null) throw new AssertionError("expected scheduled entity task");
            task.run();
        }
    }

    private static final class NoopTaskHandle implements TaskHandle {
        @Override public void cancel() { }
        @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
    }

    private static final class FakeViewer {
        final UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        final World world;
        final AtomicReference<Location> location;
        final Player player;
        final List<Entity> nearby = new ArrayList<>();
        final List<String> calls = new ArrayList<>();
        final Map<UUID, Boolean> visibility = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
        double lastY;

        FakeViewer(String worldName, double initialY, UUID worldId) {
            lastY = initialY;
            world = proxy(World.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "getUID" -> worldId;
                case "getName" -> worldName;
                case "getMinHeight" -> -64;
                case "getMaxHeight" -> 320;
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
            location = new AtomicReference<>(at(initialY));
            player = proxy(Player.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "getUniqueId" -> id;
                case "getLocation" -> location.get();
                case "getWorld" -> world;
                case "hasPermission" -> false;
                case "getNearbyEntities" -> List.copyOf(nearby);
                case "hideEntity" -> {
                    Entity subject = (Entity) args[1];
                    calls.add("hide:" + id + ":" + subject.getUniqueId());
                    visibility.put(subject.getUniqueId(), false);
                    yield null;
                }
                case "showEntity" -> {
                    Entity subject = (Entity) args[1];
                    calls.add("show:" + id + ":" + subject.getUniqueId());
                    visibility.put(subject.getUniqueId(), true);
                    yield null;
                }
                case "canSee" -> {
                    Entity subject = (Entity) args[0];
                    yield visibility.getOrDefault(subject.getUniqueId(), true);
                }
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
        }

        Location at(double y) { return new Location(world, 0, y, 0); }

        void settleAt(double y) { location.set(at(y)); }

        void settleAt(Location location) { this.location.set(location); }
    }

    private static final class FakeEntity {
        final UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        final World world;
        final AtomicReference<Location> location;
        final AtomicReference<Boolean> alive = new AtomicReference<>(true);
        final boolean visibleByDefault;
        final Entity entity;
        private final boolean vehicle;

        FakeEntity(String worldName, UUID worldId, double y, boolean visibleByDefault, boolean vehicle) {
            this.visibleByDefault = visibleByDefault;
            this.vehicle = vehicle;
            world = proxy(World.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "getUID" -> worldId;
                case "getName" -> worldName;
                case "getMinHeight" -> -64;
                case "getMaxHeight" -> 320;
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
            location = new AtomicReference<>(new Location(world, 9.5, y, 9.5));
            Class<?>[] faces = vehicle
                    ? new Class<?>[]{Vehicle.class, Entity.class}
                    : new Class<?>[]{LivingEntity.class, Entity.class};
            entity = (Entity) Proxy.newProxyInstance(getClass().getClassLoader(), faces,
                    (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                        case "getUniqueId" -> id;
                        case "isValid" -> alive.get();
                        case "isVisibleByDefault" -> visibleByDefault;
                        case "getWorld" -> world;
                        case "getLocation" -> location.get();
                        default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
                    });
        }

        LivingEntity living() { return (LivingEntity) entity; }

        Vehicle vehicle() { return (Vehicle) entity; }

        Location at(double y) { return new Location(world, 9.5, y, 9.5); }

        void placeAt(double x, double y, double z) { location.set(new Location(world, x, y, z)); }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static <T> T proxy(Class<T> type, java.lang.reflect.InvocationHandler handler) {
        return (T) Proxy.newProxyInstance(type.getClassLoader(), new Class<?>[]{type}, handler);
    }

    private static Object defaultValue(Class<?> type) {
        if (!type.isPrimitive() || type == void.class) return null;
        if (type == boolean.class) return false;
        if (type == char.class) return '\0';
        if (type == byte.class) return (byte) 0;
        if (type == short.class) return (short) 0;
        if (type == int.class) return 0;
        if (type == long.class) return 0L;
        if (type == float.class) return 0F;
        if (type == double.class) return 0D;
        return null;
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainLightSanitizerTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.protocol.world.chunk.LightData;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import java.util.BitSet;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class TerrainLightSanitizerTest {
    @Test
    void fullyConcealedLightSectionsBecomeExplicitlyEmpty() {
        LightData source = data(bitSet(1, 2), bitSet(2), lightArray((byte) 0xFF, (byte) 0xFF));

        LightData masked = TerrainLightSanitizer.sanitize(source, -16, 0);

        assertFalse(masked.getBlockLightMask().get(1));
        assertTrue(masked.getEmptyBlockLightMask().get(1));
        assertTrue(masked.getBlockLightMask().get(2));
        assertEquals(1, masked.getBlockLightCount());
        assertEquals(0xFF, masked.getBlockLightArray()[0][0] & 0xFF);
        assertTrue(source.getBlockLightMask().get(1), "input masks must remain unchanged");
        assertEquals(2, source.getBlockLightCount());
    }

    @Test
    void crossingLightSectionHasOnlyConcealedHalfZeroed() {
        LightData source = data(bitSet(1), new BitSet(), lightArray((byte) 0xFF));

        LightData masked = TerrainLightSanitizer.sanitize(source, -16, -8);
        byte[] bytes = masked.getBlockLightArray()[0];

        // Section block ordering is Y-major in the packet palette; the lowest eight
        // layers are zero, and the visible upper half retains its original 0xF nibbles.
        assertEquals(0, nibble(bytes, 0, 0, 0));
        assertEquals(0, nibble(bytes, 7, 15, 15));
        assertEquals(15, nibble(bytes, 8, 0, 0));
        assertEquals(15, nibble(bytes, 15, 15, 15));
        assertTrue(masked.getBlockLightMask().get(1));
        assertEquals(1, masked.getBlockLightCount());
    }

    @Test
    void malformedLightArraysFailRatherThanPassThrough() {
        LightData malformed = data(bitSet(1), new BitSet(), new byte[][]{new byte[4]});
        org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainLightSanitizer.sanitize(malformed, -16, 0));
    }

    private static LightData data(BitSet blockMask, BitSet emptyMask, byte[][] blockArrays) {
        return new LightData(true, blockMask, new BitSet(), emptyMask, new BitSet(),
                0, blockArrays.length, new byte[0][], blockArrays);
    }

    private static byte[][] lightArray(byte... firstBytes) {
        byte[][] sections = new byte[firstBytes.length][2048];
        for (int index = 0; index < firstBytes.length; index++) {
            java.util.Arrays.fill(sections[index], firstBytes[index]);
        }
        return sections;
    }

    private static BitSet bitSet(int... bits) {
        BitSet result = new BitSet();
        for (int bit : bits) result.set(bit);
        return result;
    }

    private static int nibble(byte[] bytes, int y, int z, int x) {
        int index = (y << 8) | (z << 4) | x;
        int packed = bytes[index >>> 1] & 0xFF;
        return (index & 1) == 0 ? packed & 0xF : (packed >>> 4) & 0xF;
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/terrainmask/TerrainMaskConfigTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.terrainmask;

import org.bukkit.configuration.InvalidConfigurationException;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class TerrainMaskConfigTest {
    private static final String VALID = """
            terrain-mask:
              enabled: true
              worlds:
                survival:
                  enabled: true
                  hide-below-y: 0
                  mask-when-player-above-y: 5
                  fake-block: DEEPSLATE
                  hide-air: true
                  hide-block-entities: true
                  hide-underground-entities: true
              refresh:
                max-chunks-per-player-per-tick: 4
                max-pending-chunks-per-player: 512
                max-cached-chunks-per-player: 512
              bedrock:
                enabled: false
            """;

    @Test
    void defaultsAreParsedAndImmutable() throws Exception {
        TerrainMaskConfig config = TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID);
        assertTrue(config.enabled());
        assertEquals(0, config.worlds().get("survival").hideBelowY());
        assertEquals(5, config.worlds().get("survival").maskWhenPlayerAboveY());
        assertEquals("DEEPSLATE", config.worlds().get("survival").fakeBlock().name());
        assertTrue(config.worlds().get("survival").hideAir());
        assertEquals(4, config.maxChunksPerPlayerPerTick());
        assertEquals(512, config.maxCachedChunksPerPlayer());
        assertFalse(config.bedrockEnabled());
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException.class, () -> config.worlds().clear());
    }

    @Test
    void invalidMaterialIsRejectedClearly() {
        IllegalArgumentException error = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("DEEPSLATE", "NOT_A_BLOCK")));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("fake-block"));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("NOT_A_BLOCK"));
    }

    @Test
    void invalidCutoffRangeAndRefreshLimitsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("hide-below-y: 0", "hide-below-y: 4096")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("mask-when-player-above-y: 5",
                        "mask-when-player-above-y: -1")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("max-chunks-per-player-per-tick: 4",
                        "max-chunks-per-player-per-tick: 0")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("max-cached-chunks-per-player: 512",
                        "max-cached-chunks-per-player: 8193")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("max-pending-chunks-per-player: 512",
                        "max-pending-chunks-per-player: 4")));
    }

    @Test
    void malformedOrUnsupportedKeysAreRejectedInsteadOfIgnored() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("hide-air: true", "hide-air: maybe")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse(VALID.replace("enabled: true\n  worlds:",
                        "enabled: true\n  ignored: true\n  worlds:")));
    }

    @Test
    void yamlSyntaxErrorsAreSurfaced() {
        assertThrows(InvalidConfigurationException.class,
                () -> TerrainMaskConfig.parse("terrain-mask: [unclosed"));
    }
}
```

```java
    @Test
    void teleportAcrossThresholdRefreshesOnlyThatViewer() throws Exception {

        TerrainMaskService service = service(scheduler, 4, 4, 4);
        FakeGateway gateway = new FakeGateway();
        service.installGateway(gateway, true, "test gateway");

    @Test

    @Test
    void joinIsProvisionallyMaskedUntilPositionResolves() throws Exception {
        FakeScheduler scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
        TerrainMaskService service = service(scheduler, 4, 2, 2);
        FakeGateway gateway = new FakeGateway();
        service.installGateway(gateway, true, "test gateway");
        FakePlayer player = new FakePlayer("world", 0);
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(player.player, Component.empty()));

        assertTrue(service.view(player.id).masked(),
                "an unvalidated join must fail closed even below the threshold");
        assertEquals(2, scheduler.delayedGlobalTasks(), "join schedules a bounded number of resync checks");
        assertEquals(0, gateway.sent.size(), "no refresh exists before validation");

        service.packetUser(player.id, "user");
        service.cacheChunk(player.id, 7, new Object());
        player.settleAt(-8);
        scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
        scheduler.runNext();

        assertFalse(service.view(player.id).masked(),
                "a settled underground position releases the provisional mask");
        assertEquals(1, service.diagnostics().pendingRefreshChunks());
        scheduler.runNext();
        assertEquals(1, gateway.sent.size());
        assertFalse(gateway.sent.getFirst().view().masked());

        scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
        scheduler.runNext();
        assertFalse(service.view(player.id).masked());
        assertEquals(1, gateway.sent.size(), "the settled resync must not replay twice");
        assertEquals(0, service.diagnostics().pendingRefreshChunks());
    }

    @Test

    @Test
    void joinResyncAbortsAfterQuitAndReconnect() throws Exception {
        FakeScheduler scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
        TerrainMaskService service = service(scheduler, 4, 2, 2);
        FakePlayer player = new FakePlayer("world", 0);
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(player.player, Component.empty()));

    @Test
    void cachedChunksAreIsolatedAndBoundedPerConnection() throws Exception {
        FakeScheduler scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
        TerrainMaskService service = service(scheduler, 1, 2, 2);
        FakePlayer first = new FakePlayer("world", 6);
        FakePlayer second = new FakePlayer("world", 6);
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(first.player, Component.empty()));
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(second.player, Component.empty()));

        Object firstPayload = new Object();
        Object secondPayload = new Object();
        assertTrue(service.cacheChunkIfAvailable(first.id, 10, firstPayload));
        assertTrue(service.cacheChunkIfAvailable(second.id, 10, secondPayload));

        assertSame(firstPayload, service.cachedChunk(first.id, 10));
        assertSame(secondPayload, service.cachedChunk(second.id, 10));
        assertNotSame(service.connection(first.id), service.connection(second.id));

        assertTrue(service.cacheChunkIfAvailable(first.id, 11, new Object()));
        assertEquals(3, service.diagnostics().cachedChunks());
        assertFalse(service.cacheChunkIfAvailable(first.id, 12, new Object()),
                "an uncached real chunk must be rejected rather than evicting a loaded snapshot");
        assertEquals(3, service.diagnostics().cachedChunks(), "per-player cache limit must be strict");
        assertEquals(1, service.diagnostics().playersWithIncompleteRefresh());
        assertNull(service.cachedChunk(first.id, 12));

    @Test
    void thresholdTransitionRefreshesOnlyBoundedBatchesForThatViewer() throws Exception {
        FakeScheduler scheduler = new FakeScheduler();
        TerrainMaskService service = service(scheduler, 1, 3, 3);
        FakeGateway gateway = new FakeGateway();
        service.installGateway(gateway, true, "test gateway");
        FakePlayer first = new FakePlayer("world", 5);
        FakePlayer second = new FakePlayer("world", 5);
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(first.player, Component.empty()));
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(second.player, Component.empty()));
        service.packetUser(first.id, "first-user");
        service.packetUser(second.id, "second-user");
        service.cacheChunk(first.id, 1, new Object());
        service.cacheChunk(first.id, 2, new Object());
        service.cacheChunk(first.id, 3, new Object());
        service.cacheChunk(second.id, 1, new Object());
        assertTrue(service.view(first.id).masked(), "fresh joins start provisional-masked");
        assertTrue(service.view(second.id).masked(), "fresh joins start provisional-masked");

        // Settled-position validation releases both viewers to real terrain first,
        // with per-viewer replay and no cross-talk.
        scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
        scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
        scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
        scheduler.runNextDelayedGlobal();
        scheduler.runNext();
        scheduler.runNext();
        scheduler.runNext();
        scheduler.runNext();
        assertFalse(service.view(first.id).masked());
        assertFalse(service.view(second.id).masked());
        assertEquals(4, service.diagnostics().pendingRefreshChunks());
        scheduler.runNext();
        scheduler.runNext();
        scheduler.runNext();
        scheduler.runNext();
        assertEquals(4, gateway.sent.size());
        assertEquals(0, service.diagnostics().pendingRefreshChunks());
        assertEquals(4, service.diagnostics().refreshedChunks());
        assertTrue(gateway.sent.stream().filter(send -> "first-user".equals(send.packetUser()))
                .allMatch(send -> !send.view().masked()));
        assertTrue(gateway.sent.stream().filter(send -> "second-user".equals(send.packetUser()))
                .allMatch(send -> !send.view().masked()));

        service.onMove(new PlayerMoveEvent(first.player, first.at(5), first.at(6)));
        scheduler.runNext();

        assertTrue(service.view(first.id).masked());
        assertFalse(service.view(second.id).masked());
        assertEquals(2, service.diagnostics().pendingRefreshChunks(),
                "all cached chunks remain queued while each pump handles only one");
        assertEquals(5, gateway.sent.size());
        assertEquals("first-user", gateway.sent.getLast().packetUser());
        assertTrue(gateway.sent.getLast().view().masked());
        assertEquals(0, service.diagnostics().playersWithIncompleteRefresh());

        scheduler.runNext();
        assertEquals(6, gateway.sent.size());
        scheduler.runNext();
        assertEquals(7, gateway.sent.size());
        assertTrue(gateway.sent.stream().filter(send -> "first-user".equals(send.packetUser())).count() == 6);
        assertTrue(gateway.sent.stream().filter(send -> "second-user".equals(send.packetUser())).count() == 1);
        assertTrue(gateway.sent.stream().filter(send -> "first-user".equals(send.packetUser()))
                .filter(send -> send.view().masked()).count() == 3);
        assertEquals(0, service.diagnostics().pendingRefreshChunks());
        assertEquals(7, service.diagnostics().refreshedChunks());
    }

    @Test
    void quitAndReconnectReplaceTheConnectionAndDiscardItsSnapshot() throws Exception {
        TerrainMaskService service = service(new FakeScheduler(), 1, 2, 2);
        FakePlayer player = new FakePlayer("world", 6);
        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(player.player, Component.empty()));

        service.onQuit(new PlayerQuitEvent(player.player, Component.empty(),
                PlayerQuitEvent.QuitReason.DISCONNECTED));
        assertNull(service.view(player.id));
        assertEquals(0, service.diagnostics().cachedChunks());

        service.onJoin(new PlayerJoinEvent(player.player, Component.empty()));
        assertNotEquals(oldToken, service.view(player.id).connectionToken());
        assertNull(service.cachedChunk(player.id, 1));
    }

    private static TerrainMaskService service(FakeScheduler scheduler, int perTick,
                                              int cacheLimit, int pendingLimit) throws Exception {
        return service(scheduler, perTick, cacheLimit, pendingLimit, null);
    }

    private static TerrainMaskService service(FakeScheduler scheduler, int perTick,
                                              int cacheLimit, int pendingLimit,
                                              ClientPlatformService platforms) throws Exception {
        String yaml = """
                terrain-mask:
                  enabled: true
                  worlds:
                    world:
                      enabled: true
                      hide-below-y: 0
                      mask-when-player-above-y: 5
                      fake-block: DEEPSLATE
                      hide-air: true
                      hide-block-entities: true
                      hide-underground-entities: true
                  refresh:
                    max-chunks-per-player-per-tick: %d
                    max-pending-chunks-per-player: %d
                    max-cached-chunks-per-player: %d
                  bedrock:
                    enabled: false
                """.formatted(perTick, pendingLimit, cacheLimit);
        Plugin plugin = proxy(Plugin.class, (object, method, args) -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType()));
        return new TerrainMaskService(plugin, scheduler, TerrainMaskConfig.parse(yaml), platforms,
                Logger.getLogger("TerrainMaskServiceTest"));
    }

    private static ClientPlatformService.Provider provider(String name, boolean installed, boolean ready) {
        return new ClientPlatformService.Provider() {
            @Override public String name() { return name; }
            @Override public boolean installed() { return installed; }
            @Override public boolean ready() { return ready; }
            @Override public Boolean isBedrock(UUID playerId) { return null; }
        };
    }

    private static final class FakeGateway implements TerrainMaskPacketGateway {
        private final java.util.List<Send> sent = new java.util.ArrayList<>();

        @Override
        public boolean sendCachedChunk(Object packetUser, Object cachedChunk,
                                       TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) {
            sent.add(new Send(packetUser, cachedChunk, view));
            return true;
        }
    }

    private record Send(Object packetUser, Object payload, TerrainMaskService.PlayerView view) { }

    private static final class FakeScheduler implements Scheduler {
        private final Queue<Runnable> entityTasks = new ArrayDeque<>();
        private final Queue<Runnable> delayedGlobalTasks = new ArrayDeque<>();

        @Override
        public TaskHandle runAtEntity(EntityTarget target, Runnable task) {
            entityTasks.add(task);
            return new NoopTaskHandle();
        }

        @Override
        public TaskHandle runAtLocation(RegionTarget target, Runnable task) { return new NoopTaskHandle(); }
        @Override
        public TaskHandle runGlobal(Runnable task) { return new NoopTaskHandle(); }
        @Override
        public TaskHandle runGlobalLater(Runnable task, long delayTicks) {
            delayedGlobalTasks.add(task);
            return new NoopTaskHandle();
        }
        @Override
        public TaskHandle runAsync(Runnable task) { return new NoopTaskHandle(); }
        @Override
        public void shutdown() { entityTasks.clear(); }

        private void runNext() {
            Runnable task = entityTasks.poll();
            if (task == null) throw new AssertionError("expected scheduled entity task");
            task.run();
        }

        private void runNextDelayedGlobal() {
            Runnable task = delayedGlobalTasks.poll();
            if (task == null) throw new AssertionError("expected scheduled delayed task");
            task.run();
        }

        private int delayedGlobalTasks() {
            return delayedGlobalTasks.size();
        }
    }

    private static final class NoopTaskHandle implements TaskHandle {
        @Override public void cancel() { }
        @Override public boolean cancelled() { return false; }
    }

    private static final class FakePlayer {
        private final UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        private final World world;
        private final AtomicReference<Location> location;
        private final Player player;

        private FakePlayer(String worldName, double initialY) {
            UUID worldId = UUID.randomUUID();
            world = proxy(World.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "getUID" -> worldId;
                case "getName" -> worldName;
                case "getMinHeight" -> -16;
                case "getMaxHeight" -> 32;
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
            location = new AtomicReference<>(at(initialY));
            player = proxy(Player.class, (object, method, args) -> switch (method.getName()) {
                case "getUniqueId" -> id;
                case "getLocation" -> location.get();
                case "hasPermission" -> false;
                default -> defaultValue(method.getReturnType());
            });
        }

        private Location at(double y) { return new Location(world, 0, y, 0); }

        private void settleAt(double y) { location.set(at(y)); }
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static <T> T proxy(Class<T> type, java.lang.reflect.InvocationHandler handler) {
        return (T) Proxy.newProxyInstance(type.getClassLoader(), new Class<?>[]{type}, handler);
    }

    private static Object defaultValue(Class<?> type) {
        if (!type.isPrimitive() || type == void.class) return null;
        if (type == boolean.class) return false;
        if (type == char.class) return '\0';
        if (type == byte.class) return (byte) 0;
        if (type == short.class) return (short) 0;
        if (type == int.class) return 0;
        if (type == long.class) return 0L;
        if (type == float.class) return 0F;
        if (type == double.class) return 0D;
        return null;
    }
}
```

`src/test/java/site/vackstudio/vanticheat/trusted/PersistentTrustedPlayerServiceTest.java`:

```java
package site.vackstudio.vanticheat.trusted;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;

class PersistentTrustedPlayerServiceTest {
    @TempDir Path temporaryDirectory;

    @Test
    void addDuplicateNameChangeSaveAndReloadUseUuidAuthority() {
        Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("data/trusted-players.yml");
        UUID id = UUID.randomUUID();
        PersistentTrustedPlayerService service = service(file);

        assertTrue(service.add(id, "FirstName"));
        assertFalse(service.add(id, "Renamed"));
        service.save();

        PersistentTrustedPlayerService reloaded = service(file);
        reloaded.load();
        assertTrue(reloaded.isTrusted(id));
        assertEquals("Renamed", reloaded.list().getFirst().name());
        assertEquals(1, reloaded.list().size());
    }

    @Test
    void removeAndMalformedEntriesAreSafe() throws Exception {
        Path file = temporaryDirectory.resolve("trusted-players.yml");
        UUID valid = UUID.randomUUID();
        Files.writeString(file, """
                trusted-players:
                  not-a-uuid:
                    name: Bad
                  %s:
                    name: Good
                    added-at: %s
                  %s:
                    name: LastName
                """.formatted(valid, Instant.EPOCH, valid));

        PersistentTrustedPlayerService service = service(file);
        service.load();
        assertTrue(service.isTrusted(valid));
        assertEquals("LastName", service.list().getFirst().name());
        assertTrue(service.remove(valid));
        assertFalse(service.remove(valid));
        assertTrue(service.list().isEmpty());
    }

    private PersistentTrustedPlayerService service(Path file) {
        return new PersistentTrustedPlayerService(file, Logger.getAnonymousLogger());
    }
}
```
